en.t: A powerful earthquake destroys large portions of the Walls of Constantinople, including 57 towers
en.s: The walls of Constantinople (Turkish: Konstantinopolis Surları; Greek: Τείχη της Κωνσταντινούπολης) are a series of defensive stone walls that have surrounded and protected the city of Constantinople (modern Fatih district of Istanbul) since its founding as the new capital of the Roman Empire by Constantine the Great. With numerous additions and modifications during their history, they were the last great fortification system of antiquity, and one of the most complex and elaborate systems ever built.

zh.t: 强烈地震摧毁君士坦丁堡城墙的大部分，包括57座塔楼
zh.s: 君士坦丁堡城墙（土耳其语：Konstantinopolis Surları；希腊语：Τείχη της Κωνσταντινούπολης）是一系列环绕并守护君士坦丁堡的石制防御墙。君士坦丁堡如今属于伊斯坦布尔法提赫区，自君士坦丁大帝将其建为罗马帝国新首都以来，城墙便一直守护着这座城市。历经多次增建和改造，它们是古代最后一套大型防御工事，也是有史以来最复杂、最精巧的防御体系之一。

en.t: The Charter of the Forest is sealed at St Paul's Cathedral, London by King Henry III, acting under the regency of William Marshall, 1st Earl of Pembroke which re-establishes for free men rights of access to the royal forest that had been eroded by William the Conqueror and his heirs
en.s: The Charter of the Forest of 1217 re-established rights of access for free men to the royal forest that had been eroded by King William the Conqueror and his heirs. Many of its provisions were in force for centuries afterwards. It was originally sealed in England by the young King Henry III, acting under the regency of William Marshal, 1st Earl of Pembroke.

zh.t: 亨利三世在威廉·马歇尔摄政期间于伦敦圣保罗大教堂加盖《森林宪章》印玺，恢复自由民进入皇家森林的权利
zh.s: 1217年《森林宪章》恢复了自由民进入皇家森林的权利；这些权利此前曾被征服者威廉及其继承者逐步削弱。宪章中的许多条款此后数百年仍然有效。它最初由年幼的国王亨利三世在彭布罗克伯爵、摄政威廉·马歇尔辅佐下于英格兰加盖印玺。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Moel-y-don was fought in 1282 as part of the conquest of Wales by Edward I. Also known as the Battle of the Bridge of Boats, it is unlikely the battle site was near Moel-y-don, but farther north.

zh.s: 莫尔伊顿之战发生于1282年，是爱德华一世征服威尔士战争的一部分。此战也称“舟桥之战”。战场可能并不在莫尔伊顿附近，而是在更北面。

en.s: The sieges of Berwick were the Scottish capture of the English town of Berwick-upon-Tweed on 6 November 1355, the subsequent unsuccessful siege of Berwick Castle, and the English siege and recapture of the town in January 1356. The Scots had been fighting the English in the Second War of Scottish Independence since 1332. After a period of military inactivity, the Scots assembled an army on the border in 1355.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1355年11月6日，苏格兰人攻占英格兰城镇贝里克，随后未能攻下贝里克城堡；1356年1月，英格兰人围城并重新夺回该镇。自1332年以来，苏格兰人一直在第二次苏格兰独立战争中与英格兰交战。经历一段军事行动停滞期后，苏格兰人于1355年在边境集结军队。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件起始日期。

en.s: The siege of Buda took place in 1603 during the Long Turkish War and was the third and last attempt to capture the town by the Habsburgs; however, despite initial success achieved by the Habsburgs, the Ottomans later thwarted the Habsburg attempt to capture the town.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1603年的布达围城战发生于长期土耳其战争期间，是哈布斯堡王朝第三次、也是最后一次试图攻占该城。哈布斯堡军一度取得进展，但奥斯曼军随后挫败了这次攻城行动。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Sufiyan (Persian: نبرد صوفيان) took place on 6 November 1605, during the Ottoman–Safavid War of 1603–1618. The Safavids, under King (Shah) Abbas I (r. 1588–1629), beat a numerically superior, fully-fledged Ottoman army. It was one of King Abbas I's greatest military victories.

zh.s: 苏菲扬战役（波斯语：نبرد صوفيان）于1605年11月6日发生，是1603—1618年奥斯曼—萨法维战争的一场战役。阿拔斯一世国王率领萨法维军队击败了人数占优、装备齐全的奥斯曼军队。这是阿拔斯一世取得的最重要军事胜利之一。

en.s: The Irraya Revolt, also known as the Gaddang Revolt (Tagalog: Pag-aalsa ng mga Gaddang) was an uprising by the Gaddang people of Northern Isabela that transpired on 6 November 1621. It was led by Felipe Cuntapay and Gabriel Dayag.

zh.s: 伊拉亚起义又称加当族起义（他加禄语：Pag-aalsa ng mga Gaddang），是北伊莎贝拉省加当族人于1621年11月6日发动的一场起义，由费利佩·昆塔派和加布里埃尔·达亚格领导。

en.s: The Dutch expedition to Valdivia was a naval expedition, commanded by Hendrik Brouwer, sent by the Dutch Republic in 1643 to establish a base of operations and a trading post on the southern coast of Chile. With Spain and the Dutch Republic at war, the Dutch wished to take over the ruins of the abandoned Spanish city of Valdivia.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 荷兰远征瓦尔迪维亚是一次海军远征，由亨德里克·布劳韦尔指挥，荷兰共和国于1643年派出，计划在智利南部海岸建立行动基地和贸易据点。当时西班牙与荷兰共和国处于战争状态，荷兰人希望控制已被废弃的西班牙城市瓦尔迪维亚遗址。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The (Leontiev) expedition to Crimea was a punitive expedition undertaken by the Russians against the Crimean Khanate. Taking place in autumn 1735, during the start of the Russo-Turkish War. The punishing forces were unable to get further than Kuban, and despite a number of successes in battle, they were forced to retreat.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 列昂季耶夫克里米亚远征
zh.s: 列昂季耶夫远征是俄罗斯对克里米亚汗国发动的一次惩罚性远征，发生于1735年秋季，正值俄土战争初期。俄军未能推进到库班以外，虽然在多场战斗中获胜，最终仍被迫撤退。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Sindhuli (Nepali: सिन्धुलीको युद्ध; also known as the Battle of Sindhuli Gadhi) was fought on 6 November 1767 near Sindhuli Gadhi. The battle was part of the unification of Nepal led by Prithvi Narayan Shah, King of Gorkha (later King of Nepal).

zh.s: 1767年11月6日，辛杜利堡附近爆发辛杜利战役（尼泊尔语：सिन्धुलीको युद्ध；又称辛杜利加迪战役）。这场战役是尼泊尔统一战争的一部分，由戈尔卡国王普里特维·纳拉扬·沙阿领导。

en.s: The 1781 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1781. The councilor from Kent County John Dickinson was elected president of Delaware for a term of three-years. Delaware politics during the 1780s witnessed the rise of conservative and radical political factions, with the radical leaders predominating during the American War of Independence.

zh.s: 1781年11月6日举行特拉华州州长选举。肯特县议员约翰·狄金森当选特拉华州总统，任期三年。1780年代，特拉华州政坛出现保守派和激进派；美国独立战争期间，激进派领导人占据主导地位。

en.s: The 1783 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1783, in order to elect the Governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Governor William Livingston was re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly against his opponent candidate John Cooper.

zh.s: 1783年11月6日举行新泽西州州长选举。联邦党籍现任州长威廉·利文斯顿在新泽西州议会选举中击败约翰·库珀，成功连任。

en.s: The Battle of Jemappes (6 November 1792) took place near the town of Jemappes in Hainaut, Belgium, near Mons during the War of the First Coalition, part of the French Revolutionary Wars. One of the first major offensive battles of the war, it was a victory for the armies of the infant French Republic, and saw the French Armée du Nord, which included a large number of inexperienced volunteers, defeat a substantially smaller regular Austrian army. General Charles François Dumouriez, in command of an army of French Revolutionary volunteers, faced the Imperial army of Field Marshal Duke Albert of Saxe-Teschen and his second-in-command François de Croix, Count of Clerfayt.

zh.s: 第一次反法同盟战争期间，法国革命战争中的热马普之战于1792年11月6日在比利时埃诺省热马普镇附近、蒙斯附近地区打响。这是战争初期一场重要的进攻战，法兰西第一共和国军队获胜。法国北方军中有大量缺乏经验的志愿兵，他们击败了规模小得多的奥地利正规军。查理·弗朗索瓦·迪穆里埃将军率领法国革命志愿军，对阵阿尔贝特·冯·萨克森-泰申公爵元帅指挥的帝国军队；元帅的副手是弗朗索瓦·德·克鲁瓦伯爵。

en.s: The 1793 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1793, in order to elect the governor of Georgia. Democratic-Republican candidate and former governor George Mathews defeated incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Edward Telfair and fellow Democratic-Republican candidate Jared Irwin in a Georgia General Assembly vote.

zh.s: 1793年佐治亚州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。民主共和党候选人、前州长乔治·马修斯在佐治亚州议会投票中击败现任民主共和党州长爱德华·特尔费尔和同党候选人贾里德·欧文。

en.s: The 1794 New Jersey gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1794, in order to elect the Governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Federalist Governor Richard Howell was re-elected by the New Jersey General Assembly against candidate John Rutherford. The exact results of this election are unknown.

zh.s: 1794年11月6日举行新泽西州州长选举。联邦党籍现任州长理查德·豪威尔在新泽西州议会选举中击败约翰·卢瑟福，成功连任。此次选举的确切结果不详。

en.s: The action of 6 November 1794 (Known in French as the Combat du 16 Brumaire an III) was a naval engagement during the War of the First Coalition. Two Royal Navy ships of the line, HMS Alexander and HMS Canada were intercepted while returning to Britain through the Celtic Sea by a large French squadron.

zh.s: 1794年11月6日海战（法语称“共和历三年雾月十六日战斗”）是第一次反法同盟战争期间的一场海战。英国皇家海军的两艘战列舰“亚历山大”号和“加拿大”号在经凯尔特海返回英国途中遭到一支庞大的法国舰队拦截。

loc: 意大利巴萨诺德尔格拉帕

en.s: The Second Battle of Bassano on 6 November 1796, saw a Habsburg Austrian army commanded by Jozsef Alvinczi fight Napoleon Bonaparte's French Army of Italy. The Austrians repulsed persistent French attacks in a struggle in which both sides suffered heavy losses. The engagement, which happened two months after the more famous Battle of Bassano, marked the first tactical defeat of Bonaparte's career and occurred near Bassano del Grappa in Northern Italy during the French Revolutionary Wars. The action was part of the third relief of the Siege of Mantua during the War of the First Coalition.

zh.s: 第二次巴萨诺战役于1796年11月6日打响。约瑟夫·阿尔文齐指挥的哈布斯堡奥地利军队与拿破仑·波拿巴的意大利法军交战。奥地利军队击退法军持续进攻，双方均损失惨重。这场战斗发生在更著名的巴萨诺战役两个月后，是波拿巴军事生涯中首次战术性失利，地点在意大利北部的巴萨诺德尔格拉帕附近。此战是第一次反法同盟战争期间第三次解围曼图亚围城战的一部分。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Third Battle of Novi (6 November 1799) saw a French Republican corps commanded by Laurent Gouvion Saint-Cyr defend itself against an attack by a Habsburg Austrian corps led by Paul Kray during the War of the Second Coalition. Saint-Cyr led the right wing of the French Army of Italy which defended Genoa. Saint-Cyr advanced his troops into the lowlands but withdrew into the hills near Novi when Kray appeared with a superior force.

zh.s: 1799年11月6日，诺维第三次战役中，洛朗·古维翁·圣西尔率领的法国共和军团抵御保罗·克雷率领的哈布斯堡奥地利军团进攻，这是第二次反法同盟战争的一部分。圣西尔指挥法国意大利军团右翼，该部负责防守热那亚。他先率部前进到低地，待克雷率优势兵力到来后，撤退至诺维附近的山地。

en.s: The 1801 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1801, in order to elect the governor of Georgia. Democratic-Republican candidate and former United States senator from Georgia Josiah Tattnall defeated Federalist candidate and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Georgia's at-large congressional district Thomas P. Carnes and former Democratic-Republican governor Jared Irwin in a Georgia General Assembly vote.

zh.s: 1801年佐治亚州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。民主共和党候选人、佐治亚州前美国参议员约西亚·塔特纳尔在州议会投票中击败联邦党候选人、佐治亚州唯一国会选区前美国众议员托马斯·P·卡恩斯，以及民主共和党前州长贾里德·欧文。

en.s: The Battle of Lübeck took place on 6 November 1806 in Lübeck, Germany between soldiers of the Kingdom of Prussia led by Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher and troops of the First French Empire under Marshals Joachim Murat, Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte, and Nicolas Soult. In this War of the Fourth Coalition action, the French inflicted a severe defeat on the Prussians, driving them from the neutral city. Lübeck is an old Baltic Sea port approximately 50 kilometres (31 mi) northeast of Hamburg. After their shattering defeat by Emperor Napoleon I at the Battle of Jena-Auerstedt, the Prussian armies withdrew to the east bank of the Elbe River and marched northeast in an attempt to reach the Oder River.

zh.s: 1806年11月6日，普鲁士王国军队与法兰西第一帝国军队在德国吕贝克交战。普军由格布哈德·列贝莱希特·冯·布吕歇尔率领，法军由若阿尚·缪拉、让-巴蒂斯特·贝尔纳多特和尼古拉·苏尔特元帅指挥。第四次反法同盟战争期间，法军重创普军，将其赶出中立城市吕贝克。吕贝克是波罗的海沿岸的古老港口，位于汉堡东北约50公里（31英里）。普军在耶拿-奥尔施泰特战役中被拿破仑一世击溃后，撤至易北河东岸并向东北进军，试图抵达奥得河。

en.s: The 1807 New Jersey gubernatorial election occurred on November 6, 1807, to elect the governor of New Jersey. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Joseph Bloomfield was re-elected with the majority vote of the New Jersey General Assembly as he contested without any competition.

zh.s: 1807年11月6日举行新泽西州州长选举。民主共和党籍现任州长约瑟夫·布卢姆菲尔德在新泽西州议会投票中获得多数，成功连任；他参选时没有对手。

en.s: The Battle of Malcolm's Mills was the last battle of the War of 1812 fought in Canada. A force of American cavalry overran and scattered a force of Canadian and British militia. The battle was fought on November 6, 1814, near the village of Oakland in Brant County, Ontario, and was part of a series of battles fought by American Brigadier General Duncan McArthur on an extended raid into Upper Canada, known variously as McArthur's Raid or Dudley's Raid.

zh.s: 1812年战争期间在加拿大进行的最后一场战役于1814年11月6日在安大略省布兰特县奥克兰村附近打响。美国骑兵部队击溃了加拿大和英国民兵。该战役是美国准将邓肯·麦克阿瑟深入上加拿大突袭行动的一部分，这次行动又称麦克阿瑟突袭或达德利突袭。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The capture of the frigate Esmeralda was a naval operation conducted on the night of 5 November 1820 during the Peruvian War of Independence. A division of boats with sailors and marines of the First Chilean Navy Squadron, commanded by Thomas Cochrane, stealthily advanced towards Callao and captured the 40-gun Spanish frigate Esmeralda in a cutting-out operation.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 埃斯梅拉达号护卫舰的俘获行动
zh.s: 埃斯梅拉达号护卫舰的俘获行动是秘鲁独立战争期间的一次海军行动，发生于1820年11月5日晚。托马斯·科克伦指挥智利第一海军分舰队的一支船艇分队，搭载水兵和海军陆战队员，悄然驶向卡亚俄，并在突袭中俘获西班牙40炮护卫舰“埃斯梅拉达”号。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1826 New York gubernatorial election was held from November 6 to 8, 1826. Incumbent governor DeWitt Clinton was elected to a second consecutive and fourth overall term in office, defeating former U.S. Representative William B. Rochester.

zh.s: 1826年纽约州州长选举于11月6日至8日举行。现任州长德威特·克林顿当选，开始第二个连续任期，也是第四个总任期；他击败了美国前众议员威廉·B·罗切斯特。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1832 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1832. This was the first gubernatorial election held under the 1831 constitution, which moved the state's general elections to November and extended the Governor's three-year term to four years, but preserved the bar on governors from succeeding themselves. Incumbent National Republican Governor David Hazzard was barred from seeking a second term. New Castle County Treasurer Caleb P.

zh.s: 1832年特拉华州州长选举于11月6日举行。这是1831年宪法通过后的首次州长选举；新宪法将州普选移至11月，并把州长任期从3年延长至4年，但仍禁止州长连续担任第二任。时任国家共和党籍州长戴维·哈扎德不得竞选连任。纽卡斯尔县财务官凯莱布·P·贝内特作为民主党候选人参选，接替哈扎德；前州众议员阿诺德·诺丹作为国家共和党候选人参选。贝内特以仅54票的微弱优势击败诺丹。

en.s: The 1837 Michigan gubernatorial election was held from November 6, 1837, to November 7, 1837. Incumbent Democrat Stevens T. Mason defeated Whig nominee Charles C. Trowbridge with 49.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1837年11月6日至7日举行密歇根州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长史蒂文斯·T·梅森以49.83%的得票率击败辉格党提名人查尔斯·C·特罗布里奇。

en.s: The 1837 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1837, to elect the governor of Mississippi. Alexander G. McNutt, a Democrat won against Whig candidate John A. Grimball and States Rights Whig candidate Jacob B. Morgan. A fourth candidate, Democrat Benjamin W. Edwards died during the campaign.

zh.s: 1837年密西西比州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。民主党人亚历山大·G·麦克纳特击败辉格党候选人约翰·A·格里姆博尔和州权辉格党候选人雅各布·B·摩根。第四名候选人、民主党人本杰明·W·爱德华兹在竞选期间去世。

en.s: The Sabinada (1837–1838) was a revolt by military officer Francisco Sabino that occurred in Brazil's Bahia province between 6 November 1837 and 16 March 1838. The rebels proposed the existence of a Bahian Republic of a transitory nature until Emperor Dom Pedro II reached the age of majority. Calling for the abolition of slavery and the redistribution of land, they fought against the government for one year until their capital of Salvador was conquered.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 萨宾纳达起义（1837—1838年）是军官弗朗西斯科·萨比诺领导的一场起义，于1837年11月6日至1838年3月16日在巴西巴伊亚省发生。起义者主张建立巴伊亚共和国，直至佩德罗二世皇帝成年。他们呼吁废除奴隶制和重新分配土地，与政府战斗一年，最终首府萨尔瓦多被攻陷。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件起始日期。

en.s: The Lower Canada Rebellion (French: rébellion du Bas-Canada), commonly referred to as the Patriots' Rebellion (Rébellion des patriotes) in French, is the name given to the armed conflict in 1837–38 between rebels and the British colonial government of Lower Canada (now southern Quebec). Together with the simultaneous rebellion in the neighbouring colony of Upper Canada (now southern Ontario), it formed the Rebellions of 1837–38 (rébellions de 1837–38).
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 下加拿大起义（法语：rébellion du Bas-Canada），在法语中通常称为“爱国者起义”（Rébellion des patriotes），指1837至1838年间，下加拿大（今魁北克南部）的叛军与英国殖民政府之间的武装冲突。它与邻近上加拿大殖民地（今安大略省南部）同时发生的起义合称1837—1838年起义。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件起始日期。

en.s: The 1843 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1843, to elect the governor of Mississippi. Albert G. Brown, an anti-bond Democrat won against Whig George R. Clayton and "bond-paying Democrat" and former U.S. Senator Thomas Hickman Williams.

zh.s: 1843年密西西比州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。反债券派民主党人艾伯特·G·布朗击败辉格党人乔治·R·克莱顿，以及“偿债派民主党人”、前美国参议员托马斯·希克曼·威廉姆斯。

en.s: The 1843 Michigan gubernatorial election was held from November 6 to 7, 1843. Incumbent Democrat John S. Barry defeated Whig nominee Zina Pitcher and Liberty nominee James G. Birney.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1843年密歇根州州长选举于11月6日至7日举行。民主党现任州长约翰·S·巴里击败辉格党提名人齐纳·皮彻和自由党提名人詹姆斯·G·伯尼。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件起始日期。

en.t: 1844 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: A presidential election was held in Rhode Island on November 6, 1844, as part of the 1844 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Rhode Island voted for the Whig candidate, Henry Clay, over Democratic candidate James K. Polk. Clay won Rhode Island by a margin of 19.97%.

zh.t: 美国罗得岛州总统选举，1844
zh.s: 1844年11月6日，罗得岛州举行总统选举，作为1844年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持辉格党候选人亨利·克莱，击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·K·波尔克。克莱在该州领先19.97个百分点。

en.s: The 1849 gubernatorial election in Wisconsin was held on November 6, 1849. Democrat Nelson Dewey won the election with 56% of the vote, winning his second term as Governor of Wisconsin. Dewey defeated Whig Party candidate Alexander Collins and Free Soil Party candidate Warren Chase.

zh.t: 美国威斯康星州州长选举，1849
zh.s: 1849年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举。民主党人纳尔逊·杜威以56%的得票率获胜，开始第二个州长任期。他击败了辉格党候选人亚历山大·柯林斯和自由土地党候选人沃伦·蔡斯。

en.s: The 1849 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1849. Democratic nominee John S. Barry defeated Whig nominee Flavius J. Littlejohn with 53.98% of the vote.

zh.s: 1849年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。民主党提名人约翰·S·巴里以53.98%的得票率击败辉格党提名人弗拉维厄斯·J·利特尔约翰。

en.s: The 1855 gubernatorial election in Wisconsin was held on November 6, 1855. Democratic candidate William A. Barstow won the election with 50% of the vote, defeating Republican Party candidate Coles Bashford. However, Bashford and the Wisconsin Attorney General, George Baldwin Smith, filed suit in the Wisconsin Supreme Court in the case Atty. Gen. ex rel. Bashford v. Barstow. They alleged that Barstow created fraudulent election returns in several fake precincts in Wisconsin's northern counties. The court found that Bashford had won the election, and was entitled to the governorship.

zh.t: 美国威斯康星州州长选举，1855
zh.s: 1855年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举。民主党候选人威廉·A·巴斯托获得50%的选票，击败共和党候选人科尔斯·巴什福德。然而，巴什福德和威斯康星州检察长乔治·鲍德温·史密斯就“巴什福德诉巴斯托案”向州最高法院提起诉讼，指控巴斯托在该州北部多个虚设选区伪造选举结果。法院裁定巴什福德才是胜选者，有权担任州长。

en.s: The 1855 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1855, in order to elect the governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democratic governor John J. McRae defeated the American Party nominee Charles D. Fontaine and so won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 1855年密西西比州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。民主党现任州长约翰·J·麦克雷击败美国党提名人查尔斯·D·方丹，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1855 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6. Know-Nothing candidate Henry J. Gardner was re-elected to a second term as Governor in a multi-partisan race, defeating Republican Julius Rockwell and Democrat Erasmus Beach. This was the first election won by a direct plurality vote, after the majority requirement was abolished by the legislature on May 23. Gardner won without ratification by the General Court.

zh.s: 1855年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月6日举行。一无所知党候选人亨利·J·加德纳连任第二个州长任期，在多党竞选中击败共和党人朱利叶斯·罗克韦尔和民主党人伊拉斯谟·比奇。这是州议会于5月23日废除多数票门槛后，首次由相对多数票决出胜者的选举。加德纳无需州议会批准便当选。

en.t: Capture of the French Folly Fort
en.s: The Capture of the French Folly Fort by British forces in China occurred on 6 November 1856 during the Second Opium War. The British dispersed 23 Chinese war junks and captured the French Folly Fort in the Pearl River near the city of Canton (Guangzhou) in the Guangdong province. The battle lasted nearly an hour. The British consul Harry Parkes described the Chinese as putting up "a very hot resistance" and the engagement as "exceeding creditable to the bravery not only of our men, but of the Chinese also."

zh.t: 英军攻占法兰西愚蠢堡
zh.s: 第二次鸦片战争期间，英军于1856年11月6日在中国攻占法兰西愚蠢堡。英军驱散23艘中国战船，在珠江上、广州附近的广东省境内攻占该堡。战斗持续了近一个小时。英国领事哈里·帕克斯称中国军队“抵抗非常激烈”，并称这场交战“充分体现了英军和中国军队的勇敢”。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1860 was the 19th presidential election. The election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 1860, and served as the immediate impetus for the outbreak of the American Civil War. The United States had been divided during the 1850s on questions surrounding the expansion of slavery and the rights of slave owners. Incumbent President James Buchanan, like his predecessor Franklin Pierce, was a northerner with sympathies for the South. He recommended that Supreme Court Justice Robert Grier vote proslavery in the Dred Scott v. Sandford case of 1857.

zh.s: 1860年美国总统选举是美国第19次总统选举，于11月6日星期二举行，直接促成了美国内战爆发。19世纪50年代，美国围绕奴隶制扩张和奴隶主权利问题产生分裂。时任总统詹姆斯·布坎南与前任富兰克林·皮尔斯一样，是一名同情南方的北方人。1857年“斯科特诉桑福德案”审理期间，他曾建议最高法院大法官罗伯特·格里尔投票支持奴隶制。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1860
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Voters chose fifteen representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia was one of only three states to vote for the Constitutional Union candidate, former U.S. Senator John Bell, over the Democratic candidate, U.S. Senator Stephen A. Douglas, and the Southern Democratic candidate, Vice President John C. Breckinridge. Former U.S. Representative Abraham Lincoln was also the Republican candidate in this election, but he received the lowest support for any Republican presidential candidate in the history of Virginia.

zh.t: 1860年美国弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1860年美国弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名代表，也就是选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州是仅有的三个支持宪政联盟候选人的州之一；该党候选人是前联邦参议员约翰·贝尔。他击败了民主党候选人、联邦参议员斯蒂芬·A·道格拉斯，以及南方民主党候选人、时任副总统约翰·C·布雷肯里奇。前联邦众议员亚伯拉罕·林肯也代表共和党参选，但他在弗吉尼亚州获得的支持率是该州历来共和党总统候选人中最低的。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1860
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Voters chose 27 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Republican candidate, Abraham Lincoln, over the Southern Democratic candidate, John C. Breckinridge. Lincoln won Pennsylvania by a margin of 18.72%.

zh.t: 美国宾夕法尼亚州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，宾夕法尼亚州举行总统选举。选民选出27名选举人，组成选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州支持共和党候选人亚伯拉罕·林肯，击败南方民主党候选人约翰·C·布雷肯里奇。林肯以18.72个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1860
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 6, 1860. Wisconsin voters chose five electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate Abraham Lincoln won the state with 57% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's five electoral votes.

zh.t: 1860年美国威斯康星州总统选举
zh.s: 1860年美国威斯康星州总统选举于11月6日举行。威斯康星州选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人亚伯拉罕·林肯以57%的普选票赢得该州，并获得威斯康星州的5张选举人票。

en.t: United States presidential election in Texas, 1860
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Texas was held on November 6, 1860. Texas voters chose 4 electors to represent the state in the Electoral College, which chose the President and Vice President. Texas voted for the Southern Democratic nominee John C. Breckinridge, who received 75% of the vote. Texas was Breckinridge's strongest state. Republican Party candidate Abraham Lincoln was not on the ballot in Texas.

zh.t: 美国得克萨斯州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，得克萨斯州举行总统选举。选民选出4名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。得克萨斯州支持南方民主党候选人约翰·C·布雷肯里奇，他获得75%的选票。得克萨斯州是布雷肯里奇支持率最高的州。共和党候选人亚伯拉罕·林肯没有出现在得州选票上。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in New York
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Voters chose 35 electors of the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New York was the tipping state in this election, and had Lincoln lost it there would have been a contingent election decided by Congress.

zh.s: 1860年11月6日，纽约州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出35名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。纽约州是这次选举的关键州；如果林肯输掉该州，选举将交由国会决定。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Minnesota voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Minnesota voted in its first ever United States presidential election, having been admitted as the 32nd state on May 11, 1858.

zh.t: 美国明尼苏达州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。这是明尼苏达州首次参加美国总统选举；该州于1858年5月11日成为美国第32个州。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in California took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California narrowly voted for the Republican nominee, former Illinois representative Abraham Lincoln. He defeated the Democratic nominee, Illinois Senator Stephen A.

zh.t: 1860年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1860年美国加利福尼亚州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。州选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州以微弱优势支持共和党候选人、前伊利诺伊州众议员亚伯拉罕·林肯。林肯击败了民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州参议员斯蒂芬·A·道格拉斯及其搭档、佐治亚州州长赫歇尔·V·约翰逊。林肯以0.61个百分点、即734票的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1860 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1860, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Illinois. Republican nominee Francis Hoffmann defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the Illinois House of Representatives Lewis Winans Ross, Independent Democrat Henry S. Blackburn and Constitutional Union nominee Thomas Snell.

zh.t: 美国伊利诺伊州副州长选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州副州长选举。共和党提名人弗朗西斯·霍夫曼击败民主党提名人、前州众议员刘易斯·怀南斯·罗斯、独立民主党人亨利·S·布莱克本和宪政联盟党提名人托马斯·斯内尔。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 6, 1860, as part of this 1860 United States presidential election. The state legislature chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. By 1860, South Carolina was the only state using this procedure in a presidential election and had been since Delaware switched to popular vote for the 1832 election.

zh.t: 美国南卡罗来纳州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，南卡罗来纳州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。州议会选出8名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。1860年，南卡罗来纳州是唯一仍由州议会选举人投票的州；自特拉华州在1832年改为普选后，它一直如此。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Tennessee was won by the Constitutional Union candidate and Tennessee native Senator John Bell and his running mate the 15th Governor of Massachusetts Edward Everett.

zh.t: 美国田纳西州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，田纳西州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。田纳西州支持宪政联盟党候选人、田纳西州人约翰·贝尔参议员及其竞选搭档、马萨诸塞州第15任州长爱德华·埃弗里特。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Mississippi voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Mississippi was won by the Southern Democratic candidate 14th Vice President of the United States John C. Breckinridge of Kentucky and his running mate Senator Joseph Lane of Oregon.

zh.t: 美国密西西比州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，密西西比州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。密西西比州支持南方民主党候选人、来自肯塔基州的美国第14任副总统约翰·C·布雷肯里奇及其竞选搭档、来自俄勒冈州的参议员约瑟夫·莱恩。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Oregon voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon voted in its first ever presidential election, having become the 33rd state on February 14, 1859.

zh.t: 美国俄勒冈州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，俄勒冈州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。这是俄勒冈州首次参加总统选举；该州于1859年2月14日成为美国第33个州。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Voters in New Jersey chose seven electors of the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. New Jersey voters voted for each elector individually, and thus could split their votes. All seven electors were chosen in a single at-large election.

zh.t: 美国新泽西州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，新泽西州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。新泽西州选民分别投票选举每一名选举人，因此可以分投不同候选人。7名选举人均在全州单一选区中选出。

en.s: The 1860 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1860, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee Charles McIlrath defeated Democratic nominee Herman Trott and Southern Democrats nominee Josiah S. Weiser.

zh.t: 明尼苏达州州审计长选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日举行明尼苏达州州审计长选举。共和党提名人查尔斯·麦克伊拉斯击败民主党提名人赫尔曼·特罗特和南方民主党提名人乔赛亚·S·韦瑟。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Louisiana voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. The Republican Party and its candidate Abraham Lincoln did not have significant ballot distribution in the state.

zh.t: 美国路易斯安那州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，路易斯安那州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党及其候选人亚伯拉罕·林肯在该州没有广泛列入选票。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Ohio took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Voters chose 23 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was won by the Republican nominee Illinois Representative Abraham Lincoln and his running mate Senator Hannibal Hamlin of Maine. They defeated the Democratic nominee, Senator Stephen A.

zh.s: 1860年美国俄亥俄州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出23名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。俄亥俄州支持共和党候选人、伊利诺伊州众议员亚伯拉罕·林肯及其搭档、缅因州参议员汉尼拔·哈姆林。他们击败了民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州参议员斯蒂芬·A·道格拉斯及其搭档、佐治亚州州长赫歇尔·V·约翰逊。林肯以7.94个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Alabama was won by the Southern Democratic candidate 14th Vice President of the United States John C. Breckinridge of Kentucky and his running mate Senator Joseph Lane of Oregon.

zh.t: 美国阿拉巴马州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，阿拉巴马州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。阿拉巴马州支持南方民主党候选人、来自肯塔基州的美国第14任副总统约翰·C·布雷肯里奇及其竞选搭档、来自俄勒冈州的参议员约瑟夫·莱恩。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the former U.S. representative from Illinois's 7th congressional district Abraham Lincoln and the senior U.S. senator from Maine Hannibal Hamlin defeated the Democratic ticket of the senior U.S. senator from Illinois Stephen A. Douglas and the governor of Georgia Herschel V.

zh.t: 1860年美国印第安纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，印第安纳州举行总统选举，属于当年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、伊利诺伊州第七国会选区前联邦众议员亚伯拉罕·林肯与缅因州资深联邦参议员汉尼拔·哈姆林组成的竞选搭档，击败了民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州资深联邦参议员斯蒂芬·A·道格拉斯与佐治亚州州长赫歇尔·V·约翰逊组成的竞选搭档。南方民主党候选人、时任副总统约翰·C·布雷肯里奇与俄勒冈州资深联邦参议员约瑟夫·莱恩得票不足5%，但以微弱优势赢得沃里克县，这是他们赢下的唯一一个县。

en.s: The 1860 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1860. Republican nominee Austin Blair defeated Democratic nominee John S. Barry with 56.63% of the vote.

zh.s: 1860年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。共和党提名人奥斯汀·布莱尔以56.63%的得票率击败民主党提名人约翰·S·巴里。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Southern Democratic candidate 14th Vice President of the United States John C. Breckinridge of Kentucky and his running mate Senator Joseph Lane of Oregon.

zh.t: 美国特拉华州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，特拉华州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。州内选民选出3名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。特拉华州支持南方民主党候选人、来自肯塔基州的美国第14任副总统约翰·C·布雷肯里奇及其竞选搭档、来自俄勒冈州的参议员约瑟夫·莱恩。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by the Republican nominees Illinois Representative Abraham Lincoln and his running mate Senator Hannibal Hamlin of Maine.

zh.t: 美国艾奥瓦州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，艾奥瓦州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。艾奥瓦州支持共和党候选人、伊利诺伊州众议员亚伯拉罕·林肯及其竞选搭档、来自缅因州的参议员汉尼拔·哈姆林。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by the Constitutional Union nominee Senator John Bell of Tennessee and his running mate Governor of Massachusetts Edward Everett.

zh.t: 美国肯塔基州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，肯塔基州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。肯塔基州支持宪政联盟党候选人、来自田纳西州的参议员约翰·贝尔及其竞选搭档、马萨诸塞州州长爱德华·埃弗里特。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Illinois voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Illinois was the home state of both major party nominees, Republican candidate and former Whig congressman Abraham Lincoln as well as Democratic candidate Senator Stephen A.

zh.t: 1860年美国伊利诺伊州总统选举
zh.s: 1860年美国伊利诺伊州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。伊利诺伊州选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。伊利诺伊州是两大党候选人的家乡：共和党候选人、前辉格党联邦众议员亚伯拉罕·林肯，以及民主党候选人、联邦参议员斯蒂芬·A·道格拉斯。这场选举实际上是两人1858年伊利诺伊州联邦参议院选举的重赛；当年道格拉斯击败了林肯。林肯最终以3.52个百分点的微弱优势赢得伊利诺伊州。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Carolina was won by the Southern Democratic candidate 14th Vice President of the United States John C.

zh.t: 1860年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1860年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南方民主党候选人、美国第14任副总统约翰·C·布雷肯里奇及其搭档、俄勒冈州参议员约瑟夫·莱恩赢得北卡罗来纳州。他们击败了宪政联盟候选人、田纳西州参议员约翰·贝尔及其搭档、马萨诸塞州第15任州长爱德华·埃弗里特。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Maryland voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland was won by the Southern Democratic candidate 14th Vice President of the United States John C. Breckinridge of Kentucky and his running mate Senator Joseph Lane of Oregon.

zh.t: 美国马里兰州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，马里兰州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。马里兰州选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。南方民主党候选人、来自肯塔基州的美国第14任副总统约翰·C·布雷肯里奇与竞选搭档、来自俄勒冈州的参议员约瑟夫·莱恩赢得马里兰州。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Arkansas voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arkansas was won by the Southern Democratic candidate 14th Vice President of the United States John C. Breckinridge of Kentucky and his running mate Senator Joseph Lane of Oregon.

zh.t: 美国阿肯色州总统选举，1860
zh.s: 1860年11月6日，阿肯色州举行总统选举，作为1860年美国总统选举的一部分。阿肯色州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。南方民主党候选人、来自肯塔基州的美国第14任副总统约翰·C·布雷肯里奇与竞选搭档、来自俄勒冈州的参议员约瑟夫·莱恩赢得阿肯色州。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by the Republican nominee, Illinois Representative Abraham Lincoln and his running mate Senator Hannibal Hamlin of Maine. They defeated the Democratic nominee, Senator Stephen A.

zh.s: 1860年美国密歇根州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。密歇根州支持共和党候选人、伊利诺伊州众议员亚伯拉罕·林肯及其搭档、缅因州参议员汉尼拔·哈姆林。他们击败了民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州参议员斯蒂芬·A·道格拉斯及其搭档、佐治亚州州长赫歇尔·V·约翰逊。林肯以15.12个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1860 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1860. Incumbent Governor Edwin D. Morgan was re-elected to a second term in office over William Kelly. The election was held alongside a referendum on universal adult male suffrage, which failed.

zh.s: 1860年纽约州州长选举于11月6日举行。现任州长埃德温·D·摩根击败威廉·凯利，连任第二个任期。选举同时就成年男性普选权举行公投，但该提案未获通过。

en.s: The 1860 New York state election was held on November 6, 1860, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, a Canal Commissioner, and an Inspector of State Prisons, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly. Besides, the question of Negro suffrage was asked, and was answered in the negative with 197,503 votes for and 337,984 against it.

zh.s: 1860年纽约州选举于11月6日举行，选出州长、副州长、运河委员、州监狱监察员以及纽约州众议院全体议员。此外，选民还就黑人选举权问题进行表决，最终以197,503票赞成、337,984票反对否决该提案。

en.t: 1860 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1860 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 6, 1860, as part of the 1860 United States presidential election. Georgia voters chose 10 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In the election, Southern Democratic candidate 14th Vice President of the United States John C.

zh.s: 1860年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。佐治亚州选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南方民主党候选人、美国第14任副总统约翰·C·布雷肯里奇及其搭档、参议员约瑟夫·莱恩获得最多选票，胜过宪政联盟候选人、参议员约翰·贝尔及其搭档、马萨诸塞州州长爱德华·埃弗里特，以及民主党候选人、参议员斯蒂芬·A·道格拉斯及其搭档、佐治亚州州长赫歇尔·V·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1860 Illinois gubernatorial election was the twelfth election for this office. Republican governor William Henry Bissell died early in his term, and incumbent governor John Wood did not seek re-election. Former Democratic Congressman and former Clerk of the U.S. House James C. Allen was the Democratic nominee. A Number of third-party candidates ran as well; none received over one percent of the vote.

zh.s: 1860年伊利诺伊州州长选举是该职位的第12次选举。共和党籍州长威廉·亨利·比塞尔在任期初期去世，时任州长约翰·伍德没有寻求连任。民主党提名前联邦众议员、前联邦众议院书记詹姆斯·C·艾伦。另有多名第三党候选人参选，但没有人获得超过1%的选票。

en.s: The Battle of Mahoetahi was fought as part of the First Taranaki War. In November 1860 a small force of around 150 Ngāti Hauā warriors travelled to Taranaki from the Waikato and challenged the British to battle at Mahoetahi, near New Plymouth. The British replied with a much larger force of British Army regulars and New Zealand colonial units and effectively encircled and defeated the Ngāti Hauā force.

zh.s: 马霍埃塔希之战是第一次塔拉纳基战争的一部分。1860年11月，一支约150人的恩加蒂·豪阿战士队伍从怀卡托前往塔拉纳基，在新普利茅斯附近的马霍埃塔希向英军挑战。英军派出规模更大的正规军和新西兰殖民部队应战，最终包围并击败了恩加蒂·豪阿部队。

en.s: The 1860 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6. Incumbent Republican governor Nathaniel Banks did not run for re-election to a fourth term. He was succeeded by Republican John Albion Andrew, a radical abolitionist.

zh.s: 1860年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任州长纳撒尼尔·班克斯没有竞选第四个任期。共和党人约翰·阿尔比恩·安德鲁继任州长，他是激进废奴主义者。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.t: Abraham Lincoln is elected the 16th president of the United States with only 40% of the popular vote, defeating John C. Breckinridge, John Bell, and Stephen A. Douglas in a four-way race
en.s: Abraham Lincoln (February 12, 1809 – April 15, 1865) was the 16th president of the United States, from 1861 until his assassination in 1865. He led the United States through the American Civil War, defeating the Confederacy and playing a major role in the abolition of slavery. Born in a one-room log cabin in Kentucky, Lincoln was raised on the frontier.

zh.t: 亚伯拉罕·林肯以仅40%的普选票当选美国第16任总统，在四方角逐中击败约翰·C·布雷肯里奇、约翰·贝尔和斯蒂芬·A·道格拉斯
zh.s: 亚伯拉罕·林肯（1809年2月12日—1865年4月15日）是美国第16任总统，任期为1861年至1865年遇刺身亡。他领导美国度过南北战争，击败邦联，并在废除奴隶制的过程中发挥重要作用。林肯出生于肯塔基州一间单室木屋，在边疆地区长大。

en.t: 1861 Confederate States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 1861 Confederate States House of Representatives election in Florida was held on Wednesday, November 6, 1861, to elect the two Confederate States Representatives from the state of Florida, one from each of the state's congressional districts, to represent Florida in the 1st Confederate States Congress. The election coincided with the elections of other offices, including the Confederate States presidential election and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 佛罗里达州1861年美利坚联盟国众议院选举
zh.s: 1861年11月6日星期三，佛罗里达州举行美利坚联盟国众议院选举，选出该州两个国会选区的代表，进入美利坚联盟国第一届国会。选举同时还举行了其他职位的投票，包括美利坚联盟国总统选举以及各州和地方选举。

en.t: 1861 Confederate States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: A presidential election was held in North Carolina on November 6, 1861 as part of the 1861 Confederate States presidential election. The secessionist ticket led by William B. Rodman defeated the conservative, or people's ticket. Both lists were pledged to the incumbent provisional president Jefferson Davis and the provisional vice president Alexander H. Stephens.

zh.t: 北卡罗来纳州1861年美利坚联盟国总统选举
zh.s: 1861年11月6日，北卡罗来纳州举行总统选举，作为美利坚联盟国1861年总统选举的一部分。分离派候选人威廉·B·罗德曼领衔的名单击败了保守派（或人民派）名单。两份名单都承诺支持临时总统杰斐逊·戴维斯和临时副总统亚历山大·H·斯蒂芬斯。

en.s: The 1861 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1861. It was held amid the early phases of the American Civil War and was contested between the Union Party's Augustus Bradford and the Democratic Party's Benjamin Chew Howard. Bradford supported the maintenance of the Union while Howard advocated for a peace treaty with the Confederacy.

zh.s: 马里兰州州长选举于1861年11月6日举行。当时美国内战刚进入初期，参选者是联邦党人奥古斯塔斯·布拉德福德和民主党人本杰明·丘·霍华德。布拉德福德主张维护联邦统一，霍华德则主张与美利坚联盟国签订和平条约。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Confederate States of America on November 6, 1861. The incumbent provisional president Jefferson Davis and provisional vice president Alexander H. Stephens were elected unopposed. These were the first and only presidential elections held under the Constitution of the Confederate States of the Confederacy.

zh.s: 美利坚联盟国于1861年11月6日举行总统选举。临时总统杰斐逊·戴维斯和临时副总统亚历山大·H·斯蒂芬斯在没有对手的情况下当选。这是联盟国宪法下举行的首次也是唯一一次总统选举。

en.s: The Battle of Rogersville was a conflict in and around the town of Rogersville, Tennessee on the morning of November 6, 1863, between the United States Army 3rd Brigade, 4th Cavalry Division and the 2nd East Tennessee Mounted Infantry, and the Confederate States Army Jones' Brigade, 2nd Cavalry Brigade and the 8th Virginia Cavalry. Because Federal forces were caught largely by surprise, the Confederates, under Brigadier General William E. Jones, were able to recapture Rogersville along with significant supplies from the town's railroad storehouses.

zh.s: 1863年11月6日上午，美国陆军第四骑兵师第三旅和东田纳西州第二骑兵步兵团，与邦联军琼斯旅、第二骑兵旅及弗吉尼亚第八骑兵团在田纳西州罗杰斯维尔镇内及周边交战。联邦军大多遭到突袭，邦联军在准将威廉·E·琼斯率领下夺回罗杰斯维尔，并缴获镇上铁路仓库的大量物资。

en.s: The Battle of Droop Mountain was a battle in Pocahontas County, West Virginia, that occurred November 6, 1863, during the American Civil War. Confederate forces engaged, but failed to prevent Union forces under Brigadier General W.W. Averell from a rendezvous with other Federal troops in a joint raid on Confederate railways. Droop Mountain was one of the largest engagements in West Virginia during the war.

zh.s: 1863年11月6日，美国内战期间，西弗吉尼亚州波卡洪塔斯县爆发德罗普山战役。邦联军与联邦军交战，但未能阻止W·W·阿维雷尔准将率领的联邦军与其他部队会合，共同袭击邦联铁路。德罗普山战役是战争期间西弗吉尼亚州规模最大的战斗之一。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1865 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1865, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Whig Robert M. Patton won with a narrow plurality of the votes, beating Democrat Michael J. Bulger by about 4,000 votes. This was the last time a Whig won any election in US history.

zh.s: 1865年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。辉格党人罗伯特·M·帕顿以微弱的相对多数获胜，以约4,000票优势击败民主党人迈克尔·J·布尔格。这是美国历史上辉格党最后一次赢得选举。

en.s: The 1866 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1866, to elect the governor of Nevada. The incumbent Republican Governor of Nevada Henry G. Blasdel won re-election against Democratic nominee John D. Winters.

zh.s: 1866年内华达州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出该州州长。共和党籍现任州长亨利·G·布拉斯德尔击败民主党候选人约翰·D·温特斯，以1,020票优势获胜，继续由共和党执掌州长职位。

en.s: The 1866 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1866, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Charles McIlrath defeated Democratic nominee Nelson E. Nelson.

zh.s: 1866年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州审计长选举。共和党候选人、时任审计长查尔斯·麦克伊尔拉斯击败民主党候选人纳尔逊·E·纳尔逊。

en.s: The 1866 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1866. Incumbent Republican Henry H. Crapo defeated Democratic nominee Alpheus S. Williams with 58.81% of the vote.

zh.s: 1866年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。时任共和党州长亨利·H·克拉波击败民主党候选人阿尔菲厄斯·S·威廉姆斯，以58.81%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 1866 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1866. On March 1, 1865, Republican Governor William Cannon died in office, elevating State Senate Speaker Gove Saulsbury, a Democrat, to the governorship. Saulsbury ran for re-election in 1866, the first Governor to do so since Joshua Clayton in 1792. He faced Republican nominee James Riddle, a prominent industrialist.

zh.s: 1866年11月6日举行特拉华州州长选举。共和党州长威廉·坎农于1865年3月1日在任内去世，州参议院议长、民主党人戈夫·索尔斯伯里继任州长。索尔斯伯里于1866年竞选连任，这是自1792年约书亚·克莱顿以来，首位寻求连任的州长。他的对手是共和党候选人、知名实业家詹姆斯·里德尔。

en.s: A gubernatorial election was held in Kansas on November 6, 1866. The Republican governor Samuel J. Crawford defeated the National Union former mayor of Leavenworth James L. McDowell.

zh.s: 1866年11月6日，堪萨斯州举行州长选举。共和党州长塞缪尔·J·克劳福德击败全国联盟党候选人、曾任莱文沃思市长的詹姆斯·L·麦克道尔。

en.s: The 1866 New York state election was held on November 6, 1866, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, a Canal Commissioner and an Inspector of State Prisons, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly. Besides, the voters were asked if a Constitutional Convention should be held in 1867, which was answered in the affirmative with 352,854 votes for, and 256,364 against the convention.

zh.s: 1866年纽约州选举于11月6日举行，选出州长、副州长、运河委员、州监狱监察员以及纽约州众议院全体议员。此外，选民还就是否应于1867年召开制宪会议进行表决，最终以352,854票赞成、256,364票反对通过。

en.s: The 1866 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1866. Incumbent Governor Reuben Fenton was re-elected to a second term in office over Conservative Union candidate John T. Hoffman.

zh.s: 1866年纽约州州长选举于11月6日举行。现任州长鲁本·芬顿击败保守派联盟候选人约翰·T·霍夫曼，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1866 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6. Governor Alexander Bullock was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democrat Theodore Sweetser.

zh.s: 1866年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月6日举行。州长亚历山大·布洛克击败民主党人西奥多·斯威策，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1869 college football season was the first season of intercollegiate football in the United States. The teams played using improvised rules more closely resembling soccer and rugby than modern gridiron football, it is traditionally considered the inaugural college football season. The 1869 season consisted of only two games, both between Rutgers College, now known as Rutgers University, and the College of New Jersey, now known as Princeton University. The first game was played on November 6, 1869, at Rutgers' campus, and the second was played on November 13, 1869, at Princeton's campus.

zh.s: 1869年是美国校际橄榄球的第一个赛季。球队采用临时规则，比赛形式更接近足球和橄榄球；这个赛季通常被视为大学橄榄球的开端。该赛季只有两场比赛，均由罗格斯学院（现罗格斯大学）和新泽西学院（现普林斯顿大学）交手。第一场于1869年11月6日在罗格斯校区举行，第二场于11月13日在普林斯顿校区举行。

en.s: The 1876 Illinois gubernatorial election was the sixteenth election for this office. Representative Shelby Moore Cullom narrowly defeated businessman Lewis Steward for the Governorship of Illinois. This was the narrowest victory for a Republican Governor since 1856, when William H. Bissell narrowly won the office in a plurality. Cullom's victory was the sixth consecutive victory for the Republican Party. Cullom also slightly overperformed Republican candidate Rutherford B.

zh.s: 1876年伊利诺伊州州长选举是该职位的第16次选举。联邦众议员谢尔比·摩尔·卡勒姆以微弱优势击败商人刘易斯·斯图尔德，当选州长。这是共和党州长自1856年以来最小的胜选优势；当年威廉·H·比塞尔凭多数票以微弱优势胜出。卡勒姆的胜利是共和党连续第六次赢得该职位。他在伊利诺伊州的得票表现也略好于共和党总统候选人拉瑟福德·B·海斯。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1877 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 6, 1877. Democrat George B. McClellan defeated Republican nominee William A. Newell with 51.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1877年11月6日举行新泽西州州长选举。民主党人乔治·B·麦克莱伦以51.65%的得票率击败共和党提名人威廉·A·纽厄尔。

en.s: The 1877 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1877 to elect the governor of Virginia. The Republicans failed to nominate a candidate in this election, and as a result Democratic nominee and former Confederate congressman Frederick Holliday faced no opposition. This is the only gubernatorial election in Virginia history in which a candidate has run unopposed.

zh.s: 1877年11月6日举行弗吉尼亚州州长选举，以选出该州州长。共和党没有提名候选人，因此民主党提名人、前邦联国会议员弗雷德里克·霍利迪没有对手。这是弗吉尼亚州历史上唯一一次只有一名候选人参选的州长选举。

en.s: The 1877 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1877. Under internal party pressure, incumbent Republican Governor Harrison Ludington, who had barely won the 1875 election, was pressured to not seek a second term. Former State Assembly Speaker William E. Smith, a longtime figure in Wisconsin politics, was selected as the Republican nominee, and Milwaukee County Municipal Judge Thomas A.

zh.s: 1877年威斯康星州州长选举于11月6日举行。面对党内压力，刚在1875年以微弱优势获胜的共和党籍州长哈里森·路丁顿没有寻求连任。曾任州众议院议长、长期活跃于威斯康星州政坛的威廉·E·史密斯获共和党提名；密尔沃基县市级法官托马斯·A·马洛里经过民主党大会上的激烈争夺后获得提名。史密斯和马洛里还与绿背党候选人爱德华·菲尔普斯·阿利斯一同参加普选。

en.s: The 1877 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1877, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State John S. Irgens defeated Democratic nominee Peter T. Lindholm, Temperance nominee Moses T. Anderson and Greenback nominee Charles H. Roberts. The Greenback Party originally nominated Albert E. Rice, but after Rice declined the nomination, he was replaced by Charles H.

zh.s: 1877年明尼苏达州州务卿选举于11月6日举行，以选出该州州务卿。共和党候选人、时任州务卿约翰·S·伊尔根斯击败民主党候选人彼得·T·林德霍尔姆、禁酒党候选人摩西·T·安德森和绿背党候选人查尔斯·H·罗伯茨。绿背党最初提名艾伯特·E·赖斯，但赖斯拒绝接受提名后，查尔斯·H·罗伯茨接替了他。

en.s: The 1877 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1877,to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor James Wakefield defeated Democratic nominee and former Mayor of Minneapolis Albert Alonzo Ames and Prohibition nominee Phineas A. Jewell.

zh.s: 1877年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行副州长选举。共和党候选人、时任副州长詹姆斯·韦克菲尔德击败民主党候选人、前明尼阿波利斯市长阿尔伯特·阿隆佐·艾姆斯，以及禁酒党候选人菲尼亚斯·A·杰维尔。

en.s: The 1877 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1877, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general George P. Wilson defeated Democratic nominee John R. Jones, Prohibition nominee James E. Child and Greenback nominee Nathan C. Martin. Squire L. Pierce was the original Greenback nominee, but he declined the nomination.

zh.t: 1877年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1877年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任总检察长乔治·P·威尔逊击败民主党候选人约翰·R·琼斯、禁酒党候选人詹姆斯·E·柴尔德和绿背党候选人内森·C·马丁。斯奎尔·L·皮尔斯原是绿背党候选人，但他后来拒绝接受提名。

en.s: The 1877 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1877, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Governor John Marshall Stone ran for election to a first full term. Stone had become governor a year prior, after the resignation of Adelbert Ames.

zh.s: 1877年密西西比州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。现任州长约翰·马歇尔·斯通竞选首个完整任期。他在阿德尔伯特·艾姆斯辞职后于前一年接任州长。

en.s: The 1877 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1877, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent John S. Pillsbury was reelected to a second term.

zh.s: 1877年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。现任州长约翰·S·皮尔斯伯里连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1877 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6. Incumbent Republican governor Alexander H. Rice was re-elected to a third term in office over former governor William Gaston.

zh.s: 1877年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任州长亚历山大·H·赖斯击败前州长威廉·加斯顿，连任第三个任期。

en.s: The Battle of Pampa Germania was a cavalry battle of the Tarapacá campaign of the War of the Pacific that took place on November 6, 1879. In this battle, the Chilean cavalry led by Lieutenant Colonel José Francisco Vergara and Sofanor Parra ambush and massacre the allied cavalry commanded by Peruvian Lieutenant Colonel José Buenaventura Sepúlveda who was in the rear of the allied army, which had already undertaken their march to Dolores, in the Pampa Germania sector, near Agua Santa.

zh.s: 潘帕赫尔曼尼亚战役是太平洋战争塔拉帕卡战役的一场骑兵战，于1879年11月6日发生。智利骑兵由何塞·弗朗西斯科·维尔加拉中校和索法诺尔·帕拉率领，在潘帕赫尔曼尼亚地区、阿瓜圣塔附近伏击并屠杀了由秘鲁中校何塞·布埃纳文图拉·塞普尔韦达指挥的盟军骑兵。当时盟军已经启程前往多洛雷斯，塞普尔韦达的部队处于后方。

en.s: The 1879 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1879. Incumbent Democratic Governor John Lee Carroll did not seek re-election. Democratic candidate William Thomas Hamilton defeated Republican candidate James Albert Gary.

zh.s: 1879年11月6日举行马里兰州州长选举。时任民主党州长约翰·李·卡罗尔没有寻求连任。民主党候选人威廉·托马斯·汉密尔顿击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·艾伯特·加里。

en.s: The 1882 Newfoundland general election was held on November 6, 1882 to elect the members of the 14th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Newfoundland Colony. The Conservative Party led by William Whiteway was re-elected on a platform promising the continued development of the Newfoundland Railway. Much of the Opposition Party from the previous election had disintegrated, but Whiteway's remaining opponents coalesced around James J.

zh.s: 1882年纽芬兰大选于11月6日举行，选出纽芬兰殖民地第14届议会的议员。威廉·怀特威领导的保守党再次当选，其竞选纲领承诺继续开发纽芬兰铁路。上届选举后，反对党大部分瓦解；剩余反对派则联合在前财政总长詹姆斯·J·罗杰森周围，组建新党。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1883 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 6, 1883. Democrat Leon Abbett defeated Republican nominee Jonathan Dixon with 49.93% of the vote.

zh.s: 1883年11月6日举行新泽西州州长选举。民主党人利昂·阿贝特以49.93%的得票率击败共和党提名人乔纳森·迪克森。

en.s: The 1883 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1883, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican incumbent Charles A. Gilman defeated Democratic nominee Randolph L. Frazee and Prohibition Party nominee Cornelius B. Shove.

zh.s: 1883年11月6日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。共和党籍时任副州长查尔斯·A·吉尔曼击败民主党候选人伦道夫·L·弗雷泽和禁酒党候选人科尼利厄斯·B·肖夫。

en.s: The 1883 Maryland gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1883. Incumbent Democratic Governor William Thomas Hamilton did not seek re-election. Democratic candidate Robert Milligan McLane defeated Republican candidate Hart B. Holton.

zh.s: 1883年11月6日举行马里兰州州长选举。时任民主党州长威廉·托马斯·汉密尔顿没有寻求连任。民主党候选人罗伯特·米利根·麦克莱恩击败共和党候选人哈特·B·霍尔顿。

en.s: The 1883 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1883, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general William John Hahn defeated Democratic nominee John W. Willis and Prohibition nominee Francis Cadwell.

zh.t: 1883年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1883年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任总检察长威廉·约翰·哈恩击败民主党候选人约翰·W·威利斯和禁酒党候选人弗朗西斯·考德威尔。

en.s: The 1883 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1883, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Frederick Von Baumbach defeated Democratic nominee James J. Green and Prohibition nominee Edwin G. Paine.

zh.s: 1883年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人、时任州务卿弗雷德里克·冯·鲍姆巴赫击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·J·格林和禁酒党候选人埃德温·G·佩恩。

en.s: The 1883 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1883, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent governor Lucius Frederick Hubbard was elected to a second term.

zh.s: 1883年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。现任州长卢修斯·弗雷德里克·哈伯德当选，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1883 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6. Governor Benjamin Butler ran for re-election on a fusion ticket between the Democratic Party and the Greenback Labor Party, but was defeated by Republican U.S. Representative George D. Robinson. In the concurrent but separate election for lieutenant governor, Republican Oliver Ames was re-elected to a second term.

zh.s: 1883年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月6日举行。州长本杰明·巴特勒代表民主党和绿背劳工党组成的联合阵营竞选连任，但败给共和党籍美国众议员乔治·D·罗宾逊。同日另行举行的副州长选举中，共和党人奥利弗·艾姆斯连任第二个任期。

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1888 was the 26th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 6, 1888. It saw Grover Cleveland of New York, the incumbent president and a Democrat, try to secure a second term against the Republican nominee Benjamin Harrison, a former U.S. Senator from Indiana. The economy was prosperous and the nation was at peace, but Cleveland lost re-election in the Electoral College, even though he won a plurality of the popular vote by a narrow margin. Tariff policy was the principal issue in the election.

zh.s: 1888年美国总统选举是美国第26次四年一度总统选举，于11月6日星期二举行。时任总统、民主党人、纽约州人格罗弗·克利夫兰争取连任，对手是共和党候选人、本为印第安纳州联邦参议员的本杰明·哈里森。美国经济繁荣，局势和平，但克利夫兰在选举人团投票中失利，尽管他以微弱优势赢得普选票最多数。关税政策是选举的主要议题。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1888
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 6, 1888. All contemporary 38 states were part of the 1888 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 36 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by the Republican nominees, former Senator Benjamin Harrison of Indiana and his running mate former Congressman Levi P. Morton of New York. Harrison and Morton defeated the Democratic nominees, incumbent President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate former Senator Allen G. Thurman of Ohio.

zh.s: 1888年美国纽约州总统选举于11月6日举行。当时美国38个州均参与总统选举。纽约州选民选出36名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、本为印第安纳州联邦参议员的本杰明·哈里森，以及他的竞选搭档、纽约州前联邦众议员利瓦伊·莫顿在纽约州胜出。他们击败了民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、前联邦参议员艾伦·G·瑟曼。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1888
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic candidate, incumbent President Grover Cleveland over the Republican candidate, former U.S. Senator Benjamin Harrison.

zh.t: 美国弗吉尼亚州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，弗吉尼亚州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持民主党候选人、现任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，击败共和党候选人、前联邦参议员本杰明·哈里森。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 1888
en.s: Elections to the United States House of Representatives in Florida were held November 6, 1888 for the 51st Congress. These elections were held concurrently with the 1888 Presidential election and election for Governor.

zh.t: 美国佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，佛罗里达州举行联邦众议院选举，选出第51届国会的代表。选举与1888年总统选举和州长选举同时进行。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1888
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 6, 1888. Wisconsin voters chose eleven electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate Benjamin Harrison won the state with 50% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's eleven electoral votes.

zh.t: 美国威斯康星州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，威斯康星州举行总统选举。选民选出11名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森获得50%的普选票，赢得该州及全部11张选举人票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1888
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1888 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 6, 1888. Republicans and Democrats each swapped a district.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，选出该州在联邦众议院的代表。共和党和民主党各自从对方手中赢得一个选区。
