en.s: The 1888 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. John Peter Richardson III was renominated by the Democrats and was reelected for a second two-year term.

zh.t: 美国南卡罗来纳州州长选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行南卡罗来纳州州长选举。民主党再次提名约翰·彼得·理查森三世，他成功连任第二个两年任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1888
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose 30 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won Pennsylvania by a margin of 7.97%.

zh.t: 美国宾夕法尼亚州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，宾夕法尼亚州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出30名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州支持共和党提名人本杰明·哈里森，击败民主党提名人、现任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰。哈里森在该州领先7.97个百分点。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a narrow margin of 2.50%.

zh.t: 美国新罕布什尔州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，新罕布什尔州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以2.50个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of Indiana's own junior U.S. senator Benjamin Harrison and the former U.S. ambassador to France Levi P. Morton defeated the Democratic ticket of the incumbent president Grover Cleveland and the former U.S. senator from Ohio Allen G. Thurman.

zh.t: 美国印第安纳州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，印第安纳州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、印第安纳州本地人、该州资历较浅的联邦参议员本杰明·哈里森，与曾任美国驻法大使的利瓦伊·P·莫顿搭档，击败民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及来自俄亥俄州的前联邦参议员艾伦·G·瑟曼。

en.s: The 1888 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Incumbent Republican governor Oliver Ames was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Democratic mayor of Cambridge William Russell.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。时任共和党州长奥利弗·艾姆斯连任，开始第三个任期；他击败了民主党候选人、剑桥市市长威廉·罗素。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee's white citizenry was divided according to partisan loyalties established in that war.

zh.t: 美国田纳西州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，田纳西州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后一个多世纪里，田纳西州的白人选民仍按战争时期形成的党派立场分化。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Michigan voted for Republican nominees Benjamin Harrison of Indiana and his running mate Levi P. Morton of New York over Democratic incumbent Grover Cleveland.

zh.t: 美国密歇根州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，密歇根州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。密歇根州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森和他的竞选搭档、来自纽约州的利瓦伊·P·莫顿，击败民主党籍时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 10.89%.

zh.t: 美国罗得岛州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，罗得岛州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以10.89个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 10.94%.

zh.t: 美国俄勒冈州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，俄勒冈州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。俄勒冈州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以10.94个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1888 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1888, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Moses E. Clapp defeated Democratic nominee Charles d'Autremont, Prohibition nominee Charles E. Shannon and Union Labor nominee William Welch.

zh.t: 1888年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任总检察长摩西·E·克拉普击败民主党候选人查尔斯·德奥特蒙、禁酒党候选人查尔斯·E·香农和工党候选人威廉·韦尔奇。

en.s: The 1888 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Democratic nominee Daniel Gould Fowle defeated Republican nominee Oliver H. Dockery with 51.97% of the vote.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，北卡罗来纳州州长选举举行。民主党候选人丹尼尔·古尔德·福尔击败共和党候选人奥利弗·H·多克里，得票率为51.97%。

en.t: 1888 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1888 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 6, 1888, with three states holding theirs early between June and September. They occurred at the same time as the election of President Benjamin Harrison. Elections were initially held for 325 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 38 states, to serve in the 51st United States Congress.

zh.s: 1888年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月6日举行，有3个州在6月至9月间提前举行。选举与本杰明·哈里森当选总统同时进行。当时共有38个州，最初举行了325个联邦众议院席位的选举，这些议员将进入第51届国会。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison. Cleveland won the state by a landslide margin of 65.11 percentage points.

zh.t: 美国南卡罗来纳州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，南卡罗来纳州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州支持民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，胜过共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森。克利夫兰以65.11个百分点的压倒性优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose 16 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison. Cleveland won the state by a margin of 4.93%.

zh.t: 美国密苏里州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，密苏里州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出16名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。密苏里州支持民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，胜过共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森；克利夫兰以4.93个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 14.38 points.

zh.t: 美国科罗拉多州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，科罗拉多州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。科罗拉多州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以14.38个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1888 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Republican nominee Lyman U. Humphrey defeated Democratic nominee John Martin with 54.68% of the vote.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。共和党候选人莱曼·U·汉弗莱击败民主党候选人约翰·马丁，得票率为54.68%。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Jersey voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison. Cleveland won his birth state by a very narrow margin of 2.35%.

zh.t: 美国新泽西州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，新泽西州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。新泽西州支持民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，胜过共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森；克利夫兰以2.35个百分点的微弱优势赢得出生州新泽西。

en.s: The 1888 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 6, 1888, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee Edward T. Noland defeated Republican nominee A. B. Frowein, Union Labor nominee and former member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Warren Vertress and Prohibition nominee William H. Craig.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，密苏里州举行州财政部长选举。民主党候选人爱德华·T·诺兰击败共和党候选人A·B·弗劳因、工党候选人沃伦·维特雷斯（曾任明尼苏达州众议员）和禁酒党候选人威廉·H·克雷格。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Alabama was held on November 6, 1888, as part of the concurrent Presidential election in which all thirty-eight contemporary states participated. Alabama voters chose ten electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-president. Alabama was won easily by the Democratic nominee, former president and Governor of New York Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, former Indiana Senator Benjamin Harrison.

zh.t: 美国阿拉巴马州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，阿拉巴马州举行总统选举，作为同期举行的美国总统选举的一部分。当时美国38个州都参加了这次选举。阿拉巴马州选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、前总统兼纽约州州长格罗弗·克利夫兰轻松获胜，击败共和党候选人、前印第安纳州参议员本杰明·哈里森。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1888, in 26 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 6, 1888 (except in Alabama, Arkansas, Georgia, Louisiana, Maine, Rhode Island and Vermont, which held early elections). In New Hampshire, the newly elected Governor's term began in the June following the election for the last time.

zh.s: 1888年，美国26个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院、联邦参议院和总统选举同日举行，即11月6日；阿拉巴马州、阿肯色州、佐治亚州、路易斯安那州、缅因州、罗得岛州和佛蒙特州提前举行。新罕布什尔州当选州长的任期在次年6月开始，这也是最后一次如此安排。

en.s: The 1888 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Republican nominee William D. Hoard defeated Democratic nominee James Morgan and two other candidates with 49.53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举。共和党候选人威廉·D·霍尔德击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·摩根和另外两名候选人，得票率为49.53%。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 18.14%.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，缅因州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。缅因州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以18.14个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 13.76%.

zh.t: 美国内布拉斯加州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，内布拉斯加州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。内布拉斯加州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以13.76个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 6, 1888. All contemporary thirty-eight states were part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose thirteen electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president.

zh.t: 美国肯塔基州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，肯塔基州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。当时美国38个州都参加了这次选举。肯塔基州选出13名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1888 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Republican nominee Job Adams Cooper defeated Democratic nominee Thomas M. Patterson with 53.84% of the vote.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。共和党候选人乔布·亚当斯·库珀击败民主党候选人托马斯·M·帕特森，得票率为53.84%。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison. Cleveland won the state by a large margin of 46.91%.

zh.t: 美国路易斯安那州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，路易斯安那州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。路易斯安那州支持民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，胜过共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森；克利夫兰以46.91个百分点的大幅优势获胜。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by the incumbent President Grover Cleveland (D–New York), running with the former Senator and Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Ohio Allen G.

zh.t: 1888年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1888年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。州选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰与搭档、前参议员兼俄亥俄州最高法院首席大法官艾伦·G·瑟曼获得49.35%的普选票；共和党候选人、本杰明·哈里森与搭档利瓦伊·P·莫顿获得49.03%。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Vermont voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won Vermont by a margin of 43.40%.

zh.t: 美国佛蒙特州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，佛蒙特州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以43.40个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in California was held on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As was standard practice at the time, voters chose the electors directly on a general ticket.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，加利福尼亚州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。按照当时的惯例，选民在全州范围内直接投票选出选举人。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Mississippi voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison. Cleveland won the state by a margin of 47.81%.

zh.t: 1888年美国密西西比州总统选举
zh.s: 1888年美国密西西比州总统选举于11月6日举行，是1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。密西西比州支持民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，胜过共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森。克利夫兰以47.81个百分点的差距赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Minnesota voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 14.47%.

zh.t: 美国明尼苏达州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。明尼苏达州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以14.47个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 7.85%.

zh.t: 美国艾奥瓦州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，艾奥瓦州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。艾奥瓦州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以7.85个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. State voters chose 23 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was narrowly won by Republican Party candidate, Benjamin Harrison, with 49.51% of the popular vote. The Democratic Party candidate, incumbent President Grover Cleveland, garnered 47.18% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国俄亥俄州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，俄亥俄州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出23名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森以微弱优势赢得俄亥俄州，得票率为49.51%；民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰的得票率为47.18%。

en.s: The 1888 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Republican nominee Cyrus G. Luce defeated Fusion candidate Wellington R. Burt with 49.20% of the vote.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。共和党候选人赛勒斯·G·卢斯击败融合党候选人惠灵顿·R·伯特，得票率为49.20%。

en.s: The 1888 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1888, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Hans Mattson defeated Democratic nominee William Bredenhagen, Prohibition nominee Peter Thompson and Union Labor nominee John P. Schoenbeck.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人、时任州务卿汉斯·马特森击败民主党候选人威廉·布雷登哈根、禁酒党候选人彼得·汤普森和工党候选人约翰·P·舍恩贝克。

en.s: The 1888 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Democratic nominee Francis P. Fleming defeated Republican nominee V. J. Shipman with 60.37% of the vote. Republican candidate Volney Job Shipman was a Union Army officer who mustered out due to injury and settled in Iowa before moving to Florida for health considerations. He established the town of Lawtey, Florida and was involved in agricultural pursuits.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行佛罗里达州州长选举。民主党候选人弗朗西斯·P·弗莱明击败共和党候选人V·J·希普曼，得票率为60.37%。沃尔尼·乔布·希普曼是共和党候选人，也是一名曾在联邦军服役的军官，因伤退役后定居艾奥瓦州，之后为了健康迁居佛罗里达州。他建立了劳特伊镇，并从事农业。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arkansas voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison. Cleveland won the state by a margin of 16.76%.

zh.t: 美国阿肯色州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，阿肯色州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。阿肯色州支持民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，胜过共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森；克利夫兰以16.76个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Florida took place on November 6, 1888. All contemporary 38 states were part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Florida voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Florida was won by the Democratic nominees, incumbent President Grover Cleveland of New York and his running mate Allen G. Thurman of Ohio.

zh.t: 美国佛罗里达州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，佛罗里达州举行总统选举。当时美国38个州都参加了1888年美国总统选举。佛罗里达州选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自纽约州的时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰及其竞选搭档、来自俄亥俄州的艾伦·G·瑟曼赢得佛罗里达州。

en.s: The 1888 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1888, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee Alexander A. Lesueur defeated Republican nominee F. W. Mott, Union Labor nominee Boswell Fox and Prohibition nominee Herman P. Faris.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，密苏里州举行州务卿选举。民主党候选人亚历山大·A·勒叙尔击败共和党候选人F·W·莫特、工党候选人博斯韦尔·福克斯和禁酒党候选人赫尔曼·P·法里斯。

en.s: The 1888 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Republican nominee Joseph W. Fifer defeated Democratic nominee John M. Palmer with 49.15% of the vote.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。共和党候选人约瑟夫·W·菲弗击败民主党候选人约翰·M·帕尔默，得票率为49.15%。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. State voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Texas was won by the incumbent President Grover Cleveland (D–New York), running with the former Senator and Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Ohio Allen G.

zh.t: 1888年美国得克萨斯州总统选举
zh.s: 1888年美国得克萨斯州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。州选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰与搭档、前参议员兼俄亥俄州最高法院首席大法官艾伦·G·瑟曼获得65.70%的普选票；共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森获得24.73%，另有自由联盟候选人阿尔森·斯特里特。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland over the Republican nominee Benjamin Harrison.

zh.t: 美国康涅狄格州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，康涅狄格州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，胜过共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森。

en.s: The 1888 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on 6 November 1888 in order to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Illinois. Republican nominee Lyman Beecher Ray defeated Democratic nominee Andrew Jackson Bell and two other third party candidates.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，伊利诺伊州举行副州长选举。共和党候选人莱曼·比彻·雷击败民主党候选人安德鲁·杰克逊·贝尔和另外两名第三党候选人。

en.s: The 1888 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1888, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee John M. Wood defeated Republican nominee L. L. Bridges and Prohibition nominee George E. Bowling.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，密苏里州举行总检察长选举。民主党候选人约翰·M·伍德击败共和党候选人L·L·布里奇斯和禁酒党候选人乔治·E·鲍林。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maryland voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison. Cleveland won the state by a narrow margin of 2.94%.

zh.t: 美国马里兰州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，马里兰州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。马里兰州支持民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，胜过共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森；克利夫兰以2.94个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1888 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Republican nominee David H. Goodell defeated Democratic nominee Charles H. Amsden with 49.45% of the vote.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党候选人大卫·H·古德尔击败民主党候选人查尔斯·H·安斯登，得票率为49.45%。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Delaware voted for the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland, over the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison. Cleveland won the state by a margin of 11.55%.

zh.t: 美国特拉华州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，特拉华州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。特拉华州支持民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰，胜过共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森；克利夫兰以11.55个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Massachusetts voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 9.38%.

zh.t: 美国马萨诸塞州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，马萨诸塞州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出14名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以9.38个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1888 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888, and featured Republican nominee George de Rue Meiklejohn defeating Democratic nominee Frank Folda as well as Prohibition Party nominee John Dale and Union Labor nominee C. W. Potter.

zh.t: 1888年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。共和党候选人乔治·德·鲁·迈克尔约翰击败民主党候选人弗兰克·福尔达、禁酒党候选人约翰·戴尔和工党候选人C·W·波特。

en.s: The 1888 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Republican nominee Alvin Peterson Hovey defeated Democratic nominee Courtland C. Matson with 49.03% of the vote.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行印第安纳州州长选举。共和党候选人阿尔文·彼得森·霍维击败民主党候选人考特兰·C·马特森，得票率为49.03%。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 15.79%.

zh.t: 美国内华达州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，内华达州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。内华达州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以15.79个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1888 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Republican nominee Morgan Bulkeley defeated Democratic nominee Luzon B. Morris with 47.94% of the vote. This was the third (and last) consecutive gubernatorial election in which the Republican-controlled state legislature elected the candidate who received fewer votes. It was also the last such election to be determined by the state legislature.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。共和党候选人摩根·布尔克利击败民主党候选人卢宗·B·莫里斯，得票率为47.94%。这是连续第三次、也是最后一次出现这样的州长选举：共和党控制的州议会选出得票较少的候选人。此后，康涅狄格州州长选举不再由州议会决定。

en.s: The 1888 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor Albert E. Rice defeated Democratic nominee and former member of the Minnesota Senate Daniel Buck, Prohibition nominee Theodore S. Reimstad and Union Labor nominee Milan N. Pond.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行副州长选举。共和党候选人、时任副州长阿尔伯特·E·赖斯击败民主党候选人、前州参议员丹尼尔·巴克、禁酒党候选人西奥多·S·雷姆斯塔德和工党候选人米兰·N·庞德。

en.s: The 1888 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1888, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent State Treasurer of Missouri James M. Seibert defeated Republican nominee George W. Martin, Union Labor nominee William H. Noerr and Prohibition nominee James S. Cobban.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，密苏里州举行州审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任密苏里州财政部长詹姆斯·M·塞伯特击败共和党候选人乔治·W·马丁、工党候选人威廉·H·诺尔和禁酒党候选人詹姆斯·S·科班。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a margin of 24.20%.

zh.t: 美国堪萨斯州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，堪萨斯州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。堪萨斯州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以24.20个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1888 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Democratic nominee Stephen Hugh Claycomb defeated Republican nominee G. H. Wallace, Prohibition nominee William C. Wilson and Union Labor nominee J. C. Seabourn.

zh.s: 1888年11月6日，密苏里州举行副州长选举。民主党候选人斯蒂芬·休·克莱科姆击败共和党候选人G·H·华莱士、禁酒党候选人威廉·C·威尔逊和工党候选人J·C·西伯恩。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 11 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. North Carolina was won by the incumbent President Grover Cleveland (D–New York), running with the former Senator and Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Ohio Allen G.

zh.t: 1888年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1888年美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州选民选出11名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党籍时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰与搭档、前参议员约瑟夫·T·罗宾逊获得51.79%的普选票；共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森与搭档利瓦伊·P·莫顿获得47.20%。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the 1888 United States presidential election. Voters chose 22 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Illinois voted for the Republican nominee, Benjamin Harrison, over the Democratic nominee, incumbent President Grover Cleveland. Harrison won the state by a narrow margin of 2.96%.

zh.t: 美国伊利诺伊州总统选举，1888
zh.s: 1888年11月6日，伊利诺伊州举行总统选举，作为1888年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出22名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。伊利诺伊州支持共和党候选人本杰明·哈里森，胜过民主党候选人、时任总统格罗弗·克利夫兰；哈里森以2.96个百分点的微弱优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1888 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888. Incumbent Democratic governor Robert Love Taylor defeated Republican nominee Samuel W. Hawkins with 51.78% of the vote.

zh.s: 1888年田纳西州州长选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任州长罗伯特·洛夫·泰勒以51.78%的选票击败共和党提名人塞缪尔·W·霍金斯。

en.s: The 1888 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, Mayor of St. Louis David R. Francis, over the Republican candidate Elbert E. Kimball, Union Labor candidate Ahira Manring, and Prohibition candidate Frank M. Lowe.

zh.s: 1888年密苏里州州长选举于11月6日举行。民主党提名人、圣路易斯市长戴维·R·弗朗西斯获胜，击败共和党候选人埃尔伯特·E·金博尔、工会劳工党候选人阿希拉·曼林和禁酒党候选人弗兰克·M·洛。

en.s: An election for Mayor of New York City was held on November 6, 1888. Incumbent mayor Abram Hewitt, who had fallen out of favor with the Tammany Hall machine, ran on the reformist "New York County Democracy" ticket, but was defeated by Tammany favorite Hugh J. Grant. Hewitt finished third, narrowly behind Republican candidate Joel Erhardt.

zh.s: 纽约市于1888年11月6日举行市长选举。现任市长亚伯拉罕·休伊特因失去坦慕尼协会政治集团的支持，代表改革派“纽约县民主党”参选，但败给坦慕尼协会支持的休·J·格兰特。休伊特排名第三，略低于共和党候选人乔尔·埃哈特。

en.s: The 1888 New York state election was held on November 6, 1888, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor and a judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly.

zh.s: 1888年纽约州选举于11月6日举行，选出州长、副州长、纽约州上诉法院法官以及纽约州众议院全体议员。

en.s: The 1888 West Virginia gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1888, to elect the governor of West Virginia. The Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia ruled that outgoing governor Emmanuel Willis Wilson would remain governor; State Senate President Robert S. Carr had claimed authority until the Court reached its decision. In 1890, the Legislature agreed that Fleming had defeated Nathan Goff, Jr.

zh.s: 1888年西弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。西弗吉尼亚州上诉法院裁定，卸任州长伊曼纽尔·威利斯·威尔逊将继续留任；州参议院议长罗伯特·S·卡尔此前曾声称，在法院作出裁决前应由他行使州长职权。1890年，州议会同意弗莱明击败了内森·戈夫。

en.t: 1888 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1888 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 6, 1888, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following Reconstruction, Georgia would be the first former Confederate state to substantially disenfranchise its newly enfranchised freedmen and many poor whites, doing so in the early 1870s.

zh.s: 1888年佐治亚州美国总统选举于11月6日举行，是美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名代表或选举人，组成选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，佐治亚州于19世纪70年代初大幅剥夺新近获得公民权的获释奴隶和许多贫困白人的投票权，成为首个这样做的前邦联州。

en.s: The 1888 Minnesota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1888, to elect the governor of Minnesota. Incumbent Andrew Ryan McGill was not not nominated for a second term. Republican William Rush Merriam was elected.

zh.s: 1888年明尼苏达州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。现任州长安德鲁·瑞安·麦吉尔未获提名竞选第二个任期。共和党人威廉·拉什·梅里亚姆当选。

en.s: The 1888 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent governor Lawrence Sullivan Ross was re-elected to a second term in a landslide over Francis Marion Martin, running on a fusion opposition ticket.

zh.s: 1888年得克萨斯州州长选举旨在选出该州州长。民主党籍时任州长劳伦斯·沙利文·罗斯以压倒性优势击败融合反对派候选人弗朗西斯·马里恩·马丁，成功连任第二个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1889 Newfoundland general election was held on 6 November 1889 to elect members of the 16th General Assembly of Newfoundland in Newfoundland Colony. The Reform Party administration of Robert Thorburn was defeated in favour of the Liberal Party led by William Whiteway formed the government. Reform soon disappeared and was replaced by the Orange Order based Tory Party.

zh.s: 1889年纽芬兰大选于11月6日举行，选出纽芬兰殖民地第16届议会议员。罗伯特·索恩伯恩领导的改革党政府败给由威廉·怀特韦领导的自由党，后者组建政府。改革党很快消失，之后由橙色会支持的托利党取代。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 6 November 1892, with a second round of voting on 13 November. The "ministerial" left-wing bloc emerged as the largest in Parliament, winning 323 of the 508 seats. The electoral system reverted to the pre-1882 method of using single-member constituencies with second round run-offs.

zh.s: 1892年11月6日举行意大利大选，11月13日进行第二轮投票。由政府支持的左翼联盟成为议会最大阵营，赢得508席中的323席。选举制度恢复1882年前的做法，采用单一议员选区，并在无人获得多数时举行第二轮投票。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1892 Wyoming gubernatorial special election was held on November 6, 1892. Republican Governor Francis E. Warren, who was elected in 1890, resigned several weeks into his term after being elected to the U.S. Senate by the state legislature, elevating Secretary of State Amos W. Barber to the governorship and triggering a special election for the balance of Warren's term.

zh.s: 1892年11月6日举行怀俄明州州长特别选举。共和党籍州长弗朗西斯·E·沃伦于1890年当选，随后在任职数周后辞职，因为他获州议会选举成为联邦参议员。州务卿阿莫斯·W·巴伯继任州长，因此举行特别选举，以选出剩余任期的州长。

en.s: The 1893 Newfoundland general election was held on November 6, 1893 to elect members of the 17th General Assembly of Newfoundland in Newfoundland Colony. Although the Liberals won the majority of seats, the Conservative party filed petitions against 15 elected Liberals and one Independent, James Murray, alleging election irregularities. The results of those elections were set aside by the Supreme Court of Newfoundland and the candidates were barred from seeking reelection.

zh.s: 1893年纽芬兰大选于11月6日举行，选出纽芬兰殖民地第17届议会议员。自由党虽然赢得多数席位，保守党仍对15名当选的自由党人和一名独立人士詹姆斯·默里提出选举请愿，指控选举违规。纽芬兰最高法院撤销了这些选举结果，并禁止相关候选人竞选连任。

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1894 occurred on November 6, 1894. Democratic candidate Daniel H. Hastings defeated Republican candidate William M. Singerly to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.t: 美国宾夕法尼亚州州长选举，1894
zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州州长选举。民主党候选人丹尼尔·H·黑斯廷斯击败共和党候选人威廉·M·辛格利，当选州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1894 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894, to elect a Governor of South Dakota. Republican Governor of South Dakota Charles H. Sheldon was re-elected, defeating Independent Isaac Howe, Democratic nominee Jasper A. Ward, and Prohibition Party nominee M. D. Alexander.

zh.t: 美国南达科他州州长选举，1894
zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行南达科他州州长选举。共和党籍州长查尔斯·H·谢尔登成功连任，击败独立候选人艾萨克·豪、民主党提名人贾斯珀·A·沃德和禁酒党提名人M·D·亚历山大。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1894
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1894 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 6, 1894. Republicans picked up three Democratic-held districts and the lone Populist open seat.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，1894
zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，选出该州在联邦众议院的代表。共和党从民主党手中赢得三个选区，并赢得人民党唯一一个空缺席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Florida, 1894
en.s: Elections to the United States House of Representatives in Florida were held on November 6, 1894, for two seats in the 54th Congress.

zh.t: 美国佛罗里达州联邦众议院选举，1894
zh.s: 1894年11月6日，佛罗里达州举行联邦众议院选举，选出第54届国会的两个席位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1894 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894 to select the governor of the state of South Carolina. John Gary Evans was nominated by the Democrats and became the 85th governor of South Carolina.

zh.t: 美国南卡罗来纳州州长选举，1894
zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行南卡罗来纳州州长选举。民主党提名约翰·加里·埃文斯，他当选南卡罗来纳州第85任州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1894 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1894. Republican Party of Minnesota incumbent Knute Nelson easily defeated People's Party challenger Sidney M. Owen and Democratic Party of Minnesota candidate George Loomis Becker.

zh.t: 美国明尼苏达州州长选举，1894
zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行明尼苏达州州长选举。明尼苏达州共和党籍现任州长克努特·纳尔逊轻松击败人民党挑战者西德尼·M·欧文和明尼苏达州民主党候选人乔治·卢米斯·贝克。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1894 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1894, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former member of the Minnesota House of Representatives Robert C. Dunn defeated Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Adolph Biermann, People's nominee Andrew L. Stromberg and Prohibition nominee Seth S. Johnson.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州审计长选举。共和党候选人、曾任州众议员的罗伯特·C·邓恩击败民主党候选人、时任审计长阿道夫·比尔曼、人民党候选人安德鲁·L·斯特龙伯格和禁酒党候选人塞思·S·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1894 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Republican nominee Roger Allin defeated People's Party nominee Elmer D. Wallace with 55.76% of the vote.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行北达科他州州长选举。共和党候选人罗杰·艾林击败人民党候选人埃尔默·D·华莱士，得票率为55.76%。

en.s: The 1894 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Republican lawyer Spencer G. Millard defeated Democratic Santa Cruz Mayor William T. Jeter with 43.22% of the vote.

zh.t: 1894年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举。共和党律师斯宾塞·G·米勒德击败民主党候选人、圣克鲁斯市长威廉·T·杰特，得票率为43.22%。

en.s: The 1894 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Republican nominee Owen Vincent Coffin defeated Democratic nominee Ernest Cady with 54.18% of the vote. Coffin defeated Samuel E. Merwin in the Republican primary.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。共和党候选人欧文·文森特·科芬击败民主党候选人欧内斯特·凯迪，得票率为54.18%。科芬此前在共和党初选中击败了塞缪尔·E·默温。

en.s: The 1894 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Republican nominee Charles A. Busiel defeated Democratic nominee Henry O. Kent with 55.98% of the vote.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党候选人查尔斯·A·布西尔击败民主党候选人亨利·O·肯特，得票率为55.98%。

en.s: The 1894 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894, and featured Republican nominee Robert E. Moore defeating Populist and Democratic fusion nominee James N. Gaffin as well as Straight Democratic (anti-Populist) nominee Rodney E. Dunphy and Prohibition Party nominee Belle G. Bigelow. Incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Thomas J. Majors did not run for reelection as lieutenant governor since he decided to seek the office of governor of Nebraska.

zh.t: 1894年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。共和党候选人罗伯特·E·摩尔击败民粹党与民主党联合提名的詹姆斯·N·加芬、反民粹派民主党候选人罗德尼·E·邓菲，以及禁酒党候选人贝尔·G·比格洛。时任副州长托马斯·J·梅杰斯没有竞选连任，转而竞选州长。

en.s: The 1894 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Republican nominee Albert McIntire defeated People's Party incumbent Davis Hanson Waite with 51.95% of the vote.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。共和党候选人阿尔伯特·麦金泰尔击败人民党籍时任州长戴维斯·汉森·韦特，得票率为51.95%。

en.s: The 1894 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Incumbent Republican Governor Lorenzo Crounse did not stand for re-election. Populist and Democratic fusion nominee Silas A. Holcomb defeated the Republican nominee, incumbent Lieutenant Governor of Nebraska Thomas Jefferson Majors.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。时任共和党州长洛伦佐·克劳恩斯没有竞选连任。民粹党与民主党联合提名的西拉斯·A·霍尔科姆击败共和党候选人、时任副州长托马斯·杰斐逊·梅杰斯。

en.s: The 1894 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Incumbent Republican Governor Frederic Greenhalge was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democratic former U.S. Representative John E. Russell.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。时任共和党州长弗雷德里克·格林哈尔格连任，开始第二个任期；他击败了民主党候选人、前联邦众议员约翰·E·罗素。

en.s: The 1894 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Incumbent Republican William J. McConnell defeated People's Party nominee James W. Ballantine with 41.51% of the vote.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行爱达荷州州长选举。时任共和党州长威廉·J·麦康奈尔击败人民党候选人詹姆斯·W·巴兰坦，得票率为41.51%。

en.s: The 1894 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1894, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee Albert Berg defeated Democratic nominee Charles J. Haines, People's nominee Peter J. Seberger and Prohibition nominee Charles O. Winger.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人阿尔伯特·伯格击败民主党候选人查尔斯·J·海恩斯、人民党候选人彼得·J·塞伯格和禁酒党候选人查尔斯·O·温格。

en.s: The 1894 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1894, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Henry W. Childs defeated Democratic nominee William Brackenridge, People's nominee and former member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Minnesota's 3rd district John L. MacDonald and Prohibition nominee Robert Taylor.

zh.t: 1894年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1894年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任总检察长亨利·W·柴尔兹击败民主党候选人威廉·布拉肯里奇、人民党候选人约翰·L·麦克唐纳（曾任明尼苏达州第三选区联邦众议员）和禁酒党候选人罗伯特·泰勒。

en.s: The 1894 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor David Marston Clough defeated People's nominee Edwin E. Lommen, Democratic nominee John Ludwig and Prohibition nominee Charles M. Way.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行副州长选举。共和党候选人、时任副州长戴维·马斯顿·克拉夫击败人民党候选人埃德温·E·洛门、民主党候选人约翰·路德维希和禁酒党候选人查尔斯·M·韦。

en.s: The 1894 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 6, 1894, to elect members to the Senate of the 29th and 30th Minnesota Legislatures. The Minnesota Republican Party won a large majority of seats, followed by the new People's Party and the Minnesota Democratic Party. The new Legislature convened on January 8, 1895.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行参议院选举，选出第29届和第30届州议会议员。明尼苏达州共和党赢得多数席位，新成立的人民党和明尼苏达州民主党紧随其后。新一届州议会于1895年1月8日召开。

en.s: The 1894 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Incumbent Democratic Governor Robert J. Reynolds was barred from seeking a second term. Sussex County Clerk of the Peace Ebe W. Tunnell won the Democratic nomination to succeed Reynolds and faced businessman Joshua H. Marvil, the Republican nominee, in the general election. Though the Republican Party had long been dormant in the state, it had almost won the 1890 gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行特拉华州州长选举。时任民主党州长罗伯特·J·雷诺兹不能竞选第二个任期。苏塞克斯县治安书记埃比·W·塔内尔赢得民主党提名，接替雷诺兹，并在大选中面对共和党候选人、商人约书亚·H·马维尔。共和党长期以来在该州势弱，但在1890年州长选举中差点获胜。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1894, in 28 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 6, 1894 (except in Alabama, Arkansas, Georgia, Maine, Oregon, Rhode Island and Vermont, which held early elections). In New York, the governor was elected to a two-year term for the first time, instead of a three-year term.

zh.s: 1894年，美国28个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举同日举行，即11月6日；阿拉巴马州、阿肯色州、佐治亚州、缅因州、俄勒冈州、罗得岛州和佛蒙特州提前举行。纽约州州长的任期首次改为两年，此前为三年。

en.s: The 1894 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Incumbent Democratic Governor George Wilbur Peck was soundly defeated by Republican nominee William H. Upham. This election ushered in a four decade period of Republican dominance in Wisconsin politics as the nation as a whole transitioned to the Fourth Party System after the Panic of 1893 and the ensuing collapse of the Democratic Party's national coalition.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举。时任民主党州长乔治·威尔伯·佩克惨败于共和党候选人威廉·H·厄珀姆。这次选举开启了共和党在威斯康星州长达40年的主导时期。1893年恐慌及随后民主党全国联盟瓦解后，美国整体转向第四政党体制。

en.s: The 1894 Wyoming gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Democratic Governor John E. Osborne, first elected in the 1892 special election, declined to seek re-election to a second term, instead aiming to be elected to the U.S. Senate. In part because of a backlash against the Democratic Party owing to the Panic of 1893, Republicans won the governorship back from the Democrats, and would hold onto it until 1914.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行怀俄明州州长选举。民主党籍州长约翰·E·奥斯本于1892年特别选举中首次当选，他拒绝竞选连任，转而争取当选联邦参议员。1893年恐慌引发了选民对民主党的反弹，这也是共和党重新夺回州长职位的原因之一；共和党此后一直执政到1914年。

en.s: The 1894 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Incumbent Republican John T. Rich defeated Democratic candidate Spencer O. Fisher with 56.89% of the vote.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。时任共和党州长约翰·T·里奇击败民主党候选人斯宾塞·O·费舍尔，得票率为56.89%。

en.t: 1894 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The Wyoming United States House election for 1894 was held on November 6, 1894. Republican Frank Wheeler Mondell defeated Democratic incumbent Henry A. Coffeen and Populist Shakespeare E. Sealey with 52.64% of the vote making Coffeen the second incumbent Representative from Wyoming to lose reelection.

zh.t: 1894年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行怀俄明州联邦众议院选举。共和党候选人弗兰克·惠勒·蒙德尔以52.64%的得票率击败民主党籍时任众议员亨利·A·科芬和民粹党候选人莎士比亚·E·西利。科芬因此成为怀俄明州第二位连任失败的联邦众议员。

en.s: The 1894 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894, in the U.S. state of Nevada. Incumbent Republican Governor Roswell K. Colcord did not stand for re-election. Silver Party nominee John Edward Jones defeated Republican nominee Abner Coburn Cleveland, Populist nominee George Peckham, and Democratic nominee Theodore Winters with 49.87% of the vote.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日，内华达州举行州长选举。时任共和党州长罗斯韦尔·K·科尔科德没有竞选连任。银党候选人约翰·爱德华·琼斯以49.87%的得票率击败共和党候选人阿布纳·科伯恩·克利夫兰、民粹党候选人乔治·佩克汉姆和民主党候选人西奥多·温特斯。

en.s: The 1894 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Republican nominee Edmund Needham Morrill defeated People's Party incumbent Lorenzo D. Lewelling with 49.53% of the vote.

zh.s: 1894年11月6日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。共和党候选人埃德蒙·尼德姆·莫里尔击败人民党籍时任州长洛伦佐·D·卢埃林，得票率为49.53%。

en.s: An election for Mayor of New York City was held on November 6, 1894. Incumbent mayor Thomas Francis Gilroy, whose administration had been severely weakened by the Lexow Committee investigations, was not a candidate for a second term. William Lafayette Strong, a reformist banker, easily defeated former mayor Hugh J. Grant to succeed Gilroy.

zh.s: 纽约市于1894年11月6日举行市长选举。现任市长托马斯·弗朗西斯·吉尔罗伊的政府因莱索委员会调查而严重受损，他没有竞选第二个任期。改革派银行家威廉·拉斐特·斯特朗轻松击败前市长休·J·格兰特，接替吉尔罗伊。

en.s: The 1894 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894. Incumbent Democratic governor Peter Turney defeated former congressman and Republican nominee Henry Clay Evans with 45.06% of the vote. Henry Clay Evans had been gerrymandered out of office for supporting the Lodge Bill. Though Turney painted Evans as a "carpetbagger," Evans ran an effective campaign, and the initial vote tally on election day indicated Evans had won with 105,104 votes to 104,356 for Turney, and 23,088 for Populist candidate A.J.

zh.s: 1894年田纳西州州长选举于11月6日举行。民主党籍时任州长彼得·特尼击败前联邦众议员、共和党候选人亨利·克莱·埃文斯，获得45.06%的选票。埃文斯曾因支持《洛奇法案》而被重新划分选区，失去原有席位。特尼将埃文斯描绘成“北方佬”，但埃文斯竞选表现出色。初步计票显示埃文斯以105,104票获胜，特尼获104,356票，民粹党候选人A·J·米姆斯获23,088票。然而，民主党控制的州议会宣称存在选举舞弊，并作废了超过23,000票，最终让特尼以约2,000票优势胜出。

en.s: The 1894 New York state election was held on November 6, 1894, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor and a judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly. Besides, a new State Constitution and four other constitutional amendments were proposed to the electorate, and were all accepted.

zh.s: 1894年纽约州选举于11月6日举行，选出州长、副州长、纽约州上诉法院法官以及纽约州众议院全体议员。此外，选民还就新州宪法和另外4项宪法修正案进行表决，全部获得通过。

en.s: The 1894 California gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1894, to elect the governor of California. Democratic former Congressman James Budd narrowly defeated Republican lawyer Morris M. Estee. Estee had previously run for governor in 1882, losing the prior election in a landslide. This was the seventh time in the previous eight gubernatorial elections that the incumbent party was ousted from the governorship.

zh.s: 1894年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。民主党前众议员詹姆斯·巴德以微弱优势击败共和党律师莫里斯·M·埃斯蒂。埃斯蒂此前曾于1882年竞选州长，但以悬殊差距落败。在此前8次州长选举中，这是现任政党第7次失去州长职位。

en.s: The 1894 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. Attorney General Charles Culberson was elected Governor with a plurality of the vote over Populist candidate Thomas Nugent.

zh.s: 1894年得克萨斯州州长选举旨在选出该州州长。总检察长查尔斯·卡尔伯森以多数票当选州长，胜过民粹党候选人托马斯·纽根特。

en.s: The Bolivian Civil War, also known as the Federal War (Spanish: Guerra Federal) was a civil war in Bolivia fought from 1898 to 1899. The war saw two factions, a conservative side supported by the political, economic and religious elite of the country with control of the armed forces and who defended a unitary state, and a liberal faction opposed to the policies set by the state and that intended to transform the country into a federation, with support of the peasantry, the indigenous peoples and small Catholic businesses.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 玻利维亚内战又称联邦战争，是1898年至1899年在玻利维亚发生的内战。交战双方一方是由该国政治、经济和宗教精英支持、控制武装力量并主张单一制国家的保守派；另一方是反对政府政策、希望将国家改为联邦制的自由派，后者得到农民、原住民和小型天主教商户的支持。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1900
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 6, 1900 throughout 45 states. Voters chose 32 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan. McKinley won Pennsylvania by a landslide margin of 24.31% in this rematch of the 1896 presidential election. The return of economic prosperity and recent victory in the Spanish–American War helped McKinley to score a decisive victory.

zh.t: 1900年美国宾夕法尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1900年美国总统选举于11月6日在45个州举行，宾夕法尼亚州也参与了选举。该州选民选出32名代表，也就是选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、总统威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、前联邦众议员及1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩。麦金莱在宾夕法尼亚州以24.31个百分点的优势大胜；经济复苏和最近赢得美西战争帮助他在全国取得决定性胜利。

en.t: United States presidential election in Montana, 1900
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Montana took place on November 6, 1900, throughout 45 states. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Montana overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan, over the Republican nominee, President William McKinley. Bryan won Montana by a landslide margin of 18.64% in this rematch of the 1896 presidential election. The return of economic prosperity and recent victory in the Spanish–American War helped McKinley more than double his votes from the previous election, but he still lost decisively.

zh.s: 1900年美国蒙大拿州总统选举于11月6日在45个州举行期间进行。该州选民选出3名代表，也就是选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。蒙大拿州以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人、前联邦众议员及1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩，击败共和党候选人、总统威廉·麦金莱。布赖恩在蒙大拿州以18.64个百分点的优势大胜。经济复苏和最近赢得美西战争让麦金莱的票数较上次选举翻倍以上，但他仍以明显差距落败。

en.t: United States presidential election in Missouri, 1900
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 6, 1900. Missouri voters chose 17 electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Republican President William McKinley against Democratic challenger William Jennings Bryan. Missouri voted for Democrat William Jennings Bryan, giving him 51.48% of the vote versus Republican William McKinley's 45.94%, a victory margin of 5.53%. While losing Missouri, McKinley nevertheless won the national election by a 6.13% margin. Notably, this was one of only two occasions in the 20th century that Missouri voted for a losing presidential candidate, the state often considered a political bellwether in that period.

zh.s: 1900年美国密苏里州总统选举于11月6日举行。密苏里州选民通过普选选出17名选举人，组成选举人团。共和党籍现任总统威廉·麦金莱与民主党挑战者威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩角逐。密苏里州支持民主党人布赖恩，他获得51.48%的选票，共和党人麦金莱获得45.94%，布赖恩领先5.53个百分点。麦金莱虽输掉密苏里州，仍以6.13个百分点的优势赢得全国选举。值得一提的是，这是20世纪密苏里州仅有的两次支持最终落败的总统候选人之一；当时该州常被视为政治风向标。

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1900
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 36 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Governor Theodore Roosevelt of New York. McKinley and Roosevelt defeated the Democratic nominees, former Congressman and 1896 presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate former Vice President Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.s: 1900年美国纽约州总统选举于11月6日举行。当时美国45个州均参与总统选举。纽约州选民选出36名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、现任总统威廉·麦金莱和竞选搭档、纽约州州长西奥多·罗斯福在纽约州获胜。他们击败了民主党候选人、前联邦众议员及1896年总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩，以及他的竞选搭档、前副总统阿德莱·史蒂文森一世。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1900 was the 29th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 6, 1900. The election was a re-match of the 1896 race between Republican candidate and incumbent President William McKinley and his Democratic challenger, William Jennings Bryan. The Republican Convention chose New York Governor Theodore Roosevelt as McKinley's running mate, since Vice-President Garret Hobart had died from heart failure in 1899. The return of economic prosperity and recent victory in the Spanish–American War for control of the Philippines helped McKinley to score a decisive victory, while Bryan's anti-imperialist stance and continued support for bimetallism attracted only limited support.

zh.s: 1900年美国总统选举是美国第29次四年一度总统选举，于11月6日星期二举行。共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱再次对阵民主党挑战者威廉·詹宁斯·布赖恩，重演1896年的竞选。共和党全国代表大会提名纽约州州长西奥多·罗斯福为麦金莱的竞选搭档，因为副总统加勒特·霍巴特已于1899年因心力衰竭去世。经济复苏以及美国在美西战争中取得胜利、控制菲律宾，帮助麦金莱获得决定性胜利；布赖恩反对帝国主义并继续支持双金属货币制，因此支持有限。

en.s: The 1900 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1900. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Samuel Rinnah Van Sant narrowly defeated incumbent Democratic Party of Minnesota Governor John Lind. This was the third of three successive elections in which Lind headed a coalition of the Democrats with the People's Party.

zh.t: 美国明尼苏达州州长选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行明尼苏达州州长选举。明尼苏达州共和党候选人塞缪尔·里纳·范桑特以微弱优势击败民主党籍现任州长约翰·林德。这是林德连续三次带领民主党与人民党组成联盟参选。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1900
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1900 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 6, 1900. California's seven-seat delegation remained all-Republican.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，选出该州在联邦众议院的代表。该州七个席位仍全部由共和党人获得。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1900 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900, to elect a Governor of South Dakota to a two-year term. Incumbent Fusion Party member Andrew E. Lee was ineligible to run again due to term limits. Republican nominee Charles N. Herreid was elected, defeating Fusion Party candidate Burre H. Lien, Prohibition Party candidate F. J. Carlisle, and Populist L. E. Stair.

zh.t: 美国南达科他州州长选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行南达科他州州长选举，选出任期两年的州长。融合党籍现任州长安德鲁·E·李受任期限制，不能再次参选。共和党提名人查尔斯·N·赫里德当选，击败融合党候选人伯尔·H·连、禁酒党候选人F·J·卡莱尔和人民党候选人L·E·斯泰尔。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1900
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Democratic candidate, former U.S. Representative William J. Bryan over the Republican candidate, incumbent President William McKinley. Bryan won the state by a margin of 11.47%.

zh.t: 美国弗吉尼亚州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，弗吉尼亚州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持民主党候选人、前联邦众议员威廉·J·布莱恩，击败共和党候选人、现任总统威廉·麦金莱。布莱恩领先11.47个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in Wisconsin, 1900
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Wisconsin was held on November 6, 1900. Wisconsin voters chose twelve electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Republican Party candidate William McKinley won the state with 60% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's twelve electoral votes.

zh.t: 美国威斯康星州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，威斯康星州举行总统选举。选民选出12名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人威廉·麦金莱获得60%的普选票，赢得该州及全部12张选举人票。

en.s: The Battle of Bothaville (Doornkraal) on 6 November 1900 was a rare defeat of Christiaan de Wet's Boer commando at the hands of a force of British Mounted Infantry (MI).

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，博塔维尔（多恩克拉尔）战役中，克里斯蒂安·德·韦特的布尔突击队罕见地败给英国骑乘步兵部队。
