en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. In its early days as a state, Colorado had, like the Plains States to its east, been solidly Republican.

zh.t: 美国科罗拉多州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，科罗拉多州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了1900年美国总统选举。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。科罗拉多州建州初期，与其东部的大平原州一样，一直坚定支持共和党。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan.

zh.t: 美国康涅狄格州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，康涅狄格州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、前联邦众议员和1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Delaware was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国特拉华州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，特拉华州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。特拉华州选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、来自纽约州的西奥多·罗斯福赢得特拉华州。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国内布拉斯加州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，内布拉斯加州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、来自纽约州的西奥多·罗斯福赢得内布拉斯加州。

en.s: The 1900 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 6, 1900, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee Robert P. Williams defeated Republican nominee William S. Fleming, Social Democratic nominee William M. Brandt, Prohibition nominee Samuel S. Allen, People's Progressive nominee DeWitt C. Fuller and Socialist Labor nominee H. M. Graber.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，密苏里州举行州财政部长选举。民主党候选人罗伯特·P·威廉姆斯击败共和党候选人威廉·S·弗莱明、社会民主党候选人威廉·M·布兰特、禁酒党候选人塞缪尔·S·艾伦、人民进步党候选人德威特·C·富勒和社会主义工党候选人H·M·格雷伯。

en.s: The 1900 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Incumbent Republican Heber M. Wells defeated Democratic nominee James H. Moyle with 51.98% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行犹他州州长选举。时任共和党州长希伯·M·威尔斯击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·H·莫伊尔，得票率为51.98%。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. North Dakota was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国北达科他州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，北达科他州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档西奥多·罗斯福赢得北达科他州。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 6, 1900. Florida voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-president. The anti-Southern animus of the Harrison presidency meant Florida's large landowners felt the disfranchisement of blacks was urgent by 1889. A poll tax was introduced in 1889 as were the so-called “Myers” and “Dortch” laws which required voters in more populous settlements to register their voting precincts.

zh.t: 美国佛罗里达州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，佛罗里达州举行总统选举。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。哈里森执政时期反南方情绪高涨，到1889年，佛罗里达州的大地主认为剥夺黑人选举权已迫在眉睫。该州于1889年引入人头税，还通过了所谓的“迈尔斯法”和“多奇法”，要求人口较多地区的选民登记自己的投票选区。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Nevada was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 美国内华达州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，内华达州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、来自伊利诺伊州的阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得内华达州。

en.s: The 1900 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1900, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and former member of the Minnesota Senate Peter E. Hanson defeated Democratic nominee Michael E. Neary and Prohibition nominee Frank E. Carlisle.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人、曾任州参议员的彼得·E·汉森击败民主党候选人迈克尔·E·尼里和禁酒党候选人弗兰克·E·卡莱尔。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Oregon voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. A return to prosperity, continued American expansion in the Philippines, and the fading of the Populist revolt that had spread into Southern Oregon during the previous decade ensured that incumbent President William McKinley would not have any trouble carrying the state.

zh.t: 美国俄勒冈州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，俄勒冈州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。俄勒冈州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。经济恢复繁荣、美国继续向菲律宾扩张，以及前十年席卷俄勒冈州南部的民粹主义运动逐渐消退，都让时任总统威廉·麦金莱轻松赢得该州。

en.s: The 1900 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1900, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general Edward Coke Crow defeated Republican nominee Samuel F. O'Fallon, Social Democratic nominee John F. Delaney, Prohibition nominee Lewis G. Adams and People's Progressive nominee Zachary Taylor.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，密苏里州举行总检察长选举。民主党候选人、时任总检察长爱德华·科克·克劳击败共和党候选人塞缪尔·F·奥法伦、社会民主党候选人约翰·F·德莱尼、禁酒党候选人刘易斯·G·亚当斯和人民进步党候选人扎卡里·泰勒。

en.s: The 1900 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Democratic nominee James Bradley Orman defeated Republican nominee Frank C. Goudy with 53.78% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。民主党候选人詹姆斯·布拉德利·奥曼击败共和党候选人弗兰克·C·古迪，得票率为53.78%。

en.s: The 1900 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Incumbent Democratic governor Benton McMillin defeated Republican nominee John E. McCall with 53.86% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行田纳西州州长选举。时任民主党州长本顿·麦克米林击败共和党候选人约翰·E·麦考尔，得票率为53.86%。

en.s: The 1900 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900, in all 92 counties in the state of Indiana. Governor James A. Mount could not succeed himself to a second term. Winfield T. Durbin was elected governor over his Democratic opponent, John W. Kern. Mount died from a heart-attack just 2 days after Durbin's inauguration.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，印第安纳州92个县都举行了州长选举。州长詹姆斯·A·芒特无法连任。温菲尔德·T·德宾击败民主党候选人约翰·W·克恩，当选州长。德宾就职仅两天后，芒特便因心脏病发作去世。

en.s: The 1900 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Incumbent Republican Governor John Riley Tanner retired in order to unsuccessfully run for U.S. Senate. Republican nominee Richard Yates Jr. defeated Democratic nominee Samuel Alschuler with 51.49% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。时任共和党州长约翰·赖利·坦纳退休，转而竞选联邦参议员，但没有成功。共和党候选人理查德·耶茨二世击败民主党候选人塞缪尔·阿尔舒勒，得票率为51.49%。

en.s: The 1900 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Democratic nominee Frank W. Hunt defeated Republican nominee D. W. Standrod with 50.87% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行爱达荷州州长选举。民主党候选人弗兰克·W·亨特击败共和党候选人D·W·斯坦德罗德，得票率为50.87%。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 美国密歇根州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，密歇根州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出14名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose 23 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ohio was won by the Republican Party candidate, incumbent president and Ohio native son William McKinley with 52.30% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国俄亥俄州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，俄亥俄州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出23名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任总统、俄亥俄州本地人威廉·麦金莱以52.30%的普选票赢得该州。

en.s: The 1900 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Democratic nominee William Sherman Jennings defeated Republican nominee Matthew B. MacFarlane with 80.98% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行佛罗里达州州长选举。民主党候选人威廉·谢尔曼·詹宁斯击败共和党候选人马修·B·麦克法兰，得票率为80.98%。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1900, in 34 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 6, 1900 (except in Alabama, Arkansas, Georgia, Louisiana, Maine, North Carolina, Rhode Island and Vermont, which held early elections). Alabama held its last gubernatorial election in August, while Rhode Island held its last in April.

zh.s: 1900年，美国34个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院、联邦参议院和总统选举同日举行，即11月6日；阿拉巴马州、阿肯色州、佐治亚州、路易斯安那州、缅因州、北卡罗来纳州、罗得岛州和佛蒙特州提前举行。阿拉巴马州最后一次在8月举行州长选举，罗得岛州最后一次在4月举行。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire decisively voted for the Republican nominee, President William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan.

zh.t: 美国新罕布什尔州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，新罕布什尔州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州以明显优势支持共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、前联邦众议员兼1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.s: The 1900 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Incumbent Republican William Eugene Stanley defeated People's Party nominee John W. Breidenthal with 52.25% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。时任共和党州长威廉·尤金·斯坦利击败人民党候选人约翰·W·布雷登塔尔，得票率为52.25%。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Vermont
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Vermont overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国佛蒙特州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，佛蒙特州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其来自纽约州的竞选搭档西奥多·罗斯福。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Kansas voters chose ten electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Kansas was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国堪萨斯州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，堪萨斯州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。堪萨斯州选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档西奥多·罗斯福赢得堪萨斯州。

en.s: The 1900 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Republican nominee Aaron T. Bliss defeated Democratic candidate William C. Maybury with 55.75% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。共和党候选人阿伦·T·布利斯击败民主党候选人威廉·C·梅伯里，得票率为55.75%。

en.s: The 1900 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1900, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Wallace B. Douglas defeated Democratic nominee Robert C. Saunders.

zh.t: 1900年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任总检察长华莱士·B·道格拉斯击败民主党候选人罗伯特·C·桑德斯。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 6, 1900. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Jersey overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan.

zh.t: 美国新泽西州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，新泽西州举行总统选举。选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。新泽西州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、前联邦众议员兼1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Kentucky was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan and his running mate, former Vice President Adlai Stevenson I.

zh.t: 美国肯塔基州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，肯塔基州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出13名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、前联邦众议员兼1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其竞选搭档、前副总统阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得肯塔基州。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Massachusetts overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan.

zh.t: 美国马萨诸塞州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，马萨诸塞州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、前联邦众议员兼1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.s: The 1900 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1900, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee Albert Otis Allen defeated Republican nominee William F. Bloebaum, Social Democratic nominee L. M. Richeson, Prohibition nominee Orange J. Hill, People's Progressive nominee Benjamin F. Allen and Socialist Labor nominee Charles Wippermann.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，密苏里州举行州审计长选举。民主党候选人阿尔伯特·奥蒂斯·艾伦击败共和党候选人威廉·F·布洛鲍姆、社会民主党候选人L·M·里奇森、禁酒党候选人奥兰治·J·希尔、人民进步党候选人本杰明·F·艾伦和社会主义工党候选人查尔斯·维珀曼。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose four representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan.

zh.t: 美国罗得岛州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，罗得岛州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、前联邦众议员兼1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.s: The 1900 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Republican nominee Robert M. La Follette defeated Democratic nominee Louis G. Bohmrich with 59.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举。共和党候选人罗伯特·M·拉福莱特击败民主党候选人路易斯·G·博姆里奇，得票率为59.83%。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee’s white population was divided according to partisan loyalties established in that war.

zh.t: 美国田纳西州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，田纳西州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出12名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后一个多世纪里，田纳西州的白人居民仍按战争时期形成的党派立场分化。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election held in each of the forty-five contemporary states. State voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，犹他州举行总统选举，作为在当时美国45个州举行的1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose six electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. West Virginia was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，西弗吉尼亚州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档、来自纽约州的西奥多·罗斯福赢得西弗吉尼亚州。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Mississippi was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 美国密西西比州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，密西西比州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其来自伊利诺伊州的竞选搭档阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得密西西比州。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for the President and Vice President. South Carolina overwhelmingly voted for the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan, over the Republican nominee, President William McKinley.

zh.t: 美国南卡罗来纳州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，南卡罗来纳州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州以压倒性优势支持民主党候选人、前联邦众议员兼1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩，击败共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱。

en.s: The 1900 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900, to elect the lieutenant governor of Minnesota. Incumbent Republican Lieutenant Governor Lyndon A. Smith defeated Democratic-People's nominee Thomas J. Meighen, Prohibition nominee C.B. Wilkinson and Midroad Populist nominee Erick G. Wallinder.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。时任共和党副州长林登·A·史密斯击败民主党与人民党联合提名的托马斯·J·米根、禁酒党候选人C·B·威尔金森和中路民粹党候选人埃里克·G·瓦林德。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，缅因州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。缅因州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱，击败民主党候选人、前联邦众议员兼1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Idaho was won by the Democratic nominees, William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 美国爱达荷州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，爱达荷州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其来自伊利诺伊州的竞选搭档阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得爱达荷州。

en.s: The 1900 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Missouri. Democratic nominee John Adams Lee defeated Republican nominee Ethelbert F. Allen, Social Democratic nominee Leon Greenbaum, Prohibition nominee Simpson Ely, People's Progressive nominee Abram Neff and Socialist Labor nominee J. F. Graber.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，密苏里州举行副州长选举。民主党候选人约翰·亚当斯·李击败共和党候选人埃塞尔伯特·F·艾伦、社会民主党候选人莱昂·格林鲍姆、禁酒党候选人辛普森·伊利、人民进步党候选人艾布拉姆·内夫和社会主义工党候选人J·F·格雷伯。

en.s: The 1900 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Republican nominee Chester B. Jordan defeated Democratic nominee Frederick E. Potter with 59.36% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党候选人切斯特·B·乔丹击败民主党候选人弗雷德里克·E·波特，得票率为59.36%。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Minnesota was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国明尼苏达州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档西奥多·罗斯福赢得明尼苏达州。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose 24 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Illinois was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国伊利诺伊州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，伊利诺伊州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出24名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其来自纽约州的竞选搭档西奥多·罗斯福赢得伊利诺伊州。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Arkansas was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 美国阿肯色州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，阿肯色州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其来自伊利诺伊州的竞选搭档阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得阿肯色州。

en.s: The 1900 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. It saw the reelection of incumbent Republican William Northcott.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州副州长选举，时任共和党副州长威廉·诺斯科特连任。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the incumbent president William McKinley and the governor of New York Theodore Roosevelt defeated the Democratic ticket of the former U.S. representative from Nebraska's 1st congressional district William Jennings Bryan and the former vice president Adlai Stevenson I.

zh.t: 美国印第安纳州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，印第安纳州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱和纽约州州长西奥多·罗斯福搭档，击败民主党候选人、曾任内布拉斯加州第一国会选区联邦众议员的威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及前副总统阿德莱·史蒂文森一世。

en.t: 1900 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1900 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 6, 1900, with Oregon, Maine, and Vermont holding theirs early in either June or September. They coincided with the re-election of President William McKinley. Elections were held for 357 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 45 states, to serve in the 57th United States Congress.

zh.s: 1900年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月6日举行，俄勒冈州、缅因州和佛蒙特州则在6月或9月提前举行。选举与威廉·麦金莱总统连任同时进行。共有45个州的357个联邦众议院席位进行选举，这些议员将进入第57届国会。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Washington was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国华盛顿州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，华盛顿州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。华盛顿州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其来自纽约州的竞选搭档西奥多·罗斯福赢得华盛顿州。

en.s: The 1900 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Republican nominee George P. McLean defeated Democratic nominee S. L. Bronson with 53.02% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。共和党候选人乔治·P·麦克莱恩击败民主党候选人S·L·布朗森，得票率为53.02%。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose four electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. South Dakota was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国南达科他州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，南达科他州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。南达科他州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档西奥多·罗斯福赢得南达科他州。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Following the overthrow of Reconstruction Republican government, Louisiana, like most of the former Confederacy, established a Democratic-dominated but highly fraudulent political system that would, from 1890, be challenged by the rise of the Populist Party due to declining conditions for farmers.

zh.t: 美国路易斯安那州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，路易斯安那州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。路易斯安那州选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。重建时期的共和党政府被推翻后，路易斯安那州与南方邦联的大多数前成员州一样，建立了由民主党主导、选举舞弊严重的政治体系。1890年起，由于农民处境恶化，民粹党崛起并开始挑战这一体系。

en.t: 1900 United States House of Representatives election in Hawaii Territory
en.s: On November 6, 1900 Hawaii elected their first representative. In 1898 Hawaii was annexed by the United States and became a territory in 1900. Robert William Wilcox won the election over former minister of affairs, Samuel Parker and prince David Kawānanakoa with 42.8% of the vote.

zh.t: 1900年夏威夷领地联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，夏威夷选出首位联邦众议员。夏威夷于1898年被美国吞并，并于1900年成为美国领地。罗伯特·威廉·威尔科克斯以42.8%的得票率击败前事务部长塞缪尔·帕克和王子戴维·卡瓦纳纳科阿，赢得选举。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose eleven electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Alabama was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 美国阿拉巴马州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，阿拉巴马州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。阿拉巴马州选出11名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其来自伊利诺伊州的竞选搭档阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得阿拉巴马州。

en.s: The 1900 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Incumbent Populist and Democratic fusion Governor William A. Poynter was defeated for re-election by Republican nominee Charles Henry Dietrich.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。民粹党与民主党联合执政的时任州长威廉·A·波因特在连任选举中败给共和党候选人查尔斯·亨利·迪特里希。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose 15 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Texas was won by the Democratic nominees, former U.S. Representative William Jennings Bryan of Nebraska and his running mate Adlai Stevenson I of Illinois.

zh.t: 美国得克萨斯州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，得克萨斯州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出15名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人、来自内布拉斯加州的前联邦众议员威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩及其来自伊利诺伊州的竞选搭档阿德莱·史蒂文森一世赢得得克萨斯州。

en.s: The 1900 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900, and featured Republican nominee Ezra P. Savage defeating incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Edward A. Gilbert, the Populist and Democratic fusion nominee. Other candidates who received two percent of the vote or less included Prohibition nominee Charles R. Lawson, Midroad Populist nominee Herman G. Reiter, and Social Democratic nominee David McKibben.

zh.t: 1900年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。共和党候选人埃兹拉·P·萨维奇击败民粹党与民主党联合提名的时任副州长爱德华·A·吉尔伯特。其他候选人得票率都不超过2%，包括禁酒党候选人查尔斯·R·劳森、中路民粹党候选人赫尔曼·G·赖特和社会民主党候选人大卫·麦基本。

en.s: The 1900 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1900, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee Sam Baker Cook defeated Republican nominee Walter L. Porterfield, Social Democratic nominee William H. Strife, Prohibition nominee Elbridge H. Benham, People's Progressive nominee Bernard Finn and Socialist Labor nominee Edward Heitzig.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日，密苏里州举行州务卿选举。民主党候选人萨姆·贝克·库克击败共和党候选人沃尔特·L·波特菲尔德、社会民主党候选人威廉·H·斯特赖夫、禁酒党候选人埃尔布里奇·H·本哈姆、人民进步党候选人伯纳德·芬和社会主义工党候选人爱德华·海齐希。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Maryland voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Maryland was won by the Republican nominees, incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国马里兰州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，马里兰州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。马里兰州选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、来自俄亥俄州的时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其竞选搭档西奥多·罗斯福赢得马里兰州。

en.s: The 1900 Montana gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Democratic nominee Joseph Toole defeated Republican nominee David S. Folsom and Independent Democrat nominee Thomas S. Hogan with 49.24% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行蒙大拿州州长选举。民主党候选人约瑟夫·图尔击败共和党候选人大卫·S·福尔瑟姆和独立民主党候选人托马斯·S·霍根，得票率为49.24%。

en.s: The 1900 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Republican nominee Frank White defeated Democratic nominee Max Wipperman with 59.20% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行北达科他州州长选举。共和党候选人弗兰克·怀特击败民主党候选人马克斯·维珀曼，得票率为59.20%。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in California took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Republican nominee, President William McKinley, over the Democratic nominee, former U.S. Representative and 1896 Democratic presidential nominee William Jennings Bryan.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，加利福尼亚州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州支持共和党候选人、时任总统威廉·麦金莱，胜过民主党候选人、前联邦众议员兼1896年民主党总统候选人威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Iowa was won by the Republican incumbent President William McKinley of Ohio and his running mate Theodore Roosevelt of New York.

zh.t: 美国艾奥瓦州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，艾奥瓦州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出13名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党籍时任总统威廉·麦金莱及其来自纽约州的竞选搭档西奥多·罗斯福赢得艾奥瓦州。

en.s: The 1900 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Though Governor Ebe W. Tunnell was eligible for re-election under the newly adopted 1897 constitution, the state convention ended up nominating Peter J. Ford, a prominent businessman. On the Republican side, the split from four years earlier threatened to divide the party once again. The Addicks and anti-Addicks Republicans nominated separate candidates for Governor.

zh.s: 1900年11月6日举行特拉华州州长选举。根据新通过的1897年宪法，州长埃比·W·塔内尔可以竞选连任，但州党代表大会最终提名了知名商人彼得·J·福特。共和党方面，四年前的分裂可能再次撕裂该党。阿迪克斯派和反阿迪克斯派共和党人分别提名了州长候选人。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the 1900 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 美国怀俄明州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，怀俄明州举行总统选举，作为1900年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 6, 1900. All contemporary 45 states were part of the 1900 United States presidential election. Voters chose 11 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. In the period between this election and that of 1896, North Carolina had seen the 1898 overthrow of its Populist/Republican fusion government by white Democrats in the Wilmington massacre.

zh.t: 美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举，1900
zh.s: 1900年11月6日，北卡罗来纳州举行总统选举。当时美国45个州都参加了这次总统选举。选民选出11名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。从1896年大选到本次选举期间，北卡罗来纳州白人民主党人在威尔明顿大屠杀中推翻了民粹党与共和党联合执政的政府。

en.s: The 1900 West Virginia gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1900, to elect the governor of West Virginia.

zh.s: 1900年西弗吉尼亚州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。

en.s: The 1900 Missouri gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900, and resulted in a victory for the Democratic nominee, former Congressman Alexander Monroe Dockery, over the Republican candidate Joseph Flory and several other candidates representing minor parties.

zh.s: 1900年密苏里州州长选举于11月6日举行。民主党提名人、前众议员亚历山大·门罗·多克里获胜，击败共和党候选人约瑟夫·弗洛里及代表多个小党的其他候选人。

en.s: The 1900 Kentucky gubernatorial special election was held on November 6, 1900. Incumbent Democratic governor J. C. W. Beckham was elected to complete William Goebel's term with 49.88% of the vote.

zh.s: 1900年肯塔基州州长特别选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任州长J·C·W·贝克汉姆以49.88%的选票当选，完成威廉·戈贝尔的任期。

en.s: The 1900 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1900. Incumbent Governor John Rankin Rogers won re-election as the Democratic nominee. He defeated Republican nominee John M. Frink with 48.86% of the vote. In 1896, Rogers was the fusion candidate of the Democratic, Populist and Silver Republican parties. In 1900, he was nominated by a unity convention which merged the three parties in the state and took the name of the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1900年华盛顿州州长选举于11月6日举行。现任州长约翰·兰金·罗杰斯作为民主党提名人成功连任，以48.86%的选票击败共和党提名人约翰·M·弗林克。1896年，罗杰斯是民主党、民粹党和银共和党的联合候选人。1900年，三党在该州通过统一大会合并，并采用民主党的名称提名他。

en.s: The 1900 New York state election was held on November 6, 1900, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the Secretary of State, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer and the state engineer, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1900年纽约州选举于11月6日举行，选出州长、副州长、州务卿、州审计长、总检察长、州财政部长和州工程师，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院全体议员。

en.t: 1900 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1900 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 6, 1900, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Following Reconstruction, Georgia would be the first former Confederate state to substantially disenfranchise its newly enfranchised freedmen and many poor whites, doing so in the early 1870s.

zh.s: 1900年佐治亚州美国总统选举于11月6日举行，是美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名代表或选举人，组成选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，佐治亚州于19世纪70年代初大幅剥夺新近获得公民权的获释奴隶和许多贫困白人的投票权，成为首个这样做的前邦联州。

en.s: The 1900 Texas gubernatorial election was held to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Governor Joseph D. Sayers was re-elected to a second term in office.

zh.s: 1900年得克萨斯州州长选举旨在选出该州州长。民主党籍时任州长约瑟夫·D·塞耶斯成功连任第二个任期。

en.t: President William McKinley is re-elected, along with his vice-presidential running mate, Governor Theodore Roosevelt of New York
en.s: William McKinley (January 29, 1843 – September 14, 1901) was the 25th president of the United States, serving from 1897 until his assassination in 1901. A member of the Republican Party, he led a realignment that made Republicans largely dominant in the industrial states and nationwide for decades. McKinley successfully led the U.S. in the Spanish–American War and oversaw a period of American expansionism, with the annexations of Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Philippines, and American Samoa.

zh.t: 威廉·麦金莱连任总统，纽约州州长西奥多·罗斯福也当选副总统
zh.s: 威廉·麦金莱（1843年1月29日—1901年9月14日）是美国第25任总统，任期为1897年至1901年。他是共和党成员，推动了美国政治格局重组，使共和党在工业州及全国范围内数十年占据主导地位。美西战争期间，麦金莱成功领导美国参战，并推动美国扩张，吞并了夏威夷、波多黎各、关岛、菲律宾和美属萨摩亚。

en.t: Anti-Qing revolutionary Tse Tsan-tai and British journalist Alfred Cunningham (克寧漢) founded the South China Morning Post in 1903, publishing its first issue on 6 November 1903
en.s: The South China Morning Post (SCMP), with its Sunday edition, the Sunday Morning Post, is a Hong Kong–based English-language newspaper owned by Alibaba Group. Founded in 1903 by Tse Tsan-tai and Alfred Cunningham, it has remained Hong Kong's newspaper of record since British colonial rule. Editor-in-chief Tammy Tam succeeded Wang Xiangwei in 2016. The SCMP prints paper editions in Hong Kong and operates an online news website that is blocked in mainland China.

zh.t: 反清革命者谢缵泰与英国记者克宁汉于1903年创办《南华早报》，首期于1903年11月6日出版
zh.s: 《南华早报》（SCMP）及其星期日版《星期日南华早报》是一份总部位于香港、由阿里巴巴集团拥有的英文报纸。报纸于1903年由谢缵泰和阿尔弗雷德·克宁汉创办。英国殖民统治时期以来，它一直是香港具有代表性的报纸。谭卫儿于2016年接替王向伟担任总编辑。《南华早报》在香港印刷纸质版，并运营一个在中国大陆遭屏蔽的新闻网站。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 6 November 1904, with a second round of voting on 13 November. The "ministerial" left-wing bloc remained the largest in Parliament, winning 339 of the 508 seats. The papal ban on Catholics voting was relaxed for the first time, and three Catholics were elected.

zh.s: 1904年11月6日举行意大利大选，11月13日进行第二轮投票。由政府支持的左翼联盟仍是议会最大阵营，赢得508席中的339席。教宗禁止天主教徒投票的禁令首次放宽，三名天主教徒当选。

en.s: The 1906 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906, to elect a Governor of South Dakota to a two-year term. The incumbent governor, Samuel H. Elrod, chose not to seek re-election. Republican nominee Coe I. Crawford was elected, defeating Democratic nominee John A. Stransky, Prohibition Party candidate Knute Lewis, and Socialist Party candidate Freeman Knowles.

zh.t: 美国南达科他州州长选举，1906
zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行南达科他州州长选举，选出任期两年的州长。现任州长塞缪尔·H·埃尔罗德决定不竞选连任。共和党候选人科·I·克劳福德当选，击败民主党候选人约翰·A·斯特兰斯基、禁酒党候选人克努特·刘易斯和社会党候选人弗里曼·诺尔斯。

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1906 occurred on November 6, 1906. Incumbent Republican governor Samuel W. Pennypacker was not a candidate for re-election. Republican candidate Edwin Sydney Stuart defeated Democratic candidate Lewis Emery, Jr. to become Governor of Pennsylvania.

zh.t: 美国宾夕法尼亚州州长选举，1906
zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长塞缪尔·W·潘尼帕克没有参选。共和党候选人埃德温·悉尼·斯图尔特击败民主党候选人刘易斯·埃默里二世，当选州长。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1906
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1906 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 6, 1906. All eight districts remained Republican.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，1906
zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，选出该州在联邦众议院的代表。八个选区均由共和党人胜出。

en.s: The 1906 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1906. Democratic Party of Minnesota candidate John Albert Johnson defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger A. L. Cole.

zh.t: 美国明尼苏达州州长选举，1906
zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行明尼苏达州州长选举。明尼苏达州民主党候选人约翰·艾伯特·约翰逊击败明尼苏达州共和党候选人A·L·科尔。

en.s: The 1906 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Incumbent Republican Governor John H. Mickey did not stand for re-election. Republican nominee George L. Sheldon defeated Democratic and Populist fusion nominee Ashton C. Shallenberger with 51.27% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。时任共和党州长约翰·H·米奇没有竞选连任。共和党候选人乔治·L·谢尔登击败民主党与民粹党联合提名的阿什顿·C·沙伦伯格，得票率为51.27%。

en.s: The 1906 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Incumbent Republican Edward W. Hoch defeated Democratic nominee William Alexander Harris with 48.24% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。时任共和党州长爱德华·W·霍克击败民主党候选人威廉·亚历山大·哈里斯，得票率为48.24%。

en.s: The 1906 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1906. Republican Party of Minnesota candidate Adolph Olson Eberhart defeated Minnesota Democratic Party challenger Lloyd G. Pendergast and Prohibition Party candidate Ole Lokensgaard.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。明尼苏达州共和党候选人阿道夫·奥尔森·埃伯哈特击败明尼苏达州民主党候选人劳埃德·G·彭德加斯特和禁酒党候选人奥勒·洛肯斯加德。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1906, in 28 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 6, 1906 (except in Arkansas, Georgia, Maine, Oregon and Vermont, which held early elections). In Iowa, the gubernatorial election was held in an even-numbered year for the first time, having previously been held in odd-numbered years. The previous election in this state took place in 1903.

zh.s: 1906年，美国28个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举同日举行，即11月6日；阿肯色州、佐治亚州、缅因州、俄勒冈州和佛蒙特州提前举行。艾奥瓦州首次在偶数年份举行州长选举，此前选举都在奇数年份。该州上一次州长选举于1903年举行。

en.s: The 1906 North Dakota gubernatorial election, sometimes called 'The Revolution of 1906' was held on November 6, 1906. This election marked a major shift in North Dakota politics as the incumbent, Republican Elmore Sarles, was defeated by a 53.20% majority vote for Democrat John Burke, who had garnered bipartisan support across the state of constituents tired of Sarles' administration, which was supported by the Republican political machine run by politician Alexander McKenzie.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行北达科他州州长选举，有时也称“1906年革命”。这次选举标志着北达科他州政局发生重大转变：时任共和党州长埃尔莫·萨尔斯以53.20%的得票率败给民主党候选人约翰·伯克。伯克获得该州选民跨党派支持，他们对萨尔斯的执政感到不满；萨尔斯的政府得到政治人物亚历山大·麦肯齐领导的共和党政治机器支持。

en.s: The 1906 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Incumbent Republican Albert B. Cummins defeated Democratic nominee Claude R. Porter with 50.18% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。时任共和党州长阿尔伯特·B·卡明斯击败民主党候选人克劳德·R·波特，得票率为50.18%。

en.t: 1906 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1906 United States House of Representatives elections were held for the most part on November 6, 1906, with Oregon, Maine, and Vermont holding theirs early in either June or September. They occurred in the middle of President Theodore Roosevelt's second term. Elections were held for 386 seats of the United States House of Representatives, representing 45 states, to serve in the 60th United States Congress (Oklahoma would later gain statehood in 1907 and increase the House membership to 391).

zh.s: 1906年美国联邦众议院选举大多于11月6日举行，俄勒冈州、缅因州和佛蒙特州则在6月或9月提前举行。选举发生在西奥多·罗斯福总统第二个任期期间。45个州的386个联邦众议院席位进行选举，这些议员将进入第60届国会。（俄克拉何马州于1907年成为州，届时众议院席位将增加到391个。）

en.s: The 1906 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Following the death of Senator William B. Bate in March 1905, governor James B. Frazier quickly convened the General Assembly and had himself elected to the vacant Senate seat. John I. Cox, who as speaker of the state senate was Frazier's constitutional successor (and who helped engineer Frazier's election in the General Assembly), then became governor.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行田纳西州州长选举。联邦参议员威廉·B·贝特于1905年3月去世后，州长詹姆斯·B·弗雷泽迅速召集州议会，并让议员推选自己填补参议院空缺。作为州参议院议长、依宪法继任州长的约翰·I·考克斯（他也帮助促成州议会选举弗雷泽）随后出任州长。

en.s: The 1906 Minnesota Senate election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 6, 1906, to elect members to the Senate of the 35th and 36th Minnesota Legislatures. The Minnesota Republican Party won a large majority of seats, followed by the Minnesota Democratic Party and the People's Party. The new Legislature convened on January 8, 1907. 31 Republicans and 4 Democrats were uncontested.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行参议院选举，选出第35届和第36届州议会议员。明尼苏达州共和党赢得多数席位，明尼苏达州民主党和人民党随后。新一届州议会于1907年1月8日召开。另有31名共和党人和4名民主党人没有对手。

en.s: The 1906 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Republican nominee Charles M. Floyd defeated Democratic nominee Nathan C. Jameson with 49.79% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党候选人查尔斯·M·弗洛伊德击败民主党候选人内森·C·詹姆森，得票率为49.79%。

en.s: The 1906 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1906, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee Julius A. Schmahl defeated Democratic nominee Peter M. Magnusson and Prohibition nominee Nels C. Hendricks.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人朱利叶斯·A·施马尔击败民主党候选人彼得·M·马格努森和禁酒党候选人内尔斯·C·亨德里克斯。

en.s: The 1906 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Primary elections were held on September 4, 1906. Incumbent Republican Governor James O. Davidson won re-election, defeating Democratic nominee John A. Aylward and Socialist nominee Winfield R. Gaylord, with 57.39% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举。初选于1906年9月4日举行。时任共和党州长詹姆斯·O·戴维森击败民主党候选人约翰·A·艾尔沃德和社会党候选人温菲尔德·R·盖洛德，得票率为57.39%，成功连任。

en.s: The 1906 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1906, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent attorney general Edward T. Young defeated Democratic nominee John Dwan.

zh.t: 1906年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1906年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任总检察长爱德华·T·杨击败民主党候选人约翰·德万。

en.s: The 1906 Wyoming gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Incumbent Republican Governor Bryant B. Brooks ran for re-election to a second term. After winning renomination against some intraparty challengers, he faced State Senator Stephen Keister in the general election. Brooks was ultimately able to win re-election by an overwhelming margin, setting a record for the largest majority in a state gubernatorial election, which would not be exceeded until Governor Stanley Hathaway's re-election in 1970.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行怀俄明州州长选举。时任共和党州长布莱恩特·B·布鲁克斯竞选连任。再次获得共和党提名后，他在大选中面对州参议员斯蒂芬·凯斯特。布鲁克斯最终以压倒性优势连任，创下州长选举最高多数票纪录；这一纪录直到1970年州长斯坦利·海瑟薇连任时才被打破。

en.s: The 1906 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1906. to elect the next Attorney General of Connecticut. Republican candidate and State Senator Marcus H. Holcomb defeated Democratic candidate William B. Stoddard.

zh.t: 1906年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行康涅狄格州总检察长选举。共和党候选人、州参议员马库斯·H·霍尔科姆击败民主党候选人威廉·B·斯托达德。

en.s: The 1906 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Republican nominee Rollin S. Woodruff defeated Democratic nominee Charles Frederick Thayer with 54.83% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。共和党候选人罗林·S·伍德拉夫击败民主党候选人查尔斯·弗雷德里克·塞耶，得票率为54.83%。

en.s: The 1906 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Incumbent Republican Fred M. Warner defeated Democratic candidate Charles H. Kimmerle with 60.88% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。时任共和党州长弗雷德·M·沃纳击败民主党候选人查尔斯·H·金默勒，得票率为60.88%。

en.s: The 1906 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906, and featured Republican nominee Melville R. Hopewell, defeating William H. Green, the Democratic and Populist fusion nominee, as well as Prohibition nominee J. D. Forsythe and Socialist nominee C. A. Howe.

zh.t: 1906年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。共和党候选人梅尔维尔·R·霍普韦尔击败民主党与民粹党联合提名的威廉·H·格林，以及禁酒党候选人J·D·福赛思和社会党候选人C·A·豪。

en.s: The 1906 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1906, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Samuel G. Iverson defeated Democratic nominee A. E. Aarnes.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州审计长选举。共和党候选人、时任审计长塞缪尔·G·艾弗森击败民主党候选人A·E·阿尔内斯。

en.s: The 1906 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Democratic nominee James H. Higgins defeated incumbent Republican George H. Utter with 49.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行罗得岛州州长选举。民主党候选人詹姆斯·H·希金斯击败时任共和党州长乔治·H·厄特，得票率为49.92%。

en.s: The 1906 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Republican nominee Henry Augustus Buchtel defeated Democratic nominee Alva Adams with 45.59% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。共和党候选人亨利·奥古斯塔斯·布赫特尔击败民主党候选人阿尔瓦·亚当斯，得票率为45.59%。

en.s: The 1906 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1906, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Democratic incumbent William D. Jelks was term-limited, and could not seek a second consecutive term.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行阿拉巴马州州长选举。时任民主党州长威廉·D·杰尔克斯受任期限制，不能连续竞选第二个任期。

en.t: 1906 United States House of Representatives election in Hawaii Territory
en.s: The 1906 United States House of Representatives election in Hawaii Territory was held on November 6, 1906 to elect the state's non-voting delegate. Incumbent Republican Jonah Kūhiō Kalanianaʻole won re-election with 59.26% of the vote.

zh.t: 1906年夏威夷领地联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行夏威夷领地联邦众议院选举，选出一名没有投票权的领地代表。时任共和党代表乔纳·库希奥·卡拉尼亚纳奥莱以59.26%的得票率连任。

en.s: The 1906 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Incumbent Republican Frank R. Gooding defeated Democratic nominee Charles Stockslager with 52.18% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行爱达荷州州长选举。时任共和党州长弗兰克·R·古丁击败民主党候选人查尔斯·斯托克斯拉格，得票率为52.18%。

en.s: The 1906 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Incumbent Silver John Sparks defeated Republican nominee Jason F. Mitchell with 58.54% of the vote.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行内华达州州长选举。时任银党州长约翰·斯帕克斯击败共和党候选人杰森·F·米切尔，得票率为58.54%。

en.s: The 1906 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Republican businessman Warren R. Porter defeated Democratic State Board of Equalization member Thomas O. Toland with 44.38% of the vote.

zh.t: 1906年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举。共和党商人沃伦·R·波特击败民主党候选人、州平等化委员会委员托马斯·O·托兰德，得票率为44.38%。

en.s: The 1906 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1906. Incumbent Republican Governor Curtis Guild Jr. was re-elected for a second one-year term, defeating Suffolk District Attorney John B. Moran.

zh.s: 1906年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。时任共和党州长小柯蒂斯·吉尔德连任，开始第二个一年任期；他击败了萨福克地区检察官约翰·B·莫兰。

en.s: The 1906 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1906 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 22 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1906 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here. The 1906 elections were the last in Iowa before primary elections were established by the Primary Election Law in 1907. The general election took place on November 6, 1906.

zh.s: 1906年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是1906年美国两年一度选举的一部分，选举于11月6日举行。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的22个选区选出州参议员，任期为4年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1906年50个州参议院选区的地图。1907年《初选法》设立初选制度前，这是艾奥瓦州最后一次举行此类选举。

en.s: The 1906 New York state election was held on November 6, 1906, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the Secretary of State, the state comptroller, the attorney general, the state treasurer and the state engineer, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1906年纽约州选举于11月6日举行，选出州长、副州长、州务卿、州审计长、总检察长、州财政部长和州工程师，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院全体议员。

en.t: 1914 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1914 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 6, 1914. Incumbent Republican Senator Isaac Stephenson did not run for re-election. Democratic State Senator Paul O. Husting narrowly defeated Republican Governor Francis E. McGovern. Socialist former mayor of Milwaukee Emil Seidel ran a strong third. This was the first United States Senate election to be held by a popular vote in Wisconsin.

zh.t: 威斯康星州1914年美国参议院选举
zh.s: 威斯康星州美国参议院选举于1914年11月6日举行。时任共和党参议员艾萨克·斯蒂芬森没有竞选连任。民主党州参议员保罗·O·赫斯廷以微弱优势击败共和党州长弗朗西斯·E·麦戈文。密尔沃基前社会主义党市长埃米尔·塞德尔也有不错表现。这是威斯康星州首次通过全民投票选举美国参议员。

en.s: The Mesopotamian campaign or Mesopotamian front (Turkish: Irak Cephesi) was a campaign in the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I fought between the British Empire, with troops from Britain, Australia and the vast majority from the British Raj, and the Central Powers, primarily the Ottoman Empire, over control of Ottoman Iraq.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 美索不达米亚战役又称美索不达米亚战线，是第一次世界大战中东战场的一场战役。英国帝国、英国和澳大利亚部队以及主要来自英属印度的部队，与以奥斯曼帝国为主的同盟国交战，争夺对奥斯曼伊拉克的控制权。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件起始日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In September 1914 Australia occupied Nauru, then part of German New Guinea, following the start of World War I. This was part of a larger plan by Japan, the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand to intercept Germany's East Asia Squadron before they could return to Germany. The island continued to be occupied by Australia until the end of the war.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战爆发后，澳大利亚于1914年9月占领当时属于德属新几内亚的瑙鲁。这是日本、英国、澳大利亚和新西兰拦截德国东亚分舰队、防止其返回德国的一项更大计划的一部分。澳大利亚一直占领该岛，直至战争结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: During the Battle of Banjo or Battle of Banyo, British forces besieged German forces entrenched on the Banjo mountain from 4 to 6 November 1915 during the Kamerun campaign of the First World War. By 6 November much of the German force had deserted, while the rest surrendered. This led to an Entente victory, and marked the breakdown of German resistance in northern Kamerun.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战喀麦隆战役期间，英军于1915年11月4日至6日在班约山围困德军阵地，这场战斗又称班约战役。到11月6日，大部分德军已逃离，其余部队投降。协约国因此获胜，德国在喀麦隆北部的抵抗也随之瓦解。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Second Battle of Champagne (French: Bataille de Champagne, German: Herbstschlacht, [Autumn Battle]) in the First World War was a French offensive against the German army in Champagne that coincided with the Third Battle of Artois in the north and ended in a German victory.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，法国军队在香槟地区对德军发动第二次香槟战役（法语：Bataille de Champagne；德语：Herbstschlacht，意为“秋季会战”）。这场攻势与北面的第三次阿图瓦战役同时进行，最终以德国获胜告终。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1917 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1917 to elect the governor of Virginia.

zh.t: 美国弗吉尼亚州州长选举，1917
zh.s: 1917年11月6日举行弗吉尼亚州州长选举，以选出该州州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1917 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1917.

zh.s: 1917年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 6, 1917, in two states. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year. Massachusetts at this time held gubernatorial elections every year. It would abandon this practice in 1920.

zh.s: 1917年11月6日，美国两个州举行州长选举。弗吉尼亚州每四年在奇数年份举行州长选举，时间安排在美国总统选举年份之后。马萨诸塞州当时每年举行州长选举，并于1920年停止了这一做法。

en.s: The 1917 New York City mayoral election was held on November 6, 1917. Incumbent mayor John Purroy Mitchel, elected as a Republican but running on the Fusion Party ticket, was defeated for re-election by Judge John Francis Hylan, a Democrat supported by Tammany Hall and William Randolph Hearst.

zh.s: 1917年11月6日举行纽约市市长选举。时任市长约翰·普罗伊·米切尔最初以共和党人身份当选，这次则代表融合党竞选连任，但败给了民主党籍法官约翰·弗朗西斯·海兰，后者得到坦慕尼协会和威廉·伦道夫·赫斯特的支持。

en.s: The 1917 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 6, 1917, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Hugh A. McMullen defeated Republican nominee William O. Atwood, Socialist nominee William A. Toole, Prohibition nominee William Magee and Labor nominee Robert W. Stevens.

zh.s: 1917年11月6日，马里兰州举行审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任审计长休·A·麦克马伦击败共和党候选人威廉·O·阿特伍德、社会党候选人威廉·A·图尔、禁酒党候选人威廉·马吉和工党候选人罗伯特·W·史蒂文斯。

en.s: The 1917 Pittsburgh mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 6, Edward V. Babcock was elected over William A. Magee in a nonpartisan election.

zh.s: 匹兹堡市长选举于1917年11月6日星期二举行。选举不设党派，爱德华·V·巴布科克击败威廉·A·马吉当选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Tel el Khuweilfe, part of the Southern Palestine Offensive, began on 1 November 1917, the day after the Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) victory at the Battle of Beersheba during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of World War I. After the Stalemate in Southern Palestine a series of coordinated attacks were launched by British Empire units on the Ottoman Empire's German commanded Yildirim Army Group's front line, which stretched from Gaza inland to Beersheba.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 特勒尔胡韦勒费战役是巴勒斯坦南部攻势的一部分，始于1917年11月1日，也就是埃及远征军在西奈及巴勒斯坦战役中于别是巴战役获胜的次日。巴勒斯坦南部僵局形成后，大英帝国部队对奥斯曼帝国由德国指挥的耶尔德勒姆集团军防线发动一系列协同进攻；该防线从加沙向内陆延伸至别是巴。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1919 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 6, 1919, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Republican nominee Alexander Armstrong defeated Democratic nominee Thomas J. Keating, Socialist nominee Frederick Haller and Labor nominee Frank N.H. Lang. As of 2022, this is the last time that a Republican was elected as Attorney General in Maryland.

zh.s: 1919年11月6日，马里兰州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人亚历山大·阿姆斯特朗击败民主党候选人托马斯·J·基廷、社会党候选人弗雷德里克·哈勒和工党候选人弗兰克·N·H·朗。截至2022年，这是共和党人最后一次当选马里兰州总检察长。

en.t: 1920 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1920 United States Senate election in California was held on November 6, 1920. Incumbent Democratic Senator James Duval Phelan ran for re-election but was defeated by Republican attorney Samuel Morgan Shortridge.

zh.t: 加利福尼亚州1920年美国参议院选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举于1920年11月6日举行。时任民主党参议员詹姆斯·杜瓦尔·费伦竞选连任，但败给共和党律师塞缪尔·摩根·肖特里奇。

en.s: The East Karelian Uprising (Finnish: itäkarjalaisten kansannousu, Karelian: päivännouzu karjalan kanzannouzu) and the Soviet–Finnish conflict 1921–1922 were an attempt by a group of East Karelian separatists supported by Finland to gain independence from the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic. They were aided by a number of Finnish volunteers, starting from 6 November 1921.

zh.s: 东卡累利阿起义（芬兰语：itäkarjalaisten kansannousu；卡累利阿语：päivännouzu karjalan kanzannouzu）及1921—1922年的苏芬冲突，是一群东卡累利阿分离主义者在芬兰支持下，试图脱离俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国、争取独立的行动。自1921年11月6日起，他们还得到一些芬兰志愿者的帮助。

en.s: The 1922 South American Championship play-off was a match held between Brazil and Paraguay to determine the winner of the 1922 South American Championship, the 6th edition of this continental championship. It was held on November 6, 1922, at Estádio das Laranjeiras of Rio de Janeiro. At the end of the regular tournament, those two teams, along with Uruguay, were tied for the first place, but Uruguay withdrew from competing further.

zh.s: 1922年南美足球锦标赛附加赛是巴西和巴拉圭之间的一场比赛，用于决出第6届南美足球锦标赛冠军。比赛于1922年11月6日在里约热内卢的拉兰热拉斯体育场举行。常规赛结束时，巴西、巴拉圭和乌拉圭并列第一，但乌拉圭退出后续比赛。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Vermont, 1923
en.s: The 1923 United States Senate special election in Vermont took place on November 6, 1923. Republican Porter H. Dale was elected to the United States Senate to serve the remainder of the deceased William P. Dillingham's term, defeating Democratic candidate Park H. Pollard.

zh.t: 美国佛蒙特州联邦参议院特别选举，1923
zh.s: 1923年11月6日举行佛蒙特州联邦参议院特别选举。共和党人波特·H·戴尔当选参议员，接替已故的威廉·P·迪林厄姆，完成其剩余任期；他击败民主党候选人帕克·H·波拉德。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1923 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 6, 1923, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and former member of the Maryland Senate Thomas H. Robinson defeated Republican nominee William C. Coleman, Socialist nominee William A. Toole and Labor nominee Louis F. Guillotte.

zh.s: 1923年11月6日，马里兰州举行总检察长选举。民主党候选人、前州参议员托马斯·H·罗宾逊击败共和党候选人威廉·C·科尔曼、社会党候选人威廉·A·图尔和工党候选人路易斯·F·吉约特。

en.s: The 1923 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1923. Democratic nominee William J. Fields defeated Republican nominee Charles I. Dawson, the attorney general, with 53.25% of the vote. The Democratic State Central Executive Committee chose Fields to replace nominee J. Campbell Cantrill, a U.S. representative who died suddenly on September 2 two months before the election.

zh.s: 1923年11月6日举行肯塔基州州长选举。民主党候选人威廉·J·菲尔兹以53.25%的得票率击败共和党候选人、州总检察长查尔斯·I·道森。民主党州中央执行委员会选择菲尔兹接替原提名人J·坎贝尔·坎特里尔；这位联邦众议员于选举前两个月的9月2日突然去世。

en.s: The 1923 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1923. Incumbent Democrat Albert Ritchie defeated Republican nominee Alexander Armstrong with 55.97% of the vote.

zh.s: 1923年11月6日举行马里兰州州长选举。时任民主党州长阿尔伯特·里奇以55.97%的得票率击败共和党候选人亚历山大·阿姆斯特朗。

en.s: The 1923 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1923, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Lee M. Russell was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term. As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate ran unopposed in the general election so therefore the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

zh.s: 1923年11月6日举行密西西比州州长选举。时任民主党州长李·M·拉塞尔受任期限制，不能竞选连任。按照当时的常见情况，民主党候选人在大选中没有对手，因此真正的竞争发生在民主党初选；赢得初选就等同于当选州长。

en.s: The 1923 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 6, 1923, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller William S. Gordy Jr. defeated Republican nominee J. Monroe Holland, Socialist nominee James L. Smiley and Labor nominee Joseph Derner.

zh.s: 1923年11月6日，马里兰州举行审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任审计长小威廉·S·戈迪击败共和党候选人J·门罗·霍兰德、社会党候选人詹姆斯·L·斯迈利和工党候选人约瑟夫·德纳。

en.s: The 1923 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 6, 1923. Incumbent James Rolph Jr. was re-elected with 62% of the vote.

zh.s: 1923年旧金山市长选举于11月6日举行。现任市长小詹姆斯·罗尔夫以62%的选票连任。

en.s: The United States Senate elections of 1923 were special elections that occurred in the near the end of Republican President Warren G. Harding's term. The Farmer-Labor party gained one seat from Republicans who kept the other seat and their majority.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1923年美国参议院选举是特别选举，发生在共和党总统沃伦·G·哈定任期接近结束时。农民—劳工党从共和党手中赢得一个席位；共和党保住另一个待选席位，并继续保持参议院多数。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1925 presidential elections in Latvia took place on November 6, 1925 over a two parliamentary period. In the elections with three candidates, Jānis Čakste was re-elected as the President of Latvia.

zh.s: 1925年拉脱维亚总统选举于11月6日举行。共有三名候选人。首次议会投票未能选出总统，因为没有候选人获得超过50票；随后雅尼斯·恰克斯特再次当选拉脱维亚总统。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1928
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 6, 1928. All contemporary 48 states, were part of the 1928 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 14 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won by the Republican nominees, Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California and his running mate Senate Majority Leader Charles Curtis of Kansas. Hoover and Curtis defeated the Democratic nominees, Governor Alfred E. Smith of New York and his running mate Senator Joseph Taylor Robinson of Arkansas.

zh.s: 1928年美国新泽西州总统选举于11月6日举行。当时美国48个州均参与总统选举。新泽西州选民选出14名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、商务部长赫伯特·胡佛（加利福尼亚州人）及其竞选搭档、参议院多数党领袖查尔斯·柯蒂斯（堪萨斯州人）在新泽西州获胜。他们击败了民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯及其竞选搭档、参议员约瑟夫·泰勒·罗宾逊（阿肯色州人）。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1928 was the 36th quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 6, 1928. Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover was nominated as the Republican candidate, as incumbent President Calvin Coolidge chose not to run for a second full term. New York Governor Al Smith was the Democratic nominee. Hoover and Smith had been widely known as potential presidential candidates long before the campaign of 1928, and both were generally regarded as outstanding leaders. As each candidate was a newcomer to the presidential race, each presented in his person and record an appeal of unknown potency to the electorate.

zh.s: 1928年美国总统选举是美国第36次四年一度总统选举，于11月6日星期二举行。商务部长赫伯特·胡佛获共和党提名；时任总统卡尔文·柯立芝决定不再竞选一个完整任期。纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯获民主党提名。两人早在1928年竞选开始前就已被视为有力的总统候选人，也都普遍被认为是杰出的领导者。两人此前都没有参加过总统选举，因此选民不确定他们的个人经历和政绩会带来多大吸引力。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1928
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 6, 1928. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1928 United States presidential election. New York voters chose 45 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by Republican Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California, who was running against Democratic Governor of New York Alfred E. Smith. Hoover's running mate was Senate Majority Leader Charles Curtis of Kansas, while Smith's running mate was Senator Joseph Taylor Robinson of Arkansas.

zh.s: 1928年美国纽约州总统选举于11月6日举行。当时美国48个州均参与总统选举。纽约州选民选出45名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、商务部长赫伯特·胡佛（加利福尼亚州人）在纽约州击败民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯。胡佛的竞选搭档是参议院多数党领袖查尔斯·柯蒂斯（堪萨斯州人），史密斯的竞选搭档是参议员约瑟夫·泰勒·罗宾逊（阿肯色州人）。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1928
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 6, 1928 throughout the 48 contiguous states. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Republican nominee, former United States Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover, over the Democratic nominee, New York Governor Al Smith. Hoover ultimately won the national election with 58.21% of the vote. This was only the second election that Virginia had voted for a Republican candidate. The first was in 1872 during the Reconstruction era.

zh.t: 1928年美国弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1928年美国弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月6日在美国本土48州举行期间进行。选民选出12名代表，也就是选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。弗吉尼亚州支持共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛，击败民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯。胡佛最终以58.21%的得票率赢得全国选举。这是弗吉尼亚州历史上第二次投票支持共和党候选人；第一次是在重建时期的1872年。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1928 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Governor of Montana John E. Erickson, who was first elected Governor in 1924, ran for re-election. Erickson only narrowly won the Democratic primary against future Governor Roy E. Ayers, and advanced to the general election, where he was opposed by Wellington D. Rankin, the Attorney General of Montana. Although Herbert Hoover carried the state in a landslide in the presidential election that year, Erickson managed to win re-election to his second term as Governor in a landslide over Rankin.

zh.s: 1928年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月6日举行。1924年首次当选的现任州长约翰·E·埃里克森竞选连任。他在民主党初选中险胜后来也担任州长的罗伊·E·艾尔斯，晋级大选，对手是蒙大拿州检察长温灵顿·D·兰金。尽管赫伯特·胡佛在当年的总统选举中以压倒性优势赢得蒙大拿州，埃里克森仍以大幅优势击败兰金，连任第二个州长任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1928
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 1928 in Minnesota as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. The Republican candidate, Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover won the state over New York governor Al Smith by a margin of 164,526 votes, or 16.94%. Nationally, Hoover won the election, with 444 electoral votes and a landslide 17.41% lead over Smith in the popular vote. This was the last presidential election held in Minnesota before the elimination of the 10th congressional district, and hence the last presidential election in which Minnesota had 12 electoral votes.

zh.t: 1928年美国明尼苏达州总统选举
zh.s: 1928年美国总统选举中，明尼苏达州于11月6日投票。共和党候选人、商务部长赫伯特·胡佛以164,526票、16.94个百分点的优势击败纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯。全国范围内，胡佛赢得444张选举人票，普选票领先史密斯17.41个百分点。这是明尼苏达州第10国会选区撤销前最后一次总统选举，因此也是该州拥有12张选举人票的最后一次总统选举。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1928
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 6, 1928. Incumbent United States Senator Burton K. Wheeler, who was first elected to the Senate in 1922, ran for re-election. After successfully defeating several challengers in the Democratic primary, Wheeler advanced to the general election, where he faced Republican nominee Joseph M. Dixon, the former Governor of Montana who had previously served in the United States Senate from 1907 to 1913. Though the election was closer than Wheeler's first election, he still managed to defeat Dixon to win his second term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1928年美国蒙大拿州参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年美国蒙大拿州参议院选举于11月6日举行。1922年首次当选的现任联邦参议员伯顿·K·惠勒竞选连任。他在民主党初选中击败数名挑战者，晋级大选，对手是共和党候选人约瑟夫·M·迪克森。迪克森曾任蒙大拿州州长，并于1907年至1913年担任联邦参议员。虽然这次选举比惠勒首次当选时竞争更激烈，他仍击败迪克森，赢得参议院第二个任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1928
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 6, 1928. All 48 states were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover over New York Governor Al Smith in a 19-point landslide. At this time the Republican Party was widely associated in the minds of many Americans with the economic success of the mid-1920s, and the post-Civil War Democratic stronghold in the deep South was still evident by the time of this election.

zh.t: 1928年美国新墨西哥州总统选举
zh.s: 1928年美国新墨西哥州总统选举于11月6日举行。当时美国48个州均参与总统选举。新墨西哥州选民选出3名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。商务部长赫伯特·胡佛以19个百分点的优势大胜纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯。许多美国人当时普遍认为共和党与20世纪20年代中期的经济繁荣有关；与此同时，内战后民主党在南方腹地长期占据优势的情况，在这次选举时仍然明显。

en.s: The 1928 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1928. Despite a fairly poor economy, a 15-point loss by Al Smith for the Arizona electoral votes, and having served for nearly 6 full terms, Hunt only narrowly lost the general election. Other state Democrats like Senator Ashurst and Representative Douglas both won re-election. John C. Phillips became the second Republican to serve as Arizona Governor, and the first to beat Hunt in a general election. John Calhoun Phillips was sworn in for his first and only term as Governor on January 7, 1929.

zh.s: 1928年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月6日举行。尽管经济不景气，阿尔·史密斯在总统选举中的得票比对手少15个百分点，而且亨特已任职近6个完整任期，他仍只以微弱差距输掉大选。该州其他民主党人，例如参议员阿什赫斯特和众议员道格拉斯，都成功连任。约翰·C·菲利普斯成为亚利桑那州历史上第二位共和党籍州长，也是首位在大选中击败亨特的共和党人。约翰·卡尔霍恩·菲利普斯于1929年1月7日宣誓就任，开始他唯一一个州长任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1928
en.s: The 1928 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 6, 1928 as part of the 1928 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 4 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont voted for the Republican nominee, Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E. Smith of New York. Hoover's running mate was Senate Majority Leader Charles Curtis of Kansas, while Smith ran with Senator Joseph Taylor Robinson of Arkansas. Hoover took 66.87% of the vote, to Smith's 32.87%, a margin of 34.00%.

zh.s: 1928年美国佛蒙特州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国48个州共同参与的总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名代表，也就是选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州支持共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州商务部长赫伯特·胡佛，击败民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯。胡佛的竞选搭档是堪萨斯州参议院多数党领袖查尔斯·柯蒂斯；史密斯的搭档是阿肯色州参议员约瑟夫·泰勒·罗宾逊。胡佛获得66.87%的选票，史密斯获得32.87%，两人相差34个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1928
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 6, 1928 throughout the continuous 48 states. Voters chose 38 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, U.S. Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover, over the Democratic nominee, New York Governor Al Smith. Hoover won Pennsylvania by a landslide margin of 31.35%. The Republicans at this time were associated with the booming economy of the 1920s while Smith was associated with the corruption of Tammany Hall.

zh.t: 1928年美国宾夕法尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1928年美国总统选举于11月6日在本土48州举行，宾夕法尼亚州也参与了选举。选民选出38名代表，也就是选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、商务部长赫伯特·胡佛，击败民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯。胡佛在宾夕法尼亚州以31.35个百分点的优势大胜。当时，共和党与20世纪20年代的经济繁荣联系在一起，而史密斯则被视为坦慕尼协会腐败政治的代表。

en.t: United States presidential election in Massachusetts, 1928
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Massachusetts took place on November 6, 1928 as part of the 1928 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 18 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Massachusetts voted for the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E. Smith of New York, over the Republican nominee, Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California. Smith's running mate was Senator Joseph Taylor Robinson of Arkansas, while Hoover's running mate was Senate Majority Leader Charles Curtis of Kansas.

zh.t: 1928年美国马萨诸塞州总统选举
zh.s: 1928年美国马萨诸塞州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国48个州共同参与的总统选举的一部分。选民选出18名代表，也就是选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。马萨诸塞州支持民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯，击败共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州商务部长赫伯特·胡佛。史密斯的竞选搭档是阿肯色州参议员约瑟夫·泰勒·罗宾逊，胡佛的搭档是堪萨斯州参议院多数党领袖查尔斯·柯蒂斯。

Republican Party candidate Herbert Hoover won the state with 54% of the popular vote, winning Wisconsin's thirteen electoral votes.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行威斯康星州总统选举。选民选出13名选举人，进入选举人团投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人赫伯特·胡佛以54%的普选票赢得该州及其全部13张选举人票。

Partridge was appointed to fill the seat until a special election could be held in March 1931.
