en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Illinois
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Illinois took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose 29 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 美国伊利诺伊州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，伊利诺伊州举行总统选举。州内选民选出29名选举人进入选举人团，由选举人团选出总统和副总统。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1928, in 35 states, concurrent with the House, Senate elections and presidential election, on November 6, 1928. Elections took place on September 10 in Maine. Among the most notable results was in New York where 1932 Democratic nominee and future president Franklin D. Roosevelt narrowly won in New York. Current Governor Al Smith contested the presidential election.

zh.s: 1928年，美国35个州举行州长选举，时间与联邦众议院、联邦参议院及总统选举同为11月6日。缅因州的选举于9月10日举行。较受关注的结果之一出现在纽约州：1932年民主党总统候选人、日后成为总统的富兰克林·D·罗斯福以微弱优势赢得该州。时任州长阿尔·史密斯参加了总统选举。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator James A. Reed did not run for re-election to a fourth term. Republican U.S. Representative Roscoe C. Patterson defeated Democrat Charles Hay to win the open seat.

zh.t: 1928年密苏里州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行密苏里州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员詹姆斯·A·里德没有竞选第四个任期。共和党联邦众议员罗斯科·C·帕特森击败民主党候选人查尔斯·海，赢得空缺席位。

en.s: The 1928 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928, in order to elect the Governor of Arkansas. Democratic nominee and incumbent Governor Harvey Parnell defeated Republican nominee Drew Bowers.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日，阿肯色州举行州长选举。民主党候选人、时任州长哈维·帕内尔击败共和党候选人德鲁·鲍尔斯。

en.s: The 1928 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Primary elections were held on September 4, 1928. Incumbent Republican Governor Fred R. Zimmerman was defeated in the Republican primary. Republican nominee Walter J. Kohler Sr. defeated Democratic nominee Albert G. Schmedeman with 55.38% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举。初选于1928年9月4日举行。时任共和党州长弗雷德·R·齐默尔曼在共和党初选中落败。共和党候选人小沃尔特·J·科勒以55.38%的得票率击败民主党候选人阿尔伯特·G·施梅德曼。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Arthur Robinson, who had been appointed and elected to finish the unexpired term of Samuel Ralston, was re-elected to a full term in office.

zh.t: 1928年印第安纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行印第安纳州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员阿瑟·罗宾逊此前由任命上任，并经选举完成塞缪尔·拉尔斯顿的剩余任期；这次他再次当选，获得完整任期。

en.s: The 1928 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Republican nominee Harry G. Leslie defeated Democratic nominee Frank C. Dailey with 51.25% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行印第安纳州州长选举。共和党候选人哈里·G·莱斯利击败民主党候选人弗兰克·C·戴利，得票率为51.25%。

en.t: 1928 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1928 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 71st United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 6, 1928, while Maine held theirs on September 10. They coincided with the election of President Herbert Hoover.

zh.s: 1928年美国联邦众议院选举旨在选出第71届国会议员，大多于11月6日举行，缅因州则在9月10日提前选举。选举与赫伯特·胡佛当选总统同时举行。共和党凭借美国经济强劲而获胜，并增加32个众议院席位，几乎全部来自民主党，从而扩大了多数席位。

en.s: The 1928 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Republican nominee Edward Henry Winter defeated Democratic nominee Frank Gaines Harris with 52.47% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行密苏里州副州长选举。共和党候选人爱德华·亨利·温特以52.47%的得票率击败民主党候选人弗兰克·盖恩斯·哈里斯。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican Senator Simeon Fess was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic Director of Agriculture Charles Truax.

zh.t: 1928年俄亥俄州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行俄亥俄州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员西缅·费斯击败民主党候选人、农业局局长查尔斯·特鲁克斯，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 6, 1928. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1928 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Iowa was won by Republican former Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California (actually an Iowan by birth) who was running against Democratic Governor of New York Alfred E.

zh.s: 1928年美国艾奥瓦州总统选举于11月6日举行。当时的48个州均参加了这次总统选举。选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛在艾奥瓦州获胜；他出生于艾奥瓦州，但当时来自加利福尼亚州。胡佛击败了民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔弗雷德·E·史密斯，并以24.20个百分点的优势获胜。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all contemporary forty-eight states. Voters chose twelve representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. This was the last election in which Alabama had twelve electoral votes: the Great Migration caused the state to lose congressional districts after the 1930 Census produced the first Congressional redistricting since 1911.

zh.t: 美国阿拉巴马州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，阿拉巴马州举行总统选举，作为在当时美国48个州举行的1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出12名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。这是阿拉巴马州最后一次拥有12张选举人票：大迁徙导致该州在1930年人口普查后失去国会选区，这是自1911年以来的首次国会选区重划。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Ohio was held on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose 24 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Between 1856 and 1908, Ohio had voted consistently, though generally narrowly, for Republican candidates, because the heavily Yankee northeast and Ohio Company counties of the southeast slightly outvoted the Copperhead Appalachian south and German-American counties of the northwest.

zh.t: 美国俄亥俄州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，俄亥俄州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出24名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。1856年至1908年间，俄亥俄州一直支持共和党候选人，通常优势不大。这是因为东北部有较多扬基人、东南部有许多俄亥俄公司县，这些选民的票数略多于阿巴拉契亚南部支持铜头党的人和西北部的德裔美国人。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Maryland
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Herbert Hoover would win Maryland by a margin of 14.73 percent against Al Smith. Hoover won all eight of the state's electoral votes as a result.

zh.t: 美国马里兰州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，马里兰州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。赫伯特·胡佛以14.73个百分点的优势击败阿尔·史密斯，赢得马里兰州，并获得该州全部8张选举人票。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate elections in Michigan
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 6, 1928, alongside a special election to the same seat. Democratic Senator Woodbridge N. Ferris died in office in March 1928. Governor Fred W. Green appointed newspaper publisher Arthur H. Vandenberg to fill Ferris's seat until a successor could be duly elected. Vandenberg won both the special election to complete Ferris's term and the regularly scheduled 1928 election, both held on November 6.

zh.t: 1928年密歇根州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行密歇根州美国参议院选举，同时还举行了同一席位的特别选举。民主党参议员伍德布里奇·N·费里斯于1928年3月在任内去世。州长弗雷德·W·格林任命报纸出版人阿瑟·H·范登堡接替费里斯，暂时出任参议员，直至正式选出继任者。范登堡在11月6日举行的特别选举中当选，完成费里斯的任期；他也在同日举行的常规选举中获胜。

en.s: The 1928 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Democratic nominee Oliver Max Gardner defeated Republican nominee Herbert F. Seawell, with just over 55% of the vote. This was, relatively, a close election for the time in North Carolina, with Gardner receiving the smallest percentage of the vote that any Democratic gubernatorial nominee won between 1900 and 1956.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行北卡罗来纳州州长选举。民主党候选人奥利弗·马克斯·加德纳击败共和党候选人赫伯特·F·西韦尔，得票率略高于55%。就当时的北卡罗来纳州而言，这次选举的差距相对较小；1900年至1956年间，加德纳的得票率是民主党州长候选人中最低的。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1928 in New Jersey was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democratic Senator Edward I. Edwards ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was defeated by Hamilton Fish Kean in a landslide. This was the third of four straight elections to this seat in which the incumbents were defeated.

zh.t: 1928年新泽西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行新泽西州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员爱德华·I·爱德华兹竞选连任第二个任期，但以压倒性劣势败给汉密尔顿·菲什·基恩。这是该席位连续四次选举中第三次出现时任参议员落败。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. Washington's voters selected seven voters to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the economy growing very rapidly, and the scandals of the earlier decade such as the Teapot Dome scandal essentially removed from the public's mind at the time, the Republican Party was at the peak of its power.

zh.t: 美国华盛顿州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，华盛顿州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。华盛顿州选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。由于经济迅速增长，且此前十年的丑闻（如茶壶山丑闻）当时已基本被公众淡忘，共和党处于势力巅峰。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Louisiana took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the passage of a new constitution in 1898, Louisiana had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 美国路易斯安那州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，路易斯安那州举行总统选举，作为美国总统大选的一部分。选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。1898年新宪法通过后，路易斯安那州一直由民主党主导，实行一党执政。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Texas
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Texas took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary forty-eight states. Voters chose 20 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since statehood, Texas had been one of the strongest states in the nation for the Democratic Party, owing to its early history as a southern state based around slavery.

zh.t: 美国得克萨斯州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，得克萨斯州举行总统选举，作为当时美国48个州共同参加的1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出20名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。自得克萨斯州加入联邦以来，它一直是全国最坚定支持民主党的州之一，这与该州作为南方奴隶制州的早期历史有关。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in North Carolina was held on November 6, 1928. North Carolina voters chose twelve electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.t: 美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，北卡罗来纳州举行总统选举。选民选出12名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。作为前美利坚联盟国成员州，北卡罗来纳州曾实行种族隔离法，剥夺非裔美国人的选举权，州政治也长期由民主党主导。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by former Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover (R–California), running with Senator Charles Curtis, with 56.54% of the popular vote, against Governor Al Smith (D–New York), running with Senator Joseph Taylor Robinson, with 43.46% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国内华达州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，内华达州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛（共和党，加利福尼亚州）与参议员查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档，获得56.54%的普选票；州长阿尔·史密斯（民主党，纽约州）与参议员约瑟夫·泰勒·罗宾逊搭档，获得43.46%。

en.s: The 1928 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor George A. Williams, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Frank A. Dutton. For the two major candidates, this election was a rematch of the previous Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election in 1926.

zh.t: 1928年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。共和党籍时任副州长乔治·A·威廉姆斯击败民主党候选人弗兰克·A·达顿。这两名主要候选人也曾在1926年内布拉斯加州副州长选举中交锋。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 美国北达科他州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，北达科他州举行总统选举，作为当时美国48个州共同参加的1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. Voters chose five representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Outside a few presidential and gubernatorial elections like that of 1922 influenced by the Ku Klux Klan, Oregon was a virtually one-party Republican state during the “System of 1896”, where the only competition was via Republican primaries.

zh.t: 美国俄勒冈州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，俄勒冈州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。除少数受到三K党影响的总统和州长选举（如1922年选举）外，在“1896年体制”时期，俄勒冈州实际上是共和党一党主导的州，党内竞争主要在共和党初选中进行。

en.s: The 1928 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. In a rematch of the previous election, incumbent Republican Fred W. Green defeated Democratic nominee William Comstock in a landslide with 69.94% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。这是上一届选举的重赛。时任共和党州长弗雷德·W·格林以69.94%的得票率大胜民主党候选人威廉·康斯托克。

en.s: The 1928 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1928, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee Susie W. Stageberg and Democratic nominee Ruth Haynes Carpenter.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人、时任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农工党候选人苏西·W·斯塔格伯格和民主党候选人露丝·海恩斯·卡彭特。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 6, 1928. Democratic Senator John B. Kendrick ran for re-election to a third term. He faced Republican Congressman Charles E. Winter in the general election, and a competitive general election ensued. Kendrick ended up winning re-election by a narrow margin, with Winters's campaign likely assisted by the strong performance of Herbert Hoover in that year's presidential election.

zh.t: 1928年怀俄明州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行怀俄明州美国参议院选举。民主党参议员约翰·B·肯德里克竞选第三个任期，对手是共和党联邦众议员查尔斯·E·温特。选举竞争激烈，肯德里克最终以微弱优势连任。温特很可能受益于赫伯特·胡佛在当年总统选举中的强劲表现。

en.s: The 1928 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 6, 1928, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Republican nominee Larry Brunk defeated Democratic nominee Richard R. Nacy, Socialist nominee Henry Siroky and Socialist Labor nominee James Wagoner.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日，密苏里州举行州财政部长选举。共和党候选人拉里·布伦克击败民主党候选人理查德·R·纳西、社会党候选人亨利·西罗基和社会主义工党候选人詹姆斯·瓦戈纳。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Tennessee was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democratic Senator Kenneth McKellar was re-elected to a third term in office, defeating Republican Mayor of Knoxville James A. Fowler.

zh.t: 1928年田纳西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行田纳西州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员肯尼思·麦凯勒击败共和党候选人、诺克斯维尔市长詹姆斯·A·福勒，连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 1928 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1928, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Republican Richard C. Dillon won a second term by a wide margin, becoming the first governor of New Mexico to be reelected. Dillon was the first Republican gubernatorial candidate to ever win Chaves County and San Juan County.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行新墨西哥州州长选举。时任共和党州长理查德·C·狄龙以较大优势连任，成为新墨西哥州首位连任成功的州长。他也是首位赢得查维斯县和圣胡安县的共和党州长候选人。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary forty-eight states. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine voted for the Republican nominee, former Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E.

zh.s: 1928年美国缅因州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年在48个州进行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。缅因州支持共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛，胜过民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔弗雷德·E·史密斯及其竞选搭档、阿肯色州参议员约瑟夫·T·罗宾逊。胡佛以37.67%的优势赢得缅因州，该州成为他支持率第三高的州。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. All contemporary forty-eight states took part, and state voters selected four voters to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah voted for Republican nominee Herbert Hoover, formerly Secretary of Commerce, over the Democratic nominee, four-time New York governor Al Smith.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日，犹他州举行总统选举，作为当时美国48个州共同参加的1928年美国总统选举的一部分。犹他州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。犹他州支持共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛，击败民主党候选人、曾四次当选纽约州州长的阿尔·史密斯。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas voted for the Republican nominee, former Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E.

zh.s: 1928年美国堪萨斯州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年在48个州进行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。堪萨斯州支持共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛，胜过民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔弗雷德·E·史密斯。胡佛以44.96个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by Republican candidate Herbert Hoover.

zh.t: 美国爱达荷州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，爱达荷州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。爱达荷州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人赫伯特·胡佛赢得爱达荷州。

en.s: The 1928 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928, to elect the Governor of Florida. Democratic nominee Doyle E. Carlton defeated Republican nominee William J. Howey with 60.97% of the vote. After the 1928 election, no Republican candidate would carry even a single county in a Florida gubernatorial race again until 1960.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行佛罗里达州州长选举。民主党候选人道尔·E·卡尔顿以60.97%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·J·豪伊。此后直到1960年，佛罗里达州州长选举中才再次有共和党候选人赢得至少一个县。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 9 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. South Carolina voted for the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E.

zh.t: 1928年美国南卡罗来纳州总统选举
zh.s: 1928年美国南卡罗来纳州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年在48个州进行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。南卡罗来纳州支持民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔弗雷德·E·史密斯，胜过共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛。史密斯与阿肯色州参议员约瑟夫·T·罗宾逊搭档，胡佛则与参议院多数党领袖查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose seven representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. During the Third Party System, Connecticut was one of a small number of critical swing states due to its opposing Democratic Catholic and Republican Yankee populations being closely matched at the polls.

zh.t: 美国康涅狄格州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，康涅狄格州举行总统选举，作为当时美国48个州共同参加的1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出7名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。在第三政党体系时期，康涅狄格州是少数几个关键摇摆州之一，因为民主党天主教选民和共和党扬基人势均力敌。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Arizona
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Arizona took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Arizona was won by former U.S. Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover (R–California), running with U.S.

zh.t: 1928年美国亚利桑那州总统选举
zh.s: 1928年美国亚利桑那州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年总统选举的一部分。州选民选出3名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛（共和党，加利福尼亚州）与参议员查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档，获得57.57%的普选票，击败了纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯（民主党）与阿肯色州参议员约瑟夫·T·罗宾逊搭档的组合，后者获得42.23%的普选票。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Arkansas was held on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose nine electors, or representatives to the United States Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice-president. Except for the Unionist Ozark counties of Newton and Searcy where Republicans controlled local government, Arkansas since the end of Reconstruction had been a classic one-party Democratic “Solid South” state.

zh.t: 美国阿肯色州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，阿肯色州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，阿肯色州一直是民主党主导的“南方铁票州”；只有牛顿县和瑟西县这两个由统一党人支持的奥扎克地区县由共和党控制地方政府。

en.s: The 1928 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1928, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent secretary of state Charles Becker defeated Democratic nominee Dwight H. Brown, Socialist nominee Gottlieb A. Hoehn and Socialist Labor nominee Leo L. Aberle.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日，密苏里州举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人、时任州务卿查尔斯·贝克尔击败民主党候选人德怀特·H·布朗、社会党候选人戈特利布·A·赫恩和社会主义工党候选人利奥·L·阿伯勒。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in South Dakota took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since statehood South Dakota had been solidly Republican apart from when supporting Populist-backed William Jennings Bryan by an exceedingly narrow 0.22% margin in 1896.

zh.t: 美国南达科他州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，南达科他州举行总统选举，作为当时美国48个州共同参加的1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。自建州以来，南达科他州一直坚定支持共和党；唯一的例外是1896年，该州以仅0.22个百分点的微弱优势支持了得到民粹党支持的威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 10 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Mississippi voted for the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E. Smith of New York, over the Republican nominee, former Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California.

zh.t: 美国密西西比州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，密西西比州举行总统选举，作为美国总统大选的一部分。选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。密西西比州支持民主党候选人、来自纽约州的州长阿尔·史密斯，击败共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Missouri was held on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. Voters chose 18 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Missouri voted for the Republican nominee, former Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E. Smith of New York.

zh.t: 美国密苏里州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，密苏里州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出18名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。密苏里州支持共和党候选人、来自加利福尼亚州的前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛，胜过民主党候选人、来自纽约州的州长阿尔·史密斯。

en.s: The 1928 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican Lieutenant Governor Frank G. Allen was elected to a two-year term, defeating Democrat Charles H. Cole. The 1928 election represents a major turning point in Massachusetts political history. Al Smith's victory in the state's presidential contest and the competitive gubernatorial election marked a departure from decades of Republican dominance.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。时任共和党副州长弗兰克·G·艾伦当选，任期两年；他击败民主党候选人查尔斯·H·科尔。阿尔·史密斯赢得该州总统选举，州长选举竞争也很激烈。这标志着马萨诸塞州数十年来共和党主导局面的重大转变。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate special election in Ohio
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate special election in Ohio was held on November 6, 1928, to elect a successor to Frank B. Willis, who died in office in March 1928. Republican U.S. Representative Theodore E. Burton, who previously held this seat from 1909 to 1915, won the open race to succeed him.

zh.t: 1928年俄亥俄州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行俄亥俄州美国参议院特别选举，选出弗兰克·B·威利斯的继任者。威利斯于1928年3月在任内去世。共和党联邦众议员西奥多·E·伯顿曾于1909年至1915年担任这一席位的参议员，这次赢得空缺席位。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Farmer–Labor U.S. Senator Henrik Shipstead defeated his Republican challenger, former St. Paul mayor Arthur E. Nelson, to win a second term.

zh.t: 1928年明尼苏达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行明尼苏达州美国参议院选举。时任农工党联邦参议员亨里克·希普斯特德击败共和党候选人、前圣保罗市长阿瑟·E·纳尔逊，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. New Hampshire voted for the Republican nominee, former Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E.

zh.t: 1928年美国新罕布什尔州总统选举
zh.s: 1928年美国新罕布什尔州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年在48个州进行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出4名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。新罕布什尔州支持共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛，胜过民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔弗雷德·E·史密斯。胡佛与参议院多数党领袖查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档，史密斯与阿肯色州参议员约瑟夫·T·罗宾逊搭档。胡佛以17.63%的优势赢得该州，几乎与其全国得票优势相同。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Thomas F. Bayard Jr. ran for a third term in office, but was defeated by former Republican Governor John G. Townsend Jr. in a landslide.

zh.t: 1928年特拉华州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行特拉华州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员小托马斯·F·贝亚德竞选第三个任期，但以压倒性劣势败给前共和党州长小约翰·G·汤森。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Earle Mayfield ran for re-election to a second term. Mayfield drew several primary challengers, including former governor Oscar Branch Colquitt and U.S. Representatives Tom Connally and Thomas L. Blanton. The candidates ran on issues such as public utilities, transportation infrastructure, immigration, and agriculture, as well as several of the candidates' records in the House and Senate.

zh.t: 1928年得克萨斯州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行得克萨斯州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员厄尔·梅菲尔德竞选第二个任期。他在党内初选中遇到多名挑战者，包括前州长奥斯卡·布兰奇·科尔奎特以及联邦众议员汤姆·康纳利和托马斯·L·布兰顿。候选人围绕公共事业、交通基础设施、移民和农业等议题展开竞选，也谈及部分候选人在众议院和参议院的履历。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Robert La Follette Jr., who had won a special election to finish his late father's term in 1925, was elected to a full term in office. La Follette had to fend off two challenges from his own party, defeating George W. Mead in the party primary and Republican State Senator William H.

zh.t: 1928年美国威斯康星州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年美国威斯康星州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍现任联邦参议员小罗伯特·拉福莱特在1925年特别选举中接替已故父亲的未完任期后，此次成功当选完整任期。他在党内初选中击败乔治·W·米德，并在普选中击败共和党州参议员威廉·H·马克姆。马克姆以支持胡佛的“常规共和党人”身份参选。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 6, 1928. The incumbent Republican, Robert B. Howell, was re-elected by a wide margin to a second term. He defeated Richard Lee Metcalfe. Howell underperformed Herbert Hoover, who won the state with 63.19% in the presidential election.

zh.t: 1928年内布拉斯加州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员罗伯特·B·豪厄尔以较大优势连任第二个任期，击败理查德·李·梅特卡夫。豪厄尔的表现不如赫伯特·胡佛；胡佛在该州总统选举中获得63.19%的选票。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Nebraska was held on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose eight electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by the Republican candidate Herbert Hoover, who won the state by 147,786 votes or 27.01 percentage points against Al Smith.

zh.t: 美国内布拉斯加州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，内布拉斯加州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人赫伯特·胡佛以147,786票、领先阿尔·史密斯27.01个百分点的优势赢得内布拉斯加州。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican Senator George P. McLean was not a candidate for re-election. In his place, Republican State Senator Frederic C. Walcott won the seat against former U.S. Representative Augustine Lonergan.

zh.t: 1928年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行康涅狄格州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员乔治·P·麦克莱恩没有竞选连任。共和党州参议员弗雷德里克·C·沃尔科特接替他参选，击败前联邦众议员奥古斯丁·洛纳根，当选参议员。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election held throughout all contemporary forty-eight states. Florida voters chose six electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the disfranchisement of blacks at the beginning of the 1890s, Florida had been a one-party state ruled by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 美国佛罗里达州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，佛罗里达州举行总统选举，作为当时美国48个州共同参加的1928年美国总统选举的一部分。佛罗里达州选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。自1890年代初剥夺黑人选举权后，佛罗里达州一直由民主党主导，实行一党执政。

en.s: The 1928 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor William I. Nolan of the Republican Party of Minnesota defeated Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party challenger Thomas J. Meighen and Minnesota Democratic Party candidate Fred Pfaender.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。明尼苏达州共和党籍时任副州长威廉·I·诺兰击败明尼苏达州农工党候选人托马斯·J·米根和明尼苏达州民主党候选人弗雷德·芬德。

en.s: The 1928 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Republican nominee Clyde M. Reed, who defeated former representative Charles Frederick Scott, lieutenant governor De Lanson Alson Newton Chase, and Secretary of State Frank Joseph Ryan for the Republican nomination, defeated Democratic nominee Chauncey B. Little with 65.60% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。共和党候选人克莱德·M·里德以65.60%的得票率击败民主党候选人昌西·B·利特尔。里德此前在共和党提名竞争中击败前联邦众议员查尔斯·弗雷德里克·斯科特、副州长德·兰森·阿尔森·牛顿·蔡斯和州务卿弗兰克·约瑟夫·瑞安。

en.s: The 1928 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928, and featured former mayor of Falls City Arthur J. Weaver, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee, former Governor Charles W. Bryan.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。共和党人、前法尔斯城（Falls City）市长阿瑟·J·韦弗击败民主党候选人、前州长查尔斯·W·布莱恩。

en.s: The 1928 Delaware gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Republican Governor Robert P. Robinson declined to seek a second term so C. Douglass Buck, the Chief Engineer of the State Highway Department, was seen as the likely frontrunner heading into the Republican convention. At the convention, Buck's primary opponent was State Senator I. Dolphus Short, whom he defeated by a wide margin, receiving 104 votes to Short's 54.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行特拉华州州长选举。共和党州长罗伯特·P·罗宾逊拒绝竞选第二个任期，因此州公路局总工程师C·道格拉斯·巴克被视为共和党大会前的热门人选。在大会上，巴克的初选对手是州参议员I·多尔弗斯·肖特；巴克以104票对54票大幅胜出。

en.s: The 1928 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Republican nominee Charles W. Tobey defeated Democratic nominee Eaton D. Sargent with 57.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党候选人查尔斯·W·托比以57.50%的得票率击败民主党候选人伊顿·D·萨金特。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. Voters chose 15 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the Panic of 1893 and the Populist movement, Michigan had been a rigidly one-party polity dominated by the Republican Party.

zh.t: 美国密歇根州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，密歇根州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出15名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。1893年恐慌和民粹主义运动兴起后，密歇根州一直由共和党主导，成为一党占绝对优势的政治格局。

en.t: 1928 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 1928 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on November 6, 1928, to elect the state's at large representative. This election coincided with the presidential election and the state's Governor election. Albert G. Simms defeated incumbent John Morrow by a margin of 4.4%. This would be the last time a republican would win a congressional district in New Mexico until 1968.

zh.t: 1928年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，新墨西哥州举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州的单一全州选区众议员。选举与总统和州长选举同时举行。阿尔伯特·G·西姆斯以4.4个百分点的优势击败时任众议员约翰·莫罗。这是共和党人直到1968年才再次赢得新墨西哥州国会选区。

en.s: The 1928 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democrat George Dern defeated Republican nominee William H. Wattis with 58.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行犹他州州长选举。时任民主党州长乔治·德恩以58.50%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·H·沃蒂斯。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican Senator Lynn Frazier, who was first elected in 1922, sought re-election. Frazier faced former Governor Ragnvald Nestos in the Republican primary, and won re-nomination. In the general election, he faced F. F. Burchard, a gubernatorial appointee to the state mill.

zh.t: 1928年美国北达科他州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年美国北达科他州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍现任参议员林恩·弗雷泽寻求连任；他于1922年首次当选。弗雷泽在共和党初选中击败前州长拉格纳尔德·内斯托斯，获得再次提名。普选中，他面对的是州农业信贷委员会受任委员F·F·伯查德。弗雷泽以压倒性优势赢得第二个任期，创下北达科他州共和党参议员候选人截至2016年的最大胜选差距。

en.s: The 1928 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Republican nominee George F. Shafer defeated Democratic incumbent Walter Maddock with 56.50% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行北达科他州州长选举。共和党候选人乔治·F·谢弗以56.50%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长沃尔特·马多克。

en.s: The 1928 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democrat Billy Adams defeated Republican nominee William L. Boatright with 67.05% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长比利·亚当斯以67.05%的得票率击败共和党候选人威廉·L·博特赖特。

en.s: The 1928 Texas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928, in order to elect the Governor of Texas. Incumbent Democratic Governor Dan Moody won re-election against Republican nominee W. H. Holmes.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日，得克萨斯州举行州长选举。时任民主党州长丹·穆迪击败共和党候选人W·H·霍姆斯，成功连任。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in California was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican Senator Hiram Johnson was re-elected to his third term in office. He defeated Democrat Minor Moore and Prohibition Party nominee Los Angeles City Councilman Charles H. Randall.

zh.t: 1928年加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员海勒姆·约翰逊再次当选，开始第三个任期。他击败民主党候选人迈纳·摩尔和禁酒党候选人、洛杉矶市议员查尔斯·H·兰德尔。

en.s: The 1928 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Republican nominee Myers Y. Cooper defeated Democratic nominee Martin L. Davey with 54.79% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。共和党候选人迈尔斯·Y·库珀以54.79%的得票率击败民主党候选人马丁·L·戴维。

en.s: The 1928 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican H. C. Baldridge defeated Democratic nominee C. Ben Ross with 57.82% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行爱达荷州州长选举。时任共和党州长H·C·鲍德里奇以57.82%的得票率击败民主党候选人C·本·罗斯。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in California took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Republican nominee, former Commerce Secretary Herbert Hoover, in a landslide over the Democratic nominee, New York Governor Al Smith.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，加利福尼亚州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出13名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯，赢得加利福尼亚州。

en.s: The 1928 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1928, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent acting attorney general Stratton Shartel defeated Democratic nominee Elmer O. Jones and Socialist Labor nominee Theodore Baeff.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日，密苏里州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任代理总检察长斯特拉顿·沙特尔击败民主党候选人埃尔默·O·琼斯和社会主义工党候选人西奥多·贝夫。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Rhode Island voted for the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E.

zh.s: 1928年美国罗得岛州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年在48个州进行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。罗得岛州支持民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔弗雷德·E·史密斯，胜过共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛。史密斯与阿肯色州参议员约瑟夫·T·罗宾逊搭档；胡佛与参议院多数党领袖查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档。

en.s: The 1928 Illinois lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican lieutenant governor Fred E. Sterling was reelected to a third consecutive term.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州副州长选举。时任共和党副州长弗雷德·E·斯特林连任，开始连续第三个任期。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 美国肯塔基州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，肯塔基州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1928 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democratic Governor William J. Bulow ran for re-election to a second term. In the general election, he faced Attorney General Buell F. Jones, the Republican nominee. Despite Republican presidential nominee Herbert Hoover overwhelmingly defeating Democratic nominee Al Smith overwhelmingly in South Dakota, Bulow defeated Jones by a decisive margin to retain the governorship.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行南达科他州州长选举。时任民主党州长威廉·J·布洛连任，开始第二个任期。大选中，他的对手是共和党候选人、州总检察长比尤尔·F·琼斯。尽管共和党总统候选人赫伯特·胡佛在南达科他州以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人阿尔·史密斯，布洛仍以明显优势击败琼斯，保住州长职位。

en.s: The 1928 Illinois gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent two-term Republican Governor Len Small was defeated in the Republican primary. Republican nominee Louis Lincoln Emmerson defeated Democratic nominee Floyd E. Thompson with 56.76% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。连任两届的时任共和党州长伦·斯莫尔在共和党初选中落败。共和党候选人路易斯·林肯·埃默森以56.76%的得票率击败民主党候选人弗洛伊德·E·汤普森。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Wyoming was won by the Republican candidate, former Secretary of Commerce and mining engineer Herbert Hoover, from the state of California, who was running with Senator Charles Curtis, with 63.68 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国怀俄明州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，怀俄明州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人赫伯特·胡佛获得63.68%的普选票，赢得怀俄明州。他来自加利福尼亚州，曾任商务部长，也是一名矿业工程师；他的竞选搭档是参议员查尔斯·柯蒂斯。

en.s: The 1928 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democratic governor Austin Peay died in office on October 2, 1927. Tennessee's Democratic Speaker of the Senate, Henry Hollis Horton became governor according to Tennessee's gubernatorial succession law. In the general election, Henry defeated Republican nominee Raleigh Hopkins with 61.1% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行田纳西州州长选举。时任民主党州长奥斯汀·皮伊于1927年10月2日在任内去世。根据州长继任法，民主党籍州参议院议长亨利·霍利斯·霍顿接任州长。霍顿在大选中以61.1%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗利·霍普金斯。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary forty-eight states. Voters chose six representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 美国科罗拉多州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，科罗拉多州举行总统选举，作为当时美国48个州共同参加的1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1928 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1928, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Lorenzo Dow Thompson defeated Democratic nominee Forrest Smith, Socialist nominee Meyer Weintraub and Socialist Labor nominee Joseph W. Molineux.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日，密苏里州举行州审计长选举。共和党候选人、时任审计长洛伦佐·道·汤普森击败民主党候选人福雷斯特·史密斯、社会党候选人迈耶·温特劳布和社会主义工党候选人约瑟夫·W·莫利纽克斯。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president.

zh.t: 美国俄克拉何马州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，俄克拉何马州举行总统选举，作为当时美国48个州共同参加的1928年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。

en.s: The 1928 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican John Hammill defeated Democratic nominee L. W. Housel with 62.79% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。时任共和党州长约翰·哈米尔以62.79%的得票率击败民主党候选人L·W·豪塞尔。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democratic Senator Park Trammell defeated a primary challenge from Governor of Florida John W. Martin and was re-elected to a third term in office over Republican Barclay Warburton. Republican Herbert Hoover won the state in the concurrent presidential election, and though Hoover's coattails did not make the race close, Warburton's percentage of the vote would not be exceeded by a Republican nominee for Senate until 1964.

zh.t: 1928年佛罗里达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行佛罗里达州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员帕克·特拉梅尔击败州长约翰·W·马丁在民主党初选中的挑战，随后再次当选，开始第三个任期；他在大选中击败共和党候选人巴克莱·沃伯顿。与此同时，共和党总统候选人赫伯特·胡佛赢得佛罗里达州。胡佛带来的助选效应未能使参议院选举变得势均力敌，但直到1964年，共和党参议院候选人的得票率才再次超过沃伯顿。

en.s: The 1928 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. It was a rematch of the 1926 Connecticut gubernatorial election. Incumbent Republican John H. Trumbull defeated Democratic nominee Charles G. Morris with 53.57% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。这是1926年康涅狄格州州长选举的重赛。时任共和党州长约翰·H·特朗布尔以53.57%的得票率击败民主党候选人查尔斯·G·莫里斯。

en.s: The 1928 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1928, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent acting attorney general G. Aaron Youngquist defeated Democratic nominee George Cahill and Farmer–Labor nominee Christian F. Gaarenstroom.

zh.t: 1928年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任代理总检察长G·亚伦·扬奎斯特击败民主党候选人乔治·卡希尔和农工党候选人克里斯蒂安·F·加伦斯特罗姆。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia voted for the Republican nominee, former Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California, over the Democratic nominee, Governor Alfred E.

zh.t: 1928年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1928年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年在48个州进行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。西弗吉尼亚州支持共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛，胜过民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔弗雷德·E·史密斯。胡佛与参议院多数党领袖查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档，史密斯与阿肯色州参议员约瑟夫·T·罗宾逊搭档。胡佛以17.39个百分点的优势赢得该州。

en.s: The 1928 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican Norman S. Case defeated Democratic nominee Alberic A. Archambault with 51.59% of the vote.

zh.s: 1928年11月6日举行罗得岛州州长选举。时任共和党州长诺曼·S·凯斯以51.59%的得票率击败民主党候选人阿尔贝里克·A·阿尚博。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose 12 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For over a century after the Civil War, Tennessee was divided according to political loyalties established in that war.

zh.t: 美国田纳西州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，田纳西州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出12名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。南北战争结束后一个多世纪里，田纳西州仍因战争时期形成的政治立场而分化。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Indiana
en.s: A presidential election was held in Indiana on November 6, 1928, as part of the 1928 United States presidential election. The Republican ticket of the U.S. secretary of commerce Herbert Hoover and the senior U.S. senator from Kansas Charles Curtis defeated the Democratic ticket of the governor of New York Al Smith and the senior U.S. senator from Arkansas Joseph T. Robinson.

zh.t: 美国印第安纳州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，印第安纳州举行总统选举，作为1928年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、美国商务部长赫伯特·胡佛和堪萨斯州资深联邦参议员查尔斯·柯蒂斯搭档，击败民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯和阿肯色州资深联邦参议员约瑟夫·T·罗宾逊。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Delaware
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Delaware took place on November 6, 1928. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1928 United States presidential election. State voters chose three electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president. Delaware was won by Republican former Secretary of Commerce Herbert Hoover of California, who was running against Democratic Governor of New York Alfred E.

zh.t: 美国特拉华州总统选举，1928
zh.s: 1928年11月6日，特拉华州举行总统选举。当时美国48个州都参加了这次总统选举。该州选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、前商务部长赫伯特·胡佛赢得特拉华州；他来自加利福尼亚州，竞选对手是民主党候选人、纽约州州长阿尔·史密斯。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democratic Senator Royal S. Copeland was re-elected to a second term, defeating Republican Alanson B. Houghton.

zh.s: 1928年纽约州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任参议员罗亚尔·S·科普兰击败共和党人阿兰森·B·霍顿，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1928 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1928 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 6, 1928, as part of the wider United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. With the exception of a handful of historically Unionist North Georgia counties – chiefly Fannin but also to a lesser extent Pickens, Gilmer and Towns – Georgia since the 1880s had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1928年佐治亚州美国总统选举于11月6日举行，是美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出14名代表或选举人，组成选举人团投票选举总统和副总统。除历史上支持联邦的佐治亚州北部少数几个县外，尤其是芬宁县，较小程度上还包括皮肯斯县、吉尔默县和汤斯县，佐治亚州自19世纪80年代以来一直是由民主党主导的一党制州。

en.s: The 1928 New York state elections were held on November 6, 1928, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general, a U.S. senator and a judge of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate. Incumbent Governor Al Smith did not seek reelection, and instead unsuccessfully ran for President.

zh.s: 1928年纽约州选举于11月6日举行，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、总检察长、美国参议员和纽约州上诉法院法官，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院全体议员。现任州长阿尔·史密斯没有竞选连任，而是转而竞选总统，但未能当选。

en.s: The 1928 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Republican Roland H. Hartley defeated Democratic nominee A. Scott Bullitt with 56.22% of the vote. This was the last gubernatorial election until 1980 in which a Republican carried Franklin County, Mason County, and Pierce County.

zh.s: 1928年华盛顿州州长选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任州长罗兰·H·哈特利以56.22%的选票击败民主党提名人A·斯科特·布利特。这是1980年以前共和党候选人最后一次赢得富兰克林县、梅森县和皮尔斯县。

en.t: 1928 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1928 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 6, 1928. Incumbent Democrat Clarence Dill was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican Chief justice Kenneth Mackintosh. As of 2026, this is the last time Washington elected a U.S. Senator from east of the Cascade Mountains.

zh.t: 1928年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1928年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任参议员克拉伦斯·迪尔击败共和党人、首席大法官肯尼斯·麦金托什，连任第二个任期。截至2026年，这是华盛顿州最后一次选出来自喀斯喀特山脉以东的美国参议员。

en.s: The 1928 Iowa Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1928 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 31 of the senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1928 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1928年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度的选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的31个选区选出州参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1928年选举中50个州参议院选区的全州地图。

en.s: The 1928 United States Senate elections were elections that coincided with the presidential election of Republican Herbert Hoover. The 32 seats of Class 1 were contested in regular elections, and special elections were held to fill vacancies. The strong economy helped the Republicans to gain seven seats from the Democrats. Senate Majority leader, Republican Charles Curtis of Kansas, was not up for election this cycle, but he was elected U.S.

zh.s: 1928年美国联邦参议院选举与共和党人赫伯特·胡佛当选总统同时举行。第一类32个席位进行常规选举，另有特别选举填补空缺。强劲的经济形势帮助共和党从民主党手中赢得7席。共和党籍参议院多数党领袖、堪萨斯州参议员查尔斯·柯蒂斯没有参加本轮参议院选举，但他当选美国副总统。

en.s: The 1930 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1930. Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party candidate Henry M. Arens defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger John H. Hougen.

zh.s: 1930年11月6日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。明尼苏达州农工党候选人亨利·M·阿伦斯击败明尼苏达州共和党候选人约翰·H·豪根。

en.s: Federal elections were held in Germany on 6 November 1932. The Nazi Party saw its vote share fall by four percentage points from the July 1932 election, while there were slight increases for the Communist Party of Germany and the national conservative German National People's Party. The results were a great disappointment for the Nazis, who lost 34 seats and again failed to form a coalition government in the Reichstag.

zh.s: 1932年11月6日，德国举行联邦选举。纳粹党得票率比1932年7月的选举下降4个百分点；德国共产党和国家保守派德国国家人民党得票略有上升。选举结果令纳粹党大失所望，该党失去34个席位，并再次未能在国会组建联合政府。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1933 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 6, 1933. In a realigning election, Democrats regained control of the mayor's office for the first time in 28 years; they have not relinquished this position since. The incumbent mayor, John Herron of the Republican Party chose to run for his first full term. Herron had been elevated to the executive office from his position as city council president after Charles H. Kline resigned over a fiscal scandal; he inherited a party whose once efficient machinery was in crisis.

zh.s: 1933年11月6日星期二，宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡举行市长选举。在这场重塑政治格局的选举中，民主党时隔28年重新赢得市长职位，并从此一直保有该职位。共和党籍现任市长约翰·赫伦竞选首个完整任期。此前，查尔斯·H·克莱因因财政丑闻辞职，时任市议会主席的赫伦接任市长；他接手的共和党组织曾运作高效，但当时已陷入危机。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Pennsylvania gubernatorial election of 1934 occurred on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican governor Gifford Pinchot was not a candidate for re-election. Democratic candidate George Howard Earle III defeated Republican candidate William A. Schnader to become Governor of Pennsylvania. This was the first Pennsylvania gubernatorial election won by the Democratic Party since 1890. Election eve was marred by the Kelayres massacre, where the local small-town Republican boss and his family fired pistols, rifles and shotguns upon a Democratic rally and parade, killing three that night, and leaving at least a dozen more seriously wounded. News of the attack was front-page headlines across the nation.

zh.s: 1934年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍现任州长吉福德·平肖没有竞选连任。民主党候选人乔治·霍华德·厄尔三世击败共和党候选人威廉·A·施纳德，当选州长。这是宾夕法尼亚州民主党自1890年以来首次赢得州长选举。选举前夕发生了凯莱尔斯惨案：当地一名共和党小镇头目及其家人向民主党集会和游行队伍开枪，造成当晚3人死亡、至少十多人重伤。袭击事件登上了全美报纸头版。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Montana, 1934
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate special election in Montana took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent United States Senator John E. Erickson, who, as governor, had appointed himself to the seat in 1933 upon the death of Thomas J. Walsh, ran for re-election. However, he was defeated in the Democratic primary by James E. Murray, who was the former Silver Bow County Attorney and the Chairman of the State Advisory Board of the Public Works Administration. In the general election, Murray defeated Scott Leavitt, a former United States Congressman who had represented Montana's 2nd congressional district, and an independent candidate in a landslide to win his first term in the Senate.

zh.t: 1934年美国蒙大拿州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1934年美国蒙大拿州联邦参议员特别选举于11月6日举行。1933年托马斯·J·沃尔什去世后，时任州长约翰·E·埃里克森任命自己接任联邦参议员席位，并竞选连任。但他在民主党初选中败给詹姆斯·E·默里。默里曾任银弓县检察官，也是公共工程管理局州顾问委员会主席。大选中，默里以压倒性优势击败前联邦众议员、曾代表蒙大拿州第二国会选区的斯科特·利维特，以及一名独立候选人，赢得参议院首个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The California gubernatorial election, 1934 was held on November 6, 1934. Held in the midst of the Great Depression, the 1934 election was amongst the most controversial in the state's political history, putting conservative Republican Frank Merriam against former Socialist Party member turned Democrat Upton Sinclair, author of The Jungle. A strong third party challenge came from Commonwealth-Progressive Raymond L. Haight, a Los Angeles lawyer campaigning for the political center. Much of the campaign's emphasis was directed at Sinclair's EPIC movement, proposing socialist reforms to cure the state's ailing economy.

zh.s: 1934年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月6日举行。选举发生在大萧条期间，是该州政治史上争议最大的选举之一。保守派共和党人弗兰克·梅里亚姆与前社会党党员、后转投民主党的厄普顿·辛克莱对决；辛克莱也是《丛林》的作者。洛杉矶律师雷蒙德·L·海特以英联邦进步党候选人身份参选，形成强有力的第三方竞争，争取中间派选民。竞选主要围绕辛克莱的“EPIC”运动展开，该运动提出以社会主义改革来拯救陷入困境的经济。

en.t: United States Senate election in Montana, 1934
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent United States Senator Burton K. Wheeler, who was first elected to the Senate in 1922, and was re-elected in 1928, ran for re-election. After easily winning the Democratic primary, Wheeler moved on to the general election, where he faced George M. Bourquin, a former United States Federal Judge and the Republican nominee. In a stark contrast to his close campaign in 1928, Wheeler won re-election to his third Senate term in a landslide.

zh.t: 1934年美国蒙大拿州参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年美国蒙大拿州参议院选举于11月6日举行。1922年首次当选、1928年连任的现任联邦参议员伯顿·K·惠勒竞选连任。他轻松赢得民主党初选，晋级大选，对手是共和党候选人乔治·M·布尔昆，后者曾任美国联邦法官。与惠勒1928年竞争激烈的竞选相比，这次他以压倒性优势连任，开始第三个参议员任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 1934
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1934 in Massachusetts was held on November 6, 1934, with Democratic incumbent David I. Walsh defeating his challengers.

zh.t: 美国马萨诸塞州参议院选举，1934
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州参议院选举。民主党籍现任参议员戴维·I·沃尔什击败挑战者，成功连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Vermont gubernatorial election of 1934 took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican Stanley C. Wilson did not run for re-election to a third term as Governor of Vermont. Republican candidate Charles M. Smith defeated Democratic candidate James P. Leamy to succeed him.

zh.t: 美国佛蒙特州州长选举，1934
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行佛蒙特州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长斯坦利·C·威尔逊没有竞选第三个任期。共和党候选人查尔斯·M·史密斯击败民主党候选人詹姆斯·P·利米，接任州长。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1934 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 6, 1934. Republican Harold G. Hoffman defeated Democratic nominee William L. Dill with 49.90% of the vote.

zh.t: 美国新泽西州州长选举，1934
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行新泽西州州长选举。共和党人哈罗德·G·霍夫曼以49.90%的得票率击败民主党候选人威廉·L·迪尔。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1934
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1934 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 6, 1934. Democrats gained three districts while losing one.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，1934
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，选出该州在联邦众议院的代表。民主党赢得三个选区，同时失去一个选区。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Missouri, 1934
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Roscoe Patterson, first elected in 1928, sought reelection to a second term. He was defeated by the Democratic nominee, future President of the United States Harry Truman.

zh.t: 美国密苏里州参议院选举，1934
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行密苏里州参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员罗斯科·帕特森于1928年首次当选，此次竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党候选人、未来的美国总统哈里·杜鲁门。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 1934
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Virginia was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Senator Harry F. Byrd, Sr. was re-elected to his first full term after defeating Independent Hilliard Berstein.

zh.t: 美国弗吉尼亚州参议院选举，1934
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行弗吉尼亚州参议院选举。现任参议员哈里·F·伯德击败独立候选人希利亚德·伯恩斯坦，连任首个完整任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1934
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator David A. Reed sought re-election to another term, but was defeated by Democratic nominee Joseph F. Guffey.

zh.t: 美国宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举，1934
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员戴维·A·里德竞选连任，但败给民主党候选人约瑟夫·F·格菲。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1934 Minnesota gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1934. Farmer–Labor Party candidate Floyd B. Olson defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger Martin A. Nelson.

zh.t: 美国明尼苏达州州长选举，1934
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行明尼苏达州州长选举。农民—劳工党候选人弗洛伊德·B·奥尔森击败明尼苏达州共和党候选人马丁·A·纳尔逊。
