en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1934, in 34 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections, on November 6, 1934. Elections took place on September 10 in Maine.

zh.s: 1934年，美国34个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和联邦参议院选举同在11月6日举行。缅因州选举于9月10日举行。

en.s: The 1934 Wisconsin Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 1934. Seventeen of the 33 seats in the Wisconsin State Senate were up for election—the odd-numbered districts. Prior to the election 22 seats were held by Republicans, 9 were held by Democrats, one seat was held by a Socialist, and one seat was vacant. The primary election was held on September 18, 1934.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日星期二举行威斯康星州参议院选举。州参议院33个席位中的17席（奇数选区）改选。选举前，共和党占22席，民主党占9席，社会党占1席，另有1席空缺。初选于1934年9月18日举行。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate elections in Wyoming
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate elections in Wyoming took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Democratic Senator John B. Kendrick died on November 3, 1933, and Joseph C. O'Mahoney was appointed by Governor Leslie A. Miller as Kendrick's replacement. Two elections for the same Senate seat were held on the same day; one as a special election to fill the remainder of Kendrick's original six-year term, and another to select a Senator to serve the next six-year term.

zh.t: 1934年怀俄明州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行怀俄明州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员约翰·B·肯德里克于1933年11月3日去世，州长莱斯利·A·米勒任命约瑟夫·C·奥马奥尼接替他。当天围绕同一个参议院席位举行了两场选举：一场特别选举用于填补肯德里克原六年任期的剩余时间，另一场常规选举则选出下一届六年任期的参议员。

en.s: The 1934 Connecticut Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1934, in order to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Democratic nominee Edward J. Daly defeated Republican nominee and incumbent Attorney General Warren Booth Burrows.

zh.t: 1934年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日，康涅狄格州举行总检察长选举。民主党候选人爱德华·J·戴利击败共和党候选人、时任总检察长沃伦·布思·巴罗斯。

en.s: The 1934 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Republican U.S. Attorney for the Northern District of California George J. Hatfield defeated Democratic attorney Sheridan Downey with 54.25% of the vote.

zh.t: 1934年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举。共和党候选人、加利福尼亚州北区联邦检察官乔治·J·哈特菲尔德以54.25%的得票率击败民主党律师谢里登·唐尼。

en.s: The 1934 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1934, to elect the state auditor of the U.S. state of Minnesota. Incumbent Republican Stafford King won re-election to a second term. King was challenged by Farmer-Labor candidate John Lyons and Democratic candidate Patrick Delaney. As of 2024, this is the closest Minnesota State Auditor election ever.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行明尼苏达州州审计长选举。时任共和党审计长斯塔福德·金连任，开始第二个任期。他的对手是农工党候选人约翰·莱昂斯和民主党候选人帕特里克·德莱尼。截至2024年，这是明尼苏达州州审计长选举中差距最小的一次。

en.s: The 1934 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Republican nominee Styles Bridges defeated Democratic nominee John L. Sullivan with 50.55% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党候选人斯泰尔斯·布里奇斯以50.55%的得票率击败民主党候选人约翰·L·沙利文。

en.s: The 1934 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1934, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent attorney general Harry H. Peterson defeated Republican nominee Oscar Youngdahl and Democratic nominee Alric Anderson.

zh.t: 1934年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。农工党候选人、时任总检察长哈里·H·彼得森击败共和党候选人奥斯卡·扬达尔和民主党候选人阿尔里克·安德森。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate elections in Nebraska
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate elections in Nebraska took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican Senator Robert B. Howell died in office on March 11, 1933. Democrat William H. Thompson was appointed by Governor Charles W. Bryan to fill Howell's seat. Two elections for the same Senate seat were held on the same day; one as a special election to fill the remainder of Howell's six-year term, and another to elect a Senator to serve the next six-year term.

zh.t: 1934年内布拉斯加州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员罗伯特·B·豪厄尔于1933年3月11日在任内去世。民主党人威廉·H·汤普森由州长查尔斯·W·布莱恩任命，接替豪厄尔。当天围绕同一个参议院席位举行了两场选举：一场特别选举用于填补豪厄尔原六年任期的剩余时间，另一场选举则选出下一届六年任期的参议员。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican Senator Lynn Frazier, first elected in 1922, ran for re-election to a third term. He easily won the Republican primary and faced Grand Forks City Commissioner Henry Holt in the general election. Despite significant Democratic gains nationwide, Frazier easily defeated Holt to win re-election.

zh.t: 1934年北达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行北达科他州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员林恩·弗雷泽于1922年首次当选，这次竞选连任第三个任期。他轻松赢得共和党初选，大选对手是大福克斯市政委员亨利·霍尔特。尽管民主党在全国范围内大幅增加席位，弗雷泽仍轻松击败霍尔特，成功连任。

en.s: The 1934 Oregon gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1934, to elect the governor of the U.S. state of Oregon. Democrat Charles H. Martin, who retired from the United States House of Representatives to run for governor, won a plurality over Republican Oregon State Senator Peter Zimmerman (who ran as an Independent), Republican nominee Joe E. Dunne, also a state senator, and several minor candidates.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行俄勒冈州州长选举。民主党人查尔斯·H·马丁辞去联邦众议员职务竞选州长，并以相对多数票获胜。他击败了共和党俄勒冈州参议员彼得·齐默尔曼（以独立候选人身份参选）、共和党候选人、州参议员乔·E·邓恩以及数名小党候选人。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Farmer–Labor U.S. Senator Henrik Shipstead defeated former State Senator Nathaniel J. Holmberg of the Republican Party of Minnesota and U.S. Representative Einar Hoidale of the Minnesota Democratic Party to win a third term.

zh.t: 1934年明尼苏达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行明尼苏达州美国参议院选举。时任农工党参议员亨里克·希普斯特德击败共和党候选人、前州参议员纳撒尼尔·J·霍姆伯格，以及明尼苏达州民主党联邦众议员埃纳尔·霍伊达尔，赢得第三个任期。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Robert La Follette Jr. left his party and, with his brother Philip, formed the new Wisconsin Progressive Party. La Follette was re-elected on the Progressive ticket over Democrat John M. Callahan and Republican John B. Chapple.

zh.t: 1934年威斯康星州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行威斯康星州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员小罗伯特·拉福莱特脱离共和党，并与弟弟菲利普共同组建新成立的威斯康星进步党。拉福莱特代表进步党参选，击败民主党候选人约翰·M·卡拉汉和共和党候选人约翰·B·查普尔，成功连任。

en.s: The 1934 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1934, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Mike Holm defeated Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent lieutenant governor of Minnesota Konrad K. Solberg, Democratic nominee Hugh T. Kennedy and Communist nominee Robert Turner.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行州务卿选举。共和党候选人、时任州务卿迈克·霍尔姆击败农工党候选人、时任副州长康拉德·K·索尔伯格、民主党候选人休·T·肯尼迪和共产党候选人罗伯特·特纳。

en.s: The 1934 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican Alf Landon defeated Democratic nominee Omar B. Ketchum with 53.51% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。时任共和党州长阿尔夫·兰登以53.51%的得票率击败民主党候选人奥马尔·B·凯彻姆。

en.s: The 1934 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934, and featured state engineer Robert L. Cochran, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee, newspaper publisher and former state legislator Dwight Griswold.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。民主党人、州工程师罗伯特·L·科克伦击败共和党候选人德怀特·格里斯沃尔德；后者是报纸出版人，曾任州议员。

en.t: 1934 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico
en.s: The 1934 United States House of Representatives election in New Mexico was held on Tuesday November 6, 1934 to elect the state's at-large representative. Incumbent Dennis Chávez decided not to run for re-election and instead opted to run in the concurrent Senate election. This was the first open seat since 1922. Dempsey prevailed in this open seat by a narrow 4 point margin.

zh.t: 1934年新墨西哥州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日星期二，新墨西哥州举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州的单一全州选区众议员。时任众议员丹尼斯·查韦斯没有竞选连任，转而参加同期举行的联邦参议院选举。这是自1922年以来首次出现空缺席位。邓普西以4个百分点的微弱优势赢得该席位。

en.t: 1934 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1934 United States House of Representatives elections were elections for the United States House of Representatives to elect members to serve in the 74th United States Congress. They were held for the most part on November 6, 1934, while Maine held theirs on September 10. They occurred in the middle of President Franklin D. Roosevelt's first term.

zh.s: 1934年美国联邦众议院选举是为第74届国会选举议员。选举大多于11月6日举行，缅因州则在9月10日举行。选举发生在富兰克林·D·罗斯福总统第一个任期期间。

en.s: The 1934 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Democrat Wilbur Lucius Cross defeated Republican nominee Hugh Meade Alcorn with 46.71% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。时任民主党州长威尔伯·卢修斯·克罗斯以46.71%的得票率击败共和党候选人休·米德·奥尔康。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Arthur Robinson ran for re-election to a second term, but lost narrowly to Democrat Sherman Minton.

zh.t: 1934年印第安纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行印第安纳州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员阿瑟·罗宾逊竞选第二个任期，但以微弱劣势败给民主党候选人谢尔曼·明顿。

en.s: The 1934 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Governor Benjamin Baker Moeur ran for reelection, he was challenged by former governor George W. P. Hunt and future Governor Rawghlie Clement Stanford in the Democratic primary, but he defeated both of them by a comfortable margin.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行亚利桑那州州长选举。时任州长本杰明·贝克·莫尔竞选连任。他在民主党初选中面对前州长乔治·W·P·亨特和未来州长罗利·克莱门特·斯坦福的挑战，但以明显优势击败两人。

en.s: The 1934 Massachusetts gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Democratic Mayor of Boston James Michael Curley was elected to his only term as governor of Massachusetts.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州州长选举。波士顿民主党籍市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利当选，担任他唯一一个州长任期。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1934 in New Jersey was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican Senator Hamilton Fish Kean ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was defeated by Governor of New Jersey A. Harry Moore in a landslide. This was among the nine seats Democrats gained in this year's elections.

zh.t: 1934年新泽西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行新泽西州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员汉密尔顿·菲什·基恩竞选连任第二个任期，但以压倒性劣势败给新泽西州州长A·哈里·摩尔。这是民主党人在当年选举中赢得的9个席位之一。

en.s: The 1934 Alabama Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 6, 1934, to elect 35 representatives to serve four-year terms in the Alabama Senate. Primary elections were held on June 12 with runoff elections on May 1. The election used the same districts first drawn by the Alabama Constitution of 1901. Only one Democratic nominee, Webb Chestnut of District 29 (Cherokee–DeKalb County), saw opposition in the general election in Republican James H.

zh.s: 1934年阿拉巴马州参议院选举于11月6日（星期二）举行，选出35名议员，任期四年。初选于6月12日举行，5月1日举行决选。选举沿用1901年阿拉巴马州宪法首次划定的选区。只有第29选区（切罗基县—迪卡尔布县）的民主党候选人韦布·切斯纳特在大选中遭遇挑战，对手是共和党人詹姆斯·H。

en.s: The 1934 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Democrat Theodore F. Green defeated Republican nominee Luke H. Callan with 56.62% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行罗得岛州州长选举。时任民主党州长西奥多·F·格林以56.62%的得票率击败共和党候选人卢克·H·卡伦。

en.s: The 1934 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 6, 1934, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee Herbert O'Conor defeated Republican nominee George Henderson, Socialist nominee William A. Toole, Labor nominee Robert W. Stevens and Communist nominee Tom Pinkerton.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日，马里兰州举行总检察长选举。民主党候选人赫伯特·奥康纳击败共和党候选人乔治·亨德森、社会党候选人威廉·A·图尔、工党候选人罗伯特·W·史蒂文斯和共产党候选人汤姆·平克顿。

en.s: The 1934 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1934. Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party candidate Hjalmar Petersen defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger Franklin F. Ellsworth and Minnesota Democratic Party candidate Arthur D. Reynolds.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。明尼苏达州农工党候选人哈尔马尔·彼得森击败明尼苏达州共和党候选人富兰克林·F·埃尔斯沃思和明尼苏达州民主党候选人阿瑟·D·雷诺兹。

en.s: The 1934 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Democratic governor Hill McAlister won re-election to a second term, defeating Independent nominee Lewis S. Pope in a rematch with 61.8% of the vote. Lewis S. Pope again challenged McAlister for the Democratic nomination, but came up short, winning just 137,253 votes to McAlister's 191,460.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行田纳西州州长选举。时任民主党州长希尔·麦卡利斯特连任第二个任期，在与独立候选人刘易斯·S·波普的重赛中以61.8%的得票率获胜。波普再次挑战麦卡利斯特，参加民主党提名角逐，但未能胜出；他获得137,253票，麦卡利斯特获得191,460票。

en.s: The 1934 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Democratic Governor Tom Berry ran for re-election to a second term. After defeating an intra-party challenge from Lieutenant Governor Hans Ustrud, Berry faced magazine publisher William C. Allen, who won a crowded Republican primary with a large plurality. Aided by the national environment favoring Democrats, Berry won re-election in a landslide.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行南达科他州州长选举。时任民主党州长汤姆·贝里竞选连任第二个任期。他先在党内击败副州长汉斯·乌斯特鲁德的挑战，随后在大选中面对共和党候选人、杂志出版人威廉·C·艾伦。艾伦在竞争激烈的共和党初选中以较大优势胜出。由于当时全国环境有利于民主党，贝里以压倒性优势连任。

en.s: The 1934 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Democrat Edwin C. Johnson defeated Republican nominee Nathan C. Warren with 58.11% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。时任民主党州长埃德温·C·约翰逊以58.11%的得票率击败共和党候选人内森·C·沃伦。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate special election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate special election in Tennessee took place on November 6, 1934, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. The special election was held because incumbent Democratic Senator Cordell Hull resigned to accept the appointment of President Franklin D.

zh.t: 1934年美国田纳西州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1934年美国田纳西州联邦参议院特别选举于11月6日举行，与其他联邦参议院选举、联邦众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。时任民主党参议员科德尔·赫尔辞职，接受富兰克林·D·罗斯福总统任命，出任国务卿，因此举行特别选举。民主党籍州长希尔·麦卡利斯特任命内森·L·巴克曼接替赫尔，完成其未满的参议员任期。巴克曼随后参加特别选举，赢得完整任期，以80.1%的得票率击败独立候选人约翰·伦道夫·尼尔二世。

en.s: The 1934 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Democrat E. W. Marland defeated Republican William B. Pine. Also on the ballot were S. P. Green of the Socialist Party, Francis M. Simpson of the Progressive Party and four Independent candidates: George G. Ison, Joseph Prather Wheat, Dan W. Womack, and John Franing.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行俄克拉何马州州长选举。民主党人E·W·马兰击败共和党人威廉·B·派恩。选票上还有社会党候选人S·P·格林、进步党候选人弗朗西斯·M·辛普森和4名独立候选人：乔治·G·艾森、约瑟夫·普拉瑟·惠特、丹·W·沃马克和约翰·弗雷宁。

en.s: The 1934 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934, in order to elect the governor of Arkansas. Incumbent Democratic governor Junius Marion Futrell was re-elected against Republican nominee G. C. Ledbetter.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日，阿肯色州举行州长选举。时任民主党州长尤尼乌斯·马里昂·富特雷尔击败共和党候选人G·C·莱德贝特，成功连任。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican Senator Simeon Fess ran for a third term in office, but was defeated by Democratic former Governor of Ohio Vic Donahey in a landslide.

zh.t: 1934年俄亥俄州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行俄亥俄州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员西缅·费斯竞选第三个任期，但以压倒性劣势败给民主党人、前俄亥俄州州长维克·多纳希。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 6, 1934. Republican Senator Arthur Vandenberg was re-elected to a second consecutive term over Democrat Frank Picard.

zh.t: 1934年密歇根州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行密歇根州美国参议院选举。共和党参议员阿瑟·范登堡击败民主党候选人弗兰克·皮卡德，再次当选，开始连续第二个任期。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican Senator Frederic C. Walcott ran for re-election to a second term, but was defeated by Democratic U.S. Representative Francis T. Maloney.

zh.t: 1934年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行康涅狄格州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员弗雷德里克·C·沃尔科特竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党联邦众议员弗朗西斯·T·马洛尼。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John G. Townsend Jr. was re-elected to a second term in office over Democratic U.S. Representative Wilbur L. Adams.

zh.t: 1934年特拉华州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行特拉华州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员小约翰·G·汤森击败民主党联邦众议员威尔伯·L·亚当斯，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1934 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 6, 1934, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller William S. Gordy Jr. defeated Republican nominee Frederic Paul Adkins, Socialist nominee Lee H. Lacey, Labor nominee Morris Levitt and Communist nominee Roy Howell.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日，马里兰州举行审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任审计长威廉·S·戈迪二世击败共和党候选人弗雷德里克·保罗·阿德金斯、社会党候选人李·H·莱西、工党候选人莫里斯·莱维特和共产党候选人罗伊·豪厄尔。

en.s: The 1934 Iowa gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Democrat Clyde L. Herring defeated Republican nominee Dan W. Turner with 51.75% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行艾奥瓦州州长选举。时任民主党州长克莱德·L·赫林以51.75%的得票率击败共和党候选人丹·W·特纳。

en.s: The 1934 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Republican nominee Harry Nice defeated Democratic incumbent Albert Ritchie with 49.52% of the vote in a rematch of the 1919 election.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行马里兰州州长选举。这是1919年选举的重赛。共和党候选人哈里·尼斯以49.52%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长阿尔伯特·里奇。

en.s: The 1934 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1934, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat Andrew W. Hockenhull, who had succeeded to the governorship in 1933 following the death of Arthur Seligman, did not run for election to a full term.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行新墨西哥州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长安德鲁·W·霍肯赫尔于1933年亚瑟·塞利格曼去世后接任州长，但没有竞选完整任期。

en.s: The 1934 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Walter H. Jurgensen, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee Charles W. Johnson.

zh.t: 1934年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。民主党籍时任副州长沃尔特·H·尤根森击败共和党候选人查尔斯·W·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1934 Nevada gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Democratic nominee Richard Kirman Sr. defeated incumbent Republican Morley Griswold with 53.94% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行内华达州州长选举。民主党候选人理查德·柯曼老先生以53.94%的得票率击败时任共和党州长莫利·格里斯沃尔德。

en.s: The 1934 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Democratic nominee Thomas H. Moodie defeated Republican nominee Lydia Cady Langer with 52.98% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行北达科他州州长选举。民主党候选人托马斯·H·穆迪以52.98%的得票率击败共和党候选人莉迪亚·凯迪·兰格。

en.s: The 1934 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Democratic Governor Leslie A. Miller ran for re-election to his second term, and his first full term, following his initial election in the 1932 special election. Miller faced Republican Alonzo M. Clark, his predecessor as governor, in the general election. Despite the closeness of Miller's first election, he took advantage of the nationwide Democratic landslide and easily defeated Clark.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行怀俄明州州长选举。时任民主党州长莱斯利·A·米勒竞选连任第二个任期，也是他的第一个完整任期；他此前在1932年特别选举中首次当选。大选中，米勒面对前州长、共和党人阿朗佐·M·克拉克。尽管米勒上次选举胜负接近，这次他借助民主党在全国大选中的大胜，轻松击败克拉克。

en.s: The 1934 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Primary elections were held on September 18, 1934. Incumbent Democratic Governor Albert G. Schmedeman was defeated by Progressive nominee Philip La Follette. As of 2022, this is the last time Green Lake County has voted for the Democratic nominee for governor. This is also the only gubernatorial election in which Waushara County did not vote for the Republican candidate.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举。初选于1934年9月18日举行。时任民主党州长阿尔伯特·G·施梅德曼败给进步党候选人菲利普·拉福莱特。截至2022年，这是绿湖县最后一次在州长选举中支持民主党候选人；这也是沃沙拉县唯一一次没有投票支持共和党候选人的州长选举。

en.s: The 1934 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Republican nominee Frank Fitzgerald defeated Democratic nominee Arthur J. Lacy with 52.41% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。共和党候选人弗兰克·菲茨杰拉德以52.41%的得票率击败民主党候选人阿瑟·J·莱西。

en.s: The 1934 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1934. Democratic nominee Martin L. Davey defeated Republican nominee Clarence J. Brown with 51.13% of the vote.

zh.s: 1934年11月6日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。民主党候选人马丁·L·戴维以51.13%的得票率击败共和党候选人克拉伦斯·J·布朗。

en.s: The 1934 New York State Election was held on November 6, 1934, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general, a U.S. senator, two U.S. representatives-at-large, the chief judge and two associate judges of the New York Court of Appeals, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1934年纽约州选举于11月6日举行，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、总检察长、美国参议员、两名无特定选区的美国众议员、纽约州上诉法院首席法官和两名副法官，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院全体议员。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 6, 1934, to elect a U.S. Senator. Incumbent Democratic Senator Royal Copeland was re-elected to a third term in office, though he would die in office in 1938.

zh.s: 1934年纽约州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出美国参议员。民主党现任参议员罗亚尔·科普兰连任第三个任期，但于1938年在任内去世。

en.t: 1934 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1934 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 6, 1934. Incumbent Democrat Clarence Dill did not run for a third term in office. He was succeeded by Democrat Lewis Schwellenbach, who defeated Republican Reno Odlin for the open seat.

zh.t: 1934年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1934年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任参议员克拉伦斯·迪尔没有竞选第三个任期。民主党人刘易斯·施韦伦巴赫接替他，击败共和党人雷诺·奥德林赢得空缺席位。

en.s: The 1934 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 6. Incumbent Democrat C. Ben Ross defeated Republican nominee Frank Stephan with 54.58% of the vote. This was the last re-election of an incumbent Idaho governor for 24 years, until 1958. Ross opted not to run for a fourth term in 1936; he ran for the U.S. Senate against its dean, Republican William Borah, who won a sixth term.

zh.s: 1934年爱达荷州州长选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任州长C·本·罗斯以54.58%的选票击败共和党提名人弗兰克·斯蒂芬。这是爱达荷州现任州长直到1958年才再次成功连任的最后一次。罗斯没有在1936年竞选第四个任期，而是转而挑战美国参议院任职时间最长的成员、共和党人威廉·博拉；博拉赢得第六个任期。

en.s: The 1934 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1934 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 22 of the state senate's 50 districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the 1934 elections is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1934年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的22个选区选出州参议员。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1934年选举中50个州参议院选区的全州地图。

en.t: The Hawker Hurricane prototype makes its first flight
en.s: The prototype Hawker Hurricane fighter, K5083, made its first flight on 6 November 1935. Designed by Sydney Camm’s Hawker team, the aircraft later entered squadron service in December 1937.
en.n: This entry records the prototype’s first flight.

zh.s: 霍克飓风战斗机原型机K5083于1935年11月6日首次飞行。飞机由悉尼·坎姆领导的霍克团队设计，后来于1937年12月进入中队服役。
zh.n: 此条记录记载霍克飓风原型机的首次飞行。

en.t: Spanish Civil War: The republican government flees from Madrid to Valencia, leading to the formation of the Madrid Defense Council in its stead
en.s: The Spanish Civil War (Spanish: guerra civil española) was fought in Spain from 1936 to 1939 between the Republicans and the Nationalist rebels. Republicans loyal to the left-leaning Popular Front government of the Second Spanish Republic included socialists, anarchists, communists, and separatists, supported by the Soviet Union. The opposing Nationalists were an alliance of Falangists, monarchists, conservatives, traditionalists, syndicalists and fascists, supported by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy.

zh.t: 西班牙内战：共和政府从马德里撤往瓦伦西亚，随后成立马德里防卫委员会接替其职能
zh.s: 西班牙内战（西班牙语：guerra civil española）于1936年至1939年在西班牙爆发，交战双方为共和派和民族主义叛军。效忠于第二共和国左倾人民阵线政府的共和派包括社会主义者、无政府主义者、共产主义者和分离主义者，并得到苏联支持。民族主义阵营则由长枪党人、君主主义者、保守派、传统主义者、工团主义者和法西斯主义者组成，得到纳粹德国和法西斯意大利支持。

en.s: The Anti-Comintern Pact, officially the Agreement against the Communist International, was an anti-communist pact concluded between Nazi Germany and the Empire of Japan on 25 November 1936 and directed against the Communist International (Comintern). It was signed by the German ambassador-at-large Joachim von Ribbentrop and the Japanese ambassador to Germany Kintomo Mushanokōji.

zh.t: 意大利加入《反共产国际协定》
zh.s: 《反共产国际协定》的正式名称为《反对共产国际协定》，是纳粹德国与日本帝国于1936年11月25日缔结的反共协定，旨在对抗共产国际。协定由德国无任所大使约阿希姆·冯·里宾特洛甫和日本驻德国大使武者小路公共签署。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Poland on 6 November 1938, with Senate elections held a week later on 13 November. They were the last elections in the Second Polish Republic. This election was held under the April Constitution of 1935, which was written to favor the Sanation movement. The Camp of National Unity, the party of the Sanation movement, won 164 of the 208 seats in the Sejm and 66 of the 96 seats in the Senate.

zh.s: 1938年11月6日，波兰举行议会选举；参议院选举一周后于11月13日举行。这是波兰第二共和国最后一次选举。选举依据1935年《四月宪法》举行，该宪法旨在使萨纳齐亚运动受益。萨纳齐亚运动的政党民族团结阵营赢得众议院208席中的164席，以及参议院96席中的66席。

en.s: The action off Cape Bougaroun (Cap Bougaroûn) [Attack on Convoy KMF 25A], was a Luftwaffe operation against an Allied naval convoy off the coast of Algeria during World War II. The convoy of American, British, Greek and Dutch ships was attacked on 6 November 1943 by 25 German bombers and torpedo-bombers. Six Allied vessels were sunk or damaged and seven German aircraft were shot down.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，德国空军在阿尔及利亚海岸外对盟军KMF 25A船队发动“布加龙角攻击”行动。1943年11月6日，25架德国轰炸机和鱼雷轰炸机袭击由美国、英国、希腊和荷兰船只组成的船队。6艘盟军船只被击沉或受损，7架德国飞机被击落。

en.t: 1944 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The regular-term 1944 United States Senate election in Kentucky took place on November 6, 1944. Democratic Senator and Senate Majority Leader Alben Barkley was re-elected to a fourth term in office over Republican James Park.

zh.t: 1944年肯塔基州美国参议院常规任期选举
zh.s: 1944年11月6日举行肯塔基州美国参议院常规任期选举。民主党参议员、参议院多数党领袖阿尔本·巴克利击败共和党候选人詹姆斯·帕克，连任第四个任期。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1945 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 6, 1945. Incumbent Democratic Party Conn Scully chose not to seek reelection. State Democratic Party chairman and longtime Pittsburgh political player David Lawrence was elected to succeed him in what is the city's most recent competitive race. Bob Waddell, the popular football coach of Carnegie Tech (now Carnegie Mellon University) ran for a second time using his colorful personality and sports fame. However, the powerful Lawrence was able to rally a large base en route to a close win.

zh.s: 1945年11月6日星期二，宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长康恩·斯卡利决定不竞选连任。州民主党主席、长期活跃于匹兹堡政坛的大卫·劳伦斯当选接任；这是该市近来最后一次竞争激烈的市长选举。卡内基理工学院（现卡内基梅隆大学）广受欢迎的橄榄球教练鲍勃·沃德尔再次参选，凭借鲜明个性和体育名气竞选。不过，势力强大的劳伦斯成功团结起大量支持者，以微弱优势获胜。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1945 took place on November 6, 1945 in New York City. The candidates were King County District Attorney William O'Dwyer, a Democrat, and Jonah J. Goldstein, a Republican judge, as well as other, third party candidates. O'Dwyer won the contest with 56.77% of the vote.

zh.s: 1945年11月6日，纽约市举行市长选举。候选人包括民主党人、金斯县地方检察官威廉·奥德怀尔，共和党法官乔纳·J·戈尔德斯坦，以及其他小党候选人。奥德怀尔以56.77%的得票率获胜。

en.s: The 1945 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1945, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Virginia. Democratic nominee and incumbent member of the Virginia House of Delegates Lewis Preston Collins II defeated Republican nominee Carl A. Marshall and Independent candidate and incumbent member of the Virginia House of Delegates Charles R. Fenwick.

zh.s: 1945年11月6日，弗吉尼亚州举行副州长选举。民主党候选人、时任弗吉尼亚州众议员刘易斯·普雷斯顿·柯林斯二世击败共和党候选人卡尔·A·马歇尔，以及独立候选人、时任弗吉尼亚州众议员查尔斯·R·芬威克。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1945 occurred on Tuesday, November 6, 1945. Former Mayor of Boston James Michael Curley defeated acting mayor John E. Kerrigan and four other candidates. Curley was inaugurated on Monday, January 7, 1946.

zh.s: 1945年11月6日星期二举行波士顿市长选举。波士顿前市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利击败代理市长约翰·E·克里根和另外4名候选人。柯利于1946年1月7日星期一就职。

en.s: The Detroit mayoral election of 1945 took place on November 6, 1945. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Edward J. Jeffries Jr. to a fourth term.

zh.s: 1945年11月6日举行底特律市长选举。现任市长小爱德华·J·杰弗里斯连任，开始第四个任期。

en.s: In the 1945 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor Colgate Darden, a Democrat, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. Lieutenant Governor William M. Tuck was nominated by the Democratic Party to run against Republican state senator S. Floyd Landreth.

zh.s: 1945年弗吉尼亚州州长选举中，民主党籍时任州长科尔盖特·达登因任期限制不能寻求连任。民主党提名副州长威廉·M·塔克，对阵共和党州参议员S·弗洛伊德·兰德雷斯。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 1945, in the state of Virginia. Virginia holds its gubernatorial elections in odd numbered years, every 4 years, following the United States presidential election year.

zh.s: 1945年，美国仅弗吉尼亚州举行州长选举。弗吉尼亚州每四年在奇数年份举行州长选举，时间安排在美国总统选举年份之后。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1945 saw the election of Thomas A. Burke.

zh.s: 1945年克利夫兰市长选举由托马斯·A·伯克胜出。

en.t: Meet the Press, the longest running television program in history, makes its debut on NBC Television
en.s: Meet the Press, also known as Meet the Press with Kristen Welker, is a weekly American television Sunday morning talk show broadcast on NBC. It is the longest-running program on American television, though its format has changed since the debut episode on November 6, 1947. Meet the Press specializes in interviews with leaders in Washington, D.C., across the country, and around the world on issues of politics, economics, foreign policy, and other public affairs, along with panel discussions that provide opinions and analysis.

zh.s: 《与媒体见面》（又名《与克里斯汀·韦尔克一起与媒体见面》）是美国每周日早间播出的NBC访谈节目，也是美国电视史上播出时间最长的节目。节目形式虽已改变，但首期节目于1947年11月6日播出。节目主要采访华盛顿、全美及世界各地的领导人，讨论政治、经济、外交政策和其他公共事务，也会安排小组讨论，提供观点和分析。

en.s: The Huaihai campaign (Chinese: 淮海戰役; pinyin: Huáihǎi Zhànyì), or Battle of Hsupeng (traditional Chinese: 徐蚌會戰; simplified Chinese: 徐蚌会战; pinyin: Xúbèng Huìzhàn), was one of the military conflicts in the late stage of the Chinese Civil War between the Kuomintang and the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). The campaign started when the People's Liberation Army (PLA) launched a major offensive against the Kuomintang headquarters in Xuzhou on 6 November 1948, and ended on 10 January 1949 when the PLA reached the north of the Yangtze.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 淮海战役又称徐蚌会战，是国共内战后期国民党与中国共产党之间的一场军事战役。1948年11月6日，中国人民解放军向国民党军位于徐州的指挥中枢发动大规模攻势，战役由此开始；至1949年1月10日，解放军推进至长江以北地区，战役结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: Philadelphia's municipal election of November 6, 1951 was the first held under the city's new charter, which had been approved by the voters the previous April. The positions contested included those of mayor, district attorney, all seventeen city council seats, among other offices. There was also a referendum on whether to consolidate the city and county governments. Citywide, the Democrats took majorities of over 100,000 votes, breaking a 67-year Republican hold on city government. Joseph S. Clark, Jr. and Richardson Dilworth, two of the main movers for the charter reform, were elected mayor and district attorney, respectively.

zh.s: 费城于1951年11月6日举行地方选举，这是该市新宪章通过后举行的首场选举。新宪章于前一年4月获选民批准。改选职位包括市长、地方检察官、全部17个市议会席位等；选民还就是否合并市政府和县政府举行公投。民主党在全市的领先票数超过10万票，结束了共和党对市政府长达67年的控制。推动宪章改革的主要人物之一约瑟夫·S·克拉克二世当选市长，理查森·迪尔沃思当选地方检察官。

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1951 occurred on Tuesday, November 6, 1951 between Mayor John B. Hynes and former Mayor James Michael Curley. Hynes was elected to his second term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 25, 1951.

zh.s: 1951年11月6日星期二，波士顿举行市长选举，由市长约翰·B·海因斯对阵前市长詹姆斯·迈克尔·柯利。海因斯当选，开始第二个任期。无党派市政预选于1951年9月25日举行。

en.s: The Columbus mayoral election of 1951 was the 69th mayoral election in Columbus, Ohio. It was held on Tuesday, November 6, 1951. During the primary nomination on August 14, 1951, the Columbus electorate nominated two Republicans, incumbent mayor Jim Rhodes and former mayor Floyd F. Green, to compete in the general election. Incumbent mayor Rhodes defeated Green.

zh.t: 俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长选举，1951
zh.s: 1951年11月6日星期二，俄亥俄州哥伦布市举行第69次市长选举。1951年8月14日的提名初选中，选民提名两名共和党人参加大选：现任市长吉姆·罗兹和前市长弗洛伊德·F·格林。罗兹击败格林，成功连任。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1951 took place on November 6, 1951, and saw the election of Republican municipal court judge Alex M. Clark as mayor, defeating Democratic incumbent Philip L. Bayt. Clark became one of the youngest mayors in Indianapolis' history.

zh.t: 1951年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1951年11月6日举行印第安纳波利斯市长选举。共和党市政法院法官亚历克斯·M·克拉克当选市长，击败民主党籍时任市长菲利普·L·贝特。克拉克成为印第安纳波利斯历史上最年轻的市长之一。

en.s: The 1951 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1951, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Fielding L. Wright was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second full term. As was common at the time, the Democratic candidate ran unopposed in the general election; therefore the Democratic primary was the real contest, and winning the primary was considered tantamount to election.

zh.s: 1951年11月6日举行密西西比州州长选举。时任民主党州长菲尔丁·L·赖特受任期限制，不能竞选第二个完整任期。按照当时的常见情况，民主党候选人在大选中没有对手，因此真正的竞争发生在民主党初选；赢得初选就等同于当选州长。

en.s: The 1951 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1951. Incumbent Democrat Lawrence Wetherby defeated Republican nominee Eugene Siler with 54.60% of the vote.

zh.s: 1951年11月6日举行肯塔基州州长选举。时任民主党州长劳伦斯·韦瑟比以54.60%的得票率击败共和党候选人尤金·赛勒。

en.s: The 1951 San Francisco mayoral election was held on November 6, 1951. Incumbent mayor Elmer Robinson narrowly won re-election with 38% of the vote.

zh.s: 1951年旧金山市长选举于11月6日举行。现任市长埃尔默·罗宾逊以38%的选票险胜，成功连任。

en.s: Elections are currently held every four years to elect the mayor of Springfield, Massachusetts. Before 1961, mayoral elections were partisan. Starting in 1961, they have been nonpartisan. Terms had, originally, been for a length of a single year, but were later extended to two years. Starting with the 2011 mayoral election, terms were extended further to four years.

zh.t: 马萨诸塞州斯普林菲尔德市长选举
zh.s: 斯普林菲尔德目前每四年举行一次市长选举。1961年以前，市长选举按党派举行；1961年起改为无党派选举。市长任期最初为一年，后来延长至两年。自2011年市长选举起，任期进一步延长至四年。

en.s: The Second Battle of Maryang-san (4–6 November 1951) was fought during the Korean War, in which British forces, possessing a Maryang-san (Hill 317, a.k.a. Hill 315) and surrounding area (Hill 217), were overwhelmed by Chinese forces. The hill remained in Chinese hands for the remainder of the war.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次马良山战役于1951年11月4日至6日在朝鲜战争期间进行。中国军队击溃了占据马良山（317高地，又称315高地）及周边地区（217高地）的英军。此后直到战争结束，该山一直由中国军队控制。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1954
en.s: The United States House of Representatives elections in California, 1954 was an election for California's delegation to the United States House of Representatives, which occurred as part of the general election of the House of Representatives on November 6, 1954. Democrats gained two seats and lost one seat.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，1954
zh.s: 1954年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州联邦众议院选举，选出该州在联邦众议院的代表。民主党赢得两席，同时失去一席。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1956
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 6, 1956. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1956 United States presidential election. New Jersey voters chose 16 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New Jersey was won overwhelmingly by the Republican nominees, incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower of Pennsylvania and his running mate incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon of California. Eisenhower and Nixon defeated the Democratic nominees, former Governor Adlai Stevenson of Illinois and his running mate Senator Estes Kefauver of Tennessee.

zh.s: 1956年美国新泽西州总统选举于11月6日举行。当时美国48个州均参与总统选举。新泽西州选民选出16名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州籍现任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔及其竞选搭档、时任副总统理查德·尼克松（加利福尼亚州人）在新泽西州以压倒性优势获胜。他们击败了民主党候选人、前伊利诺伊州州长阿德莱·史蒂文森，以及他的竞选搭档、田纳西州参议员埃斯蒂斯·基福弗。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1956
en.s: The 1956 United States Presidential Election in Vermont took place on November 6, 1956 as part of the 1956 United States Presidential Election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Vermont voted overwhelmingly for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower of Pennsylvania, over the Democratic nominee, former Governor Adlai Stevenson of Illinois. Eisenhower ran with incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon of California, while Stevenson's running mate was Senator Estes Kefauver of Tennessee.

zh.s: 1956年美国佛蒙特州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国48个州共同参与的总统选举的一部分。选民选出3名代表，也就是选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。佛蒙特州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州籍现任总统德怀特·艾森豪威尔，击败民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州前州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。艾森豪威尔的竞选搭档是加利福尼亚州籍现任副总统理查德·尼克松；史蒂文森的搭档是田纳西州参议员埃斯蒂斯·基福弗。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 1956
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 6, 1956. All 48 states were part of the United States presidential election. New Mexico voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College, which voted for President and Vice President. New Mexico was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower by a 16-point landslide. Running against Eisenhower was former Governor of Illinois Adlai Stevenson, whom Eisenhower had earlier defeated for the Presidency in 1952. This election reflected one of the last election cycles where the Democratic Party still had post Civil War political domination of the deep South.

zh.t: 1956年美国新墨西哥州总统选举
zh.s: 1956年美国新墨西哥州总统选举于11月6日举行。当时美国48个州均参与总统选举。新墨西哥州选民选出4名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。现任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔以16个百分点的优势大胜。他的对手是伊利诺伊州前州长阿德莱·史蒂文森，艾森豪威尔曾于1952年击败他。这次选举反映出当时美国民主党在南方腹地的内战后政治优势仍在，但这种情况已接近尾声。

en.s: The 1956 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Governor of Montana J. Hugo Aronson, who was first elected Governor in 1952, ran for re-election. He was unopposed in the Republican primary and advanced to the general election, where he faced Arnold Olsen, the Attorney General of Montana and the Democratic nominee. Despite the fact that then-President Dwight D. Eisenhower won the state in a landslide that year in the presidential election, Aronson only narrowly defeated Arnold to win his second and final term as governor.

zh.s: 1956年蒙大拿州州长选举于11月6日举行。1952年首次当选的现任州长J·雨果·阿伦森竞选连任。他在共和党初选中没有对手，晋级大选，对手是蒙大拿州检察长、民主党候选人阿诺德·奥尔森。尽管时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔当年以压倒性优势赢得蒙大拿州，阿伦森仍以微弱优势击败奥尔森，赢得第二个也是最后一个州长任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Pennsylvania, 1956
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Pennsylvania took place on November 6, 1956 throughout the continuous 48 states, but not Alaska or Hawaii which would be admitted to the Union in 1959. Voters chose 32 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Pennsylvania overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, President Dwight D. Eisenhower, over the Democratic nominee, former Illinois Governor Adlai Stevenson. Pennsylvania was the home state of President Eisenhower as he moved to the Gettysburg area after World War II. Eisenhower won Pennsylvania by a massive margin of 13.19%.

zh.t: 1956年美国宾夕法尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1956年美国宾夕法尼亚州总统选举于11月6日在美国本土48州举行，阿拉斯加和夏威夷当时尚未成为州。宾夕法尼亚州选民选出32名代表，也就是选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。宾夕法尼亚州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔，击败民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州前州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。艾森豪威尔在宾夕法尼亚州以13.19个百分点的巨大优势获胜。二战后，艾森豪威尔已迁居该州葛底斯堡一带。

en.t: United States presidential election in Virginia, 1956
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Virginia took place on November 6, 1956 throughout the 48 contiguous states. Voters chose 12 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Virginia voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Dwight Eisenhower, over the Democratic nominee, former Illinois Governor Adlai Stevenson and former Commissioner of Internal Revenue T. Coleman Andrews, who received the nomination of the States' Rights Party. Andrews had his strongest showing in his home state of Virginia. Eisenhower ultimately won the national election with 57.37% of the vote.

zh.t: 1956年美国弗吉尼亚州总统选举

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 1956
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 6, 1956. All contemporary 48 states were part of the 1956 United States presidential election. New York voters chose forty five electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President. New York was won by incumbent Republican President Dwight D. Eisenhower, who was running against former Democratic Governor of Illinois Adlai Stevenson. Eisenhower ran with incumbent Vice President Richard Nixon, and Stevenson ran with Tennessee Senator, and principal opponent during the 1956 Democratic Primaries, Estes Kefauver. Eisenhower received 61.19% of the vote to Stevenson's 38.78%, a margin of 22.41%.

en.s: The United States presidential election of 1956 was the 43rd quadrennial presidential election, held on Tuesday, November 6, 1956. The popular incumbent President, Republican Dwight D. Eisenhower, successfully ran for re-election. The election was a re-match of 1952, as Eisenhower's opponent in 1956 was Adlai Stevenson, a former Illinois governor, whom Eisenhower had defeated four years earlier. Eisenhower was popular, although his health had become a quiet issue. Stevenson remained popular with a core of liberal Democrats, but held no office and had no real base. He (and Eisenhower) largely ignored the subject of civil rights.

zh.s: 1956年美国总统选举是美国第43次四年一度总统选举，于11月6日星期二举行。广受欢迎的共和党籍现任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔成功连任。这场选举重演了1952年的对决，艾森豪威尔再次对阵伊利诺伊州前州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。艾森豪威尔声望很高，但他的健康状况逐渐成为一个私下关注的问题。史蒂文森仍受到一部分自由派民主党人的支持，但没有担任公职，也缺乏真正的政治基础。他和艾森豪威尔都很少谈到民权问题。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1956
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 1956 in Minnesota as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. The Republican Party candidate, incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower won the state over former Illinois governor Adlai Stevenson by a margin of 101,777 votes, or 7.6%. Eisenhower went on to win the election nationally, with 457 electoral votes and a landslide 15.4% lead over Stevenson in the popular vote. The 1956 presidential election was a rematch of the 1952 election, in which Eisenhower also defeated Stevenson, both nationally and in Minnesota.

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1956
en.s: The 1956 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 6, 1956. The incumbent, Republican Senator Milton Young, sought and received re-election to his third term, defeating North Dakota Democratic-NPL Party candidate Quentin N. Burdick, son of North Dakota congressman Usher L. Burdick. Only Young filed as a Republican, and the endorsed Democratic candidate was Quentin Burdick, the son of well-known politician Usher Burdick, and former candidate for Governor of North Dakota. zh.s: 1956年11月6日，印第安纳州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。共和党候选人、时任美国总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔和副总统理查德·尼克松，击败民主党候选人、前伊利诺伊州州长阿德莱·史蒂文森二世和田纳西州资深联邦参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Florida
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Florida was held on November 6, 1956, as part of the concurrent United States presidential election. Florida voters chose ten electors, or representatives to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Except for the 1928 election when fierce anti-Catholicism and Prohibitionism caused Herbert Hoover to defeat the wet Catholic Al Smith, Florida since the end of Reconstruction had been a classic Southern one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 美国佛罗里达州总统选举，1956

en.s: The 1956 Arizona Senate election was held on November 6, 1956. Voters elected all 28 members of the Arizona Senate to serve two-year terms. en.t: 1956 United States House of Representatives elections

en.s: The 1956 United States Senate elections in Kansas took place on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Republican Senator Frank Carlson ran for re-election to a second full term. Carlson defeated Hart in a landslide, as Republican President Dwight D.

zh.t: 1956年美国堪萨斯州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年美国堪萨斯州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍现任参议员弗兰克·卡尔森竞选连任，争取第二个完整任期。他在党内初选中胜出，随后在普选中对阵乔治·哈特；哈特是1954年民主党副州长候选人。卡尔森以压倒性优势击败哈特；共和党总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔也以压倒性优势赢得堪萨斯州。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Maryland

Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 60.04% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 39.96% of the popular vote.

State voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Louisiana was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 53.28% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 39.51% of the popular vote.

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Idaho
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Idaho was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 61.17% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 38.78% of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日，爱达荷州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得61.17%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得38.78%。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Democratic Senator Sam Ervin was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican farmer and businessman Joel Johnson.

zh.t: 1956年北卡罗来纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行北卡罗来纳州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员萨姆·欧文击败共和党农民和商人乔尔·约翰逊，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Wyoming took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. en.t: 1956 United States Senate special election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate special election in Kentucky was held on November 6, 1956, to fill the vacant seat left by Alben Barkley. Former Senator John Sherman Cooper was elected to complete the term ending in 1961, defeating Democratic former Governor Lawrence Wetherby.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行得克萨斯州州长选举。时任民主党州长艾伦·希弗斯没有竞选第四个任期。参议员普莱斯·丹尼尔赢得选举，得票率超过78%。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in New Hampshire

zh.s: 1956年11月6日，特拉华州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得55.09%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得44.62%。

Ernest McFarland defeated longtime The Arizona Republic journalist and Republican nominee Horace B. Griffen in the general election by a wide margin.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行亚利桑那州州长选举。时任州长欧内斯特·麦克法兰竞选第二个任期。他在大选中以较大优势击败共和党候选人霍勒斯·B·格里芬；格里芬长期担任《亚利桑那共和报》记者。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Ohio
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Ohio took place on November 6, 1956, throughout all 48 states, which was part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Voters chose 25 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Ohio was won by the Republican Party candidate, incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower. He won all counties except for Pike County.

zh.t: 美国俄亥俄州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，俄亥俄州举行总统选举，作为在全部48个州举行的1956年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出25名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔赢得俄亥俄州，除派克县外，他赢得了所有县。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. North Carolina voters chose 14 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. As a former Confederate state, North Carolina had a history of Jim Crow laws, disfranchisement of its African-American population and dominance of the Democratic Party in state politics.

zh.t: 美国北卡罗来纳州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，北卡罗来纳州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。北卡罗来纳州选民选出14名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。作为前美利坚联盟国成员州，北卡罗来纳州曾实行种族隔离法，剥夺非裔美国人的选举权，州政治也长期由民主党主导。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate special election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate special election in West Virginia took place on November 6, 1956, to elect a U.S. Senator to complete the unexpired term of Senator Harley M. Kilgore, who died on February 28. 1956. State Tax Commissioner William Laird III was appointed to fill this seat by Governor William C. Marland to fill the vacancy until a special election could be held and assumed office on March 13, 1956.

zh.t: 1956年西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院特别选举，选出一名参议员完成哈雷·M·基尔戈尔的剩余任期。基尔戈尔于1956年2月28日去世。州长威廉·C·马兰任命州税务专员威廉·莱尔德三世填补空缺；莱尔德于1956年3月13日就任，任职至特别选举举行。

en.s: The 1956 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Republican nominee John E. Davis defeated Democratic nominee Wallace E. Warner with 58.46% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行北达科他州州长选举。共和党候选人约翰·E·戴维斯以58.46%的得票率击败民主党候选人华莱士·E·华纳。

en.s: The 1956 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 6, 1956. Voters elected members of the Arizona House of Representatives in all 80 of the state's House districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 11, 1956.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行亚利桑那州众议院选举，选出州众议院全部80个选区的议员，任期两年。选举与其他职位选举同时举行，包括州长、美国参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院选举。初选于1956年9月11日举行。

en.s: The 1956 Wisconsin gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Republican nominee Vernon W. Thomson defeated Democratic nominee William Proxmire with 51.89% of the vote. Proxmire was defeated for the third consecutive gubernatorial election; he would subsequently win a special election for the United States Senate the following year after the death of Joseph McCarthy.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举。共和党候选人弗农·W·汤姆森以51.89%的得票率击败民主党候选人威廉·普罗克斯迈尔。普罗克斯迈尔连续第三次在州长选举中落败。次年约瑟夫·麦卡锡去世后，他在美国参议院特别选举中获胜。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Tennessee took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Tennessee voters chose eleven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Incumbent Republican Dwight D. Eisenhower narrowly carried the state over Democratic candidate Adlai Stevenson, becoming the first Republican nominee ever to carry the state more than once.

zh.t: 美国田纳西州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，田纳西州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。田纳西州选民选出11名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。时任共和党总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔以微弱优势赢得田纳西州，击败民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森；他也成为首位不止一次赢得该州的共和党总统候选人。

en.s: The 1956 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Republican Governor Joe Foss defeated Democratic nominee Ralph Herseth with 54.39% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行南达科他州州长选举。时任共和党州长乔·福斯以54.39%的得票率击败民主党候选人拉尔夫·赫塞思。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Republican Senator Herman Welker was defeated for re-election by Democratic nominee Frank Church.

zh.t: 1956年爱达荷州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行爱达荷州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员赫尔曼·韦尔克在连任竞选中败给民主党候选人弗兰克·丘奇。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Colorado
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. State voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Colorado was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 59.49% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 39.81% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国科罗拉多州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，科罗拉多州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得59.49%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得39.81%。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 6, 1956, in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, Secretary of the Commonwealth, treasurer, and auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, state representatives, state senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held on September 18, 1956.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日，马萨诸塞州举行大选，包括州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、州财政部长和审计长等全州职位选举；联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长委员会成员等选区选举；以及州级和地方公投问题。民主党和共和党候选人由两党于1956年9月18日举行的初选选出。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Missouri
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Democrat Adlai Stevenson II narrowly won the state of Missouri over the Republican incumbent, Dwight D. Eisenhower, thanks in large part to a 72,000-vote margin in St.

zh.s: 1956年美国密苏里州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出13名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森二世以微弱优势击败共和党籍时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔，赢得密苏里州；圣路易斯地区的72,000票优势是重要原因。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Kansas
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Kansas took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kansas was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 65.44 percent of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 34.21 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国堪萨斯州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，堪萨斯州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得65.44%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得34.21%。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 6, 1956. Primaries were held on April 10, 1956. The results strongly favored the Republican Party, which retained control both chambers of the Illinois General Assembly as well as all statewide elected executive offices. They also won the state in the presidential election, retained the U.S. Senate seat up for election, and flipped a single U.S.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日星期二，伊利诺伊州举行选举。初选于1956年4月10日举行。结果明显有利于共和党，该党保住伊利诺伊州议会两院和全部州级行政职位。共和党还赢得该州总统选举，保住当年改选的联邦参议院席位，并增加一个联邦众议院席位。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Alabama
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Alabama took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Alabama voters chose eleven representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. In Alabama, voters voted for electors individually instead of as a slate, as in the other states.

zh.t: 美国阿拉巴马州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，阿拉巴马州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。阿拉巴马州选民选出11名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。与其他州不同，阿拉巴马州选民分别投票选择各名选举人，而不是对一份选举人名单投票。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Utah
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. State voters chose four representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Utah was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 64.56 percent of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 35.44 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日，犹他州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。犹他州选民选出4名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得64.56%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得35.44%。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 6, 1956 to elect one of Illinois's members to the United States Senate. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Everett Dirksen won reelection to a second term.

zh.t: 1956年伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举，选出一名联邦参议员。时任共和党参议员埃弗里特·德克森再次当选，开始第二个任期。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in South Carolina
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in South Carolina took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. South Carolina voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. For six decades up to 1950 South Carolina had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party.

zh.t: 美国南卡罗来纳州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，南卡罗来纳州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。直到1950年之前的60年里，南卡罗来纳州一直由民主党主导，实行一党制。

en.s: The 1956 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Democrat G. Mennen Williams defeated Republican nominee Albert E. Cobo with 54.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。时任民主党州长G·梅嫩·威廉姆斯以54.65%的得票率击败共和党候选人阿尔伯特·E·科博。

en.s: The 1956 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Democratic governor Dennis J. Roberts defeated Republican Christopher Del Sesto narrowly after five thousand ballots were invalidated by the Rhode Island Supreme Court.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行罗得岛州州长选举。时任民主党州长丹尼斯·J·罗伯茨击败共和党候选人克里斯托弗·德尔·塞斯托，胜负接近。罗得岛州最高法院宣布5,000张选票无效后，罗伯茨获胜。

en.s: The 1956 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Democratic Governor Orval Faubus won election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Roy Mitchell with 80.65% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行阿肯色州州长选举。时任民主党州长奥瓦尔·福布斯以80.65%的得票率击败共和党候选人罗伊·米切尔，连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Oregon
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Oregon took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oregon was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 55.25% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 44.75% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国俄勒冈州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，俄勒冈州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得55.25%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得44.75%。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Louisiana was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Russell B. Long won re-election to a third term. At this time, Louisiana was a one-party state. Long's victory in the July 31 primary was tantamount to election, and he was unopposed in the general election.

zh.t: 1956年路易斯安那州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行路易斯安那州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员拉塞尔·B·朗再次当选，开始第三个任期。当时路易斯安那州由民主党一党主导。朗在7月31日的初选中获胜就等于当选，因为他在大选中没有对手。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Michigan
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Michigan was held on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Voters chose 20 electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Michigan was won by the Republican Party candidate Dwight D. Eisenhower with 56% of the popular vote, winning the state's twenty electoral votes.

zh.t: 美国密歇根州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，密歇根州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出20名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔赢得密歇根州，获得56%的普选票，并拿下该州全部20张选举人票。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Nevada
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Nevada took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. State voters chose three representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nevada was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 57.97% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 42.03% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国内华达州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，内华达州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。该州选民选出3名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得57.97%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得42.03%。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Nevada
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Alan Bible, who won a special election to complete the unexpired term of Pat McCarran, was re-elected to a full term in office over Republican U.S. Representative Cliff Young despite Republican nominee Dwight David Eisenhower winning the state in the concurrent presidential election in Nevada.

zh.t: 1956年内华达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行内华达州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员艾伦·比布尔此前在特别选举中当选，完成帕特·麦卡伦的剩余任期；这次他击败共和党联邦众议员克利夫·杨，当选完整任期。与此同时，共和党总统候选人德怀特·戴维·艾森豪威尔赢得内华达州。

en.s: The 1956 Oregon gubernatorial special election took place on November 6, 1956. Democratic state senator Robert D. Holmes narrowly defeated Republican incumbent Elmo Smith to win the election.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行俄勒冈州州长特别选举。民主党州参议员罗伯特·D·霍姆斯以微弱优势击败时任共和党州长埃尔莫·史密斯，赢得选举。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Iowa
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Iowa took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Iowa voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Iowa was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 59.06% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 40.65% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国艾奥瓦州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，艾奥瓦州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得59.06%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得40.65%。

en.s: The 1956 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Democratic nominee Stephen McNichols defeated Republican nominee Donald G. Brotzman with 51.34% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。民主党候选人斯蒂芬·麦克尼科尔斯以51.34%的得票率击败共和党候选人唐纳德·G·布罗茨曼。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Washington (state)
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Voters chose nine representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Washington was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 53.91% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 45.44% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国华盛顿州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，华盛顿州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出9名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得53.91%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得45.44%。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Maine
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Maine took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose five representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Maine overwhelmingly voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Dwight D.

zh.s: 1956年美国缅因州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年在48个州举行的总统选举的一部分。选民选出5名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。缅因州以压倒性优势支持共和党候选人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（宾夕法尼亚州），胜过民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州前州长阿德莱·史蒂文森。艾森豪威尔与时任副总统理查德·尼克松搭档。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Senator Prescott Bush, who won a special election in 1952, was re-elected to a full term in office over Democratic U.S. Representative Thomas J. Dodd. Dodd would later be elected to the state's other Senate seat in 1958. As of 2025, this is the last time that a Republican has been elected to Connecticut's Class 3 Senate seat.

zh.t: 1956年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行康涅狄格州美国参议院选举。时任参议员普雷斯科特·布什曾在1952年特别选举中当选，这次击败民主党联邦众议员托马斯·J·多德，赢得完整任期。多德后来于1958年当选该州另一个参议院席位。截至2025年，这是共和党人最后一次当选康涅狄格州第三类参议院席位。

en.s: The 1956 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Democratic nominee George Docking defeated Republican nominee Warren W. Shaw with 55.46% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。民主党候选人乔治·多金以55.46%的得票率击败共和党候选人沃伦·W·肖。

en.s: The 1956 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Republican nominee David P. Buckson defeated Democratic nominee Vernon B. Derrickson.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日，特拉华州举行副州长选举。共和党候选人大卫·P·巴克森击败民主党候选人弗农·B·德里克森。

en.s: The 1956 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Republican nominee C. William O'Neill defeated Democratic nominee Michael DiSalle with 56.04% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。共和党候选人C·威廉·奥尼尔以56.04%的得票率击败民主党候选人迈克尔·迪萨尔。

en.s: The 1956 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1956, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent attorney general Miles Lord defeated Republican nominee Keith Kennedy.

zh.t: 1956年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行总检察长选举。民主党—农工党候选人、时任总检察长迈尔斯·洛德击败共和党候选人基思·肯尼迪。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Nebraska
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Nebraska took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Voters chose six representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Nebraska was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 65.51% of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 34.49% of the popular vote.

zh.t: 美国内布拉斯加州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，内布拉斯加州举行总统选举，作为1956年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出6名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党候选人、宾夕法尼亚州人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得65.51%的普选票；民主党候选人、伊利诺伊州人阿德莱·史蒂文森与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得34.49%。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Senator George H. Bender, who won a special election to complete the term of the late Senator Robert A. Taft, ran for re-election to a full six-year term. He was defeated by Democratic Governor Frank Lausche. Until 2024, this was the last time that an incumbent Senator from Ohio lost re-election until Sherrod Brown was unseated by Bernie Moreno.

zh.t: 1956年俄亥俄州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行俄亥俄州美国参议院选举。时任参议员乔治·H·本德曾在特别选举中当选，完成已故参议员罗伯特·A·塔夫脱的剩余任期。这次他竞选完整的六年任期，但败给民主党籍州长弗兰克·劳舍。直到2024年，这是俄亥俄州时任参议员最后一次连任失败；此后谢罗德·布朗败给伯尼·莫雷诺。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Republican Senator Francis H. Case ran for re-election to a second term. In the general election, Case was opposed by former State Representative Kenneth Holum, who was the 1954 Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate.

zh.t: 1956年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行南达科他州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员弗朗西斯·H·凯斯竞选连任第二个任期。大选中，他的对手是前州众议员肯尼斯·霍勒姆；霍勒姆曾在1954年获民主党提名竞选联邦参议员。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate special election in Colorado took place on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Republican Senator Eugene Millikin declined to seek re-election to a third term and a competitive election ensued. Former Congressman John A. Carroll, in his third consecutive bid for the Senate, narrowly defeated former U.S. Secretary of Agriculture Charles F.

zh.t: 1956年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1956年美国科罗拉多州联邦参议院特别选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍现任参议员尤金·米利金拒绝竞选第三个任期，选举因此竞争激烈。曾任联邦众议员的约翰·A·卡罗尔连续第三次竞选参议员，先在民主党初选中以微弱优势击败美国前农业部长查尔斯·F·布兰南，随后进入普选，对阵共和党候选人、州长丹·桑顿。尽管民主党总统候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森在科罗拉多州表现不佳，州级民主党候选人的表现好得多。卡罗尔最终以微弱优势获胜，赢得其唯一一个联邦参议员任期。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. West Virginia was won by incumbent President Dwight D.

zh.t: 1956年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举
zh.s: 1956年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。西弗吉尼亚州选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党籍时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（宾夕法尼亚州）与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得54.08%的普选票，击败民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）及其搭档、田纳西州参议员埃斯蒂斯·基福弗。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election which was held throughout all contemporary 48 states. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Connecticut voted for the Republican nominee, incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower of Pennsylvania, over the Democratic nominee, former Governor Adlai Stevenson of Illinois.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日，康涅狄格州举行总统选举，这是1956年美国总统选举的一部分，当时全美48个州均举行了选举。选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。康涅狄格州支持共和党候选人、时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（宾夕法尼亚州），他击败了民主党候选人、前州长阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Republican Senator Wallace F. Bennett won re-election to a second term.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行犹他州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员华莱士·F·贝内特连任，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1956 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Lieutenant Governor Karl Rolvaag of the Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger Leonard R. Dickinson.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。明尼苏达州民主党—农工党籍时任副州长卡尔·罗尔瓦格击败明尼苏达州共和党候选人伦纳德·R·迪金森。

en.s: The 1956 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Democrat LeRoy Collins defeated Republican nominee William A. Washburne Jr. in a landslide with 73.69% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行佛罗里达州州长选举。时任民主党州长勒罗伊·柯林斯以73.69%的得票率大胜共和党候选人小威廉·A·沃什伯恩。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John Marshall Butler was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democratic businessman George P. Mahoney. As of 2023, this was the last time Maryland voted simultaneously for a Republican presidential candidate and a Republican senate candidate. This was the first time ever that Maryland re-elected a Republican Senator.

zh.t: 1956年马里兰州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行马里兰州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员约翰·马歇尔·巴特勒击败民主党商人乔治·P·马奥尼，连任第二个任期。截至2023年，这是马里兰州最后一次同时支持共和党总统候选人和共和党参议员候选人。这也是马里兰州首次有共和党参议员成功连任。

en.s: The 1956 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 6, 1956, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri. Democratic nominee and former state treasurer Mount Etna Morris defeated Republican nominee F. P. Graves.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日，密苏里州举行州财政部长选举。民主党候选人、前州财政部长芒特·埃特纳·莫里斯击败共和党候选人F·P·格雷夫斯。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Mississippi
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Mississippi was held on November 6, 1956. Mississippi voters chose eight representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Ever since the end of Reconstruction, Mississippi had been a one-party state dominated by the Democratic Party. The Republican Party was virtually nonexistent as a result of disenfranchisement among African Americans and poor whites, including voter intimidation against those who refused to vote Democratic.

zh.t: 美国密西西比州总统选举，1956
zh.s: 1956年11月6日，密西西比州举行总统选举。密西西比州选民选出8名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。重建时期结束后，密西西比州一直由民主党主导，实行一党制。非裔美国人和贫困白人遭到剥夺选举权，而不愿投票支持民主党的人还会受到恐吓，因此共和党几乎不存在。

en.s: The 1956 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Democratic nominee Edward V. Long defeated Republican nominee Richard M. Webster with 53.49% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行密苏里州副州长选举。民主党候选人爱德华·V·朗以53.49%的得票率击败共和党候选人理查德·M·韦伯斯特。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Alexander Wiley was re-elected to a fourth term in office. He survived a close primary challenge from U.S. Representative Glenn R. Davis before defeating Henry Maier in the general election. This election marks the last Senate election in Wisconsin to date in which the Republican candidate won Milwaukee County.

zh.t: 1956年威斯康星州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行威斯康星州美国参议院选举。时任共和党联邦参议员亚历山大·威利再次当选，开始第四个任期。他在党内初选中险胜联邦众议员格伦·R·戴维斯的挑战，随后在大选中击败亨利·迈尔。截至目前，这是威斯康星州共和党候选人最后一次在参议院选举中赢得密尔沃基县。

en.s: The 1956 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1956. Republican nominee Harold W. Handley defeated Democratic nominee Ralph Tucker with 55.61% of the vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行印第安纳州州长选举。共和党候选人哈罗德·W·汉德利以55.61%的得票率击败民主党候选人拉尔夫·塔克。

en.s: The 1956 Illinois gubernatorial election was held in Illinois on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Governor William Stratton, a Republican, narrowly won reelection to a second term. Stratton's narrow victory came despite the fact that the Republican ticket of Dwight D. Eisenhower and Richard Nixon carried the state of Illinois in a landslide in the presidential election.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。共和党籍时任州长威廉·斯特拉顿险胜，连任第二个任期。尽管共和党总统候选人德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔和理查德·尼克松在伊利诺伊州大幅领先，斯特拉顿的胜利仍十分接近。

en.s: The 1956 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1956, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Democrat John F. Simms ran for reelection to a second term but was defeated by former governor Edwin L. Mechem. This was the last gubernatorial election until 1994 in which a Republican carried Sandoval County.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行新墨西哥州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长约翰·F·西姆斯竞选连任第二个任期，但败给前州长埃德温·L·米肯。直到1994年，这是共和党候选人最后一次赢得桑多瓦尔县。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Democratic Senator Mike Monroney ran for re-election to a second term. He avoided a contentious Democratic primary when Lieutenant Governor Cowboy Pink Williams declined to challenge him and easily won renomination. In the general election, he faced Republican state party chairman Douglas McKeever. Even though President Dwight D.

zh.t: 1956年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年美国俄克拉何马州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行。民主党籍现任参议员迈克·门罗尼竞选连任第二个任期。副州长“牛仔”平克·威廉姆斯放弃挑战，使门罗尼避开了激烈的民主党初选，并轻松获得提名。普选中，他对阵共和党州党主席道格拉斯·麦基弗。尽管共和党总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔轻松赢得该州，门罗尼仍以较大优势连任。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Kentucky voters chose ten representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Kentucky was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 54.30 percent of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 45.21 percent of the popular vote.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日，肯塔基州举行总统选举，这是1956年美国总统选举的一部分。肯塔基州选民选出10名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。时任总统、共和党人德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（宾夕法尼亚州）与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，以54.30%的普选票获胜；民主党人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）与参议员埃斯特斯·凯弗维搭档，获得45.21%的普选票。

en.s: The 1956 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1956, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent secretary of state Walter H. Toberman defeated Republican nominee Jesse E. Smith.

zh.s: 1956年11月6日举行密苏里州州务卿选举。民主党候选人、时任州务卿沃尔特·H·托伯曼击败共和党候选人杰西·E·史密斯。

en.t: 1956 United States presidential election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1956 United States presidential election in Oklahoma took place on November 6, 1956, as part of the 1956 United States presidential election. Voters chose eight representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Oklahoma was won by incumbent President Dwight D. Eisenhower (R–Pennsylvania), running with Vice President Richard Nixon, with 55.13 percent of the popular vote, against Adlai Stevenson (D–Illinois), running with Senator Estes Kefauver, with 44.87 percent of the popular vote.

zh.t: 1956年美国俄克拉何马州总统选举
zh.s: 1956年美国俄克拉何马州总统选举于11月6日举行，是当年美国总统选举的一部分。选民选出8名总统选举人，由他们投票选出总统和副总统。共和党籍时任总统德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔（宾夕法尼亚州）与副总统理查德·尼克松搭档，获得55.13%的普选票，击败民主党候选人阿德莱·史蒂文森（伊利诺伊州）及其搭档、参议员埃斯蒂斯·基福弗；后者获得44.87%。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1956 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Warren Magnuson won a third term in office, defeating Republican nominee Arthur B. Langlie.

zh.t: 1956年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1956年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任参议员沃伦·马格努森击败共和党提名人阿瑟·B·兰利，赢得第三个任期。

en.t: 1956 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The United States Senate election of 1956 in New York was held on November 6, 1956. Incumbent Senator Herbert H. Lehman retired after one full term in the Senate. Republican Attorney General of New York Jacob K. Javits defeated Mayor of New York City Robert F. Wagner Jr. to win the open seat. The major parties met on September 10 in Albany and nominated Javits and Wagner unanimously, though not without some pre-convention campaigning.

zh.s: 1956年纽约州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。参议员赫伯特·H·雷曼在完整任职一个任期后退休。纽约州共和党总检察长雅各布·K·贾维茨击败纽约市市长小罗伯特·F·瓦格纳，赢得空缺席位。两大政党于9月10日在奥尔巴尼召开会议，一致提名贾维茨和瓦格纳；会前也曾进行竞选活动。

en.s: The 1956 Washington gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1956, between Democratic state senator Albert Rosellini and Republican lieutenant governor Emmett T. Anderson. Rosellini defeated Anderson during the general election, becoming the first Italian American to lead a U.S. state west of the Mississippi River. Incumbent Republican governor Arthur B. Langlie declined to run for a fourth term, instead challenging Warren Magnuson for a U.S.
