en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 1962
en.s: The 1962 U.S. Senate election for the state of North Dakota was held November 6, 1962. The incumbent, Republican Senator Milton Young, sought and received re-election to his fourth term, defeating North Dakota Democratic-NPL Party candidate William Lanier of Fargo, North Dakota. Only Young filed as a Republican, and the endorsed Democratic candidate was William Lanier of Fargo, North Dakota, who had previously faced Young in a special election held in 1946 to fill the seat which was vacated by the late John Moses. Lanier is not to be confused with former Governor of North Dakota William Langer.

All five incumbents who ran were re-elected and the open seat in the 2nd congressional district was retained by the Democrats. en.s: Minnesota's 1962 gubernatorial election was the closest statewide race in Minnesota history and one of the closest gubernatorial elections in American history. The election was held on November 6, 1962, but the results were not known until March 21, 1963. After recounts and court challenges, it was determined that then-Lieutenant Governor Karl Rolvaag of the DFL had defeated Governor Elmer L. Andersen, Republican, by 91 votes out of nearly 1.3 million cast. Rolvaag collected 619,842 votes to Andersen's 619,751. At that time governors and lieutenant governors were elected on separate ballots. Thus the incumbent governor was a Republican while the lieutenant governor was a Democrat.

zh.s: 1962年明尼苏达州州长选举是该州历史上竞争最激烈的全州选举，也是美国历史上最接近的州长选举之一。选举于1962年11月6日举行，但结果直到1963年3月21日才确定。经过重新计票和法律诉讼，民主农民劳工党副州长卡尔·罗尔瓦格以91票之差击败共和党州长埃尔默·L·安德森；近130万张选票中，罗尔瓦格获619,842票，安德森获619,751票。当时州长和副州长分别投票选举，因此现任州长是共和党人，副州长是民主党人。

Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held on September 18, 1962.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日，马萨诸塞州举行大选。选举包括联邦参议员、州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、财政部长和审计长等全州职位，以及联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长委员会成员等地区职位，还有州和地方层面的公投问题。民主党和共和党候选人于1962年9月18日举行的党内初选中产生。

en.s: The 1962 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Republican nominee John Arthur Love defeated Democratic incumbent Stephen McNichols with 56.67% of the vote.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。共和党候选人约翰·阿瑟·洛夫以56.67%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长斯蒂芬·麦克尼科尔斯。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican Senator Wallace F. Bennett won re-election to a third term.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行犹他州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员华莱士·F·贝内特再次当选，赢得第三个任期。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Senator Frank Lausche was re-elected to a second term in office, easily defeating Republican attorney John Marshall Briley.

zh.t: 1962年俄亥俄州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行俄亥俄州美国参议院选举。时任参议员弗兰克·劳舍再次当选，赢得第二个任期，轻松击败共和党律师约翰·马歇尔·布里利。

en.s: The 1962 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democrat J. Millard Tawes defeated Republican nominee Frank Small Jr. with 55.64% of the vote.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行马里兰州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长J·米勒德·塔韦斯以55.64%的得票率击败共和党候选人小弗兰克·斯莫尔。

en.s: The 1962 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 6, 1962. Voters elected members of the Arizona House of Representatives in all 80 of the state's House districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 11, 1962.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行亚利桑那州众议院选举。选民从该州全部80个众议院选区选出议员，任期两年。选举与州长、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院等职位的选举同时举行。党内初选于1962年9月11日举行。

en.s: The 1962 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1962, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Joseph L. Donovan defeated Republican nominee Norbert A. McCrady. This was the first election for a four-year term following the passage of a constitutional amendment in 1958 that provided four-year terms for all state constitutional officers.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。民主党—农工党候选人、时任州务卿约瑟夫·L·多诺万击败共和党候选人诺伯特·A·麦克雷迪。这是1958年通过宪法修正案、规定所有州宪法官员任期为四年后的首次选举。

en.s: The 1962 Idaho lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Democratic incumbent William Drevlow defeated Republican nominee Kenneth Arnold with 54% of the vote.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行爱达荷州副州长选举。民主党籍时任副州长威廉·德雷夫洛以54%的得票率击败共和党候选人肯尼思·阿诺德。

en.t: 1962 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1962 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives on November 6, 1962, to elect members to serve in the 88th United States Congress. They occurred in the middle of President John F. Kennedy's term. As in most midterm elections, Kennedy's Democratic Party lost seats to the opposition Republican Party, but retained a majority.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行美国联邦众议院选举，选出第88届国会的议员。选举发生在约翰·F·肯尼迪总统任期中段。与多数中期选举一样，肯尼迪所属的民主党失去席位，但仍保住多数。

en.s: The 1962 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962, and was a race for Governor of Oklahoma. Republican Henry Bellmon defeated Democrat W. P. Bill Atkinson and Independent L. Richard Zavitz to become the first Republican governor of Oklahoma. Former governor Raymond D. Gary, lieutenant governor George Nigh, state senator Fred R. Harris, and State Treasurer William A. Burkhart unsuccessfully sought the Democratic nomination.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行俄克拉何马州州长选举。共和党人亨利·贝尔蒙击败民主党人W·P·比尔·阿特金森和独立候选人L·理查德·扎维茨，当选该州首位共和党州长。前州长雷蒙德·D·加里、副州长乔治·奈、州参议员弗雷德·R·哈里斯和州财政部长威廉·A·伯克哈特都曾竞选民主党提名，但未能胜出。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 6, 1962 to elect one of Illinois's members to the United States Senate. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator and Minority Leader Everett Dirksen won re-election to his third term.

zh.t: 1962年伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举，选出该州一名联邦参议员。时任共和党联邦参议员、少数党领袖埃弗里特·德克森再次当选，开始第三个任期。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Arkansas
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Arkansas took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Senator J. William Fulbright won a fourth term in office, defeating primary challenger Winston G. Chandler and Republican Party nominee Kenneth G. Jones without much threat.

zh.t: 1962年阿肯色州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行阿肯色州美国参议院选举。时任参议员J·威廉·富布赖特当选第四个任期，轻松击败党内初选挑战者温斯顿·G·钱德勒和共和党候选人肯尼斯·G·琼斯。

en.s: The 1962 Tennessee gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962, to elect the next governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Democratic governor Buford Ellington was ineligible to run for re-election, as the Constitution of Tennessee prohibited governors from serving consecutive terms at the time. Former Democratic governor Frank G. Clement defeated independent candidate William Anderson, and Republican nominee Hubert Patty, with 50.9% of the vote.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行田纳西州州长选举。由于当时州宪法禁止州长连续任职，民主党籍时任州长布福德·埃灵顿不能竞选连任。前民主党州长弗兰克·G·克莱门特以50.9%的得票率击败独立候选人威廉·安德森和共和党候选人休伯特·帕蒂。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator John A. Carroll ran for re-election to a second term in office, but was defeated by Republican U.S. Representative Peter H. Dominick.

zh.t: 1962年科罗拉多州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行科罗拉多州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员约翰·A·卡罗尔竞选连任第二个任期，但败给共和党联邦众议员彼得·H·多米尼克。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate special election in Idaho
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate special election in Idaho took place on November 6, 1962, to elect a U.S. Senator to complete the unexpired term of Senator Henry Dworshak, who died on July 23, 1962. Following his nomination for the special election by the Republican state committee, former Governor of Idaho Len Jordan was appointed on August 6, 1962, by Governor Robert E.

zh.t: 1962年美国爱达荷州联邦参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1962年美国爱达荷州联邦参议院特别选举于11月6日举行，以选出一名联邦参议员，完成亨利·德沃夏克于1962年7月23日去世后留下的未满任期。共和党州委员会提名爱达荷州前州长伦·乔丹后，州长罗伯特·E·斯迈利于8月6日任命乔丹暂时填补空缺，直至举行特别选举。乔丹在特别选举中以微弱优势击败民主党候选人格雷西·普福斯特。

en.s: The 1962 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 6, 1962, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Albert L. Coles won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Leonard Levy.

zh.t: 1962年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行康涅狄格州总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长阿尔伯特·L·科尔斯击败共和党候选人伦纳德·利维，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1962 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Republican nominee John Chafee defeated Democratic incumbent John A. Notte Jr. with 50.06% of the vote, a margin of just 398 votes.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行罗得岛州州长选举。共和党候选人约翰·查菲以50.06%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长约翰·A·诺特二世，领先仅398票。

en.s: The 1962 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1962, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Democratic nominee and incumbent state auditor Haskell Holman defeated Republican nominee Joseph M. Badgett.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行密苏里州审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任州审计长哈斯克尔·霍尔曼击败共和党候选人约瑟夫·M·巴杰特。

en.s: The 1962 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 6, 1962, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Louis L. Goldstein defeated Republican nominee David C. Champion.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行马里兰州审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任审计长路易斯·L·戈德斯坦击败共和党候选人大卫·C·钱皮恩。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Alaska
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Alaska took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Ernest Gruening ran for a second (his first full) term in office and defeated Republican nominee, Anchorage lawyer, former Interior Solicitor & former U.S. Attorney Ted Stevens. Stevens was appointed to Alaska's other (Class II) U.S.

zh.t: 1962年美国阿拉斯加州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年美国阿拉斯加州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行。民主党籍现任参议员欧内斯特·格鲁宁竞选第二个任期（也是他的第一个完整任期），并击败共和党候选人、安克雷奇律师、前内政部法律顾问及前联邦检察官泰德·史蒂文斯。1968年，州长任命史蒂文斯填补该州另一席（第二类）联邦参议员空缺；他随后任职超过40年。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Oklahoma took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic Senator Mike Monroney was re-elected to a third term. After winning a sizable victory in the Democratic primary, Monroney faced Republican former U.S. Attorney B. Hayden Crawford in the general election. Monroney won his last term in the Senate before his defeat in 1968.

zh.t: 1962年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员迈克·莫罗尼再次当选，赢得第三个任期。他在民主党初选中大幅获胜后，在大选中面对共和党前联邦检察官B·海登·克劳福德。莫罗尼赢得了在参议院的最后一个任期，之后于1968年败选。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Homer Capehart ran for re-election to a fourth consecutive term in office, but was narrowly defeated by Democratic former State House Speaker Birch Bayh.

zh.t: 1962年印第安纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行印第安纳州美国参议院选举。时任共和党联邦参议员霍默·凯普哈特竞选连续第四个任期，但以微弱差距败给民主党籍前州众议院议长伯奇·贝。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate special election in Kansas
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate special election in Kansas took place on November 6, 1962, to elect a U.S. Senator to complete the unexpired term of Senator Andrew Frank Schoeppel, who died on January 21, 1962. Former State Senator James B. Pearson was appointed on January 31, 1962, by Governor John Anderson Jr. to fill the vacancy until a special election could be held.

zh.t: 1962年堪萨斯州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行堪萨斯州美国参议院特别选举，选出一名联邦参议员完成安德鲁·弗兰克·舍佩尔去世后留下的任期。舍佩尔于1962年1月21日去世。前州参议员詹姆斯·B·皮尔逊于1962年1月31日由州长约翰·安德森二世任命，填补席位空缺，直至举行特别选举。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Idaho
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Idaho took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic Senator Frank Church won re-election to a second term. This election was the first time ever that an incumbent Democratic Senator from Idaho was re-elected.

zh.t: 1962年爱达荷州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行爱达荷州美国参议院选举。时任民主党参议员弗兰克·丘奇连任第二个任期。这是爱达荷州民主党籍时任参议员首次成功连任。

en.t: 1962 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The 1962 United States Virgin Islands general election was held on November 6, 1962, to elect members of the 5th Virgin Islands Legislature. As this was before the 1966 Amending Act, no gubernatorial election took place. The Unity Party, a party with no national affiliate, won a majority in the chamber. Shortly after the beginning of the session, the Unity party changed their name to the Unity-Democratic party.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行美属维尔京群岛大选，选出第五届维尔京群岛立法机构的议员。由于当时尚未通过1966年修正法案，因此没有举行州长选举。没有全国性党派背景的团结党赢得议会多数。新一届议会任期开始后不久，团结党更名为团结—民主党。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in North Carolina
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in North Carolina was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic Senator Sam Ervin was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican farmer Claude Greene Jr. Ervin was elected to a second full (six-year) term, though by a somewhat smaller margin than he enjoyed in his victory in 1956.

zh.t: 1962年北卡罗来纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行北卡罗来纳州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员萨姆·欧文击败共和党农民克劳德·格林二世，连任第二个任期。欧文赢得了第二个完整的六年任期，但领先幅度比1956年胜选时小一些。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Nevada
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Alan Bible was re-elected to a second term in office over Republican William B. Wright.

zh.t: 1962年内华达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行内华达州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员艾伦·比布尔击败共和党候选人威廉·B·赖特，连任第二个任期。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 6, 1962 in 35 states, concurrent with the House and Senate elections. In Minnesota, the governor was elected to a 4-year term for the first time, instead of a 2-year term. In North Dakota, this was the last election on a 2-year cycle, before switching to a 4-year term for governors.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日，美国35个州举行州长选举，与联邦众议院和参议院选举同时进行。明尼苏达州州长首次改为四年一任，此前为两年一任。北达科他州本次是改为四年一任前最后一次按两年周期举行的州长选举。

en.s: The 1962 New Hampshire gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Democratic nominee John W. King defeated Republican nominee John Pillsbury with 58.89% of the vote. This was the first time since 1922 that a Democrat was elected Governor of New Hampshire.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。民主党候选人约翰·W·金以58.89%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·皮尔斯伯里。这是自1922年以来，民主党人首次当选新罕布什尔州州长。

en.s: The 1962 Arizona Senate election was held on November 6, 1962. Voters elected all 28 members of the Arizona Senate to serve two-year terms. At the time, each of Arizona's 14 counties elected two state senators for a total of 28 members of the Arizona Senate. Primary elections were held on September 11, 1962. Prior to the elections, the Democrats held a supermajority of 24 seats over the 4 Republican seats.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行亚利桑那州参议院选举，选出全部28名州参议员，任期两年。当时该州14个县各选出两名州参议员。党内初选于1962年9月11日举行。选举前，民主党以24席对共和党的4席占据绝对多数。

en.s: The 1962 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Democratic incumbent Glenn M. Anderson narrowly defeated Republican nominee George Christopher with 51.42% of the vote.

zh.t: 1962年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举。民主党籍时任副州长格伦·M·安德森以51.42%的得票率险胜共和党候选人乔治·克里斯托弗。

en.s: The 1962 Connecticut lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Mayor of Bridgeport Democrat Samuel J. Tedesco defeated former Connecticut State Treasurer Republican nominee Joseph A. Adorno with 53.4% of the vote. On, January 21, 1961, Governor Abraham Ribicoff resigned to become a member of President John F. Kennedy's cabinet. His lieutenant, John N. Dempsey, succeeded him as governor.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行康涅狄格州副州长选举。布里奇波特市长、民主党人塞缪尔·J·特德斯科以53.4%的得票率击败共和党候选人、前康涅狄格州财政部长约瑟夫·A·阿多尔诺。1961年1月21日，州长亚伯拉罕·里比科夫辞职，加入约翰·F·肯尼迪总统的内阁。副州长约翰·N·登普西继任州长。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Florida took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic Senator George Smathers won re-election to a third term. To date, this is the last time that a winning United States Senate candidate carried all counties in Florida for the Class 3 Senate seat from Florida, and the last time that a winning United States Senate candidate carried all counties in Florida for a Senate seat from Florida until 1994.

zh.t: 1962年佛罗里达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行佛罗里达州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员乔治·斯马瑟斯连任第三个任期。截至目前，这是佛罗里达州三类参议院席位的胜选者最后一次赢得该州所有县；也是佛罗里达州任一参议院席位的胜选者最后一次赢得所有县，之后直到1994年才再次出现。

en.s: The 1962 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1962, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor (DFL) nominee and incumbent attorney general Walter Mondale defeated the Republican nominee, Robert Lowe Kunzig.

zh.t: 1962年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行明尼苏达州总检察长选举。民主党—农工党候选人、时任总检察长沃尔特·蒙代尔击败共和党候选人罗伯特·洛威·昆齐格。

en.s: The 1962 Minnesota lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1962. Minnesota Democratic-Farmer-Labor Party candidate Sandy Keith defeated Republican Party of Minnesota challenger C. Donald Peterson.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行明尼苏达州副州长选举。明尼苏达州民主党—农工党候选人桑迪·基思击败共和党候选人C·唐纳德·彼得森。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Louisiana
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Louisiana was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic Senator Russell Long was elected to a fourth term in office. On August 17, Long won the Democratic primary with 80.15% of the vote. Long won the general election against Shreveport attorney Taylor W. O'Hearn, who staged a rare bid for statewide office on the Republican line.

zh.t: 1962年路易斯安那州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行路易斯安那州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员拉塞尔·朗当选第四个任期。8月17日，朗在民主党初选中获得80.15%的选票并胜出。大选中，他击败了什里夫波特律师泰勒·W·奥赫恩；后者作为共和党候选人参加州级公职竞选，这种情况并不常见。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Senator Prescott Bush retired instead of seeking a second full term in office. Former Governor of Connecticut and United States Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare Abraham Ribicoff was elected his successor over Congressman Horace Seely-Brown Jr. Ribicoff had previously sought election to this seat in 1952 but lost to Bush.

zh.t: 1962年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行康涅狄格州美国参议院选举。时任参议员普雷斯科特·布什退休，没有竞选第二个完整任期。康涅狄格州前州长、美国卫生、教育与福利部长亚伯拉罕·里比科夫当选继任者，击败联邦众议员霍勒斯·西利-布朗二世。里比科夫曾于1952年竞选这一席位，但败给布什。

en.s: The 1962 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1962, in order to elect the state auditor of Minnesota. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Stafford King defeated Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee John D. Nevin.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行明尼苏达州审计长选举。共和党候选人、时任州审计长斯塔福德·金击败民主党—农工党候选人约翰·D·内文。

en.s: The 1962 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Governor Paul Fannin ran for reelection against President of the Western Conference of United Funds Samuel Pearson Goddard in the general election, winning a third consecutive term, a first for a Republican Governor in Arizona. Fannin was sworn into his third term on January 1, 1963.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行亚利桑那州州长选举。时任州长保罗·范宁竞选连任，挑战者是西部联合基金会议主席塞缪尔·皮尔逊·戈达德。范宁胜选，连续第三次当选州长，这是亚利桑那州共和党州长首次做到这一点。他于1963年1月1日宣誓就职第三个任期。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in California was held on November 6, 1962. Republican incumbent Thomas Kuchel was elected to a third term in office over Democratic state senator Richard B. Richards. Kuchel carried every county in California and remains the most recent candidate for Senate to do so as of 2026. As of 2026, this is the last time a Republican was elected to the Class 3 Senate seat from California.

zh.t: 1962年加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员托马斯·库切尔击败民主党州参议员理查德·B·理查兹，当选第三个任期。库切尔赢得加州所有县。截至2026年，他仍是最近一位做到这一点的参议院候选人。截至2026年，这是共和党人最后一次当选加利福尼亚州第三类参议院席位。

en.s: The 1962 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1962, to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Incumbent Republican Edwin L. Mechem ran for reelection for a sixth term against Democrat Jack Campbell. Campbell defeated Mechem by a decisive six point margin.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行新墨西哥州州长选举。共和党籍时任州长埃德温·L·米肯竞选第六个任期，民主党候选人杰克·坎贝尔以明显优势领先6个百分点，击败米肯。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate special election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate special election in Wyoming was held on November 6, 1962. This election was prompted by the death of Senator-elect Keith Thomson, who had been elected to the Senate in 1960. After his death Democratic Governor John J. Hickey appointed himself to fill the vacancy. A special election was then held to complete the remaining four years of the term in 1962.

zh.t: 1962年怀俄明州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行怀俄明州美国参议院特别选举。时任参议员基思·汤姆森当选后去世，因此举行此次选举。民主党籍州长约翰·J·希基随后任命自己填补空缺。1962年举行特别选举，以完成剩余四年任期。

en.s: The 1962 Michigan Auditor General election was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democrat Billie S. Farnum defeated Republican nominee L. William Seidman who got 50.32% of the vote. This was the last Michigan Auditor General election, because with the ratification of the 1963 Michigan Constitution, the State Auditor General became an appointed position, rather than an elected one.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行密歇根州审计长选举。民主党籍时任审计长比莉·S·法纳姆击败共和党候选人L·威廉·塞德曼，后者获得50.32%的选票。这是密歇根州最后一次举行审计长选举，因为1963年密歇根州宪法获批准后，州审计长改为任命产生，不再由选举产生。

en.s: The 1962 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic Governor Orval Faubus won election to a fifth term, defeating Republican nominee Willis Ricketts with 73.27% of the vote.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行阿肯色州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长奥瓦尔·福布斯以73.27%的得票率胜选，赢得第五个任期，击败共和党候选人威利斯·里基茨。

en.s: The 1962 Nebraska gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962, and featured incumbent Governor Frank B. Morrison, a Democrat, defeating Republican nominee, former U.S. Secretary of the Interior Fred A. Seaton, to win a second two-year term in office.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长弗兰克·B·莫里森击败共和党候选人、前美国内政部长弗雷德·A·西顿，赢得第二个两年任期。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in South Dakota took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican Senator Francis H. Case ran for re-election to a third term. He won the Republican primary against Attorney General A. C. Miller, but shortly after the primary, died. The Republican State Central Committee named Lieutenant Governor Joseph H.

zh.t: 1962年美国南达科他州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年美国南达科他州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍现任参议员弗朗西斯·H·凯斯竞选第三个任期。他在共和党初选中击败州检察长A·C·米勒，但初选后不久去世。共和党州中央委员会提名副州长约瑟夫·H·博特姆接替凯斯列入选票，州长阿奇·古布鲁德任命博特姆填补空缺。普选中，博特姆对阵民主党候选人乔治·麦戈文；麦戈文曾任“粮食换和平”项目负责人和联邦众议员。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Iowa took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican Senator Bourke B. Hickenlooper was re-elected to a fourth term in office over Democrat E.B. Smith.

zh.t: 1962年艾奥瓦州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行艾奥瓦州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员伯克·B·希肯卢珀击败民主党人E·B·史密斯，连任第四个任期。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican Senator Frank Carlson was re-elected to a third term in office over Democratic nominee Ken Smith.

zh.t: 1962年堪萨斯州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行堪萨斯州美国参议院选举。时任共和党参议员弗兰克·卡尔森击败民主党候选人肯·史密斯，连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 1962 Kansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican John Anderson Jr. defeated Democratic nominee Dale E. Saffels with 53.4% of the vote.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。共和党籍时任州长约翰·安德森二世以53.4%的得票率击败民主党候选人戴尔·E·萨费尔斯。

en.s: The 1962 North Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Democrat William L. Guy defeated Republican nominee Mark Andrews with 50.44% of the vote. For the last time, the Governor of North Dakota was elected to a two-year term. Afterwards, North Dakota governors would be elected for terms of four years.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行北达科他州州长选举。民主党人威廉·L·盖伊以50.44%的得票率击败共和党候选人马克·安德鲁斯。这是北达科他州最后一次选举两年任期的州长；此后州长任期改为四年。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate special election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate special election in New Hampshire took place on November 6, 1962, to elect a U.S. Senator to complete the unexpired term of Senator Styles Bridges, who died on November 26, 1961. New Hampshire Attorney General Maurice J. Murphy Jr. was appointed on December 7, 1961, by Governor Wesley Powell to fill the vacancy until a special election could be held.

zh.t: 1962年新罕布什尔州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州美国参议院特别选举，选出一名联邦参议员完成斯泰尔斯·布里奇斯去世后留下的任期。布里奇斯于1961年11月26日去世。新罕布什尔州总检察长莫里斯·J·墨菲二世于1961年12月7日由州长韦斯利·鲍威尔任命，填补空缺，直至举行特别选举。

en.s: The 1962 Connecticut gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democrat John N. Dempsey defeated Republican nominee John deKoven Alsop with 53.21% of the vote.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长约翰·N·登普西以53.21%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·德科文·奥尔索普。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Maryland was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John Marshall Butler did not run for re-election to a third term in office. Democratic U.S. Representative Daniel Brewster won the re-election to succeed him easily over Republican U.S. Representative Edward Tylor Miller.

zh.t: 1962年马里兰州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行马里兰州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员约翰·马歇尔·巴特勒没有竞选第三个任期。民主党联邦众议员丹尼尔·布鲁斯特当选接替他，轻松击败共和党联邦众议员爱德华·泰勒·米勒。

en.s: The 1962 South Dakota gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican Governor Archie M. Gubbrud defeated Democratic nominee Ralph Herseth with 56.10% of the vote, in a rematch of the previous election.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行南达科他州州长选举。共和党籍时任州长阿奇·M·古布鲁德以56.10%的得票率击败民主党候选人拉尔夫·赫塞思。这是两人继上次选举后的再次交锋。

en.s: The 1962 Nebraska lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962, and featured incumbent Nebraska Lieutenant Governor Dwight Burney, a Republican, defeating Democratic nominee Rudolph D. Anderson.

zh.t: 1962年内布拉斯加州副州长选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州副州长选举。共和党籍时任副州长德怀特·伯尼击败民主党候选人鲁道夫·D·安德森。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Hawaii took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic Senator Oren Long retired after serving an abbreviated three-year term. Democratic U.S. Representative Dan Inouye was elected to succeed Long, defeating Republican Ben Dillingham II, the heir to the massive Dillingham industrial fortune. Inouye would continue to hold the seat with little trouble for nearly fifty years, until his death in 2012.

zh.t: 1962年夏威夷州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行夏威夷州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员奥伦·朗任期缩短至三年，之后退休。民主党联邦众议员丹尼尔·井上当选接替朗，击败共和党候选人本·迪林厄姆二世；后者是迪林厄姆大型工业企业的继承人。井上在此后近50年里一直轻松保住这一席位，直至2012年去世。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in New Hampshire took place on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican Senator Norris Cotton won re-election to a second full term.

zh.t: 1962年新罕布什尔州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员诺里斯·科顿再次当选，赢得第二个完整任期。

en.s: The 1962 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Republican nominee Jim Rhodes defeated Democratic incumbent Michael DiSalle with 58.92% of the vote.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行俄亥俄州州长选举。共和党候选人吉姆·罗兹以58.92%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长迈克尔·迪萨尔。

en.s: The 1962 Michigan gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962. Republican George W. Romney defeated incumbent Democrat John B. Swainson with 51.36% of the vote.

zh.s: 1962年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举。共和党人乔治·W·罗姆尼以51.36%的得票率击败民主党籍时任州长约翰·B·斯温森。

en.s: The 1962 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1962, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia. Democratic nominee Peter Zack Geer ran unopposed and subsequently won the election.

zh.s: 1962年佐治亚州副州长选举于11月6日举行，选出副州长。民主党提名人彼得·扎克·吉尔无人挑战，随后当选。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in New York was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Jacob Javits won against Democratic challenger James B. Donovan.

zh.s: 1962年纽约州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任参议员雅各布·贾维茨击败民主党挑战者詹姆斯·B·多诺万。

en.t: 1962 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 1962 United States Senate election in Washington was held on November 6, 1962. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Warren Magnuson won a fourth term in office, narrowly defeating Republican nominee Richard G. Christensen.

zh.t: 1962年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1962年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任参议员沃伦·马格努森险胜共和党提名人理查德·G·克里斯滕森，赢得第四个任期。

en.s: The 1962 New York state election was held on November 6, 1962, to elect the governor, the lieutenant governor, the state comptroller, the attorney general, a judge of the New York Court of Appeals and a U.S. senator, as well as all members of the New York State Assembly and the New York State Senate.

zh.s: 1962年纽约州选举于11月6日举行，选出州长、副州长、州审计长、总检察长、纽约州上诉法院法官和美国参议员，以及纽约州众议院和州参议院全体议员。

en.s: The 1962 United States Senate elections was an election for the United States Senate. Held on November 6, the 34 seats of Class 3 were contested in regular elections. Special elections were also held to fill vacancies. They occurred in the middle of President John F. Kennedy's term. His Democratic Party made a net gain of four seats from the Republicans, increasing their control of the Senate to 68–32.

zh.s: 1962年美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，常规选举改选第三类的34个席位，另举行特别选举填补空缺。选举在约翰·F·肯尼迪总统任期中期举行。他所属的民主党净增4席，扩大了在参议院的控制权，以68席对32席占多数。

en.s: The 1962 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election was held on November 6. Republican Bill Scranton and Democrat Richardson Dilworth, each a member of a powerful political family, faced off in a bitter campaign.

zh.s: 1962年宾夕法尼亚州州长选举于11月6日举行。来自显赫政治家族的共和党人比尔·斯克兰顿和民主党人理查德森·迪尔沃思在一场激烈竞选中对决。

en.s: The 1962 Idaho gubernatorial election was held on November 6; incumbent Republican Robert E. Smylie defeated Democratic nominee Vernon K. Smith with over 54.6% of the vote to win a third term as governor.

zh.s: 1962年爱达荷州州长选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任州长罗伯特·E·斯迈利以超过54.6%的选票击败民主党提名人弗农·K·史密斯，赢得第三个州长任期。

en.s: The 1962 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1962 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 27 of the state senate's 50 districts. At that time, the Iowa Senate still had several multi-member districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate. The Iowa General Assembly provides statewide maps of each district.

zh.s: 1962年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民在州参议院50个选区中的27个选区选出州参议员。当时，该州仍有若干多议员选区。州参议员任期四年。艾奥瓦州议会提供了各选区的全州地图。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral special election of 1962 saw the election of incumbent mayor Ralph S. Locher, who became mayor after Anthony J. Celebrezze resigned as mayor in 1962 to serve as United States Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare under President John F. Kennedy.

zh.s: 1962年克利夫兰市长特别选举由时任市长拉尔夫·S·洛彻胜出。此前，安东尼·J·切莱布雷泽于1962年辞去市长职务，转任约翰·F·肯尼迪总统任内的美国卫生、教育与福利部长。

en.s: United Nations General Assembly Resolution 1761 was passed on 6 November 1962 in response to the racist policies of apartheid established by the South African Government.
en.n: United Nations General Assembly Resolution 1761 was passed on 6 November 1962 in response to the racist policies of apartheid established by the South African Government.

zh.s: 联合国大会第1761号决议于1962年11月6日通过，以回应南非政府推行的种族隔离政策。
zh.n: 联合国大会第1761号决议于1962年11月6日通过，以回应南非政府推行的种族隔离政策。

en.t: Nguyễn Ngọc Thơ is appointed to head the South Vietnamese government by General Dương Văn Minh's junta, five days after the latter deposed and assassinated President Ngô Đình Diệm
en.s: Nguyễn Ngọc Thơ (Vietnamese: [ŋwiən˦ˀ˥ ŋawk͡p̚˧˨ʔ tʰəː˧˧]; chữ Hán: 阮玉書 26 May 1908 – 12 June 1976) was a South Vietnamese politician who was the first vice president of South Vietnam, serving under President Ngô Đình Diệm from 1956 until Diệm's overthrow and assassination in 1963. He also served as the first prime minister of South Vietnam, serving from November 1963 to late January 1964.

zh.t: 阮玉书被杨文明将军领导的军政府任命为南越政府首脑；五天前，杨文明推翻并杀害了总统吴廷琰
zh.s: 阮玉书（越南语：阮玉書；1908年5月26日—1976年6月12日）是南越政治人物，1956年至1963年在总统吴廷琰手下担任南越首任副总统，直至吴廷琰被推翻并遭暗杀。阮玉书还担任南越首任总理，任期自1963年11月至1964年1月下旬。

en.s: The New Orleans mayoral election of 1965 resulted in the re-election of Victor Schiro to his second full term as Mayor of New Orleans. No runoff was needed, as Schiro received over 50% of the vote. Elections were held on November 6.

zh.s: 1965年新奥尔良市长选举中，维克多·希罗连任，开始第二个完整市长任期。希罗获得超过50%的选票，因此无需举行决选。投票于11月6日举行。

en.s: The Laguna del Desierto incident occurred between four Chilean Carabineros and between 40 and 90 members of the Argentine National Gendarmerie and took place in an area south of O'Higgins/San Martín Lake on 6 November 1965, resulting in one lieutenant killed and a sergeant injured, both members of Carabineros, prompting a diplomatic crisis between Chile and Argentina.

zh.s: 1965年11月6日，4名智利卡宾枪骑警与40至90名阿根廷国家宪兵在奥希金斯湖／圣马丁湖以南地区发生冲突。两名智利卡宾枪骑警伤亡，其中一名中尉死亡、一名警长受伤，事件引发智利与阿根廷之间的外交危机。

en.t: United States Senate election in Oregon, 1966
en.s: The 1966 Oregon United States Senate election was held on November 6, 1966 to select the U.S. Senator from the state of Oregon. Incumbent Senator Maurine Brown Neuberger did not seek re-election. Held during the escalation of United States involvement of the Vietnam War, the race was between Republican candidate and incumbent Governor of Oregon Mark Hatfield, who opposed the war, and Democratic congressman Robert B. Duncan, who supported the war. In an unusual move, Oregon's other Senator, Democrat Wayne Morse, who also opposed the war, crossed party lines to endorse Hatfield, who won in a close election, his first of five terms in the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1966年美国俄勒冈州参议院选举
zh.s: 1966年美国俄勒冈州参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州的联邦参议员。民主党籍现任参议员莫琳·布朗·纽伯格没有竞选连任。选举在美国升级参与越南战争期间举行。共和党候选人、反对战争的现任俄勒冈州州长马克·哈特菲尔德，对阵支持战争的民主党联邦众议员罗伯特·B·邓肯。另一名反战人士、民主党籍俄勒冈州联邦参议员韦恩·莫斯采取少见做法，跨党派支持哈特菲尔德。哈特菲尔德以微弱优势获胜，开始五个联邦参议员任期中的第一个。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1966 Hessian state election was held on 6 November 1966 to elect the 6th Landtag of Hesse. The outgoing government was a majority of the Social Democratic Party (SPD) and All-German Party (GDP) led by Minister-President Georg-August Zinn. The SPD retained its majority and remained stable on 51%. The opposition Christian Democratic Union (CDU) slipped to 26%, and the Free Democratic Party (FDP) 10%.

zh.s: 1966年11月6日举行黑森州第六届州议会选举。由州长格奥尔格-奥古斯特·津恩领导的上届政府由社会民主党和全德党组成多数派。社会民主党保住多数，得票率维持在51%。反对党基督教民主联盟得票率降至26%，自由民主党获得10%。

en.s: The 1967 United Nations Security Council election was held on 6 November 1967 during the Twenty-second session of the United Nations General Assembly, held at United Nations Headquarters in New York City. The General Assembly elected Algeria, Hungary, Pakistan, Paraguay, and Senegal, as the five new non-permanent members of the UN Security Council for two-year mandates commencing on 1 January 1968.

zh.s: 1967年11月6日，联合国大会第二十二届会议在纽约联合国总部举行期间进行了安全理事会选举。大会选出阿尔及利亚、匈牙利、巴基斯坦、巴拉圭和塞内加尔为5个新的非常任理事国，任期两年，从1968年1月1日开始。

en.t: The United States Atomic Energy Commission tests the largest U.S. underground hydrogen bomb, code-named Cannikin, on Amchitka Island in the Aleutians
en.s: The United States Atomic Energy Commission (AEC) was an agency of the United States government established after World War II by the U.S. Congress to foster and control the peacetime development of atomic science and technology. President Harry S. Truman signed the McMahon/Atomic Energy Act on August 1, 1946, transferring the control of atomic energy from military to civilian hands, effective on January 1, 1947.

zh.t: 美国原子能委员会在阿留申群岛安奇卡岛试爆代号“坎尼金”的美国最大型地下氢弹
zh.s: 美国原子能委员会（AEC）是美国国会在二战后设立的政府机构，负责推动并管理和平时期原子科学与技术的发展。哈里·S·杜鲁门总统于1946年8月1日签署《麦克马洪／原子能法》，将原子能控制权从军方移交给民间，该法于1947年1月1日生效。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 1973 occurred on Tuesday, November 6, 1973, with the Democratic candidate, New York City Comptroller Abraham Beame winning the mayoralty with a decisive majority amongst a highly divided field. Beame, a Democrat, also ran on the Civil Service ballot line. Beame received a decisive 56.49% of the vote citywide. Beame also swept all five boroughs, breaking 60% of the vote in Brooklyn, winning majorities in Queens and the Bronx, and winning with pluralities in Manhattan and Staten Island. Beame's distant but closest competitor was the Republican nominee, state senator John Marchi, who received 16.07% of the vote.

zh.s: 1973年纽约市市长选举于11月6日星期二举行。候选人众多且分散，民主党候选人、纽约市审计长亚伯拉罕·比姆仍以明显优势当选市长。他也登记参加了公务员党选票，获得全市56.49%的选票。比姆赢得全部五个行政区：在布鲁克林得票超过60%，在皇后区和布朗克斯区赢得多数票，在曼哈顿区和史泰登岛区得票最多但未过半。距离最近的竞争者是共和党候选人、州参议员约翰·马尔基，得票率为16.07%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1973 gubernatorial elections were held in New Jersey and Virginia. Their general elections were on 6 November 1973. In both cases, a conservative managed to win in the end, while a moderate (or liberal) lost. In Virginia, Mills E. Godwin, Jr. had won a term for governor as a Democrat in the 1965 gubernatorial election. This time, he won as a Republican. Howell too was also an ex-Democrat as well. Howell tried to run from a populist stance, but he wasn't successful. Godwinpushed the conservative line and won.

zh.s: 1973年新泽西州和弗吉尼亚州举行了州长选举，两州的普选都在1973年11月6日进行。两州最终都是保守派候选人获胜，温和派（或自由派）落败。在弗吉尼亚州，米尔斯·E·戈德温曾以民主党人身份赢得1965年州长选举；这一次，他以共和党人身份胜出。霍威尔 也是一名前民主党人。他试图以民粹主义立场参选，但没有成功。戈德温坚持保守路线并获胜。

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 1973 was a race for Governor of New Jersey held on November 6, 1973. Democrat Brendan Byrne defeated Republican nominee Charles W. Sandman, Jr. with 66.67% of the vote.

zh.t: 美国新泽西州州长选举，1973
zh.s: 1973年11月6日举行新泽西州州长选举。民主党人布伦丹·伯恩以66.67%的得票率击败共和党提名人小查尔斯·W·桑德曼。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Mayoral election of 1973 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 6, 1973. The incumbent mayor, Pete Flaherty of the Democratic Party chose to run for his second full term.

zh.s: 1973年11月6日星期二，宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长皮特·弗拉赫蒂竞选第二个完整任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: 1973 New York City Council presidential election
en.s: An election was held on November 6, 1973 to elect the President of the New York City Council. Democratic incumbent Sanford Garelik initially did not run for re-election, choosing instead to run for mayor in the Democratic Party primary. After dropping out of the mayoral primary and running for re-election, Garelik was defeated in the Democratic primary by Paul O'Dwyer. In the general election, O'Dwyer defeated Thomas F.

zh.s: 1973年11月6日举行选举，选出纽约市议会主席。民主党籍时任主席桑福德·加雷利起初没有寻求连任，而是参加民主党市长初选。退出市长初选并转而竞选连任后，加雷利在民主党初选中输给保罗·奥德怀尔。普选中，奥德怀尔以较大优势击败托马斯·F·加尔文和西缅·戈拉尔。

en.s: The 1973 Virginia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1973. Republican nominee John N. Dalton defeated Democratic nominee James Harry Michael Jr. with 53.96 percent of the vote. This was the last time until 1997 that a Republican was elected lieutenant governor of Virginia.

zh.s: 1973年11月6日举行弗吉尼亚州副州长选举。共和党候选人约翰·N·道尔顿以53.96%的得票率击败民主党候选人小詹姆斯·哈里·迈克尔。这是共和党人直到1997年才再次当选弗吉尼亚州副州长。

en.s: The Cleveland mayoral election of 1973 saw the reelection of Ralph Perk. This was the first Cleveland mayoral election to use a nonpartisan system.

zh.s: 1973年克利夫兰市长选举中，拉尔夫·珀克成功连任。这是克利夫兰首次采用无党派选举制度举行市长选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1973 New Jersey Senate elections were held on November 6. The result of the elections were large gains for the Democratic Party, which won control of the Senate. The party picked up twelve seats. This election marked the first time since 1967 that Democrats controlled the State Senate. Republicans would not regain control of the State Senate until 1991.

zh.s: 新泽西州参议院选举于1973年11月6日举行。民主党大幅增加席位并赢得参议院控制权，共增加12席。这是民主党自1967年以来首次控制州参议院。共和党直到1991年才重新取得控制权。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In the 1973 Virginia gubernatorial election, incumbent Governor A. Linwood Holton, Jr., a Republican, was unable to seek re-election due to term limits. Mills E. Godwin, Jr., former Democratic Governor of Virginia, was nominated by the Republican Party to run against Independent Lieutenant Governor of Virginia Henry Howell. The Democrats did not field a candidate, mostly choosing to support Howell's candidacy.

zh.s: 1973年弗吉尼亚州州长选举中，共和党籍时任州长A·林伍德·霍尔顿因任期限制无法竞选连任。共和党提名前民主党籍弗吉尼亚州州长米尔斯·E·戈德温，对阵独立参选的弗吉尼亚州副州长亨利·霍威尔。民主党没有提名候选人，主要选择支持霍威尔。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Singapore on 6 November 1974. The election took place during a sitting of Parliament on 6 November 1974 where 59 members were present and 6 members were absent. Prime Minister Lee Kuan Yew nominated Benjamin Sheares for a second term as president. Sheares was unanimously re-elected by Parliament as president. Sheares was sworn in for his second four-year term as president on 2 January 1975.

zh.s: 1974年11月6日，新加坡举行间接总统选举。选举在当天召开的国会会议期间进行，59名议员出席，6名缺席。总理李光耀提名本杰明·谢尔思连任总统。国会一致选举谢尔思连任，他于1975年1月2日宣誓就任第二个四年任期。

en.s: The 1976 Scottish League Cup final was played on 6 November 1976 and was the final of the 31st Scottish League Cup competition. It was contested by Aberdeen and Celtic. Aberdeen won the match 2–1, thanks to goals by Drew Jarvie and Davie Robb.

zh.s: 1976年苏格兰联赛杯决赛于11月6日举行，是第31届苏格兰联赛杯赛事的决赛。阿伯丁对阵凯尔特人，阿伯丁凭借德鲁·贾维和戴维·罗布的进球，以2比1获胜。

en.s: The 1973 Allentown mayoral election was a municipal election in Allentown, Pennsylvania, United States. Incumbent Republican mayor Clifford S. Bartholomew was defeated in the Republican primaries by Leroy S. Bogert, who lost the mayoral election to two-term Democratic city councilman Joseph S. Daddona.

zh.s: 1973年宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举是一场地方选举。时任共和党市长克利福德·S·巴塞洛缪在共和党初选中败给勒罗伊·S·博格特；博格特随后在市长选举中败给已任职两届的民主党市议员约瑟夫·S·达多纳。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 1979 occurred on Tuesday, November 6, 1979 between Mayor Kevin White and state senator Joseph F. Timilty. This was the second election in a row between White and Timilty. White once again defeated Timilty and was elected to a fourth term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 25, 1979.

zh.s: 1979年11月6日星期二，波士顿举行市长选举，由市长凯文·怀特对阵州参议员约瑟夫·F·蒂米尔蒂。这是怀特和蒂米尔蒂连续第二次在市长选举中交锋。怀特再次击败蒂米尔蒂，当选并开始第四个任期。无党派市政预选于1979年9月25日举行。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 1979 took place on November 6, 1979, and saw the reelection of Republican William H. Hudnut III. Hudnut defeated Democratic former city-county councilman Paul Cantwell in what was reported to have been the greatest margin of defeat for a Democratic candidate in an Indianapolis mayoral election in 150 years. Cantwell had resigned his seat on the Indianapolis City-County Council in order to focus on his campaign.

zh.t: 1979年印第安纳波利斯市长选举
zh.s: 1979年11月6日举行印第安纳波利斯市长选举，共和党人威廉·H·哈德纳特三世连任。他击败民主党籍前市县议员保罗·坎特韦尔。据报道，这是150年来印第安纳波利斯市长选举中民主党候选人遭遇的最大败选差距。坎特韦尔辞去印第安纳波利斯市县议会议席，专心竞选。

en.s: The 1979 Virginia Senate elections were held on November 6, 1979, alongside the Virginia House of Delegates election. All 40 seats in the Senate of Virginia were up for election.

zh.s: 1979年11月6日举行弗吉尼亚州参议院选举，与州众议院选举同时进行。州参议院的全部40个席位都进行改选。

en.s: The 1979 Kentucky lieutenant gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1979, to elect the lieutenant governor of Kentucky. Incumbent Democratic lieutenant governor Thelma Stovall chose not to seek re-election to a second term, instead choosing to run for governor. Kentucky Court of Appeals clerk Martha Layne Collins beat Republican nominee and commonwealth attorney for Pulaski and Rockcastle counties Harold Rogers.

zh.s: 1979年11月6日举行肯塔基州副州长选举。民主党籍时任副州长塞尔玛·斯托瓦尔没有竞选连任第二个任期，而是转而竞选州长。肯塔基州上诉法院书记官玛莎·莱恩·柯林斯击败共和党候选人哈罗德·罗杰斯；罗杰斯是普拉斯基县和罗克卡斯尔县的联邦检察官。

en.s: The 1979 Mississippi gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1979, in order to elect the Governor of Mississippi. Incumbent Democrat Cliff Finch was term-limited, and could not run for reelection to a second term. As of 2020, this was the most recent election in which a Democrat won over 60 percent of the statewide vote in a gubernatorial election in the state.

zh.s: 1979年11月6日举行密西西比州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长克利夫·芬奇受任期限制，不能竞选连任第二个任期。截至2020年，这是密西西比州州长选举中民主党人最后一次赢得超过60%的全州选票。

en.s: The 1979 Kentucky gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1979. Democratic nominee John Y. Brown Jr. defeated Republican nominee Louie Nunn with 59.49% of the vote.

zh.s: 1979年11月6日举行肯塔基州州长选举。民主党候选人小约翰·Y·布朗以59.49%的得票率击败共和党候选人路易·纳恩。

en.s: The 1979 Durham mayoral election was held on November 6, 1979 to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the election of Harry E. Rodenhizer Jr., who unseated incumbent mayor Wade L. Cavin.

zh.s: 1979年达勒姆市长选举于11月6日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市市长。哈里·E·罗登海泽二世当选，击败现任市长韦德·L·卡文。

en.s: The 1979 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 6, 1979, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. George Voinovich defeated incumbent mayor Dennis Kucinich. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the October 2 primary advancing to the general election.

zh.s: 1979年克利夫兰市长选举于11月6日举行，选出俄亥俄州克利夫兰市市长。乔治·沃伊诺维奇击败现任市长丹尼斯·库辛尼奇。选举依法不设党派，10月2日初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选。

en.s: The 1979 Philadelphia mayoral election saw the election of William J. Green III. Ahead of the election there had been an unsuccessful effort to amend the city charter to allow incumbent mayor Frank Rizzo to run for a third consecutive term.

zh.s: 1979年费城市长选举由威廉·J·格林三世胜出。选举前，曾有人提议修订市宪章，允许时任市长弗兰克·里佐连续竞选第三个任期，但未能成功。

en.s: The 1979 Baltimore mayoral election saw the reelection of William Donald Schaefer to a third consecutive term.

zh.s: 1979年巴尔的摩市长选举中，威廉·唐纳德·谢弗成功连任，开始连续第三个市长任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1979 mayoral election was held to elect the mayor of San Francisco. Incumbent mayor Dianne Feinstein, who had succeeded George Moscone after his assassination the prior year, was elected to her first full term as mayor of the City and County, the first woman to be elected to the position in the city's history. Feinstein, with 46.63%, and Quentin L.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1979年旧金山市长选举旨在选出旧金山市长。时任市长黛安·范士丹（Dianne Feinstein）在前任乔治·莫斯科尼遇刺身亡后接任，并在此次选举中赢得首个完整任期，成为旧金山历史上首位当选市长的女性。首轮投票中，范士丹得票率为46.63%，昆廷·L·科普（Quentin L. Kopp）得票率为44.72%，两人进入第二轮。

en.s: The siege of Abadan was the encirclement of the city by Iraqi forces beginning in November 1980. The city had already been under almost daily bombardment since the early days of the war, which began the previous September. Abadan Island was the site of the Abadan Refinery, one of the world's largest oil refineries.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 阿巴丹围城战是伊拉克军队自1980年11月起对阿巴丹市实施的包围。战争于此前一年9月爆发后，这座城市几乎每天都遭到炮击。阿巴丹岛上设有阿巴丹炼油厂，当时它是世界上最大的炼油厂之一。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1982 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1982. Incumbent Democratic governor Hugh Gallen ran for re-election but was defeated by Tufts University professor John Sununu. Sununu, who defeated Lou D'Allesandro for the Republican nomination, became the first Arab-American governor of New Hampshire. Gallen died just over a week before Sununu's inauguration.

zh.s: 1982年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长休·加伦竞选连任，但败给塔夫茨大学教授约翰·苏努努。苏努努在共和党初选中击败卢·达历山德罗，之后成为新罕布什尔州首位阿拉伯裔美国人州长。加伦在苏努努宣誓就职前一周多去世。

en.s: State elections were held in South Australia on 6 November 1982. All 47 seats in the South Australian House of Assembly were up for election. The incumbent Liberal Party of Australia led by Premier of South Australia David Tonkin was defeated by the Australian Labor Party led by Leader of the Opposition John Bannon. A referendum on daylight saving was held on the same day, and was passed.

zh.s: 南澳大利亚州于1982年11月6日举行州选举，州众议院全部47个席位都进行改选。由州长戴维·汤金领导的澳大利亚自由党政府败给由反对党领袖约翰·班农领导的澳大利亚工党。同日举行的夏令时公投也获得通过。

en.s: Operation Muharram (Persian: عملیات محرم) was a series of four Iranian operations in Amara area which failed to penetrate deep into Iraq and only had small gains. It was conducted during the Iran–Iraq War by the command of Hasan Bagheri. Iraq managed to repulse Iranian offensives in the direction of Al-Amarah. It was started on 1 November 1982 at 22:08 o'clock with the code of "La-Hawla wa La-Qowwatah Ela Bellah; Ya Zeinab-Kobra (S)".
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 穆哈兰姆行动是伊朗在阿马拉地区实施的一系列四次军事行动，未能深入伊拉克境内，只取得有限进展。行动发生于两伊战争期间，由哈桑·巴盖里指挥；伊拉克成功击退了伊朗向阿马拉方向发动的攻势。行动于1982年11月1日22时08分开始，口令为“除真主外别无能力与力量；赞奈卜·库布拉（愿主福安之）”。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 6 November 1983, the first since 1977 after democratic rights were abandoned after the military coup of 1980. The National Security Council banned the previous political parties from participating, leading to the establishment of new parties. Turgut Özal's Motherland Party (ANAP) won a significant victory in this elections by gaining 45.14% of the votes.

zh.s: 土耳其于1983年11月6日举行大选。这是1977年以来首次大选；1980年军事政变后，民主权利一度被中止。国家安全委员会禁止原有政党参选，促使新政党成立。图尔古特·厄扎尔领导的祖国党赢得45.14%的选票，大获全胜。

en.t: United States presidential election in West Virginia, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 6, 1984. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1984 United States presidential election. West Virginia voters chose 6 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President of the United States. West Virginia was won by incumbent United States President Ronald Reagan of California, who was running against former Vice President Walter Mondale of Minnesota. zh.t: 1984年美国西弗吉尼亚州总统选举

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 6, 1984 as part of the 1984 United States presidential election, which was held throughout all 50 states and D.C. Voters chose 3 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. en.s: The United States presidential election of 1984 was the 50th quadrennial presidential election. It was held on Tuesday, November 6, 1984. The contest was between the incumbent President Ronald Reagan, the Republican candidate, and former Vice President Walter Mondale, the Democratic candidate. Reagan carried 49 of the 50 states, becoming one of only two candidates to do so (the other was Richard Nixon in the 1972 presidential election). Reagan touted a strong economic recovery from 1970s stagflation and the 1981–82 recession, as well as the widespread perception that his presidency had overseen a revival of national confidence and prestige.

zh.s: 1984年美国总统选举是美国第50次四年一度总统选举，于11月6日星期二举行。共和党籍现任总统罗纳德·里根对阵民主党候选人、前副总统沃尔特·蒙代尔。里根赢得50个州中的49个，是历史上仅有的两位做到这一点的候选人之一；另一位是1972年的理查德·尼克松。里根称自己带来了经济复苏，帮助美国摆脱20世纪70年代的滞胀和1981至1982年的经济衰退；许多人也认为他的政府恢复了国家信心和声望。

en.s: The North Carolina gubernatorial election of 1984 was held on November 6, 1984. Popular Democratic incumbent Jim Hunt was unable to run for another consecutive term under the North Carolina Constitution. Hunt ran instead for the U.S. Senate against Jesse Helms and lost. Popular 9th District Congressman James G. Martin ran as the Republican nominee against Democratic Attorney General Rufus L. Edmisten, who defeated Hunt's Lt. Governor, James Green, among other candidates, in a hotly-contested primary. Martin won by a comfortable margin on Election Day thanks to the surprise endorsement of Green, and to President Ronald Reagan's coattails (see also United States presidential election, 1984).

zh.s: 1984年北卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月6日举行。民主党籍热门现任州长吉姆·亨特因州宪法限制，无法连续竞选下一任期。他转而竞选联邦参议员，对阵杰西·赫尔姆斯，但未能当选。共和党候选人、第9国会选区热门联邦众议员詹姆斯·G·马丁，对阵民主党候选人、州检察长鲁弗斯·L·埃德米斯滕。埃德米斯滕在竞争激烈的初选中击败了亨特的副州长詹姆斯·格林等人。格林随后出人意料地支持马丁，加上罗纳德·里根的助选效应，马丁在大选日获胜，优势相当明显。

en.s: The Arkansas gubernatorial election of 1984 was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Governor Bill Clinton won reelection with a 25% margin of victory over Jonesboro businessman Woody Freeman. This was the last gubernatorial election in Arkansas before the implementation of Amendment 63, lengthening the term of the governor of Arkansas from two to four years. Winning his third of five terms as Governor of Arkansas, Clinton continued to serve this office until he was elected President of the United States in 1992.

zh.s: 1984年阿肯色州州长选举于11月6日举行。现任州长比尔·克林顿以25个百分点的优势击败琼斯伯勒商人伍迪·弗里曼，成功连任。这是阿肯色州根据第63号修正案延长州长任期前的最后一次州长选举；该修正案将任期从两年延长至四年。克林顿赢得他五个州长任期中的第三个，直到1992年当选美国总统后才离任。

en.t: United States presidential election in Utah, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in Utah took place on November 6, 1984. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1984 United States presidential election. Utah voters chose 5 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President of the United States. Utah was won by incumbent United States President Ronald Reagan of California, who was running against former Vice President Walter Mondale of Minnesota. Reagan ran for a second time with former C.I.A. Director George H. W. Bush of Texas, and Mondale ran with Representative Geraldine Ferraro of New York, the first major female candidate for the Vice-Presidency.

en.s: The United States gubernatorial elections of 1984 were held on November 6, 1984 in thirteen states. The Republican party had a net gain of one seat in this election which coincided with the re-election of Ronald Reagan. This was the last year in which Arkansas held a gubernatorial election on the same year as the presidential election. The length of gubernatorial terms for Arkansas' governor would be extended from two-years to four years with elections taking place in Midterm election years following the passage of the Sixty-third Amendment to the Arkansas Constitution.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日，美国13个州举行州长选举。共和党净增一个州长席位，选举与罗纳德·里根连任总统同期举行。这是阿肯色州最后一次在总统选举年举行州长选举。阿肯色州州长任期原为两年；该州宪法第63条修正案通过后，任期将延长至四年，选举则安排在总统任期中期举行。

en.t: United States presidential election in Minnesota, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 1984 in Minnesota as part of the 1984 United States presidential election. The Democratic Party candidate, former Vice President Walter Mondale, narrowly won his home state over incumbent President Ronald Reagan by just 3,761 votes, giving him his only state victory in the election (Mondale also carried the District of Columbia). Minnesota was the only state not to back Reagan in either of his presidential campaigns. Since all 49 other states went to the Republican Party in 1984, this established Minnesota's status as the state with the longest streak of voting Democratic.

en.t: United States presidential election in Maryland, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in Maryland took place on November 6, 1984, as part of the 1984 United States presidential election. Voters chose ten representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Maryland was won by incumbent President Ronald Reagan (R-California), with 52.51% of the popular vote, over former Vice President Walter Mondale (D-Minnesota) with 47.02% of the popular vote, a decisive 5.49% margin. Reagan ultimately won the national vote, defeating Mondale.

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 6, 1984. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1984 United States presidential election. en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 6, 1984, as part of the 1984 United States presidential election. Voters chose three representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. Alaska was won by incumbent President Ronald Reagan (R-California) with almost two-thirds of the popular vote against Walter Mondale (D-Minnesota) with 29.9%. Reagan ultimately won the national vote, winning re-election. Alaska has only voted Democratic once, and that was in the 1964 election for Lyndon B. Johnson.

en.t: United States presidential election in North Carolina, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in North Carolina took place on November 6, 1984 throughout all 50 states and D.C., which was part of the 1984 United States presidential election. Voters chose 13 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for President and Vice President. North Carolina strongly voted for the Republican nominee, President Ronald Reagan, over the Democratic nominee, Vice President Walter Mondale in a landslide. The final margin was 61.90% to 37.89%, which compared to the other southern states, was close to the southern average. This margin was a huge swing from 1980, where Reagan had only narrowly carried the state.

en.s: The 1984 Indiana gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1984 in all 92 counties of the Indiana. Robert D. Orr, the state's incumbent Republican governor, was comfortably reelected to a second term, defeating State Senator Wayne Townsend and two minor party challengers in the general election. His victory marked the fifth consecutive victory for the Republican Party in Indiana gubernatorial elections, and the last time Republicans would win the governorship in the 20th century. Despite losing the election, Townsend received 195,351 more votes than the Democratic nominee for president, Walter Mondale, who won less than 38% of the vote in Indiana and was handily defeated by Ronald Reagan in the presidential election of 1984.

en.t: United States Senate election in Illinois, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Illinois took place on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Charles H. Percy ran for re-election to a fourth term in the United States Senate. Senator Percy was opposed by Democratic nominee Paul Simon, who was a United States Congressman from Illinois's 22nd congressional district. The campaign between Percy and Simon was brutal and toughly-fought, and ended up with Simon ousting Percy by fewer than 90,000 votes, which was, at the time, considered an upset.

en.s: The 1984 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Governor of Montana Ted Schwinden, who was first elected in 1980, ran for re-election. Kentucky voters chose 9 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the President and Vice President of the United States. Kentucky was won by incumbent United States President Ronald Reagan of California, who was running against former Vice President Walter Mondale of Minnesota. Reagan ran for a second time with former C.I.A. Director George H. W. Bush of Texas, and Mondale ran with Representative Geraldine Ferraro of New York, the first major female candidate for the Vice-Presidency.

zh.s: 1984年美国肯塔基州总统选举于11月6日举行。当时美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区都参与总统选举。肯塔基州选民选出9名选举人，组成选举人团，投票选出总统和副总统。加利福尼亚州籍现任总统罗纳德·里根击败明尼苏达州前副总统沃尔特·蒙代尔，在肯塔基州获胜。里根再次与前中央情报局局长、得克萨斯州人乔治·H·W·布什搭档；蒙代尔的搭档是纽约州联邦众议员杰拉尔丁·费拉罗，她是首位代表主要政党竞选副总统的女性。

en.t: United States presidential election in the District of Columbia, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia was held on November 6, 1984. Democratic candidate Walter Mondale won D.C. with 85% of the vote, giving him 3 electoral votes. In the general election, he only carried a total of 13 electoral votes, the other 10 coming from his home state of Minnesota. The incumbent Ronald Reagan won re-election in 1984, carrying 49 U.S. states.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日，哥伦比亚特区举行总统选举。民主党候选人沃尔特·蒙代尔在特区获得85%的选票，赢得3张选举人票。在全国大选中，他总共只赢得13张选举人票，另外10张来自家乡明尼苏达州。共和党籍现任总统罗纳德·里根赢得1984年大选，拿下美国49个州。

en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Montana took place on November 6, 1984. Incumbent United States Senator Max Baucus, who was first elected in 1978, ran for re-election. en.t: United States Senate election in Alaska, 1984
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Alaska was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Republican United States Senator Ted Stevens sought re-election to a third term in the United States Senate. en.t: United States presidential election in Indiana, 1984
en.s: The 1984 Presidential Election in Indiana took place on November 6, 1984. President Ronald Reagan won this state by a substantial 23.99% margin. He carried every county in the Hoosier state except for Lake County in the northwest corner. No Democratic candidate has won Indiana since 1964, until Barack Obama broke this record in 2008.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行印第安纳州总统选举。罗纳德·里根以23.99个百分点的明显优势赢得该州。他拿下除西北角莱克县以外的每个县。自1964年以来，没有民主党候选人赢得印第安纳州，直到巴拉克·奥巴马在2008年打破这一纪录。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Carolina, 1984
en.s: The North Carolina United States Senate election of 1984 was held on 6 November 1984 as part of the nationwide elections to the Senate, and coinciding with the 1984 presidential election. The election was fought between the Republican incumbent Jesse Helms and serving Democratic Governor Jim Hunt. Helms won the election, the most expensive non-presidential election in United States history up to that point, by a margin significantly reduced from that that Helms achieved in 1978.

en.s: The Alaska Congressional election of 1984 was held on Tuesday, November 6, 1984. The term of the state's sole Representative to the United States House of Representatives expired on January 3, 1985. The winning candidate would serve a two-year term from January 3, 1985, to January 3, 1987.

en.s: The 1984 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 6, 1984, in order to elect the state treasurer of Missouri.
