zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行密苏里州财政部长选举。共和党候选人、前密苏里州第八选区联邦众议员温德尔·贝利击败民主党候选人、时任密苏里州众议员汤姆·维拉。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Oregon
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Oregon took place on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Mark Hatfield was re-elected to a fourth term in office, defeating Democratic State Senator Margie Hendriksen. As of 2022, this is the last U.S. Senate race in Oregon where every county voted for the same candidate.

zh.t: 1984年俄勒冈州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行俄勒冈州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员马克·哈特菲尔德击败民主党州参议员玛吉·亨德里克森，连任第四个任期。截至2022年，这是俄勒冈州参议院选举中最后一次所有县都支持同一名候选人。

en.s: The 1984 West Virginia Attorney General election took place on November 6, 1984, to elect the Attorney General of West Virginia. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Chauncey H. Browning Jr. chose not to seek re-election to a fifth term, choosing instead to run for governor. Charleston attorney and former Deputy Attorney General Charlie Brown beat Republican nominee John F. McCuskey 55.5% to 44.5%.

zh.t: 1984年西弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长小昌西·H·布朗宁没有竞选第五个任期，而是转而竞选州长。查尔斯顿律师、前副总检察长查理·布朗以55.5%对44.5%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·F·麦卡斯基。

en.s: The 1984 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Governor J. Joseph Garrahy retired after four terms in office. Republican nominee and Cranston mayor Edward D. DiPrete defeated Democratic nominee Anthony J. Solomon with 60% of the vote.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行罗得岛州州长选举。时任州长J·约瑟夫·加拉希任职四届后退休。共和党候选人、克兰斯顿市长爱德华·D·迪普雷特以60%的得票率击败民主党候选人安东尼·J·所罗门。

en.t: 1984 United States presidential election in California
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in California took place on November 6, 1984, as part of the 1984 United States presidential election. State voters chose 47 representatives, or electors, to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. California voted for the Republican incumbent and former California Governor, Ronald Reagan, in a landslide over the Democratic challenger, former Minnesota Senator and Vice President Walter Mondale.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日，加利福尼亚州举行总统选举，这是1984年美国总统选举的一部分。州内选民选出47名选举人，由他们组成的选举人团选出总统和副总统。共和党籍时任总统、加利福尼亚州前州长罗纳德·里根以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人、明尼苏达州前参议员兼副总统沃尔特·蒙代尔。

en.s: The 1984 Utah gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1984. Republican nominee Norman H. Bangerter defeated Democratic nominee Wayne Owens with 55.87% of the vote, becoming Utah's first Republican governor in 20 years.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行犹他州州长选举。共和党候选人诺曼·H·班格特以55.87%的得票率击败民主党候选人韦恩·欧文斯，成为20年来犹他州首位共和党州长。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Republican Senator Roger Jepsen ran for re-election to a second term in office. Jepsen was opposed by U.S. Representative Tom Harkin, from Iowa's 5th congressional district, who won the Democratic primary uncontested.

zh.t: 1984年艾奥瓦州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行艾奥瓦州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员罗杰·杰普森竞选连任第二个任期。他的对手是艾奥瓦州第五选区联邦众议员汤姆·哈金；哈金在民主党初选中无人竞争，直接获得提名。

en.s: The 1984 North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1984. Democratic nominee Robert B. Jordan defeated Republican nominee John H. Carrington with 53.70% of the vote.

zh.t: 1984年北卡罗来纳州副州长选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行北卡罗来纳州副州长选举。民主党候选人罗伯特·B·乔丹以53.70%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·H·卡林顿。

en.t: 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island
en.s: The 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island were held on November 6, 1984, to determine who would represent Rhode Island in the United States House of Representatives. Rhode Island had two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 1984年罗得岛州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行罗得岛州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。罗得岛州有两个众议院席位，按1980年美国人口普查结果分配。联邦众议员任期为两年。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 6, 1984. Primaries were held on March 20.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日，星期二，伊利诺伊州举行选举。党内初选于3月20日举行。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Alan Simpson was re-elected to a second term in office, defeating Democrat Victor Ryan in a landslide, winning 78.32% of votes and outperforming Republican President Ronald Reagan’s vote share in the concurrent presidential race by 7.81%.

zh.t: 1984年怀俄明州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行怀俄明州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员艾伦·辛普森以压倒性优势击败民主党人维克多·瑞安，赢得78.32%的选票，连任第二个任期。他的得票率比同日总统选举中共和党总统候选人罗纳德·里根高7.81%。

en.s: The 1984 West Virginia State Auditor election took place on November 6, 1984, to elect the West Virginia State Auditor.

zh.t: 1984年西弗吉尼亚州审计长选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州审计长选举，选出该州审计长。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Colorado
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Colorado was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Republican William L. Armstrong defeated Democratic nominee Nancy Dick with 64.25% of the vote. Armstrong carried all but three counties in the state, and to date is the last Republican Senate candidate to carry normally heavily Democratic Denver. This is the best ever performance by a Republican in a popular vote election in Colorado for the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1984年科罗拉多州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行科罗拉多州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员威廉·L·阿姆斯特朗以64.25%的得票率击败民主党候选人南希·迪克。阿姆斯特朗赢得该州除3个县以外的所有县。截至目前，他是最后一位赢得通常由民主党大幅领先的丹佛市的共和党参议院候选人。这也是共和党候选人在科罗拉多州联邦参议员普选中取得的最高成绩。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Carl Levin won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican candidate and former astronaut Jack Lousma. Coinciding with Republican Ronald Reagan's landslide in Michigan and the rest of the country, this was the only Senate election of Levin's career in which his percentage of the vote and margin of victory decreased from the previous one.

zh.t: 1984年密歇根州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行密歇根州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员卡尔·莱文击败共和党候选人、前宇航员杰克·劳斯马，连任第二个任期。这次选举与共和党人罗纳德·里根在密歇根州及全国大胜同时举行，也是莱文从政期间唯一一次得票率和胜选优势都比上次参议院选举下降。

en.t: 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire were held on November 6, 1984, to determine who would represent New Hampshire in the United States House of Representatives. New Hampshire had two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 1984年新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。新罕布什尔州有两个众议院席位，按1980年美国人口普查结果分配。联邦众议员任期为两年。

en.s: The 1984 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 6, 1984. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. House and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 11, 1984. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 39 seats over the Democrats' 21 seats.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行亚利桑那州众议院选举。选民从多席位选区选出全部60名州众议员，任期两年。选举与联邦众议院和州参议院等职位选举同时举行。党内初选于1984年9月11日举行。选举前，共和党以39席对民主党的21席占多数。

en.s: The 1984 Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1984. Democratic nominee Harriett Woods defeated Republican nominee Mel Hancock with 53.82% of the vote.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行密苏里州副州长选举。民主党候选人哈丽特·伍兹以53.82%的得票率击败共和党候选人梅尔·汉考克。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in New Jersey was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Democrat Bill Bradley defeated Republican nominee Mary V. Mochary with 64.16% of the vote, winning every county in the state. To date, this is the most recent time Hunterdon, Sussex, and Warren counties were won by a Democrat in a statewide election.

zh.t: 1984年新泽西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行新泽西州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员比尔·布拉德利以64.16%的得票率击败共和党候选人玛丽·V·莫查里，赢得该州所有县。截至目前，这是亨特登县、苏塞克斯县和沃伦县在全州选举中最后一次支持民主党候选人。

en.t: 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama
en.s: The 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama were held on November 6, 1984, to determine who would represent Alabama in the United States House of Representatives. Alabama had seven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 1984年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。阿拉巴马州有7个众议院席位，按1980年美国人口普查结果分配。联邦众议员任期为两年。

en.s: The 1984 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1984, in order to elect the secretary of state of Missouri. Republican nominee Roy Blunt defeated Democratic nominee Gary D. Sharpe.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行密苏里州州务卿选举。共和党候选人罗伊·布朗特击败民主党候选人加里·D·夏普。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Democratic Senator Howell Heflin was easily re-elected to a second term. Heflin received 94% of the black vote.

zh.t: 1984年阿拉巴马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行阿拉巴马州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任参议员豪厄尔·赫夫林轻松连任第二个任期。赫夫林获得94%的非裔选民选票。

en.t: 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 6, 1984, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-seven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. Texas underwent mid-decade redistricting due to the District Court case Upham v. Seamon. The U.S.

zh.t: 1984年美国得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1984年美国得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州联邦众议院代表团成员。根据1980年人口普查，得克萨斯州拥有27个联邦众议院席位。由于联邦地区法院审理Upham诉Seamon案，该州在十年中期重新划分选区。美国司法部依据《1965年投票权法》第5条，对得克萨斯州议会1981年通过的第15和第27选区边界提出异议。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Kansas
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Kansas was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Senator Nancy Kassebaum was re-elected to a second term in office.

zh.t: 1984年堪萨斯州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行堪萨斯州美国参议院选举。时任参议员南希·卡塞鲍姆再次当选，赢得第二个任期。

en.t: 1984 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont
en.s: The 1984 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont was held on Tuesday, November 6, 1984, to elect the U.S. representative from the state's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including the concurrent presidential election. Incumbent representative Jim Jeffords won re-election to a 6th term with 65.41% of the vote.

zh.t: 1984年佛蒙特州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日，星期二，佛蒙特州举行联邦众议院选举，选出该州单一选区的联邦众议员。此次选举与总统选举等其他联邦和州职位选举同时举行。时任众议员吉姆·杰福兹以65.41%的得票率当选第六个任期。

en.t: 1984 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1984 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Representative Dick Cheney defeated Hugh B. McFadden, Jr. with 73.57% of the vote.

zh.t: 1984年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行怀俄明州联邦众议院选举。时任众议员迪克·切尼以73.57%的得票率击败小休·B·麦克法登。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Republican Senator Larry Pressler was easily re-elected to a second term after famously declining to take bribes during the Abscam Scandal.

zh.t: 1984年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行南达科他州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任参议员拉里·普雷斯勒因阿布斯坎丑闻中拒绝收受贿赂而广为人知，此次轻松连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1984 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1984, in order to elect the attorney general of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent member of the Missouri House of Representatives William L. Webster defeated Democratic nominee and fellow incumbent member of the Missouri House of Representatives Richard P. Beard.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行密苏里州总检察长选举。共和党候选人、时任密苏里州众议员威廉·L·韦伯斯特击败民主党候选人、同为州众议员的理查德·P·比尔德。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in New Hampshire
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in New Hampshire was held on November 6, 1984. Senator Gordon Humphrey was re-elected to a second term in office.

zh.t: 1984年新罕布什尔州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州美国参议院选举。参议员戈登·汉弗莱再次当选，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1984 Delaware gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Republican governor Pierre S. duPont IV was barred from seeking a third term in office. Lieutenant Governor Mike Castle was elected to succeed him, defeating State Supreme Court Justice William T. Quillen. This was the last time that a gubernatorial nominee and a lieutenant gubernatorial nominee of different political parties were elected simultaneously in Delaware.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行特拉华州州长选举。共和党籍时任州长皮埃尔·S·杜邦四世不能竞选第三个任期。副州长迈克·卡斯尔当选接替他，击败州最高法院法官威廉·T·奎伦。这是特拉华州最后一次同时选出来自不同政党的州长和副州长。

en.t: 1984 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1984 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives on November 6, 1984, to elect members to serve in the 99th United States Congress. They coincided with the re-election of President Ronald Reagan in a landslide. This victory also yielded gains for Reagan's Republican Party in the House, where they picked up a net of sixteen seats from the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行美国联邦众议院选举，选出第99届国会的议员。选举与罗纳德·里根压倒性连任同时进行。里根获胜也带动共和党在众议院增加16个席位。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 6, 1984, to select the U.S. Senator from the state of Tennessee. Popular three-term Republican incumbent Howard Baker, who had served as United States Senate Majority Leader since 1981 (Minority Leader from 1977 to 1981) decided not to seek re-election in order to concentrate on a planned bid for the 1988 Republican presidential nomination (which did not happen, as he later accepted a White House Chief of Staff position under President Ronald Reagan).

zh.t: 1984年田纳西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行田纳西州美国参议院选举。曾任职三届的共和党参议员霍华德·贝克自1981年起担任参议院多数党领袖，此前于1977年至1981年担任少数党领袖。他决定不竞选连任，以专注于计划参加1988年共和党总统提名竞选；但后来他接受罗纳德·里根总统任命，出任白宫办公厅主任，因此没有参选。

en.s: The 1984 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Governor John Sununu was re-elected to a second term in office.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。时任州长约翰·苏努努再次当选，赢得第二个任期。

en.s: The 1984 Arizona Senate election was held on November 6, 1984. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 11, 1984. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 18 seats over the Democrats' 12 seats.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行亚利桑那州参议院选举，选出该州全部30个立法选区的州参议员，任期两年。党内初选于1984年9月11日举行。选举前，共和党以18席对民主党的12席占多数。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Oklahoma was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Senator David Boren was re-elected to a second term in office in a landslide. This is the last time that Oklahoma simultaneously voted for presidential and U.S. Senate candidates of different political parties.

zh.t: 1984年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举。时任参议员大卫·博伦以压倒性优势再次当选，赢得第二个任期。这是俄克拉何马州总统选举和联邦参议院选举最后一次同时支持不同政党的候选人。

en.s: The 1984 Delaware lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1984, in order to elect the lieutenant governor of Delaware. Democratic nominee S. B. Woo defeated Republican nominee Battle R. Robinson.

zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行特拉华州副州长选举。民主党候选人S·B·吴击败共和党候选人巴特尔·R·罗宾逊。

en.t: 1984 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 6, 1984. It was held as part of the 1984 Puerto Rican general election. It saw the election of Baltasar Corrada del Río, a member of the New Progressive Party.

zh.t: 1984年波多黎各圣胡安市长选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日，波多黎各圣胡安举行市长选举，这是1984年波多黎各大选的一部分。新进步党成员巴尔塔萨·科拉达·德尔里奥当选。

en.t: 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada
en.s: The 1984 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada were held on November 6, 1984, to determine who would represent Nevada in the United States House of Representatives. Nevada had two seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 1984年内华达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行内华达州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。内华达州有两个众议院席位，按1980年美国人口普查结果分配。联邦众议员任期为两年。

en.s: The 1984 West Virginia State Treasurer election took place on November 6, 1984, to elect the West Virginia State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic Treasurer Larrie Bailey ran for re-election to a third term, but was defeated in the Democratic primary by Secretary of State A. James Manchin. Manchin then went on to win the general election over Republican nominee Manuel "Pat" Hale, 66.3% to 33.7%.

zh.t: 1984年西弗吉尼亚州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州财政部长选举。民主党籍时任财政部长拉里·贝利竞选第三个任期，但在民主党初选中败给州务卿A·詹姆斯·曼钦。曼钦随后在大选中以66.3%对33.7%的得票率击败共和党候选人曼努埃尔·“帕特”·黑尔。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Jennings Randolph chose to retire instead of seeking re-election to a fifth term, and was succeeded by West Virginia Governor Jay Rockefeller, who defeated Republican John Raese in one of the closer races of the year.

zh.t: 1984年西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员詹宁斯·伦道夫选择退休，没有竞选第五个任期。西弗吉尼亚州州长杰伊·洛克菲勒接替他，并在当年竞争较激烈的选举中击败共和党人约翰·雷斯。

en.s: The 1984 San Diego mayoral election was held on November 6, 1984, to elect the mayor for San Diego. Incumbent mayor Roger Hedgecock stood for reelection. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though some candidates do receive funding and support from various political parties. The non-partisan primary was held June 5, 1984. Roger Hedgecock and Dick Carlson received the most votes and advanced to the November runoff.

zh.s: 1984年圣迭戈市长选举于11月6日举行，选出市长。现任市长罗杰·赫奇科克竞选连任。加利福尼亚州市政选举依法不设党派，但一些候选人会获得不同政党的资助和支持。无党派初选于1984年6月5日举行。罗杰·赫奇科克和迪克·卡尔森得票最高，进入11月决选。

en.t: 1984 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 6, 1984. All 50 states and the District of Columbia, were part of the 1984 United States presidential election. Georgia voters chose 12 electors to the Electoral College, which selected the president and vice president of the United States. Georgia was won by incumbent President Ronald Reagan, running with Vice President George H.

zh.s: 1984年美国佐治亚州总统选举于11月6日举行。美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加了这次总统选举。佐治亚州选民选出12名总统选举人，由他们选出美国总统和副总统。时任总统罗纳德·里根与副总统乔治·H·W·布什搭档，击败前副总统沃尔特·蒙代尔及其搭档、联邦众议员杰拉尔丁·费拉罗。佐治亚州在本次选举中比全国平均多出2个百分点的共和党倾向。

en.s: The 1984 Nova Scotia general election was held on November 6, 1984, to elect members of the 54th House of Assembly of the province of Nova Scotia, Canada. It was won by the Progressive Conservative party.

zh.s: 1984年新斯科舍省大选于11月6日举行，选出加拿大新斯科舍省第54届众议院议员。进步保守党赢得选举。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 6, 1984. Primaries were held March 20, 1984. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, Recorder of Deeds, State's Attorney, 4 seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县于1984年11月6日举行普选。初选于1984年3月20日举行。此次选举改选巡回法院书记官、契据登记官、州检察官、水资源回收区委员会4个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官职位。

en.t: 1984 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Georgia was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Sam Nunn won re-election to a third term.

zh.t: 1984年佐治亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1984年佐治亚州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任参议员萨姆·纳恩成功连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 1984 Washington gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1984. Incumbent Republican John Spellman ran for re-election to a second term and was defeated by Democrat Booth Gardner despite Republican President Ronald Reagan carrying the state by 13 points in the concurrent presidential election. As of 2026, this is the last time that the Washington governor's office changed partisan control or that an incumbent governor of Washington was defeated.

zh.s: 1984年华盛顿州州长选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任州长约翰·斯佩尔曼竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党人布思·加德纳，尽管共和党籍总统罗纳德·里根在同期总统选举中以13个百分点的优势赢得该州。截至2026年，这是华盛顿州州长职位最近一次易手，也是该州现任州长最近一次败选。

en.s: The 1984 Connecticut State Senate elections took place as a part of the biennial 1984 United States elections. All 36 seats were up for re-election. Senators serve two year terms and are up for re-election every election cycle. Mainly with the help of Reagan's coattails, as he had won Connecticut by twenty-one points on the same ballot, the Republicans took control of the Senate, managing to secure a two-thirds supermajority over the Democrats, although failing to secure a supermajority in the state house.

zh.s: 1984年康涅狄格州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。州参议院36个席位全部改选。州参议员任期两年，每轮选举都要竞选连任。罗纳德·里根在同一张选票的总统选举中以21个百分点优势赢得康涅狄格州，共和党因此控制州参议院，并取得超过三分之二的绝对多数；但未能在州众议院取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 1984 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1984 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 even-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1984 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held on November 6. In the open race, Democratic lieutenant governor John Kerry defeated Republican businessman Ray Shamie. Primary elections were held on September 16. Kerry defeated U.S. representative James Shannon, David M. Bartley, and Michael J.

en.s: The 1984 United States Senate elections were held on November 6, with the 33 seats of Class 2 contested in regular elections. They coincided with the landslide re-election of President Ronald Reagan in the presidential election. In spite of the lopsided presidential race, Reagan's Republican Party suffered a net loss of two Senate seats to the Democrats, although it retained control of the Senate with a reduced 53–47 majority.

en.s: The 1984 United States Senate election in Idaho was held on November 6. Incumbent Senator Jim McClure was re-elected to a third term in office.

en.t: 1984 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 1984 United States presidential straw poll in Guam was held on November 6, 1984, Guam is a territory and not a state. Thus, it is ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College, instead, the territory conducts a non-binding presidential straw poll during the general election. It does not cast direct electoral votes for president and for vice president.

zh.s: 1984年美国总统选举关岛非约束性投票于1984年11月6日举行。关岛是属地而非州，因此不能选举选举人团成员。该领地会在大选期间举行无约束力的总统民意投票，但不会直接投票选举总统和副总统。

en.s: The Palace of Justice siege was an attack carried out in Bogotá, Colombia, on November 6–7, 1985, in which a guerrilla commando of the 19th of April Movement (M-19) took over the Palace of Justice, housing the Supreme Court and the Council of State. The guerrillas held roughly 350 people hostage, among them Supreme Court justices, councilors of state, judicial staff, employees, and visitors.

zh.s: 1985年11月6日至7日，游击队在哥伦比亚波哥大袭击并占领司法宫。四月十九日运动（M-19）的游击队占据了设有最高法院和国务委员会的司法宫，扣押约350名人质，其中包括最高法院法官、国务委员会成员、司法人员、雇员和访客。

en.s: The 1985 Allentown mayoral election was a municipal election to determine the mayor of Allentown, the third largest city in Pennsylvania. Incumbent Democratic mayor Joseph S. Daddona sought re-election to a second consecutive and third overall term and saw a challenge from Republican salesman and activist Charles J. “Chuck” Theisen.

zh.s: 1985年阿伦敦市长选举旨在选出宾夕法尼亚州第三大城市阿伦敦的市长。民主党籍时任市长约瑟夫·S·达多纳竞选连续第二个、总计第三个任期，并受到共和党销售员兼活动人士查尔斯·J·“查克”·泰森挑战。

en.s: On November 6, 1986, Washington, D.C., held an election for its mayor, with Democratic candidate and incumbent mayor Marion Barry defeating Republican candidate Carol Schwartz. Incumbent Marion Barry sought a third term as mayor in 1986. By this time, his dominance of city politics was so absolute that he faced only token opposition in the Democratic primary in the form of former school board member Mattie Taylor, whom Barry dispatched rather easily.

zh.s: 1986年11月6日，华盛顿特区举行市长选举。民主党候选人、时任市长马里恩·巴里击败共和党候选人卡罗尔·施瓦茨。巴里竞选第三个市长任期，当时他在市政政治中的主导地位已经十分稳固，在民主党初选中只遇到前教育委员会成员马蒂·泰勒象征性的挑战，并轻松胜出。

en.s: On 6 November 1986, a Boeing-Vertol Model 234LR Chinook helicopter returning workers from the Brent oilfield crashed on approach to land at Sumburgh Airport in the Shetland Islands. At 2.5 mi (4.0 km) from the runway the helicopter had a catastrophic forward transmission failure which caused the tandem rotor blades to collide. The helicopter crashed into the sea and sank.

zh.t: 1986年英国国际直升机公司支奴干直升机坠毁事故
zh.s: 1986年11月6日，一架波音-韦托尔234LR型支奴干直升机从布伦特油田接载工人返回，在设得兰群岛桑伯勒机场进近着陆时坠毁。距跑道2.5英里（4.0公里）处，直升机的前传动装置发生灾难性故障，导致前后排列的旋翼相撞。直升机坠入海中并沉没。

en.s: The 1988 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1988. Incumbent Governor John Sununu did not run for re-election, and was succeeded by U.S. Representative Judd Gregg. As of 2020, this marks the most recent time that Republicans won the races for Governor and for President concurrently.

zh.s: 1988年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。时任州长约翰·苏努努没有竞选连任，由联邦众议员贾德·格雷格接任。截至2020年，这是共和党最近一次同时赢得新罕布什尔州州长和总统选举。

en.s: On 6 November 1988, two earthquakes struck Lancang and Gengma counties, Yunnan, near the China–Myanmar border. The first earthquake measured moment magnitude (Mw) 7.0, occurring at 21:03 CST. Twelve minutes later, a Mw 6.9 earthquake occurred about 60 km (37 mi) to north–northwest. They were caused by movement along the Lancang–Gengma Fault Zone, a 210 km (130 mi) long right-lateral strike-slip fault.

zh.s: 1988年11月6日，中国云南澜沧县和耿马县、靠近中缅边境的地区发生两次地震。第一场地震发生于中国标准时间21时03分，矩震级为7.0。12分钟后，约在其北偏西北60公里（37英里）处发生第二场地震，矩震级为6.9。地震由长210公里（130英里）的澜沧—耿马断裂带发生右旋走滑运动引发。

en.s: The 1990 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democratic Governor of Ohio Dick Celeste was unable to run for a third term due to term limits, thus creating an open seat. Former Mayor of Cleveland George Voinovich, who also ran for the United States Senate in 1988, was uncontested for the Republican nomination, while Ohio Attorney General Anthony J. Celebrezze Jr. emerged from the Democratic primary. In the end, Voinovich was able to defeat Celebrezze by a fairly wide margin, enabling him to win what would be the first of two terms as governor.

zh.s: 1990年俄亥俄州州长选举于11月6日举行。民主党籍现任州长迪克·塞莱斯特因任期限制无法竞选第三个任期，州长职位因此空缺。克利夫兰前市长乔治·沃伊诺维奇没有对手，直接获得共和党提名；俄亥俄州检察长安东尼·J·塞莱布雷兹二世则赢得民主党初选。最终，沃伊诺维奇以较大优势击败塞莱布雷兹，当选州长，并开始两个州长任期中的第一个。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Carolina, 1990
en.s: The North Carolina United States Senate election of 1990 was held on 6 November 1990 as part of the nationwide elections to the Senate. The general election was fought between the Republican incumbent Jesse Helms and the Democratic nominee Mayor of Charlotte Harvey Gantt. Helms won re-election to a fourth term by a slightly wider margin than the close election in 1984. Helms drew controversy for airing what became known as the "Hands" ad produced by Alex Castellanos. It showed a pair of white hands with the voiceover saying You wanted this job, but because of a law they had to give it to a minority.

zh.t: 1990年美国北卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年美国北卡罗来纳州参议院选举于11月6日举行，是全国参议院选举的一部分。大选由共和党籍现任参议员杰西·赫尔姆斯对阵民主党候选人、夏洛特市长哈维·甘特。赫尔姆斯成功连任，开始第四个任期，领先优势略高于竞争激烈的1984年选举。赫尔姆斯投放的一则广告引发争议，后来被称为“手部广告”，由亚历克斯·卡斯特利亚诺斯制作。广告展示一双白人手，并配有旁白：“你想要这份工作，但因为一项法律，他们不得不把它给少数族裔。”

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in Iowa
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Iowa was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Tom Harkin sought re-election to a second term in office. Harkin was opposed by Republican U.S. Congressman Tom Tauke, from Iowa's 2nd congressional district, and both Harkin and Tauke won their primaries uncontested. Though Harkin performed slightly worse than he had six years earlier, he was successful in his re-election bid and defeated Tauke.

en.t: United States Senate election in Minnesota, 1990
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Minnesota was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Rudy Boschwitz was defeated by Democratic challenger Paul Wellstone in a tight race. Wellstone gained national attention after his upset victory. Widely considered an underdog and outspent by a 7-to-1 margin, he was the only candidate to defeat an incumbent senator in the 1990 election cycle.

zh.t: 美国明尼苏达州参议院选举，1990
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行明尼苏达州参议院选举。共和党籍现任参议员鲁迪·博施维茨在竞争激烈的选举中败给民主党挑战者保罗·韦尔斯通。韦尔斯通因意外胜选而受到全国关注。他普遍被视为弱势候选人，筹款额也只有对手的七分之一，却是1990年整个选举周期中唯一击败现任参议员的候选人。

en.s: The 1990 Alaska gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1990 for the open seat of Governor of Alaska. In 1989, incumbent Governor Steve Cowper, a Democrat, had announced that he would not seek re-election for a second term. In a rare third-party win in American politics, former Republican Governor Walter Hickel, running on the ticket of the Alaskan Independence Party, defeated Democratic candidate Tony Knowles and Republican candidate Arliss Sturgulewski.

zh.t: 美国阿拉斯加州州长选举，1990
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行阿拉斯加州州长选举，竞逐空缺的州长职位。民主党籍现任州长史蒂夫·考珀于1989年宣布不竞选第二个任期。在美国政治中罕见的第三党获胜中，前共和党州长沃尔特·希克尔代表阿拉斯加独立党参选，击败民主党候选人托尼·诺尔斯和共和党候选人阿利斯·斯特古列夫斯基。

en.s: The 1992 United States Senate election in Colorado took place on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Republican senator William L. Armstrong did not seek re-election to another term. Republican nominee Hank Brown won the open seat, defeating Democratic nominee Josie Heath.

zh.t: 1990年科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 科罗拉多州联邦参议员选举于1990年11月6日举行。时任共和党参议员威廉·L·阿姆斯特朗没有寻求连任。共和党提名人汉克·布朗赢得空缺席位，击败民主党提名人乔西·希思。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1990–91 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1990, for the post of Governor of Arizona. Incumbent Democratic Governor Rose Mofford declined to run for a full term. Republican Fife Symington defeated the Democratic nominee and Mayor of Phoenix Terry Goddard. Because no candidate received a majority of votes, a runoff election was held later on February 26, 1991, which Symington also won.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行亚利桑那州州长选举。时任民主党州长罗斯·莫福德没有竞选完整任期。共和党人菲夫·西明顿击败民主党候选人、菲尼克斯市长特里·戈达德。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，1991年2月26日举行了第二轮选举，西明顿再次获胜。

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in Oklahoma
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Oklahoma was held November 6, 1990 to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Oklahoma as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state elections. The primaries were held August 28.

zh.t: 1990年俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行俄克拉何马州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员。同日，其他州也举行了联邦参议院选举，并举行联邦众议院选举和各州选举。党内初选于8月28日举行。

en.s: The 1990 Maryland comptroller election was held on November 6, 1990, in order to elect the comptroller of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent comptroller Louis L. Goldstein defeated Republican nominee Larry Mark Epstein.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行马里兰州审计长选举。民主党候选人、时任审计长路易斯·L·戈德斯坦击败共和党候选人拉里·马克·爱泼斯坦。

en.t: 1990 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 6, 1990, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Democratic nominee Charles Moreland won the election by a large margin against his opponents.

zh.t: 1990年哥伦比亚特区美国影子联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日，哥伦比亚特区举行美国联邦众议院选举，选出一名影子众议员。与没有投票权的特区代表不同，影子众议员只获特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或取得国会议席。民主党候选人查尔斯·莫兰以较大优势击败对手。

en.t: 1990 United States House of Representatives elections in Montana
en.s: The 1990 United States House of Representatives elections in Montana were held on November 6, 1990 to elect the two U.S. representatives to represent the state of Montana in the 102nd Congress. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the U.S. Senate, and various other state and local elections.

zh.t: 1990年蒙大拿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行蒙大拿州联邦众议院选举，选出两名代表该州进入第102届国会的联邦众议员。选举与联邦众议院、参议院的其他选举，以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 1990 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1990, in order to elect the Secretary of State of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent Secretary of State Joan Growe defeated Independent-Republican nominee David Jennings and Grassroots nominee Candice E. Sjostrom.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。民主党—农工党候选人、时任州务卿琼·格罗击败独立共和党候选人大卫·詹宁斯和草根党候选人坎迪斯·E·约斯特伦。

en.s: The 1990 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990. Democratic nominee Bruce Sundlun defeated incumbent Republican Edward D. DiPrete in a landslide. Sundlun won 74.15% of the vote to DiPrete’s 25.85%. Sundlun carried every single county and municipality by double digits. To date, this is the last time that an incumbent governor of Rhode Island lost re-election.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行罗得岛州州长选举。民主党候选人布鲁斯·桑德伦以压倒性优势击败共和党籍时任州长爱德华·D·迪普雷特，得票率分别为74.15%和25.85%。桑德伦在每个县和市镇都以两位数差距获胜。截至目前，这是罗得岛州时任州长最后一次竞选连任失败。

en.s: The 1990 Michigan Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democrat Frank J. Kelley defeated Republican nominee Clifford W. Taylor with 63.73% of the vote.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行密歇根州总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长弗兰克·J·凯利以63.73%的得票率击败共和党候选人克利福德·W·泰勒。

en.s: The 1990 Orange County, Florida Chairman election took place on November 6, 1990, to elect the Chairman of Orange County, Florida. The 1990 election was the first election for the position after voters approved the Orange County Charter in 1986 and amended it in 1988 to establish a county-wide executive position. County Commissioner Linda Chapin won the Democratic nomination unopposed and faced Republican State Representative Tom Drage in the general election.

zh.t: 1990年佛罗里达州奥兰治县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行佛罗里达州奥兰治县行政长官选举。1986年选民通过《奥兰治县宪章》，并于1988年修订宪章，设立全县范围的行政职位；这是该职位设立后的首次选举。县委员琳达·查平在无人竞争的情况下获得民主党提名，并在大选中面对共和党州众议员汤姆·德拉奇。

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Wyoming was held November 6, 1990. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Alan K. Simpson was elected to a third term in office.

zh.t: 1990年怀俄明州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行怀俄明州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员艾伦·K·辛普森当选第三个任期。

en.s: The 1990 California Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1990. Republican nominee Dan Lungren narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Arlo Smith with 46.77% of the vote.

zh.t: 1990年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州总检察长选举。共和党候选人丹·伦格伦以微弱优势击败民主党候选人阿洛·史密斯，获得46.77%的选票。

en.s: The 1990 Kansas gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Republican Governor Mike Hayden lost re-election to Democratic nominee Joan Finney. The State Treasurer at the time, Finney was elected governor over Hayden in 1990, giving Hayden the distinction of being the first incumbent governor of any state to lose to a woman.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行堪萨斯州州长选举。共和党籍时任州长迈克·海登竞选连任失败，败给民主党候选人琼·芬尼。当时担任州财政部长的芬尼在1990年击败海登当选州长，使海登成为美国首位败给女性候选人的时任州长。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 1990 took place on November 6, 1990. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, and Prince George's County elected county executives.

zh.t: 1990年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行马里兰州县行政长官选举。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县和乔治王子县选出县行政长官。

en.s: The 1990 California State Controller election was held on November 6, 1990, to elect the state controller of California. Primary elections took place on June 5, 1990. The incumbent Democrat Gray Davis, defeated the Republican nominee, Matt Fong.

zh.t: 1990年加利福尼亚州州审计长选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州审计长选举，党内初选于1990年6月5日举行。民主党籍时任州审计长格雷·戴维斯击败共和党候选人方克明。

en.s: The 1990 California Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1990, to elect the Secretary of State of California. Primary elections were held on June 5, 1990. Incumbent Democratic Secretary March Fong Eu was re-elected to her fifth term in office.

zh.t: 1990年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州州务卿选举，党内初选于1990年6月5日举行。民主党籍时任州务卿梅·方欧连任第五个任期。

en.s: The 1990 Arizona House of Representatives elections were held on November 6, 1990. Voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve a two-year term. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including Governor, U.S. House, and State Senate. Primary elections were held on September 11, 1990. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 34 seats over the Democrats' 26 seats.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行亚利桑那州众议院选举。选民从多席位选区选出全部60名州众议员，任期两年。选举与州长、联邦众议院和州参议院等职位选举同时举行。党内初选于1990年9月11日举行。选举前，共和党以34席对民主党的26席占多数。

en.t: 1990 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia
en.s: The 1990 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia were held on November 6, 1990 to determine who will represent the state of West Virginia in the United States House of Representatives. West Virginia has three seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. Representatives are elected for two-year terms.

zh.t: 1990年西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。西弗吉尼亚州有3个众议院席位，按1980年美国人口普查结果分配。联邦众议员任期为两年。

en.s: The 1990 Arkansas gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democratic governor Bill Clinton won re-election in a two-way race against Democrat turned Republican Sheffield Nelson with 57.5% of the vote. This was Clinton's fourth consecutive, and fifth overall, term as Governor of Arkansas, as well as his final term (he was elected to the presidency in 1992). Nelson had defeated Representative Tommy F.

zh.s: 1990年阿肯色州州长选举于11月6日举行。民主党籍时任州长比尔·克林顿在两人竞选中以57.5%的得票率成功连任，击败由民主党转投共和党的谢菲尔德·纳尔逊。这是克林顿连续第四次、总计第五次担任阿肯色州州长，也是他的最后一个州长任期；他于1992年当选美国总统。纳尔逊此前击败联邦众议员汤米·F·罗宾逊，获得共和党提名。

en.t: 1990 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 1990 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 6, 1990, to elect two shadow members to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The members were only recognized by the District of Columbia and not officially sworn or seated by the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1990年哥伦比亚特区美国影子参议员选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日，哥伦比亚特区举行选举，选出两名代表特区的美国影子参议员。他们只获哥伦比亚特区承认，没有在美国参议院正式宣誓就职或取得席位。

en.s: The 1990 Illinois gubernatorial election occurred on November 6, 1990 to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of Illinois. Republican Jim Edgar, the Illinois Secretary of State, narrowly defeated Democrat Neil Hartigan, the Illinois Attorney General, by about 80,000 votes out of the over 3.2 million cast. The incumbent Republican governor, Jim Thompson, chose not to seek a fifth term, making this the first open-seat gubernatorial election in Illinois since 1952.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州州长和副州长选举。共和党人、伊利诺伊州州务卿吉姆·埃德加以约8万票的优势险胜民主党人、州总检察长尼尔·哈蒂根；两人合计获得超过320万张选票。共和党籍时任州长吉姆·汤普森没有竞选第五个任期，这是自1952年以来伊利诺伊州首次出现州长职位无时任州长寻求连任的选举。

en.t: 1990 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 1990 congressional elections in Tennessee was held on November 6, 1990, to determine who will represent the state of Tennessee in the United States House of Representatives. Following the 1990 elections, no seats changed hands, leaving the Tennessee delegation at a 6-3 Democratic majority.

zh.t: 1990年田纳西州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行田纳西州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。选举后，没有席位易手，田纳西州代表团仍由民主党以6席对3席占多数。

en.t: 1990 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1990 United States House of Representatives elections was an election for the United States House of Representatives on November 6, 1990, to elect members to serve in the 102nd United States Congress. They occurred in the middle of President George H. W. Bush's term. As in most midterm elections, the president's Republican Party lost seats to the Democratic Party, slightly increasing the Democratic majority in the chamber.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行美国联邦众议院选举，选出第102届国会的议员。选举发生在乔治·H·W·布什总统任期中段。与多数中期选举一样，总统所属的共和党失去席位，民主党在众议院的多数优势略有增加。

en.s: The 1990 Colorado gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democrat Roy Romer defeated Republican nominee John Andrews with 61.89% of the vote.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行科罗拉多州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长罗伊·罗默以61.89%的得票率击败共和党候选人约翰·安德鲁斯。

en.t: 1990 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: General elections were held in the United States Virgin Islands on 6 November 1990, to elect a new governor and lieutenant governor, 15 members of the Legislature of the Virgin Islands and the Delegate to United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日，美属维尔京群岛举行大选，选出新任州长和副州长、15名维尔京群岛立法机构成员，以及一名联邦众议院代表。

en.s: The 1990 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1990, in order to elect the State Auditor of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee Mark Dayton defeated Independent Republican nominee Bob Heinrich. As of 2025 this is the most recent election of which a male was elected State Auditor.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行明尼苏达州审计长选举。民主党—农工党候选人马克·戴顿击败独立共和党候选人鲍勃·海因里希。截至2025年，这是最近一次由男性当选州审计长的选举。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on Tuesday, November 6, 1990. The primary elections were held on March 20, 1990. All statewide offices saw their incumbents forgo seeking reelection. However, no statewide office saw a change in party composition, with Republicans retaining the governorship and lieutenant governorship in their joint election, as well as the office of Secretary of State, and Democrats retaining the offices of Attorney General, Comptroller, and Treasurer.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日，星期二，伊利诺伊州举行选举。党内初选于1990年3月20日举行。所有州级职位的时任官员都没有寻求连任，但各职位的政党归属均未改变：共和党保住州长和副州长职位（两职联合选举）及州务卿职位，民主党保住总检察长、审计长和财政部长职位。

en.s: The 1990 Connecticut gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1990, to elect the governor of Connecticut. It was a three-way race for a seat left open when Governor William A. O'Neill declined to run for re-election. A Connecticut Party nominee Lowell Weicker narrowly won the election, becoming the first candidate who was not a member of one of the two major parties to win a gubernatorial election since the 1974 election in Maine.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州长选举，竞选时任州长威廉·A·奥尼尔不再寻求连任后留下的空缺职位。这是一场三方竞选，康涅狄格党候选人洛厄尔·魏克尔以微弱优势胜出。他成为自1974年缅因州选举以来，首位赢得州长选举的两大党之外候选人。

en.s: On November 6, 1990, Washington, D.C., held an election for its mayor, with Democratic candidate Sharon Pratt Dixon defeating Republican Maurice Turner. Sharon Pratt Dixon announced at the 1988 Democratic National Convention that she would challenge incumbent mayor Marion Barry in the 1990 election. Pratt was the only candidate to have officially announced her plans to run for mayor when Barry was arrested on drug charges and dropped out of the race in early 1990.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日，华盛顿特区举行市长选举。民主党候选人莎朗·普拉特·迪克森击败共和党人莫里斯·特纳。迪克森在1988年民主党全国代表大会上宣布将于1990年挑战时任市长马里恩·巴里。1990年初巴里因毒品指控被捕并退出竞选时，迪克森是唯一正式宣布参选市长的候选人。

en.s: The 1990 Tennessee gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1990, to elect the governor of Tennessee. Incumbent Democratic governor Ned McWherter was re-elected, defeating his Republican opponent Dwight Henry, a one term member of the Tennessee House of Representatives. McWherter received 60.8% of the vote.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行田纳西州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长内德·麦克沃特连任，击败共和党对手德怀特·亨利。亨利曾在田纳西州众议院任职一届。麦克沃特获得60.8%的选票。

en.s: The 1990 Maryland Senate election were held on November 6, 1990, to elect senators in all 47 districts of the Maryland Senate. Members were elected in single-member constituencies to four-year terms. These elections were held concurrently with various federal and state elections, including for Governor of Maryland.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行马里兰州参议院选举，改选全部47个州参议院选区。议员从单一议员选区选出，任期四年。选举与马里兰州州长等联邦和州职位选举同时举行。

en.s: The 1990 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democrat William Donald Schaefer defeated Republican nominee William S. Shepard handily (59.76% to 40.23%).

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行马里兰州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长威廉·唐纳德·谢弗以59.76%对40.23%的得票率轻松击败共和党候选人威廉·S·谢泼德。

en.s: The 1990 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democratic Governor Mike Sullivan ran for re-election. In the general election, he faced Republican nominee Mary Mead, a businesswoman and the daughter of former U.S. Senator and Governor Clifford Hansen. Owing to Sullivan's personal popularity, he won re-election over Mead in a landslide, marking the fifth straight Democratic victory in Wyoming's gubernatorial races, a streak that has yet to be broken by either party.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行怀俄明州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长迈克·沙利文竞选连任，大选中面对共和党候选人玛丽·米德；她是商人，也是前联邦参议员兼州长克利福德·汉森的女儿。沙利文凭借个人声望以压倒性优势连任。这是民主党连续第五次赢得怀俄明州州长选举，这一连胜纪录至今未被任何政党打破。

en.t: 1990 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 1990 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas occurred on November 6, 1990, to elect the members of the state of Texas's delegation to the United States House of Representatives. Texas had twenty-seven seats in the House, apportioned according to the 1980 United States census. These elections occurred simultaneously with the United States Senate elections of 1990, the United States House elections in other states, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 1990年得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州进入联邦众议院的议员。得克萨斯州有27个众议院席位，按1980年美国人口普查结果分配。选举与1990年美国联邦参议院选举、其他州的联邦众议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Michigan was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Carl Levin won re-election to a third term against future Michigan Attorney General Bill Schuette.

zh.t: 1990年密歇根州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行密歇根州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员卡尔·莱文再次当选，赢得第三个任期；他的对手是未来的密歇根州总检察长比尔·舒埃特。

en.s: The 1990 Texas lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990, to elect the Lieutenant Governor of Texas. Incumbent Comptroller Bob Bullock was elected over Republican Robert Mosbacher Jr. Bullock's term as Comptroller was complicated; despite his public drinking problem and proneness to outbursts, he remained popular because of his record that included large settlements that benefited the state and its citizens.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行得克萨斯州副州长选举。时任州审计长鲍勃·布洛克击败共和党人小罗伯特·莫斯巴赫，当选副州长。布洛克担任州审计长期间情况复杂：尽管他有公开饮酒的问题，也容易发脾气，但因其工作成果仍受欢迎，其中包括为州和居民争取到大笔和解金。

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in West Virginia was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Jay Rockefeller won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1990年西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员杰伊·洛克菲勒连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 1990 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990, to elect the governor of Oklahoma. Democratic businessman David Walters won the election easily despite his lack of political experience. This is most recent gubernatorial election in which Cimarron County has voted Democratic.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行俄克拉何马州州长选举。民主党商人戴维·沃尔特斯轻松胜选，尽管他此前没有从政经验。这是奇马龙县最近一次支持民主党州长候选人。

en.s: Elections were held in Guam on November 6, 1990, to elect several public officials in the federal and territorial government as part of the 1990 United States elections.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日，关岛举行选举，选出联邦和属地政府的多名公职人员，这是1990年美国选举的一部分。

en.s: The 1990 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 1990, in order to elect the attorney general of Minnesota. Democratic–Farmer–Labor nominee and incumbent attorney general Hubert Humphrey III defeated Republican nominee Kevin E. Johnson.

zh.t: 1990年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行明尼苏达州总检察长选举。民主党—农工党候选人、时任总检察长小休伯特·汉弗莱击败共和党候选人凯文·E·约翰逊。

en.s: The 1990 Missouri State Auditor election was held on November 6, 1990, in order to elect the state auditor of Missouri. Republican nominee and incumbent state auditor Margaret B. Kelly defeated Democratic nominee Connie B. Hendren.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行密苏里州审计长选举。共和党候选人、时任州审计长玛格丽特·B·凯利击败民主党候选人康妮·B·亨德伦。

en.s: The 1990 Arizona Senate election was held on November 6, 1990. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. Primary elections were held on September 11, 1990. Prior to the elections, the Republicans held a majority of 17 seats over the Democrats' 13 seats.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行亚利桑那州参议院选举，改选全部30个立法选区的州参议员，任期两年。党内初选于1990年9月11日举行。选举前，共和党以17席对民主党的13席占多数。

en.s: The 1990 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 6, 1990, to elect the Attorney General of Connecticut. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Clarine Nardi Riddle was appointed by Governor William O'Neill to fill the remainder of the term to which Joe Lieberman had been elected in 1986. Lieberman resigned on January 3, 1989, following his election to the U.S. Senate.

zh.t: 1990年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行康涅狄格州总检察长选举。时任民主党总检察长克拉琳·纳迪·里德尔由州长威廉·奥尼尔任命，填补乔·利伯曼的剩余任期。利伯曼于1989年1月3日当选联邦参议员后辞职。

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in Kentucky
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Kentucky was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Mitch McConnell won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 1990年肯塔基州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行肯塔基州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员米奇·麦康奈尔连任第二个任期。

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in Illinois
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Illinois was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Paul Simon sought re-election to a second term in office. Simon was opposed by Republican nominee Lynn Morley Martin, a U.S. Congresswoman from Illinois's 16th congressional district, whom he easily defeated to win a second and final term in the Senate. Martin carried only two counties, Edwards and McHenry.

zh.t: 1990年伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州美国参议院选举。民主党籍时任联邦参议员保罗·西蒙竞选连任第二个任期。他的对手是共和党候选人琳恩·莫利·马丁，后者是伊利诺伊州第16选区的联邦女众议员。西蒙轻松获胜，赢得自己在参议院的第二个、也是最后一个任期。马丁只赢得爱德华兹县和麦克亨利县。

en.s: The 1990 Connecticut State Treasurer election took place on November 6, 1990, to elect the Connecticut State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Francisco L. Borges won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Joan R. Kemler. Kemler, who served as state treasurer for a year after being appointed by Governor William A. O'Neill in February 1986, switched parties from Democrat to Republican to run for state treasurer in 1990.

zh.t: 1990年康涅狄格州财政部长选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行康涅狄格州财政部长选举。民主党籍时任财政部长弗朗西斯科·L·博尔赫斯连任第二个任期，击败共和党候选人琼·R·凯姆勒。凯姆勒于1986年2月由州长威廉·A·奥尼尔任命，曾担任一年州财政部长；她后来从民主党转为共和党，参加1990年财政部长选举。

en.t: 1990 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The Wyoming United States House election for 1990 was held on November 6, 1990. The incumbent Representative Craig L. Thomas won his first regular election after winning the special election to fill the empty seat of Dick Cheney. Thomas defeated Pete Maxfield with 55.09% of the vote.

zh.t: 1990年怀俄明州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行怀俄明州联邦众议院选举。时任众议员克雷格·L·托马斯此前在特别选举中接替迪克·切尼，这次首次通过常规选举当选。他以55.09%的得票率击败皮特·马克斯菲尔德。

en.s: The 1990 California Insurance Commissioner election occurred on November 6, 1990, with the primary elections taking place on June 5, 1990. The Democratic nominee, John Garamendi, defeated the Republican nominee, Huntington Beach mayor Wes Bannister. Garamendi was the first person elected to the position of Insurance Commissioner due to the passage of Proposition 103 in 1988. Proposition 103 changed the Insurance Commissioner position from a governor-appointed position to an elected position.

zh.t: 1990年加利福尼亚州保险专员选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州保险专员选举，党内初选于1990年6月5日举行。民主党候选人约翰·加拉门迪击败共和党候选人、亨廷顿海滩市长韦斯·班尼斯特。1988年《103号提案》通过后，保险专员由州长任命改为选举产生；加拉门迪是首位通过选举当选该职位的人。

en.t: 1990 Connecticut Secretary of the State election
en.s: The 1990 Connecticut Secretary of the State election took place on November 6, 1990, to elect the Secretary of the State of Connecticut. Republican nominee Pauline R. Kezer defeated two-term incumbent Democrat Julia H. Tashjian. As of 2026, this was the last time a Republican was elected Secretary of the State of Connecticut.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州务卿选举。共和党候选人波琳·R·凯泽击败已任职两届的民主党籍时任州务卿朱莉娅·H·塔什坚。截至2026年，这是共和党人最后一次当选康涅狄格州州务卿。

en.s: The 1990 Maryland attorney general election was held on November 6, 1990, in order to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Democratic nominee and incumbent attorney general J. Joseph Curran Jr. defeated Republican nominee Edward L. Blanton Jr.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行马里兰州总检察长选举。民主党候选人、时任总检察长小J·约瑟夫·柯伦击败共和党候选人小爱德华·L·布兰顿。

en.t: 1990 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election
en.s: The 1990 Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries election was held on November 6, 1990 to elect the Alabama Commissioner of Agriculture and Industries. Albert McDonald was term-limited and ineligible to run for a third term.

zh.t: 1990年阿拉巴马州农业与工业专员选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行阿拉巴马州农业与工业专员选举。阿尔伯特·麦克唐纳受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。

en.s: A Massachusetts general election was held on November 6, 1990 in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. The election included: statewide elections for United States Senator, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of the Commonwealth, Treasurer, and Auditor; district elections for U.S. Representatives, State Representatives, State Senators, and Governor's Councillors; and ballot questions at the state and local levels. Democratic and Republican candidates were selected in party primaries held September 19, 1990.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日，马萨诸塞州举行大选。选举包括联邦参议员、州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、财政部长和审计长等全州职位，以及联邦众议员、州众议员、州参议员和州长委员会成员等地区职位，还有州和地方层面的公投问题。民主党和共和党候选人于1990年9月19日举行的党内初选中产生。

en.s: The 1990 Michigan Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democrat Richard H. Austin defeated Republican nominee Judy Miller with 60.63% of the vote. As of 2026, this was the last time a man was elected Secretary of State in Michigan. After 1990, Democrats would not win another Michigan Secretary of State election again until 2018.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行密歇根州州务卿选举。民主党籍时任州务卿理查德·H·奥斯汀以60.63%的得票率击败共和党候选人朱迪·米勒。截至2026年，这是最后一次由男性当选密歇根州州务卿。1990年之后，民主党直到2018年才再次赢得密歇根州州务卿选举。

en.t: 1990 West Virginia Attorney General special election
en.s: The 1990 West Virginia Attorney General special election took place on November 6, 1990, to elect the Attorney General of West Virginia. The election was held to complete the unexpired term of Charlie Brown, who resigned in August 1989 to end a grand jury investigation against him. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Roger W. Tompkins, who was appointed by governor Gaston Caperton, chose not to seek election to a full term.

zh.t: 1990年西弗吉尼亚州总检察长特别选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州总检察长特别选举，以选出总检察长。此前，查理·布朗于1989年8月辞职，结束对他的陪审团调查，因此需要举行选举完成他的剩余任期。民主党籍时任总检察长罗杰·W·汤普金斯由州长加斯顿·卡珀顿任命，但他决定不竞选完整任期。

en.s: The 1990 Maryland House of Delegates elections were held on November 6, 1990, as part of the 1990 United States elections, including the 1990 Maryland gubernatorial election. All 141 of Maryland's state delegates were up for reelection.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行马里兰州众议院选举，这是1990年美国选举的一部分，也包括马里兰州州长选举。马里兰州众议院全部141个席位都进行改选。

en.s: The 1990 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democrat Leo T. McCarthy defeated Republican nominee Marian Bergeson with 51.29% of the vote.

zh.t: 1990年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州副州长选举。民主党籍时任副州长利奥·T·麦卡锡以51.29%的得票率击败共和党候选人玛丽安·伯格森。

en.s: The 1990 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 6, 1990, to elect 15 members of the Wyoming Senate. This was the last election held before Gorin v. Karpan struck down Wyoming's county-based legislative apportionment plan in favor of single-member districts in 1992.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行怀俄明州参议院选举，改选15名州参议员。这是1992年戈林诉卡潘案推翻按县划分议席的立法选区方案、改为单席选区前最后一次选举。

en.s: The 1990 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1990, in order to elect the Governor of New Mexico. Due to term limits, incumbent Republican Garrey Carruthers was ineligible to seek a second term as governor. Democrat Bruce King won his third and final term overall as governor, defeating Republican Frank Bond. King won the largest share of the vote out of his four gubernatorial campaigns.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行新墨西哥州州长选举。共和党籍时任州长加里·卡拉瑟斯受任期限制，不能竞选第二个任期。民主党人布鲁斯·金当选第三个、也是最后一个州长任期；这是他四次州长竞选中得票率最高的一次。

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in South Dakota
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in South Dakota was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Larry Pressler ran for re-election to a third term, beating Democratic nominee Theodore 'Ted' Muenster by 19,000 votes. This was the last time until 2014 that a Republican would be elected to South Dakota's Class 2 Senate seat.

zh.t: 1990年南达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行南达科他州美国参议院选举。共和党籍时任联邦参议员拉里·普雷斯勒竞选第三个任期，以1.9万票击败民主党候选人西奥多·“特德”·明斯特。这是共和党人直到2014年才再次当选南达科他州第二类参议院席位。

en.s: The 1990 Florida gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Republican Governor Bob Martinez ran for a second term in office, but was defeated by Democratic challenger Lawton Chiles, a former U.S. senator. Martinez, who was just the second member of his party elected Governor of Florida after Reconstruction, was deeply unpopular.

zh.s: 1990年11月6日举行佛罗里达州州长选举。共和党籍时任州长鲍勃·马丁内斯竞选第二个任期，但败给民主党挑战者、前联邦参议员劳顿·奇利斯。马丁内斯是重建时期结束后第二位当选佛罗里达州州长的共和党人，但他非常不受欢迎。

en.s: The 1990 New York State Attorney General election took place on November 6, 1990, to elect a candidate to the position of Attorney General. Democratic nominee and incumbent Attorney General Robert Abrams defeated Republican nominee Bernard C. Smith, resulting in the re-election of Abrams to the position of Attorney General.

zh.s: 1990年纽约州总检察长选举于11月6日举行，选出州总检察长。民主党提名人、现任总检察长罗伯特·艾布拉姆斯击败共和党提名人伯纳德·C·史密斯，成功连任。

en.s: The 1990 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990, to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia, concurrently with the 1990 gubernatorial election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Georgia is one of 21 states that elects its lieutenant governor separately from its governor.

zh.s: 1990年佐治亚州副州长选举于11月6日举行，并与州长、美国参议院、美国众议院以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。佐治亚州是21个单独选举副州长、而不与州长搭档共同参选的州之一。

en.s: The 1990 United States Senate elections were held on November 6, 1990, with the 33 seats of Class 2 contested in regular elections. Special elections were also held to fill vacancies. The Democratic Party increased its majority with a net gain of one seat from the Republican Party. The election cycle took place in the middle of President George H. W.

zh.s: 1990年美国联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行，常规选举改选第二类的33个席位，另有特别选举填补空缺。民主党净增1席，扩大了多数席位。选举周期处于乔治·H·W·布什总统任期中期；与多数中期选举一样，未执政的政党在国会取得席位。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 6, 1990, in 36 states and two territories. Most elected in these elections would serve for a 4-year term, while those in New Hampshire, Rhode Island, and Vermont would serve for a 2-year term. The elections coincided with the mid-term elections for the United States Senate and the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 美国36个州和两个属地于1990年11月6日举行州长选举。多数当选者任期4年，新罕布什尔州、罗得岛州和佛蒙特州的当选者任期2年。选举与美国参议院和众议院中期选举同时举行。

en.s: The 1990 New York State Comptroller election took place on November 6, 1990. Republican nominee and incumbent Comptroller Edward Regan narrowly defeated Democratic nominee Carol Bellamy, winning a fourth term in office. He staved off attacks from Carol Bellamy that he was an "ineffective watchdog", though such hefty competition made this his closest race in 12 years.

zh.s: 1990年纽约州审计长选举于11月6日举行。共和党提名人、现任审计长爱德华·里根以微弱优势击败民主党提名人卡罗尔·贝拉米，赢得第四个任期。里根顶住了贝拉米称他是“失职的监督者”的批评，但竞争激烈，使这场选举成为他12年来最接近的一次。

en.s: The 1990 New York gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990, to elect the governor and Lieutenant Governor of New York. Democratic governor Mario Cuomo won a third term in office, making him the first Democrat elected to three terms as Governor of New York since Herbert H. Lehman. Though the Republican Party and Conservative Party had run the same candidate through fusion voting since 1974, the parties diverged in 1990.

zh.s: 1990年纽约州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长和副州长。民主党州长马里奥·科莫赢得第三个任期，成为继赫伯特·H·雷曼之后，首位通过选举连任三届的民主党州长。自1974年以来，共和党和保守党一直通过融合投票共同提名同一名候选人，但两党在1990年分开提名。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 6, 1990. Primaries were held March 20, 1990. Elections were held for the offices of Assessor, Clerk, Sheriff, State's Attorney, Cook County Superintendent of Education Service Region, Treasurer, President of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 17 seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, both seats of the Cook County Board of Appeals, 3 seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县于1990年11月6日举行普选。初选于1990年3月20日举行。选举职位包括评估员、书记官、警长、州检察官、库克县教育服务区主管、财政部长、库克县委员委员会主席、委员会全部17个席位、库克县上诉委员会两个席位、水资源回收区委员会3个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官职位。

en.s: The 1990 Georgia gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 1990. Lieutenant Governor Zell Miller ran for governor after incumbent Joe Frank Harris was term-limited, defeating Andrew Young, Roy Barnes, and Lester Maddox for the Democratic nomination, and defeated Johnny Isakson, a member of the Georgia House of Representatives.

zh.s: 1990年佐治亚州州长选举于11月6日举行。副州长泽尔·米勒在现任州长乔·弗兰克·哈里斯达到任期限制后竞选州长。他赢得民主党提名，击败安德鲁·扬、罗伊·巴恩斯和莱斯特·马多克斯；随后又击败佐治亚州众议员约翰尼·艾萨克森。

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in Georgia
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Georgia was held on November 6, 1990. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Sam Nunn won re-election to a fourth term uncontested. This is the last time a Democrat was re-elected to the Senate from the state until 2022. This was also the last United States Senate election in Georgia where a candidate ran unopposed.

zh.t: 1990年佐治亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年佐治亚州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任参议员萨姆·纳恩在无人挑战的情况下连任第四个任期。这是民主党人直到2022年才再次从佐治亚州连任美国参议员，也是该州最后一次出现只有一名候选人参选的美国参议院选举。

en.t: 1990 United States Senate election in Alabama
en.s: The 1990 United States Senate election in Alabama was held on Tuesday November 6, Democratic candidate Incumbent United States Senator Howell Heflin won re-election to a third term. As of 2026, it is the last time a Democrat was elected to the Class 2 Senate seat in Alabama until 2017, and the last time overall in which a Democrat was elected to and served a full term as a Democrat in the United States Senate from Alabama.

zh.t: 1990年阿拉巴马州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 1990年阿拉巴马州美国参议院选举于11月6日星期二举行。民主党候选人、现任美国参议员豪厄尔·赫夫林成功连任第三个任期。截至2026年，这是民主党人在阿拉巴马州第二类参议院席位上于2017年前最后一次当选，也是民主党人在该州最后一次当选并以民主党人身份完成完整任期的参议员选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: In the 1990 Nebraska gubernatorial election, Democratic challenger Ben Nelson narrowly defeated first-term Republican incumbent Kay Orr for the governorship of the state of Nebraska. Orr's popularity had suffered due to changes in the state's income-tax structure enacted in 1987, which were seen as a violation of her pledge not to increase taxes. The impending construction of a low-level radioactive-waste repository in north central Nebraska also occasioned discontent with her administration.

zh.s: 在1990年内布拉斯加州州长选举中，民主党挑战者本·尼尔森以微弱优势击败共和党籍首任州长凯·奥尔，当选州长。奥尔因1987年调整州所得税结构而失去支持；选民认为这一做法违背了她不加税的承诺。在内布拉斯加州中北部建设低放射性废物储存库的计划，也引发了民众对其政府的不满。

en.s: The 1990 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 1990 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in half of the state senate's districts—the 25 odd-numbered state senate districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle. A statewide map of the 50 state Senate districts in the year 1990 is provided by the Iowa General Assembly here.

zh.s: 1990年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民选出州参议院一半选区的议员，即25个奇数编号选区。州参议员任期四年，每轮选举改选一半席位。艾奥瓦州议会提供了1990年50个州参议院选区的全州地图。

en.t: Mayoral elections in Chula Vista, California
en.s: Elections are currently held every four years to elect the mayor of Chula Vista, California.

zh.t: 加利福尼亚州丘拉维斯塔市长选举
zh.s: 丘拉维斯塔目前每四年举行一次市长选举。

en.s: The 1990 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in 16 of the 31 State Senate. The winners of this election served in the 72rd Texas Legislature.

zh.s: 1990年得克萨斯州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。得克萨斯州选民在该州31个参议院选区中的16个选区选出州参议员。当选议员将在第72届得克萨斯州议会任职。

en.s: The 1990 Connecticut State Senate elections took place as a part of the biennial 1990 United States elections. All 36 seats were up for re-election. Senators serve two year terms and are up for re-election every election cycle. The Democrats lost 3 seats, while the Republicans gained 4 seats, with the Democrats ultimately maintaining their majority in the Senate.

zh.s: 1990年康涅狄格州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。州参议院36个席位全部改选。州参议员任期两年，每轮选举都要竞选连任。民主党失去3席，共和党增加4席，但民主党最终仍保住参议院多数。

en.s: The 1990 Shreveport mayoral election resulted in the election of Republican councilwoman Hazel Beard in the race to succeed the term limited incumbent, John Brennan Hussey. The primary election was held on October 6, 1990. Beard and C. O. Simpkins, a dentist and civil rights activist, advanced to the general election held on November 6, 1990. Beard became the first woman, and the first Republican since Reconstruction, to serve as mayor of Shreveport.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1990年什里夫波特市长选举中，共和党市议员黑泽尔·比尔德当选，接替受任期限制的现任市长约翰·布伦南·赫西。初选于1990年10月6日举行。比尔德和牙医兼民权活动家C·O·西姆金斯进入11月6日举行的大选。比尔德成为该市历史上首位女市长，也是重建时期结束后首位共和党籍市长。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的决选日期。

en.s: The Battle of Logorište was fought east of Duga Resa and south of Karlovac, Croatia, from 4–6 November 1991 during the Croatian War of Independence, between the Croatian National Guard (Zbor narodne garde – ZNG) and the Yugoslav People's Army (Jugoslovenska Narodna Armija – JNA).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克罗地亚独立战争期间，克罗地亚国民卫队和南斯拉夫人民军于1991年11月4日至6日在克罗地亚洛戈里什泰交战。战场位于杜加雷萨以东、卡尔洛瓦茨以南。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1993 New Zealand general election was held on 6 November 1993 to determine the composition of the 44th New Zealand Parliament. It saw the governing National Party, led by Jim Bolger, win a second term in office, despite a major swing back towards the Labour Party. The new Alliance and New Zealand First parties gained significant shares of the vote, but won few seats. The election was New Zealand's last to date under the non-proportional first past the post electoral system.

zh.s: 新西兰于1993年11月6日举行大选，选出第44届新西兰议会。吉姆·博尔杰领导的执政国家党赢得第二个任期，尽管工党支持率大幅回升。新成立的联盟党和新西兰优先党获得了相当比例的选票，但只赢得少数席位。这是新西兰迄今最后一次采用非比例代表制的简单多数选举制度举行大选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Legislative Assembly elections were held in Delhi on the 6 November 1993. The result was a victory for the Bhartiya Janata Party, which won 49 of the 70 seats in the Assembly.

zh.s: 1993年11月6日，德里举行立法议会选举。印度人民党获胜，赢得议会70个席位中的49席。

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 1993 in Atlantic City were the joint ninth world kickboxing championships hosted by the W.A.K.O. organization arranged by W.A.K.O. USA president Jim Lantrip. As with the 1985 championships the organization had suffered a temporary split due to political differences, and a second event was planned later in the month in Budapest, although the differences would be resolved in the near future. The Atlantic City championships were open to amateur men and women, with thirty-one countries taking part, and styles on offer included Semi-Contact, Light-Contact and Musical Forms. Christine Bannon-Rodrigues, who had made history at the 1991 championships, repeated the feat by winning a further three gold medals and proving the first time was no fluke. By the end of the event, hosts USA were the strongest nation, with Hungary second and Germany third. It was held at the Trump Taj Mahal in Atlantic City, NJ, USA over three days - starting on Thursday, 4 November and ending on Saturday, 6 November 1993.

zh.s: 1993年W.A.K.O.大西洋城世界锦标赛是由W.A.K.O.组织主办的第九届世界踢拳锦标赛之一，由W.A.K.O. USA主席吉姆·兰特里普筹办。与1985年锦标赛一样，该组织因政治分歧一度分裂，并计划于当月晚些时候在布达佩斯举办另一场赛事，但不久后分歧得到解决。大西洋城赛事向业余男女选手开放，共有31个国家参赛，项目包括半接触、轻接触和音乐套路。克里斯蒂娜·班农-罗德里格斯曾在1991年锦标赛创造历史，此次再夺3枚金牌，证明此前的成绩并非偶然。赛事结束时，东道主美国排名第一，匈牙利第二，德国第三。比赛于1993年11月4日星期四至11月6日星期六在美国新泽西州大西洋城的特朗普泰姬陵酒店举行，为期3天。

en.s: When Worlds Collide (Spanish: Cuando Los Mundos Chocan) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view that took place on November 6, 1994, at the Los Angeles Memorial Sports Arena in Los Angeles, California. It was scripted and produced by the Mexican lucha libre company Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) and their American partner, International Wrestling Council (IWC). The show was produced by the technical staff of World Championship Wrestling (WCW). WCW Executive Vice-President Eric Bischoff had helped AAA secure the show to be broadcast by American pay-per-view providers, marking the first time a non-US-based wrestling promotion was shown live on US PPV television.

zh.s: 职业摔角付费直播赛事《世界碰撞》（西班牙语：Cuando Los Mundos Chocan）于1994年11月6日在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶纪念体育馆举行。赛事由墨西哥摔角公司AAA及其美国合作伙伴国际摔角理事会策划和制作，世界摔角锦标赛的技术团队负责制作。该组织副总裁埃里克·比肖夫帮助AAA联系美国付费电视供应商播出赛事，这也是美国以外的摔角推广公司首次在美国付费电视上进行现场直播。

en.s: The 1994 Montreal municipal election took place on November 6, 1994. Pierre Bourque was elected to his first term as mayor, defeating incumbent Jean Doré. Elections were also held in Montreal's suburban communities.

zh.s: 1994年11月6日举行蒙特利尔市政选举。皮埃尔·布尔克击败现任市长让·多雷，当选并开始首个市长任期。蒙特利尔郊区社区也举行了选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Tajikistan on 6 November 1994. Emomali Rahmonov, who had been de facto president since 1992, ran for the revived post with the support (though not the formal nomination) of the Communist Party of Tajikistan and won with 1,434,437 votes. Voter turnout was 95%.

zh.s: 1994年11月6日，塔吉克斯坦举行总统选举。埃莫马利·拉赫蒙诺夫自1992年以来一直是事实上的总统，他在恢复设立的总统职位竞选，得到塔吉克斯坦共产党支持，但并未获其正式提名，最终以1,434,437票当选。投票率为95%。

en.s: The 1994 Scottish Challenge Cup final, also known as the B&Q Cup final for sponsorship reasons, was an association football match between Dundee and Airdrieonians on 6 November 1994 at McDiarmid Park in Perth. It was the fifth final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the Scottish Football League.

zh.s: 1994年苏格兰挑战杯决赛因赞助原因也称为B&Q杯决赛，是邓迪和艾尔德里人队于1994年11月6日在珀斯麦克迪阿米德公园举行的一场足球比赛。这是自1990年为庆祝苏格兰足球联赛百年而创办该赛事以来的第5届决赛。

en.s: Early general elections were held in Trinidad and Tobago on 6 November 1995, after the ruling People's National Movement had seen its majority reduced to a single seat due to a defection and a lost by-election. The results saw the PNM and the United National Congress both won 17 seats. Although they had received fewer votes, the UNC was able to form a coalition with the two-seat National Alliance for Reconstruction, allowing UNC leader Basdeo Panday to become the country's first Prime Minister of Indian descent. Voter turnout was 63.3%.

zh.s: 特立尼达和多巴哥于1995年11月6日提前举行大选。执政的人民民族运动党因有人叛党和补选失利，议席多数缩减至仅多出一席。结果，该党与联合国民大会党各赢得17席。尽管联合国民大会党的得票较少，该党仍与拥有两席的国家重建联盟组成联合政府，使联合国民大会党领袖巴斯迪奥·潘迪成为该国首位印度裔总理。投票率为63.3%。

en.t: Cleveland Browns relocation controversy: Art Modell announces that he signed a deal that would relocate the Cleveland Browns to Baltimore
en.s: The Cleveland Browns relocation controversy—colloquially called "The Move" by fans—followed the announcement by Cleveland Browns owner Art Modell that his National Football League (NFL) team would move from its longtime home of Cleveland to Baltimore for the 1996 NFL season. Subsequent legal actions by the City of Cleveland and Browns season ticket holders led the NFL to broker a compromise in which Modell agreed to return the Browns franchise to the league.

zh.t: 克利夫兰布朗队迁址争议：阿特·莫德尔宣布签署协议，将球队迁至巴尔的摩
zh.s: 克利夫兰布朗队迁址争议（球迷俗称“搬迁”）始于球队老板阿特·莫德尔宣布将国家橄榄球联盟（NFL）的克利夫兰布朗队迁往巴尔的摩，并于1996赛季在当地参赛。克利夫兰市政府和布朗队季票持有者随后采取法律行动，促使NFL居中达成妥协：莫德尔同意将布朗队特许经营权交还联盟。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Paisley South was held on 6 November 1997 following the death of incumbent Member of Parliament (MP) Gordon McMaster of the Labour Party. It was won by Douglas Alexander, who retained the seat for Labour despite a swing of 11% to the Scottish National Party.

zh.s: 1997年11月6日，英国议会佩斯利南选区举行补选。工党籍时任议员戈登·麦克马斯特去世后，选区出现空缺。道格拉斯·亚历山大赢得补选，为工党保住席位；尽管苏格兰民族党支持率上升了11%。

en.s: The 1999 Northern Mariana Islands general election was held on November 6, 1999. Voters in the Northern Mariana Islands voted for 3 seats in the Northern Mariana Islands Senate, all eighteen seats in the Northern Mariana Islands House of Representatives, seats for the municipal council, and seats for the board of education, and a judge.

zh.s: 1999年11月6日举行北马里亚纳群岛大选。选民选出北马里亚纳群岛参议院的3个席位、众议院全部18个席位、市政委员会席位、教育委员会席位和一名法官。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Tajikistan on 6 November 1999. They were won by the incumbent, Emomali Rahmonov, who received 98% of the vote. The opposition, who had demanded the elections be postponed, amid claims that the government obstructed candidates from registering as candidates, described the result as illegal. International observers were also critical of the elections, particularly regarding the issues of candidate registration, media access and voting irregularities, including multiple voting.

zh.s: 1999年11月6日，塔吉克斯坦举行总统选举。时任总统埃莫马利·拉赫蒙诺夫获胜，得到98%的选票。反对派曾要求推迟选举，并指称政府阻挠候选人登记，认为选举结果不合法。国际观察员也批评了选举，尤其关注候选人登记、媒体接触和投票违规问题，包括重复投票。

en.s: The 1999 Holt by-election was held in the Australian electorate of Holt in Victoria on 6 November 1999. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of the sitting member, former Australian Labor Party deputy leader Gareth Evans on 30 September 1999. The writ for the by-election was issued on 1 October 1999.

zh.s: 澳大利亚维多利亚州霍尔特选区于1999年11月6日举行补选。此次补选由现任议员、澳大利亚工党前副领袖加雷思·埃文斯于1999年9月30日辞职引发。补选令状于1999年10月1日签发。

en.s: The New York City mayoral election of 2001 was held on November 6, 2001. Incumbent Republican mayor Rudy Giuliani could not run again due to term limits. As Democrats outnumber Republicans by 5 to 1 in the city, it was widely believed that a Democrat would succeed him in City Hall. However, businessman Michael Bloomberg, a lifelong Democrat, changed his party affiliation and ran as a Republican. Mark J. Green narrowly defeated Fernando Ferrer in the primary, surviving a negative contest that divided the party. A number of factors led to Bloomberg's ultimate victory in the general election, 50.3% to Green's 47.9%.

zh.s: 2001年纽约市市长选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍现任市长鲁迪·朱利安尼因任期限制无法再次竞选。纽约市民主党选民人数约为共和党的5倍，因此普遍认为民主党人会接任市长。但终身为民主党人的商人迈克尔·布隆伯格改变党籍，以共和党人身份参选。马克·J·格林在初选中险胜费尔南多·费雷尔，赢得一场令民主党分裂的激烈选战。最终，布隆伯格在大选中获胜，得票率为50.3%，格林为47.9%。
