en.s: The 2001 Virginia gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2001. Incumbent Republican Governor Jim Gilmore was barred from seeking a second term; Democratic nominee Mark Warner, the 1996 Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate, defeated Republican nominee Mark Earley, the Attorney General of Virginia.

zh.t: 美国弗吉尼亚州州长选举，2001
zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行弗吉尼亚州州长选举。共和党籍现任州长吉姆·吉尔摩不能竞选第二个任期。民主党提名人马克·华纳曾于1996年代表民主党竞选联邦参议员；他击败共和党提名人、弗吉尼亚州检察长马克·厄利。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Mayoral election of 2001 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2001. The incumbent mayor, Tom Murphy of the Democratic Party was running for a record-tying third straight term.

zh.s: 2001年11月6日星期二，宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡举行市长选举。民主党籍现任市长汤姆·墨菲竞选第三个连续任期，力求追平市长连任纪录。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The U.S. gubernatorial elections of 2001 were held on November 6, 2001. Two states voted to select a governor, as well as other statewide offices and members of state legislatures.

zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行美国州长选举。两个州举行投票，选出州长以及其他全州职位和州议会成员。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The New Jersey gubernatorial election of 2001 was a race for the Governor of New Jersey. It was held on November 6, 2001. Primaries took place on June 25. Democrat nominee Jim McGreevey won the general election with 56% of the vote — the first majority-elected governor since James Florio. His Republican opponent in that race was Bret Schundler.

zh.t: 美国新泽西州州长选举，2001
zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行新泽西州州长选举，初选于6月25日举行。民主党提名人吉姆·麦克格里维以56%的得票率赢得大选，是詹姆斯·弗洛里奥以来首位经多数选民支持当选的州长。他的共和党对手是布雷特·申德勒。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Boston mayoral election of 2001 occurred on Tuesday, November 6, 2001 between incumbent mayor Thomas Menino and City Councilor Peggy Davis-Mullen. Menino was re-elected to a third term. The nonpartisan municipal preliminary election was held on September 25, 2001. By finishing second, Mullen became the second woman to be a finalist for mayor in city history.

zh.s: 2001年11月6日星期二，波士顿举行市长选举，由现任市长托马斯·梅尼诺对阵市议员佩吉·戴维斯-穆伦。梅尼诺连任第三个任期。无党派市政预选于2001年9月25日举行。穆伦名列第二，成为该市历史上第二位进入市长决选的女性。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2001 Boise mayoral election was held on November 6, 2001, to elect the mayor of Boise, Idaho. Incumbent Mayor Brent Coles ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged by six opponents, including former State Senator Rod Beck. On May 23, 2001, city voters approved a $10 million levy to purchase and preserve land in the Boise foothills, which Coles championed, by a wide margin.

zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行爱达荷州博伊西市长选举。时任市长布伦特·科尔斯竞选第三个任期，面对包括前州参议员罗德·贝克在内的6名挑战者。2001年5月23日，市民以较大优势通过一项1000万美元的征税提案，用于购买和保护博伊西山麓的土地；科尔斯曾大力支持该提案。

en.s: The 2001 Toledo, Ohio mayoral election took place on November 6, 2001, to elect the mayor of Toledo, Ohio. Incumbent Mayor Carty Finkbeiner was term-limited and could not run for re-election to a second term, and instead explored a run for Governor in 2002. Six candidates ran to succeed him, with two Democrats, State Representative Jack Ford and County Treasurer Ray Kest, emerging as the frontrunners.

zh.t: 2001年俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举
zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行俄亥俄州托莱多市长选举。时任市长卡蒂·芬克拜纳受任期限制，不能竞选第二个任期，转而考虑参加2002年州长竞选。共有6名候选人角逐继任者，其中两名民主党人——州众议员杰克·福特和县财政部长雷·凯斯特——成为主要竞争者。

en.s: The 2001 Cincinnati mayoral election took place on November 6, 2001, to elect the Mayor of Cincinnati, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the primary election advancing to the general election, regardless of party. This was the first election in Cincinnati where the mayor was elected directly. Previously, the person that got the most votes in the city council elections automatically became mayor.

zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行俄亥俄州辛辛那提市长选举。选举正式上不分党派，初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选，不论其党派。这是辛辛那提首次直接选举市长。此前，市议会选举中得票最多的人会自动成为市长。

en.t: 2001 New York City borough president elections
en.s: The 2001 New York City borough president elections were held on November 6, 2001, to elect the presidents of each of the five boroughs in New York City. They coincided with other city elections, including for mayor, comptroller, public advocate, and city council. Primary elections were originally held on September 11, but due to the September 11 attacks were postponed to September 25, 2001 (votes cast on September 11 were not counted).

zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行纽约市五个行政区区长选举。选举与市长、审计长、公共倡导员和市议会等其他市级职位选举同时进行。初选原定于9月11日举行，但因9·11袭击推迟至2001年9月25日；9月11日投出的选票未计入。

en.s: The 2001 mayoral election in Allentown, Pennsylvania was held on November 6, 2001, and resulted in the Democrat and former state senator Roy Afflerbach, being elected over Republican challenger and businessman, Bob Lovett. Since this election there has never been a Republican mayor of Allentown.

zh.t: 2001年宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举
zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦市长选举。民主党人、前州参议员罗伊·阿弗勒巴赫当选，击败共和党挑战者、商人鲍勃·洛维特。自此次选举以来，阿伦敦从未出现共和党市长。

en.s: The 2001 Minneapolis City Council elections were held on November 6, 2001, to elect the 13 members of the Minneapolis City Council for four-year terms.

zh.t: 2001年明尼阿波利斯市议会选举
zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行明尼阿波利斯市议会选举，选出13名市议员，任期四年。

en.s: The 2001 New Jersey General Assembly elections were held on November 6, 2001, for all 80 seats in the lower house of the New Jersey Legislature. The election coincided with a gubernatorial election where Democrat Jim McGreevey won. Republicans held a 45-35 majority in the lower house prior to the election. The members of the New Jersey Legislature are chosen from 40 electoral districts.

zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行新泽西州众议院全部80个席位的选举。选举与州长选举同时举行，民主党人吉姆·麦格里维胜出。选举前，共和党以45席对民主党的35席占据众议院多数。新泽西州议会成员从40个选区选出。

en.s: The 2001 Rochester mayoral election took place on November 6, 2001, in the city of Rochester, New York, United States. Incumbent William A. Johnson Jr. was elected to a third term as mayor of Rochester.

zh.t: 2001年纽约州罗切斯特市长选举
zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行美国纽约州罗切斯特市长选举。时任市长小威廉·A·约翰逊当选第三个任期。

en.s: The 2001 United States state legislative elections were held on November 6, 2001, during President George W. Bush's first term in office. Elections were held for three legislative chambers in two states, simultaneous to those states' gubernatorial elections. Both chambers of the Northern Mariana Islands legislature were up as well. These were the first elections affected by the 2000 redistricting cycle, which reapportioned state legislatures based on data from the 2000 United States census.

zh.s: 2001年11月6日，美国举行州议会选举，当时乔治·W·布什总统正处于第一个任期。两个州的三个议会院举行选举，并与这两个州的州长选举同时进行。北马里亚纳群岛立法机构的两院也举行选举。这是2000年重新划分选区周期后首次举行选举；该轮调整依据2000年美国人口普查数据重新分配州议会席位。

en.s: The 2001 Dayton mayoral election took place on November 6, 2001. Incumbent Mayor Mike Turner ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged by State Senator Rhine McLin. Because Turner and McLin were the only two candidates to file for the election, no May primary was held and they both proceeded to the November general election.

zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行俄亥俄州代顿市长选举。时任市长迈克·特纳竞选第三个任期，面对州参议员莱茵·麦克林的挑战。由于只有特纳和麦克林两人登记参选，5月没有举行初选，两人直接进入11月大选。

en.s: The 2001 Virginia Attorney General election was held on November 6, 2001, to elect the next attorney general of Virginia. The Republican nominee, Jerry Kilgore, defeated the Democratic nominee, Donald McEachin, by around 20 points.

zh.t: 2001年弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2001年11月6日举行弗吉尼亚州总检察长选举，选出下一任州总检察长。共和党候选人杰里·基尔戈尔以约20个百分点的优势击败民主党候选人唐纳德·麦克伊钦。

en.s: The 2001 Fayetteville mayoral election took place on November 6, 2001, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina. It saw the election of mayor Marshall Pitts Jr., who unseated incumbent mayor Milo McBryde, who had taken office following the death of J.L. Dawkins. Pitts became the city's first African American mayor.

zh.t: 2001年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举
zh.s: 2001年费耶特维尔市长选举于11月6日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市市长。马歇尔·皮茨当选，击败现任市长米洛·麦克布莱德；麦克布莱德是在J·L·道金斯去世后接任市长的。皮茨成为该市首位非裔美国人市长。

en.s: The 2001 Buffalo Mayoral election took place on November 6, 2001. Incumbent Anthony M. Masiello, a Democrat, easily trounced his sole opponent in the primary, going on to win a third term with no serious opposition in the general election. Buffalo's 2001 mayoral election was notable for its uncharacteristic quietness, despite pressing issues such as allegations of environmental contamination in the Hickory Woods neighborhood of South Buffalo and chronic poverty and urban blight.

zh.s: 2001年布法罗市长选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任市长安东尼·M·马谢洛在初选中轻松击败唯一对手，随后在大选中没有遇到有力挑战，赢得第三个任期。尽管南布法罗希科里伍兹社区受到环境污染指控，以及长期贫困和城市衰败等问题突出，2001年布法罗市长选举却异常平静。

en.s: The 2001 Cleveland mayoral election took place on November 6, 2001, to elect the Mayor of Cleveland, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan, with the top two candidates from the October 2 primary advancing to the general election, regardless of party. Incumbent mayor Michael R. White decided not to run for re-election to a fourth term in office.

zh.s: 2001年克利夫兰市长选举于11月6日举行，选出俄亥俄州克利夫兰市市长。选举依法不设党派，不论党派，10月2日初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选。现任市长迈克尔·R·怀特决定不竞选第四个任期。

en.s: The 2001 Houston mayoral election took place on November 6, 2001. Incumbent Mayor Lee Brown was re-elected to a third term. Officially the race was non-partisan. None of the candidates received a majority of the votes, so a run-off election was held on December 1, 2001.

zh.s: 2001年休斯敦市长选举于11月6日举行。现任市长李·布朗连任第三个任期。选举依法不设党派。由于没有候选人获得过半选票，2001年12月1日举行了决选。

en.s: The 2001 Atlanta mayoral election occurred on November 6, 2001. Incumbent mayor Bill Campbell, a member of the Democratic Party who had been in office since 1994, was ineligible to run for reelection due to term limits. Since Franklin received a majority in the general election, no runoff election was held.

zh.s: 2001年亚特兰大市长选举于11月6日举行。现任市长比尔·坎贝尔自1994年起任职，因任期限制不能竞选连任。富兰克林在大选中获得过半选票，因此没有举行决选。

en.s: The 2001 Winston-Salem mayoral election was held on November 6, 2001, to elect the mayor of Winston-Salem, North Carolina. It saw the election of Allen Joines, who defeated incumbent mayor Jack Canvanagh.

zh.s: 2001年温斯顿-塞勒姆市长选举于11月6日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州温斯顿-塞勒姆市市长。艾伦·乔因斯当选，击败现任市长杰克·卡瓦纳。

en.s: The Raleigh mayoral election of 2001 was held on November 6, 2001, to elect a Mayor of Raleigh, North Carolina. The election was non-partisan. It was won by Charles Meeker, who defeated incumbent Paul Coble in the run-off. A third candidate was eliminated in the first round on October 9.

zh.s: 2001年罗利市长选举于11月6日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州罗利市市长。选举不设党派。查尔斯·米克尔获胜，在决选中击败现任市长保罗·科布尔。第三名候选人于10月9日的首轮投票中被淘汰。

en.s: The 2001 King County Executive election was held on November 6, 2001. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Ron Sims ran for re-election to a second term. Though several prominent Republicans, including County Councilman Rob McKenna, considered running against Sims, he faced relatively little-known challengers. He was challenged by Kirkland City Councilman Santos Contreras, civil engineer Alan Lobdell. In the blanket primary, Sims received 59 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2001年金县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任县行政长官罗恩·西姆斯竞选连任第二个任期。虽然包括县议会议员罗布·麦肯纳在内的几位知名共和党人考虑挑战西姆斯，但他面对的挑战者知名度都不高。其中有柯克兰市议会议员桑托斯·孔特雷拉斯和土木工程师艾伦·洛布德尔。在综合初选中，西姆斯获得59%的选票。

en.t: Mayoral elections in Manchester, New Hampshire, in the 21st century
en.s: Beginning shortly after the city's incorporation as a city in 1846, elections have been held in the mayor of Manchester, New Hampshire. The following article provides information on the elections for mayor in the city during the 21st century.

zh.t: 21世纪新罕布什尔州曼彻斯特市长选举
zh.s: 曼彻斯特于1846年建市后不久便开始举行市长选举。本文介绍21世纪该市的历届市长选举。

en.s: The 2001 Saint Paul mayoral election in the U.S. state of Minnesota held a scheduled primary election on 11 September and a general election on 6 November. Incumbent mayor Norm Coleman had opted against seeking a third term. The general election was particularly close, with Kelly winning by a mere 403 vote margin.

zh.s: 美国明尼苏达州圣保罗市于2001年11月6日举行普选，初选于9月11日举行。现任市长诺姆·科尔曼决定不竞选第三个任期。大选竞争非常激烈，凯利仅以403票的优势获胜。

en.s: The Virginia House of Delegates election of 2001 was held on Tuesday, November 6.

zh.s: 弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于2001年11月6日星期二举行。

en.s: Luxair Flight 9642 was a scheduled international passenger flight from Berlin Tempelhof Airport, Germany, to Luxembourg Findel Airport, Luxembourg, operated by Luxembourg's national airline Luxair. On 6 November 2002, the Fokker 50 operating the flight lost control and crashed onto a field during an attempted landing at the airport. Out of 22 passengers and crew members on board, only two people survived.

zh.t: 卢森堡航空9642号班机空难
zh.s: 卢森堡航空9642号班机原定从德国柏林滕珀尔霍夫机场飞往卢森堡芬德尔机场，由卢森堡国家航空公司卢森堡航空运营。2002年11月6日，执行该航班的福克50飞机在尝试降落时失控，坠毁在机场附近的田地里。机上22名乘客和机组人员中只有两人幸存。

en.t: Open Letter to the 16th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
en.s: The Open Letter to the 16th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was a petition from political activists in the People's Republic of China which urged the Chinese Communist Party to introduce political reforms. There were 192 signatories to the letter of a letter in November 2002, which was posted on the Internet calling on the 16th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party to introduce political reforms.
en.n: Jiang Lijun is detained by Chinese police for signing the Open Letter to the 16th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party.

zh.t: 致中国共产党第十六次全国代表大会的公开信
zh.s: 《致中国共产党第十六次全国代表大会的公开信》是一份由中华人民共和国政治活动人士发起的请愿书，呼吁中国共产党推进政治改革。2002年11月，192名人士签署了这封公开信，并将其发布到互联网上，呼吁中共十六大推动政治改革。
zh.n: 江棋生因签署《致中国共产党第十六次全国代表大会的公开信》而被中国警方拘留。

en.s: The London Labour Party mayoral selection of 2002 was the process by which the Labour Party selected its candidate for Mayor of London, to stand in the 2004 mayoral election. Nicky Gavron, Deputy Mayor of London and London Assembly member for Enfield and Haringey, was selected to stand.

zh.t: 2002年伦敦工党市长候选人遴选
zh.s: 2002年伦敦工党市长候选人遴选，是工党为2004年伦敦市长选举挑选候选人的过程。伦敦副市长、伦敦议会议员妮基·加夫隆获选为工党候选人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2003 Conservative Party leadership election was held due to the enforced resignation of incumbent leader Iain Duncan Smith, who lost a confidence vote among his parliamentary party. The causes of Duncan Smith's fall are often cited as his lack of charisma and impact with the public, the uninspired direction of the party under his leadership, and his previous failure to achieve more than a third of support among members of parliament in the 2001 leadership contest.

zh.s: 2003年英国保守党党魁选举是因时任党魁伊恩·邓肯·史密斯被迫辞职而举行的；他在党内议员的信任投票中失利。他下台的原因通常包括缺乏个人魅力和公众影响力、领导期间党内方向缺乏号召力，以及他在2001年党魁选举中未能获得超过三分之一议员的支持。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Yalengga Raid was a military raid conducted by Kopassus against the OPM on Jayawijaya Regency, Highland Papua and also halted the OPM attacks on Wamena. The raid resulted in killing the most-wanted OPM commander Yustinus Murib and seizure of most of the OPM's weapons and documents.

zh.s: 亚伦加突袭是印尼特种部队Kopassus针对巴布亚自由组织（OPM）在查亚维查亚县高地巴布亚实施的军事突袭，也阻止了OPM对瓦梅纳的袭击。行动击毙了OPM最受通缉的指挥官尤斯蒂努斯·穆里布，并缴获该组织大部分武器和文件。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: Senate elections were held in the Czech Republic on 5 and 6 November 2004, with a second round on 12 and 13 November. The result was a victory for the Civic Democratic Party, which won 37 of the 81 seats. Voter turnout was 28.6% in the first round and just 18.4% in the second.

zh.s: 2004年11月5日和6日，捷克举行参议院选举，11月12日和13日进行第二轮投票。公民民主党获胜，赢得81席中的37席。第一轮投票率为28.6%，第二轮仅为18.4%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Ufton Nervet rail crash occurred on 6 November 2004 when a passenger train collided with a stationary car on a level crossing on the Reading–Taunton line near Ufton Nervet, Berkshire, England. The collision derailed the train, and seven people—including the drivers of the train and the car—were killed. An inquest found that all railway personnel and systems were operating correctly, and the crash was caused by the suicide of the car driver.

zh.t: 阿夫顿内尔维特铁路事故
zh.s: 2004年11月6日，雷丁至汤顿铁路线上，一列客运列车在英格兰伯克郡阿夫顿内尔维特附近的平交道口撞上一辆停着的汽车。列车因此脱轨，7人死亡，其中包括列车和汽车的司机。调查庭认定，铁路人员和系统均正常运作，事故由汽车司机自杀引起。

en.s: The 2005 Longueuil municipal election took place on November 6, 2005, to elect a mayor and city councillors in Longueuil, Quebec, Canada. Claude Gladu was elected to his third term as mayor, and first term of the re-constituted city of Longueuil. His party won 19 of the 26 seats on Longueuil City Council.

zh.s: 2005年11月6日，加拿大魁北克省隆格伊举行市政选举，选出市长和市议员。克劳德·格拉迪当选，开始第三个市长任期，也是重组后的隆格伊市首个任期。他所在的政党赢得市议会26席中的19席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2005 Montreal municipal election was held on November 6, 2005, to elect a city mayor, borough mayors, city councillors, and borough councillors in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. In the contest for mayor of Montreal, Gérald Tremblay was elected to a second term over former mayor Pierre Bourque.

zh.s: 2005年11月6日，加拿大魁北克省蒙特利尔举行市政选举，选出市长、区长、市议员和区议员。蒙特利尔市长选举中，热拉尔·特朗布莱击败前市长皮埃尔·布尔克，连任第二个任期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2005 Scottish Challenge Cup final, also known as the Bell's Cup final for sponsorship reasons, was an association football match between St Mirren and Hamilton Academical on 6 November 2005 at Excelsior Stadium in Airdrie. It was the 15th final of the Scottish Challenge Cup since it was first organised in 1990 to celebrate the centenary of the Scottish Football League.

zh.s: 2005年苏格兰挑战杯决赛因赞助原因也称为贝尔杯决赛，是圣米伦和汉密尔顿学院队于2005年11月6日在艾尔德里的埃克塞尔西奥球场举行的一场足球比赛。这是自1990年为庆祝苏格兰足球联赛百年而创办该赛事以来的第15届决赛。

en.s: The Canadian province of Quebec held municipal elections in its municipalities on November 6, 2005. The municipalities in Quebec for the 2005 election were different from the previous 2001 election, as many municipalities had voted to de-amalgamate. Every municipality in Quebec held elections except Port-Cartier, Thetford Mines, Sept-Îles and in the village and parish of Saint-Georges-de-Cacouna (they were held in 2006).

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省各市于2005年11月6日举行市政选举。与2001年上届选举相比，参加2005年选举的魁北克各市有所不同，因为许多市镇曾投票决定撤销合并。魁北克省所有市镇都举行选举，只有波特卡蒂尔、塞特福德矿区、塞蒂尔，以及圣乔治-德卡库纳村和堂区例外；这些地方的选举于2006年举行。

en.s: The 2005 Norwegian Football Cup final was the final match of the 2005 Norwegian Football Cup, the 100th season of the Norwegian Football Cup, the premier Norwegian football cup competition organized by the Football Association of Norway (NFF). The match was played on 6 November 2005 at the Ullevaal Stadion in Oslo, and opposed two Tippeligaen sides Molde and Lillestrøm.

zh.s: 2005年挪威足球杯决赛是2005年挪威足球杯的决赛，也是挪威足协主办的挪威最高级别足球杯赛第100个赛季的决赛。比赛于2005年11月6日在奥斯陆的乌勒瓦尔球场举行，由莫尔德和利勒斯特伦两支挪威超级联赛球队交手。

en.s: Shimmer Volumes are the DVDs produced by the all-female professional wrestling promotion Shimmer Women Athletes. Since 2005, it has had 86 releases, with the most recent releases (82-91) being two volume, two disc sets, representing one night of events each, a practice not done since the out of print special edition of volume 1-2.

zh.s: Shimmer Volumes是全女子职业摔角团体Shimmer Women Athletes发行的DVD系列。自2005年以来，该系列已发行86部；最近的发行版本（第82至91卷）采用两卷一套、每套两张光盘的形式，每套记录一晚赛事。这种做法自绝版的第1至2卷特别版以来未再采用。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Tajikistan on 6 November 2006. The result was a victory for incumbent President Emomali Rahmonov, who won a third term in office after receiving 80% of the vote.

zh.s: 2006年11月6日，塔吉克斯坦举行总统选举。时任总统埃莫马利·拉赫蒙诺夫获胜，赢得第三个任期，得票率为80%。

en.s: The Molise regional election of 2006 took place on 5–6 November 2006. Incumbent Michele Iorio (Forza Italia) defeated Roberto Ruta (The Daisy).
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 莫利塞大区选举于2006年11月5日至6日举行。现任意大利力量党籍大区主席米凯莱·约里奥击败雏菊党候选人罗伯托·鲁塔。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: 2006 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: At the time of the election, Georgia had 13 congressional districts whose lines were redrawn in 2005 after Republicans took control of the state legislature and the previous maps were struck down by federal judges. Each district is home to approximately 630,000 Georgia residents. In 2006, seven seats were held by Republicans and six seats were held by Democrats.

zh.t: 2006年佐治亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 选举时，佐治亚州有13个国会选区。共和党控制州议会后于2005年重新划分了选区；此前的选区地图已被联邦法官裁定无效。每个选区约有63万名居民。2006年选举前，共和党占有7席，民主党占有6席。

en.s: The Kentucky gubernatorial election, 2007 was held on November 6, 2007. In this election, incumbent Republican Governor Ernie Fletcher lost to Democratic challenger Steve Beshear, who therefore began serving as Governor of Kentucky in December 2007 for a term through December 2011. A Primary Election to determine the Republican and Democratic nominees for governor was held on May 22, 2007 in which Ernie Fletcher (Republican) and Steve Beshear (Democrat) won their respective primaries. Beshear's running mate, Daniel Mongiardo, was elected as Lieutenant Governor of Kentucky for that same time period.

zh.s: 2007年肯塔基州州长选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍现任州长厄尼·弗莱彻败给民主党挑战者史蒂夫·贝希尔。贝希尔于2007年12月就任州长，任期至2011年12月。州长初选于2007年5月22日举行，弗莱彻和贝希尔分别赢得共和党和民主党提名。贝希尔的竞选搭档丹尼尔·蒙贾尔多也当选副州长，任期相同。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2007 Philadelphia mayoral election was held on November 6, 2007 when Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, United States elected Michael Nutter as the Mayor of Philadelphia starting in 2008. The incumbent mayor, John F. Street was barred from seeking a third term because of term limits. The Democratic Party primary campaign saw two well-known, well-funded Philadelphia congressmen – Bob Brady and Chaka Fattah – eclipsed by self-funding businessman Tom Knox and reformist former Philadelphia City Council member Nutter, who won by a surprisingly large margin in the primary election on May 15.

zh.s: 2007年11月6日，费城（宾夕法尼亚州）举行市长选举，迈克尔·纳特当选，2008年开始任职。现任市长约翰·F·斯特里特因任期限制无法竞选第三个任期。民主党初选于5月15日举行，费城两名知名且资金充足的联邦众议员鲍勃·布雷迪和查卡·法塔赫未能胜出，最终由自筹竞选经费的商人汤姆·诺克斯和主张改革的前市议员纳特领先，纳特以出人意料的较大优势获胜。

en.s: The Mayoral election of 2007 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania was a special election held on Tuesday, November 6, 2007. The incumbent mayor, Luke Ravenstahl of the Democratic Party faced Republican challenger Mark DeSantis, a telecommunications executive and adjunct professor at Carnegie Mellon University. The race was notable for the strength of its Republican challenger, rare in Pittsburgh, and the election of such a young mayor, Ravenstahl being 27 years old at the time. Ravenstahl was elected with a comfortable margin in an election marked by unusually cold weather and low voter turnout.

zh.s: 2007年11月6日星期二，宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡举行市长特别选举。民主党籍现任市长卢克·雷文斯塔尔面对共和党挑战者马克·德桑蒂斯，后者是电信业主管，也是卡内基梅隆大学兼职教授。共和党候选人在匹兹堡通常难有强劲表现，因此德桑蒂斯的实力引人注目；当时年仅27岁的雷文斯塔尔当选，也使他成为年轻市长之一。天气异常寒冷、投票率偏低，雷文斯塔尔仍以明显优势获胜。

en.s: The Houston Mayoral Election of 2007 took place on November 6, 2007. Incumbent Mayor Bill White was re-elected to a third term. Officially the race was non-partisan, but Mayor White is a member of the Democratic Party.

zh.s: 2007年11月6日举行休斯敦市长选举。现任市长比尔·怀特连任第三个任期。选举正式上是无党派选举，但怀特是民主党人。

en.s: The Indianapolis mayoral election of 2007 took place on November 6, 2007. Voters elected the Mayor of Indianapolis, members of the Indianapolis City-County Council, as well as several other local officials. Incumbent Democrat Bart Peterson was seeking a third term. Republicans nominated former Marine Greg Ballard to run against Peterson. In what was called, "the biggest upset in Indiana political history", Ballard defeated Peterson 51% to 47%.

zh.t: 印第安纳波利斯市长选举，2007
zh.s: 2007年11月6日举行印第安纳波利斯市长选举，选民还选出市县议会议员和其他地方官员。民主党籍现任市长巴特·彼得森竞选第三个任期。共和党提名前海军陆战队员格雷格·巴拉德与彼得森对决。巴拉德以51%比47%击败彼得森，被称为“印第安纳州政治史上最大的冷门”。

en.s: The 2007 Texas Constitutional Amendment Election took place 6 November 2007. Sixteen proposed amendments (propositions) appeared on the ballot — all of which were approved by the voters. About 1,088,137 voters statewide went to the polls, out of 12,587,501 registered voters in Texas. Note: The following summaries are taken from a newspaper abridgement of a Texas Legislative Council summary booklet.

zh.t: 得克萨斯州宪法修正案公投，2007
zh.s: 2007年11月6日，得克萨斯州举行宪法修正案公投。选票上有16项拟议修正案（提案），全部获选民通过。全州有约1,088,137名选民投票，登记选民共12,587,501人。注：以下各项摘要取自报纸对得州立法委员会摘要手册的节录。

en.s: The 2007 Flint mayoral election was held on November 6, 2007, with the primary election occurring on August 7, 2007. Incumbent Mayor Don Williamson ran for re-election. He faced a crowded field of opponents, and received less than one-third of the vote in the primary election, winning just 33 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2007年11月6日举行弗林特市长选举，初选于2007年8月7日举行。现任市长唐·威廉姆森竞选连任。他面对众多对手，在初选中获得不到三分之一的选票，得票率为33%。

en.s: A general election was held in Mississippi on November 6, 2007, to elect to four-year terms for all members of the Mississippi State Legislature (122 representatives, 52 senators), the offices of Governor of Mississippi, Lieutenant Governor, Secretary of State, Attorney General, State Auditor, State Treasurer, Commissioner of Agriculture and Commerce, and Commissioner of Insurance, plus all three members of the Mississippi Transportation Commission and Mississippi Public Service Commission.

zh.s: 2007年11月6日，密西西比州举行大选，选出州议会全部成员，任期四年，包括122名州众议员和52名州参议员；还选出州长、副州长、州务卿、总检察长、州审计长、州财政部长、农业与商务专员和保险专员，以及密西西比州交通委员会和公共服务委员会的全部3名成员。

en.s: The 2007 Indianapolis City–County Council elections took place on November 6, 2007. All 29 seats were up for re-election, 25 districts and 4 at-large seats, on the Indianapolis City–County Council. Seven of the seats were unopposed, 4 held by Democrats and 3 held by Republicans. Prior to the elections Democrats held a 15–14-seat majority. Following the elections Republicans gained control of the council with a 16–13 majority.

zh.t: 2007年印第安纳波利斯市县议会选举
zh.s: 2007年11月6日举行印第安纳波利斯市县议会选举，改选全部29个席位，包括25个选区席位和4个全市席位。7个席位没有竞争，其中4席由民主党人担任，3席由共和党人担任。选举前，民主党以15席对14席占多数。选举后，共和党以16席对13席取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2007 Kentucky elections for the statewide offices of governor, lieutenant governor, attorney general, auditor of public accounts, commissioner of agriculture, secretary of state, and state treasurer were held on November 6, 2007. All incumbents were reelected with the exception of incumbent governor Ernie Fletcher, who was defeated in his reelection bid for governor by former Lieutenant Governor Steve Beshear.

zh.s: 2007年11月6日举行肯塔基州州长、副州长、总检察长、公共账目审计长、农业专员、州务卿和州财政部长等全州职位选举。除民主党籍时任州长厄尼·弗莱彻竞选连任失败、败给前副州长史蒂夫·贝希尔外，所有时任官员都连任。

en.s: The 2007 New Jersey General Assembly elections were held on November 6, 2007, for all 80 seats in the lower house of the New Jersey Legislature. The election occurred midway through Democratic Governor Jon Corzine's term. Democrats held a 49–31 majority in the lower house prior to the election. The members of the New Jersey Legislature are chosen from 40 electoral districts.

zh.s: 2007年11月6日举行新泽西州众议院全部80个席位的选举。选举在民主党籍州长乔恩·科尔津任期中段举行。选举前，民主党以49席对31席占多数。新泽西州议会成员从40个选区选出。

en.s: The 2007 Tucson mayoral election occurred on November 6, 2007, to elect the mayor of Tucson, Arizona, USA, and coincided with the elections to the Tucson City Council wards 1, 2 and 4. The incumbent Mayor, Bob Walkup, was re-elected.

zh.t: 2007年亚利桑那州图森市长选举
zh.s: 2007年11月6日举行亚利桑那州图森市长选举，与图森市议会第一、第二和第四选区的选举同时进行。时任市长鲍勃·沃克普再次当选。

en.s: The 2007 Boise mayoral election was held on November 6, 2007, to elect the mayor of Boise, Idaho. Incumbent Mayor Dave Bieter ran for re-election to a second term, and was challenged by City Councilman Jim Tibbs. Bieter defeated Tibbs in a landslide, winning his second term with 64 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2007年爱达荷州博伊西市长选举
zh.s: 2007年11月6日举行爱达荷州博伊西市长选举。时任市长戴夫·比特尔竞选连任第二个任期，面对市议员吉姆·蒂布斯的挑战。比特尔以压倒性优势击败蒂布斯，获得64%的选票，连任成功。

en.s: Elections to state legislatures were held on November 6, 2007. Seven legislative chambers in four states held regularly scheduled elections. These off-year elections coincided with other state and local elections, including gubernatorial elections in three states. Both chambers of the Northern Mariana Islands were up as well. Democrats held control of both chambers of the New Jersey and Louisiana legislatures, and held control of the Mississippi House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2007年11月6日举行美国州议会选举。4个州的7个议会院举行定期选举。这些非总统选举年选举与其他州和地方选举同时进行，其中包括3个州的州长选举。北马里亚纳群岛立法机构的两院也举行选举。民主党控制新泽西州和路易斯安那州议会的两院，并控制密西西比州众议院。

en.s: The 2007 Durham mayoral election was held on November 6, 2007, to elect the mayor of Durham, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Bill Bell.

zh.s: 2007年达勒姆市长选举于11月6日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州达勒姆市市长。现任市长比尔·贝尔成功连任。

en.s: The 2007 Baltimore mayoral election was held on November 6, 2007. Because Baltimore's electorate is overwhelmingly Democratic, Sheila Dixon's victory in the Democratic primary on September 11 all but assured her of victory in the general election; she defeated Republican candidate Elbert Henderson in the general election by an overwhelming majority.

zh.s: 2007年巴尔的摩市长选举于11月6日举行。由于巴尔的摩选民绝大多数是民主党人，希拉·迪克斯在9月11日赢得民主党初选后，几乎可以确定会在大选中获胜；她最终以压倒性多数击败共和党候选人埃尔伯特·亨德森。

en.s: The 2007 Allegheny County Executive election was held on November 6, 2007. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Dan Onorato ran for re-election to a second term. Despite speculation that Onorato would run for Governor in 2010 and not complete his term, he faced only token opposition in the Democratic primary, and no other candidate filed to oppose him.

zh.t: 2007年阿勒格尼县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2007年阿勒格尼县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任县行政长官丹·奥诺拉托竞选连任第二个任期。尽管有人猜测奥诺拉托可能在2010年竞选州长、不会完成任期，但他在民主党初选中只遇到象征性竞争，也没有其他候选人登记参选挑战他。

en.s: The 2007 Snohomish County Executive election took place on November 6, 2007, to elect the county executive of Snohomish County, Washington. In 2004, Washington adopted a top-two primary system for most elections in the state, but the new primary law was struck down by the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. The 2007 election took place during the state's appeal to the U.S.

zh.t: 2007年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2007年斯诺霍米什县行政长官选举于11月6日举行，选出华盛顿州斯诺霍米什县行政长官。2004年，华盛顿州为多数选举采用前两名晋级的初选制度，但新初选法后来被美国第九巡回上诉法院推翻。2007年选举举行时，该州仍在上诉至美国最高法院；最高法院最终裁决维持该初选制度。因此，2007年选举采用各党分别举行初选的方式。

en.s: The 2007 San Francisco mayoral election occurred on November 6, 2007. Voters elected a Mayor of San Francisco and several local officials. Incumbent Mayor Gavin Newsom was re-elected by an overwhelming margin. There were 12 candidates on the ballot as well as 6 write-ins. Besides Newsom, other notable candidates included Josh Wolf, a journalist who was jailed for refusing to testify and turn over video evidence to a federal grand jury.

zh.s: 2007年旧金山市长选举于11月6日举行。选民选出市长及多名地方官员。现任市长加文·纽森以压倒性优势连任。选票上有12名候选人，另有6名写入候选人。除纽森外，其他知名候选人包括记者乔什·沃尔夫；他因拒绝向联邦大陪审团作证并交出视频证据而被监禁。

en.s: The 2007 Columbus mayoral election took place on November 6, 2007, to elect the mayor of Columbus, Ohio. The election was officially nonpartisan. Since there were fewer than three candidates, no primary was necessary. Incumbent mayor Michael B. Coleman was reelected.

zh.t: 2007年俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长选举
zh.s: 2007年哥伦布市市长选举于11月6日举行，选出俄亥俄州哥伦布市市长。选举依法不设党派。由于候选人不足3名，无需举行初选。现任市长迈克尔·B·科尔曼连任。

en.s: The 2007 Fayetteville mayoral election took place on November 6, 2007, to elect the mayor of Fayetteville, North Carolina. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor Tony Chavonne.

zh.t: 2007年北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市长选举
zh.s: 2007年费耶特维尔市长选举于11月6日举行，选出北卡罗来纳州费耶特维尔市市长。现任市长托尼·沙沃内连任。

en.s: The 2007 Des Moines mayoral election was held on November 6, 2007, to elect the mayor of Des Moines, Iowa. It saw Frank Cownie win reelection.

zh.s: 2007年得梅因市长选举于11月6日举行，选出艾奥瓦州得梅因市市长。弗兰克·考尼连任。

en.s: The 2007 Mississippi gubernatorial election was held on Tuesday, November 6. Incumbent Haley Barbour was re-elected to serve a four-year term as governor of Mississippi from January 15, 2008, through January 10, 2012. The Lieutenant Governor of Mississippi is also on the ballot and elected for the same time period. This was the first time that Panola County and Yalobusha County voted Republican for governor since Reconstruction.

zh.s: 密西西比州州长选举于2007年11月6日星期二举行。现任州长海利·巴伯连任，任期为2008年1月15日至2012年1月10日。副州长职位也在同一张选票上改选，任期相同。这是重建时期结束后，帕诺拉县和亚卢布沙县首次在州长选举中投票支持共和党。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in October and November 2007 in three states. The final results were a net change of zero among the parties. Republicans picked up the open seat in Louisiana and reelected incumbent Haley Barbour in Mississippi, while Democrats defeated Republican incumbent Ernie Fletcher in Kentucky. Going into the elections, the Democratic Party held 28 governors' seats, while the Republican Party held 22.

zh.s: 2007年10月和11月，美国三个州举行了州长选举。各党派席位净变化为零：共和党赢得路易斯安那州的空缺席位，并让现任州长海利·巴伯在密西西比州连任；民主党则击败肯塔基州的共和党现任州长欧内斯特·弗莱彻。选举前，民主党拥有28个州长席位，共和党拥有22个。

en.s: The 2008 Glenrothes by-election was a by-election held in Scotland on 6 November 2008 to elect a new Member of Parliament (MP) for the House of Commons constituency of Glenrothes in Fife, Scotland. The seat fell vacant when the previous MP, John MacDougall (Labour), died of pleural mesothelioma on 13 August 2008, aged 60. Pleural Mesothelioma is a rare form of lung cancer caused by prolonged exposure to asbestos. The by-election was won by Lindsay Roy of the Labour Party.

zh.s: 2008年11月6日，苏格兰举行格伦罗西斯选区补选，为英国下议院选出一名新议员。该席位因前议员、工党人约翰·麦克杜格尔于2008年8月13日去世而空缺，享年60岁。麦克杜格尔死于胸膜间皮瘤，这是一种由长期接触石棉引起的罕见肺癌。工党候选人林赛·罗伊赢得补选。

en.s: The 2010 AFC Cup final was a football match played on Saturday, 6 November 2010 between Al-Qadsia and Al-Ittihad. It was the 7th final of the AFC Cup. The game was played at Jaber International Stadium, Kuwait City. Both finalists were eligible to compete in the play-offs for the 2011 AFC Champions League, subject to AFC's assessment for professionalism based on selected criteria.

zh.s: 2010年亚足联杯决赛于2010年11月6日星期六举行，由卡迪西亚和伊蒂哈德交手。这是第7届亚足联杯决赛，比赛在科威特城的贾比尔国际体育场举行。两支决赛球队都可参加2011年亚足联冠军联赛附加赛，资格取决于亚足联按照选定标准进行的职业化评估。

en.t: Central and Western District Council election, 2011
en.s: The 2011 Central and Western District Council election was held on 6 November 2011 to elect all 15 elected members to the 18-member District Council. The pro-Beijing Democratic Alliance for the Betterment and Progress of Hong Kong took over the Democratic Party as the largest party in the council, with the Democrats losing two seats by narrow margin in Belcher and Tung Wah. Civic Party's Tanya Chan the incumbent Legislative Councillor also lost her seat in Peak to Liberal Party's Joseph Chan Ho-lim.

zh.s: 2011年中西区区议会选举于11月6日举行，选出18席区议会中的15名民选议员。亲北京的民建联取代民主党，成为议会第一大党；民主党在坚尼地城和东华选区均以微弱差距失去议席，共少了两席。公民党现任立法会议员陈淑庄也在山顶选区落败，输给自由党陈浩濂。

en.s: The 2011 Ford FAI Cup final was the 88th final of the FAI Cup, the oldest domestic football competition in Ireland. The match took place on 6 November 2011 at Aviva Stadium in Dublin for the second consecutive year. The two clubs contesting the 2011 final were Premier Division side, Sligo Rovers and First Division side, Shelbourne, with the victors guaranteeing a berth in the UEFA Europa League.

zh.s: 2011年福特爱尔兰足协杯决赛是该杯赛第88届决赛，也是爱尔兰历史最悠久的国内足球赛事。比赛于2011年11月6日在都柏林的英杰华体育场举行，这是该场地连续第二年承办决赛。参赛的两支球队是爱尔兰超级联赛球队斯莱戈流浪者和甲级联赛球队谢尔伯恩，胜者可获得欧足联欧洲联赛参赛资格。

en.s: The 2011 Norwegian Football Cup final was the 106th final of the Norwegian Football Cup. It was played on 6 November 2011 at Ullevaal Stadion, in Oslo, Norway. In the final Brann meet Aalesund. The winner, Aalesund, earned a place in the second qualifying round of the 2012–13 UEFA Europa League.

zh.s: 2011年挪威足球杯决赛是第106届挪威足球杯决赛，于2011年11月6日在挪威奥斯陆的乌勒瓦尔球场举行。决赛由布兰对阵奥勒松。奥勒松获胜后，取得2012—13赛季欧洲联赛第二轮资格赛的参赛资格。

en.s: Elections to the United States Senate were held on November 6, 2012, with 33 of the 100 seats in the Senate being contested in regular elections whose winners will serve six-year terms beginning January 3, 2013 with the 113th Congress. The Democrats had 21 seats up for election, plus two independents who caucused with the Democrats, while the Republicans had only ten seats up for election. The Democrats gained a net of two seats, leaving them with a total of 53 seats. The Republicans lost a net of two seats, ending with a total of 45 seats.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行美国参议院选举，100席中有33席按常规改选，胜选者将于2013年1月3日开始在第113届国会任职六年。民主党有21席面临改选，另有两名与民主党共同议事的独立议员也在其中；共和党则有10席改选。民主党净增两席，共有53席；共和党净失两席，最终有45席。

en.t: United States presidential election in West Virginia, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in West Virginia took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. West Virginia voters chose five electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. On election day, Mitt Romney defeated Barack Obama in the state of West Virginia by a landslide 26.76% margin.

en.t: United States presidential election in Kentucky, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Kentucky took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Kentucky voters chose eight electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. en.s: The North Carolina lieutenant gubernatorial election of 2012 was held on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the other elections to the Council of State and the gubernatorial election. Primary elections were held May 8. The offices of Governor and Lieutenant Governor are elected independently. The incumbent, Lt. Gov. Walter H. Dalton, announced on Jan. 26, 2012 that he would run for Governor. In the general election, Republican Dan Forest won 50.08% of the vote, narrowly defeating Democrat Linda Coleman. The election result was in doubt for almost two weeks after Election Day, and was within the margin in which Coleman could ask for a recount, but she chose not to do so on Nov.

en.t: United States presidential election in Idaho, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Idaho took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Idaho voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. en.t: United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 to elect the non-voting Delegate to the United States House of Representatives from the District of Columbia. The election coincided with the elections of other federal offices, including a quadrennial presidential election. The non-voting delegate is elected for two-year terms. Democrat Eleanor Holmes Norton, who has represented the district since 1991, ran for re-election. She ran unopposed in the Democratic primary, held on April 3, 2012.

zh.t: 美国哥伦比亚特区联邦众议院代表选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，哥伦比亚特区举行选举，选出一名在联邦众议院没有投票权的特区代表。选举与总统选举等其他联邦职位选举同时举行。特区代表任期两年。自1991年起代表该区的民主党籍埃莉诺·霍姆斯·诺顿竞选连任；她在2012年4月3日举行的民主党初选中没有对手。

en.s: The 2012 Washington State Senate elections took place on November 6, 2012. Twenty-five of Washington's forty-nine state senators were elected. Each state legislative district has one senator elected to a four-year term, but state senate elections alternate so that about half of the senators are elected in presidential election years (e.g., 2008, 2012) and the other half are elected in non-presidential even numbered election years (e.g., 2010, 2014). A top two primary election on August 7, 2012 determined which candidates appear on the November ballot.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行华盛顿州参议院选举，49名州参议员中有25人改选。每个州议会选区选出一名参议员，任期四年。参议院选举交替安排，约一半席位在总统选举年改选（如2008年、2012年），另一半在非总统选举的偶数年改选（如2010年、2014年）。8月7日举行的前两名初选决定哪些候选人进入11月大选。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012. It coincided with the re-election of President Barack Obama. Elections were held for all 435 seats representing the 50 U.S. states and also for the delegates from the District of Columbia and five major U.S. territories. The winners of this election cycle served in the 113th United States Congress. This was the first congressional election using districts drawn-up based on the 2010 United States Census. Although Democratic candidates received a nationwide plurality of more than 1.4 million votes (1.2%) in all House elections, the Republican Party won a 33-seat advantage in the state-apportioned totals, thus retaining its House majority by 17 seats.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行美国众议院选举，改选代表50个州的全部435席，以及哥伦比亚特区和五个主要美国属地的代表。胜选者将在第113届国会任职。此次是首次使用依据2010年人口普查重新划定的选区进行国会选举。民主党候选人在众议院选举中全国得票总数领先逾140万票（1.2%），但共和党在按各州分配席位的统计中多赢得33席，因此以17席优势保住众议院多数。

en.t: United States Senate election in Tennessee, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 6, 2012, as part of the general election including the 2012 U.S. presidential election, elections to the House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Bob Corker won a second term. Corker easily won the Republican primary with 85% of the vote. He faced Democratic Party nominee Mark E. Clayton as well as several third-party candidates and several independents. Clayton won the Democratic nomination with 30% of the vote, despite raising no money and having a website that was four years out of date.

zh.t: 美国田纳西州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行田纳西州参议院选举，与总统、众议院及州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任参议员鲍勃·科克赢得第二个任期。他在共和党初选中轻松获胜，得票率为85%。大选中，他面对民主党候选人马克·E·克莱顿，以及数名第三党候选人和独立候选人。克莱顿虽然没有筹款，个人网站也已有四年未更新，仍以30%的得票率赢得民主党提名。

en.t: United States Senate election in North Dakota, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the 2012 U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic-NPL U.S. Senator Kent Conrad decided to retire instead of running for re-election to a fifth term. en.t: North Carolina Council of State election, 2012
en.s: The North Carolina Council of State elections of 2012 were held November 6, 2012 to select the nine officers of the North Carolina Council of State. This election coincided with the U.S. presidential election, U.S. House elections, the gubernatorial election and the statewide judicial elections. Primary elections were held on May 8, 2012; for races in which no candidate received 40 percent of the vote in the primary, runoff elections (officially known as "second" primaries) were held on July 17. The nine members of the North Carolina Council of State are statewide-elected officers serving four-year terms.

en.s: The 2012 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the 2012 U.S. presidential election, U.S. House elections, and various state and local elections. Four-term incumbent governor John Lynch was eligible to seek a fifth term. In the fall of 2011, Lynch announced that he would retire rather than run for re-election. On September 11, 2012, Democrat Maggie Hassan and Republican Ovide Lamontagne defeated primary opponents to win their parties' nominations. Hassan won the election while carrying every county in the state and began the two-year term on January 3, 2013.

en.t: United States presidential election in New York, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in New York took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行得克萨斯州联邦众议院选举，选出该州36名众议员。根据2010年美国人口普查重新分配席位后，该州席位增加四席。选举与总统、参议院及其他联邦和州职位选举同时举行。初选原定于2012年3月6日举行，第二轮初选原定于5月22日；由于选区重划问题，初选推迟至5月29日，第二轮推迟至7月31日。

en.s: The 2012 North Carolina gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the 2012 U.S. presidential election, U.S. House elections, statewide judicial elections, Council of State elections and various local elections. Incumbent Democratic Governor Bev Perdue was eligible to run for re-election to a second term. However, she announced on January 26, 2012, that she would not seek re-election. The Democratic nominee was incumbent Lieutenant Governor Walter H. Dalton, the Republican nominee was former Mayor of Charlotte Pat McCrory and the Libertarian nominee was Barbara Howe.

zh.t: 美国北卡罗来纳州州长选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行北卡罗来纳州州长选举，与美国总统、众议院、全州司法职位、州务委员会和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任州长贝弗莉·珀杜有资格竞选连任，但她于2012年1月26日宣布不再参选。民主党提名时任副州长沃尔特·H·道尔顿；共和党提名前夏洛特市市长帕特·麦克罗里；自由党提名芭芭拉·豪。

en.t: United States Senate election in Massachusetts, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Massachusetts took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election and elections to the U.S. Senate in other states, as well as elections to the House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Senator Scott Brown ran for re-election to a first full term. He had been elected in a special election in 2010 following the death of incumbent Democratic Senator Ted Kennedy. Brown faced no challengers from his own party. For the Democrats, an initial wide field of prospective candidates narrowed after the entry of Harvard Law School Professor Elizabeth Warren, the architect of the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau.

zh.t: 美国马萨诸塞州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州参议院选举，与总统选举、其他州的参议院选举、众议院选举及州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任参议员斯科特·布朗竞选完整的第一个任期。他在2010年特别选举中当选，该次选举是为了填补民主党籍参议员泰德·肯尼迪去世后的空缺。布朗在共和党初选中没有对手。民主党方面，哈佛法学院教授、消费者金融保护局的创建者伊丽莎白·沃伦参选后，原本人数众多的意向候选人范围缩小。

en.s: The 2012 Montana gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2012, to elect the Governor of Montana. Incumbent Democratic Governor Brian Schweitzer was term-limited and could not run for re-election to a third term. Montana Attorney General Steve Bullock won the Democratic primary with 87% of the vote and former U.S. Representative Rick Hill won the Republican primary with 34% of the vote. In the general election, Bullock was victorious by 7,571 votes, taking 48.9% of the vote to Hill's 47.3%.

zh.t: 美国蒙大拿州州长选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行蒙大拿州州长选举。民主党籍现任州长布赖恩·施韦策任期届满，不能竞选第三个任期。蒙大拿州检察长史蒂夫·布洛克以87%的得票率赢得民主党初选；前联邦众议员里克·希尔以34%的得票率赢得共和党初选。大选中，布洛克以7,571票之差获胜，得票率为48.9%，希尔为47.3%。

en.t: United States Senate election in Indiana, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate, House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Richard Lugar ran for re-election to a seventh term, but was defeated in the primary by Tea Party-backed Richard Mourdock. Congressman Joe Donnelly, a moderate Democrat from Indiana's 2nd Congressional District, received his party's nomination after running unopposed in the primary contest, and then defeated both Mourdock and Libertarian Andrew Horning in the general election.

zh.t: 美国印第安纳州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行印第安纳州参议院选举，与总统、参议院、众议院及州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任参议员理查德·卢格竞选第七个任期，但在初选中被获茶党支持的理查德·莫多克击败。民主党籍众议员乔·唐纳利代表印第安纳州第二国会选区，因无人竞争而获得本党提名。他在大选中击败莫多克和自由党候选人安德鲁·霍宁。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina, 2012
en.s: (See also: South Carolina elections, 2012) The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 and elected the seven U.S. Representatives from the state of South Carolina, an increase of one seat as a result of reapportionment thanks to the continued strong growth found in South Carolina as reported in the 2010 United States Census. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election. The people of South Carolina elected six Republicans and one Democrat to represent the state in the 113th United States Congress.

zh.t: 美国南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举，选出该州七名众议员。根据2010年美国人口普查，南卡罗来纳州人口持续增长，席位重新分配后增加一席。选举与总统选举等其他联邦和州职位选举同时举行。该州选民选出六名共和党籍和一名民主党籍众议员，代表南卡罗来纳州参加第113届国会。

en.t: United States Senate election in Virginia, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Virginia took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the 2012 U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Jim Webb decided to retire instead of running for re-election to a second term. Former Governor of Virginia Tim Kaine was unopposed for the Democratic nomination and the Republican party nominated former Senator and Governor George Allen through a primary on June 12, 2012. Kaine won the open seat.

zh.t: 美国弗吉尼亚州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行弗吉尼亚州参议院选举，与总统、参议院、众议院及州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员吉姆·韦伯决定退休，不竞选第二个任期。前州长蒂姆·凯恩在民主党初选中没有对手；共和党于2012年6月12日通过初选提名前参议员兼州长乔治·艾伦。凯恩赢得这个空缺席位。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Mexico, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in New Mexico took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. This was the 25th U.S. Presidential Election in which New Mexico participated. New Mexico voters chose five electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan.

zh.t: 美国新墨西哥州总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，新墨西哥州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。这是新墨西哥州参加的第25次美国总统选举。选民通过普选选出5名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。

en.t: United States presidential election in Mississippi, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Mississippi took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Mississippi voters chose six electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Romney and Ryan won Mississippi with 55.3% of the popular vote to Obama's and Biden's 43.8%, thus winning the state's six electoral votes.

zh.t: 美国密西西比州总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，密西西比州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出6名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。罗姆尼和瑞安获得55.3%的普选票，奥巴马和拜登获得43.8%，共和党赢得该州全部6张选举人票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, to elect the 14 U.S. Representatives from the state of Michigan, a decrease of one following the 2010 United States Census. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election and an election to the U.S. Senate. Primary elections were held on August 7, 2012. The filing deadling for candidates to file to run in the primary was May 15. Except for two seats, all the incumbents sought re-election. The open seats were the 5th and 11th Congressional Districts.

zh.t: 美国密歇根州联邦众议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行密歇根州联邦众议院选举，选出该州14名众议员；根据2010年美国人口普查，席位减少一席。选举与总统、参议院及其他联邦和州职位选举同时举行。初选于2012年8月7日举行，候选人登记参加初选的截止日期为5月15日。除两个席位外，所有现任众议员都竞选连任；空缺席位来自第五和第十一区。

en.t: United States Senate election in Wisconsin, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Wisconsin took place on November 6, 2012, alongside a U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Herb Kohl retired instead of running for re-election to a fifth term. Primary elections were held on August 14, 2012. Democratic Congresswoman Tammy Baldwin of Wisconsin's 2nd congressional district ran unopposed for her party's nomination. The Republican nominee was former Governor of Wisconsin and former Secretary of Health and Human Services Tommy Thompson, who won with a plurality in a four-way race.

zh.t: 美国威斯康星州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行威斯康星州参议院选举，与总统、参议院、众议院及州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员赫伯·科尔退休，不竞选第五个任期。初选于2012年8月14日举行。民主党籍联邦众议员塔米·鲍德温在党内没有对手。共和党提名前州长、前卫生与公众服务部部长汤米·汤普森；他在四人竞选中以相对多数获胜。

en.t: United States Senate election in California, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in California took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the 2012 U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. The primary election on June 5 took place under California's new blanket primary law, where all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party. In the primary, voters voted for any candidate listed, or write-in any other candidate. The top two finishers — regardless of party — advanced to the general election in November, even if a candidate managed to receive a majority of the votes cast in the June primary.

zh.t: 美国加利福尼亚州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州参议院选举，与总统、参议院、众议院及州和地方选举同时进行。6月5日的初选依照加州新的开放式初选法举行，所有候选人不分党派列在同一张选票上。选民可投给名单上的任何候选人，也可写入其他候选人的名字。无论党派，得票最高的两名候选人进入11月大选，即使有人在6月初选中已获得多数票也一样。

en.t: United States presidential election in Colorado, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Colorado took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Colorado voters chose 9 electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Obama and Biden carried Colorado with 51.5% of the popular vote to Romney's and Ryan's 46.1%, thus winning the state's 9 electoral votes.

zh.t: 美国科罗拉多州总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，科罗拉多州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出9名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。奥巴马和拜登在科罗拉多州获得51.5%的普选票，罗姆尼和瑞安获得46.1%，民主党赢得该州全部9张选举人票。

en.t: United States Senate election in Missouri, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Missouri was held on November 6, 2012, alongside a presidential election, other elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent U.S. Senator Claire McCaskill was unopposed in the Democratic primary and U.S. Representative Todd Akin won the Republican nomination with a plurality in a close three-way race. McCaskill was re-elected to a second term.

zh.t: 美国密苏里州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行密苏里州参议院选举，与总统选举、其他州的参议院选举、众议院选举及州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员克莱尔·麦卡斯基尔在民主党初选中没有对手。共和党籍联邦众议员托德·阿金在竞争激烈的三人初选中以相对多数获胜，赢得共和党提名。麦卡斯基尔连任，开始第二个任期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Connecticut, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Connecticut was held on November 6, 2012, in conjunction with the 2012 U.S. presidential election, other elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Primaries to elect Senate candidates from the Republican and Democratic parties were held on Tuesday, August 14, 2012. Incumbent U.S. Senator Joe Lieberman, an independent who caucuses with the Democratic Party, decided to retire instead of running for re-election to a fifth term.

zh.t: 美国康涅狄格州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行康涅狄格州参议院选举，与总统选举、其他州的参议院选举、众议院选举及州和地方选举同时进行。共和党和民主党初选于2012年8月14日举行。与民主党共同议事的独立派现任参议员乔·利伯曼决定退休，不竞选第五个任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in the District of Columbia, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in the District of Columbia took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. D.C. voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Obama and Biden carried the District of Columbia with 90.9% of the popular vote to Romney's and Ryan's 7.3%, thus winning the district's three electoral votes.

zh.t: 美国哥伦比亚特区总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，哥伦比亚特区与其他各州一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出3名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。奥巴马和拜登在特区获得90.9%的普选票，罗姆尼和瑞安获得7.3%，民主党赢得特区全部3张选举人票。

en.t: United States presidential election in Michigan, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Michigan took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Michigan voters chose 16 electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Michigan was won by Democratic incumbent Barack Obama by a 9.5% margin of victory. Obama received 54.21% of the vote to Romney's 44.71%.

zh.t: 美国密歇根州总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，密歇根州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出16名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。奥巴马以9.5个百分点的优势赢得密歇根州，得票率为54.21%，罗姆尼为44.71%。

en.t: United States Senate election in Texas, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 6, 2012, along with other elections to the United States Senate the United States House of Representatives in additional states. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Kay Bailey Hutchison decided to retire instead of running for re-election to a fourth full term. Libertarian John Jay Myers was elected by nomination at the Texas Libertarian Party State Convention on June 8, 2012. After the first round of primary on May 29, 2012, a runoff was held on July 31, 2012, for both the Democratic and Republican parties, with Paul Sadler and Ted Cruz winning, respectively.

zh.t: 美国得克萨斯州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行得克萨斯州参议院选举，并与其他州的参议院、众议院选举同时举行。共和党籍现任参议员凯·贝利·哈奇森决定退休，不竞选第四个完整任期。自由党候选人约翰·杰伊·迈尔斯于2012年6月8日在得州自由党州代表大会上获提名。5月29日第一轮初选后，两党均于7月31日举行第二轮初选；民主党的保罗·萨德勒和共和党的特德·克鲁兹分别胜出。

en.t: United States presidential election in Vermont, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Vermont took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Vermont voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Repeating his success from 2008, Obama again carried Vermont in a landslide, taking 66.57% of the vote to Romney's 30.97%, a Democratic victory margin of 35.60%.

zh.t: 美国佛蒙特州总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，佛蒙特州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出3名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。奥巴马再次赢得佛蒙特州，得票率为66.57%，罗姆尼为30.97%，民主党领先35.60个百分点，与2008年一样大胜。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 to elect the five U.S. Representatives from the state of Oregon, apportioned according to the 2010 United States Census. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election. All five incumbents, four Democrats and one Republican, were re-elected to another term. Primary elections for Democrats and Republicans were held on May 15, 2012; other parties had other nominating procedures. Several candidates received nominations for multiple parties, as permitted by Oregon law.

zh.t: 美国俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举，选出该州按2010年美国人口普查重新分配的五个众议院席位。选举与总统选举等其他联邦和州职位选举同时举行。五名现任众议员全部连任，其中四人为民主党人、一人为共和党人。民主党和共和党初选于2012年5月15日举行，其他党派采用各自的提名程序。俄勒冈州法律允许同一候选人获得多个党派提名，因此有数名候选人获得不止一个党派提名。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 to elect the nine U.S. Representatives from the state of Massachusetts, a loss of one seat following the 2010 Census, for service in the 113th Congress from January 3, 2013 to January 3, 2015. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election. The candidate elected in each of the state's congressional districts was a member the Democratic Party. Primary elections were held on September 6, 2012.

zh.t: 美国马萨诸塞州联邦众议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州联邦众议院选举，选出该州九名众议员。根据2010年人口普查重新分配席位后，马萨诸塞州减少一席。胜选者将于2013年1月3日至2015年1月3日在第113届国会任职。选举与总统选举等其他联邦和州职位选举同时举行。该州九个选区的胜选者全是民主党人。初选于2012年9月6日举行。

en.t: United States presidential election in Alaska, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Alaska took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Alaska voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Mitt Romney won the state of Alaska with 54.80% of the vote. Barack Obama received 40.81% of the vote.

zh.t: 美国阿拉斯加州总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，阿拉斯加州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出3名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。罗姆尼获得阿拉斯加州54.80%的选票，奥巴马获得40.81%。

en.t: United States presidential election in Arkansas, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Arkansas took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Arkansas voters chose six electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Romney and Ryan carried Arkansas with 60.57% of the popular vote to Obama's and Biden's 36.88% of the vote, winning the state's six electoral votes.

zh.t: 美国阿肯色州总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，阿肯色州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出6名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。罗姆尼和瑞安获得60.57%的普选票，奥巴马和拜登获得36.88%，共和党赢得该州全部6张选举人票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut, 2012
en.s: The 2012 U.S. House of Representatives elections in Connecticut were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, to elect the five congressional representatives from the state, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election, a U.S. Senate election, and state legislature races. Primaries to select Republican and Democratic candidates in some districts were held on Tuesday, August 14, 2012. The Democratic Party candidate won in each of the five districts on Election Day.

zh.t: 美国康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举，选出该州五个国会选区的五名众议员。选举与总统、参议院及州议会选举同时举行。部分选区的共和党和民主党初选于2012年8月14日举行。选举日，民主党候选人赢得全部五个选区。

en.t: United States Senate election in Nebraska, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the 2012 U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S. senator Ben Nelson had chosen to retire instead of seeking a third term.Former U.S. senator Bob Kerrey, a Democrat, and state senator Deb Fischer, a Republican, won their respective parties' primary elections on May 15, 2012. Fischer won the general election with 58% of the vote.

zh.t: 美国内布拉斯加州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州参议院选举，与总统、参议院、众议院及州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员本·纳尔逊决定退休，不竞选第三个任期。民主党前参议员鲍勃·克里和共和党州参议员黛布·菲舍尔分别于2012年5月15日赢得本党初选。菲舍尔在大选中获得58%的选票并获胜。

en.t: United States Senate election in Nevada, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Nevada was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, alongside 33 other elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives, and the 2012 United States presidential election. The primary election was held June 12, 2012. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator Dean Heller, who was recently appointed to this seat left vacant by resigning U.S. Senator John Ensign, was narrowly elected to his first full term over Congresswoman Shelley Berkley.

zh.t: 美国内华达州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行内华达州参议院选举，与其他33个州的参议院选举、众议院选举及总统选举同时进行。初选于2012年6月12日举行。共和党籍现任参议员迪恩·海勒此前获任填补约翰·恩赛因辞职后留下的席位；此次他险胜联邦众议员雪莉·伯克利，当选首个完整任期。

en.t: United States presidential election in Connecticut, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Connecticut took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Connecticut voters chose seven electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Obama and Biden carried Connecticut with 58.1% of the popular vote to Romney's and Ryan's 40.7%, thus winning the state's seven electoral votes.

zh.t: 美国康涅狄格州总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，康涅狄格州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出7名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。奥巴马和拜登获得58.1%的普选票，罗姆尼和瑞安获得40.7%，民主党赢得该州全部7张选举人票。

en.t: United States presidential election in Rhode Island, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Rhode Island took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Rhode Island voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Rhode Island was won by Democratic nominee and incumbent President Barack Obama by a 27.5% margin of victory.

en.t: United States presidential election in Washington (state), 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Washington took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Washington voters chose 12 electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. zh.s: 2012年11月6日，华盛顿州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出12名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。奥巴马以56.16%的得票率轻松赢得该州，罗姆尼获得41.29%，两人相差14.87个百分点。

en.t: United States presidential election in North Dakota, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in North Dakota took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. North Dakota voters chose three electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. en.t: United States presidential election in Missouri, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Missouri took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. Missouri voters chose 10 electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. zh.s: 2012年11月6日，密苏里州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出10名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。罗姆尼获得53.76%的选票，奥巴马获得44.38%，罗姆尼领先9.38个百分点。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 to elect the eight U.S. Representatives from the state of Maryland, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including the quadrennial presidential election and an election to the U.S. Senate. The new congressional map, drawn and passed by the Democratic-controlled Maryland General Assembly, was signed into law by Governor Martin O'Malley on October 20, 2011. The map made the 6th district, at that time represented by Republican Roscoe Bartlett, much more favorable to Democrats.

zh.t: 美国马里兰州联邦众议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行马里兰州联邦众议院选举，选出该州八个国会选区的八名众议员。选举与总统和参议院选举等其他联邦和州职位选举同时举行。由民主党控制的马里兰州议会绘制并通过新的国会选区地图，州长马丁·奥马利于2011年10月20日签署生效。新地图使当时由共和党人罗斯科·巴特利特代表的第六选区更有利于民主党。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on November 6, 2012, alongside a presidential election, other elections to the United States Senate in other states, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Bob Casey, Jr. ran for and won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Tom Smith, and Libertarian nominee Rayburn Smith. The requisite primary elections occurred on April 24, 2012, during which the Republicans and Democrats selected nominees for the general election. The Republican primary was a five-way contest.

zh.t: 美国宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举，与总统选举、其他州的参议院选举、众议院选举及州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员鲍勃·凯西竞选并赢得第二个任期，击败共和党候选人汤姆·史密斯和自由党候选人雷伯恩·史密斯。两党的初选均于2012年4月24日举行，选出大选候选人。共和党初选共有五名候选人。

en.s: (This article is about the United States presidential election held in 2012. For information about other elections held within the United States in 2012, see United States elections, 2012.) The United States presidential election of 2012 was the 57th quadrennial presidential election. It was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012. The Democratic nominee, incumbent President Barack Obama, and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, were elected to a second term, defeating the Republican nominee, former Governor of Massachusetts Mitt Romney and his running mate, Representative Paul Ryan of Wisconsin. As the incumbent president, Obama secured the Democratic nomination with no serious opposition.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行美国总统选举，这是第57届每四年一次的总统选举。民主党候选人、现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和竞选搭档、副总统乔·拜登成功连任，击败共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其竞选搭档、威斯康星州联邦众议员保罗·瑞安。作为现任总统，奥巴马在民主党内没有遇到有力挑战，获得提名。

en.t: United States presidential election in New Jersey, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in New Jersey took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. New Jersey voters chose 14 electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. Due to the difficulty of getting to polling places because of the damage caused by Hurricane Sandy, voters who were displaced were allowed to vote electronically.

zh.t: 美国新泽西州总统选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，新泽西州与其他各州及哥伦比亚特区一同举行总统选举。选民通过普选选出14名选举人，进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马和副总统候选人乔·拜登，对阵共和党候选人、前马萨诸塞州州长米特·罗姆尼及其副手、众议员保罗·瑞安。飓风桑迪造成部分选民前往投票站困难，因此被迫迁离住所的选民获准通过电子方式投票。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 to elect the 13 U.S. Representatives from the state of North Carolina. The elections coincided with the U.S. presidential election, N.C. gubernatorial election, statewide judicial elections, Council of State elections and various local elections. Primary elections were held on May 8, 2012; for races in which no candidate received 40 percent of the vote in the primary, runoff elections (officially known as "second" primaries) were held on July 17.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas occurred on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 to elect the four U.S. Representatives from the state, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election. As the result of redistricting following the 2010 United States Census, the boundaries of the state's congressional districts have been redrawn. Governor Mike Beebe, who signed the new map into law in April 2011, described it as the "status quo" and not partisan.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 to elect the three U.S. Representatives from West Virginia, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. en.t: United States presidential election in New Hampshire, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in New Hampshire took place on November 6, 2012 as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus The District of Columbia participated. New Hampshire voters chose four electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan. On election day, New Hampshire voters chose to re-elect President Barack Obama, giving Obama 51.98% of the vote to Mitt Romney's 46.40%, a Democratic victory margin of 5.58%.

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in California, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in California were held on November 6, 2012, with a primary election on June 5, 2012. Voters elected the 53 U.S. representatives from the state, one from each of the state's 53 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election and a U.S. Senate election. en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 to elect the eight U.S. Representatives from the state of Minnesota. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election and an election to the U.S. Senate. Primary elections were held on August 14, 2012.

zh.t: 美国明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行明尼苏达州联邦众议院选举，选出该州八名众议员。选举与总统和参议院选举等其他联邦和州职位选举同时举行。初选于2012年8月14日举行。

en.t: United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012 and elected the 12 U.S. Representatives from the state of New Jersey, a loss of one seat following the 2010 United States Census. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election and an election to the U.S. Senate.

zh.t: 美国新泽西州联邦众议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行新泽西州联邦众议院选举，选出该州12名众议员。根据2010年美国人口普查重新分配席位后，新泽西州减少一席。选举与总统和参议院选举等其他联邦和州职位选举同时举行。

en.s: The Missouri lieutenant gubernatorial election, 2012 was held on November 6, 2012. Republican Peter Kinder, Missouri's current lieutenant governor, faced off with Democratic nominee and former state auditor Susan Montee, Libertarian Matthew Copple, and the Constitution Party nominee, former state representative Cynthia Davis.

zh.t: 美国密苏里州副州长选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行密苏里州副州长选举。共和党籍现任副州长彼得·金德对阵民主党提名人、前州审计长苏珊·蒙蒂，自由党候选人马修·科普尔，以及宪法党提名人、前州众议员辛西娅·戴维斯。

en.s: West Virginia's 2012 general elections were held on November 6, 2012. Primary elections were held on May 8, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州大选。初选于2012年5月8日举行。

en.t: United States Senate election in Wyoming, 2012
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 6, 2012, alongside a U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican U.S. Senator John Barrasso won re-election to a first full term. The primary elections were held August 21, 2012.

zh.t: 美国怀俄明州参议院选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行怀俄明州参议院选举，与总统、参议院、众议院及州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍现任参议员约翰·巴拉索连任首个完整任期。初选于2012年8月21日举行。
