en.s: The 2012 Wisconsin elections was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin in 2012. The fall general election occurred on November 6, 2012. One of Wisconsin's U.S. Senate seats and all of Wisconsin's eight seats in the United States House of Representatives were up for election, as well as sixteen seats in the Wisconsin State Senate and all 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly.

zh.s: 2012年威斯康星州举行了选举。秋季普选于2012年11月6日举行。该州一个联邦参议院席位、全部8个联邦众议院席位、16个州参议院席位以及全部99个州众议院席位均进行选举。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held in 12 states (including a recall election in Wisconsin on June 5) and two territories. Of the eight Democratic and four Republican seats contested, only that of North Carolina changed party hands, giving the Republicans a net gain of one governorship. These elections (except for Wisconsin) coincided with the presidential election on November 6, 2012.

zh.s: 美国12个州（包括6月5日威斯康星州罢免选举）和两个属地举行了州长选举。在参与角逐的8个民主党席位和4个共和党席位中，只有北卡罗来纳州发生党派易手，共和党净增一个州长席位。这些选举（威斯康星州除外）与2012年11月6日的总统选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2012 Volusia County Chair election was held on November 6, 2012, following a primary election on August 14, 2012, to elect the Volusia County chair. Incumbent County Chair Frank Bruno was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. Three candidates ran to succeed him: County Councilman Carl Persis, U.S. Army veteran Jason Davis, and school board attorney Ted Doran.

zh.t: 沃卢西亚县委员会主席选举，2012
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行沃卢西亚县委员会主席选举，初选于2012年8月14日举行。现任主席弗兰克·布鲁诺受任期限制，不能竞选第三个连续任期。三名候选人竞逐接替他：县议员卡尔·珀西斯、美国陆军退伍军人杰森·戴维斯，以及学区委员会律师特德·多兰。

en.s: The 2012 Wisconsin State Assembly elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012. All 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly were up for election. Before the election, 58 Assembly seats were held by Republicans, 38 seats were held by Democrats, 1 was held by an independent, and 2 were vacant. The primary election was held on August 14, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，星期二，举行威斯康星州众议院选举，改选全部99个席位。选举前，共和党占58席，民主党占38席，独立人士占1席，另有2席空缺。初选于2012年8月14日举行。

en.s: The 2012 Hawaii State House of Representatives Elections were held on November 6, 2012. All 51 seats were up for election. A total of 6 (3 Democratic and 3 Republican) seats changed sides as a result of the election. 2 Republican incumbents failed to secure reelection against Democratic opponents. 3 Republicans took advantage of the redistricting and gained seats in districts vacated by incumbents.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行夏威夷州众议院全部51个席位的选举。选举后有6个席位易手，民主党和共和党各获得3席。两名共和党籍时任众议员败给民主党对手。另有3名共和党人利用选区重划，在时任议员空出的选区赢得席位。

en.s: The Illinois State Senate Election of 2012 was held on November 6, 2012. Elections were held in all 59 senate seats because the election followed a redistricting of the state's legislative districts.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州参议院选举。由于州立法选区刚刚重新划分，全部59个席位都举行选举。

en.s: On Tuesday, November 6, 2012, an election was held in Portland, Oregon, to elect the mayor. Charlie Hales was elected, defeating Jefferson Smith. Incumbent mayor Sam Adams did not seek a second term. Portland uses a nonpartisan system for local elections, in which all voters are eligible to participate. All candidates are listed on the ballot without any political party affiliation.

zh.t: 2012年俄勒冈州波特兰市长选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，星期二，俄勒冈州波特兰举行市长选举。查理·黑尔斯击败杰斐逊·史密斯当选。时任市长萨姆·亚当斯没有竞选第二个任期。波特兰地方选举不分党派，所有选民都可参加投票，候选人以不注明党派的方式列在选票上。

en.s: The 2012 Missouri Attorney General election was held on November 6, 2012, alongside the presidential and gubernatorial elections. The incumbent Missouri Attorney General Chris Koster, a Democrat, won re-election for a second full term against Republican attorney Ed Martin. As of 2026, this is the last time a Democrat was elected Attorney General of Missouri.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行密苏里州总检察长选举，与总统和州长选举同时进行。民主党籍时任总检察长克里斯·科斯特击败共和党律师埃德·马丁，连任第二个完整任期。截至2026年，这是民主党人最后一次当选密苏里州总检察长。

en.t: 2012 New Jersey's 10th congressional district special election
en.s: The 2012 special election in New Jersey's 10th congressional district was held on November 6, 2012. Incumbent Democrat Donald M. Payne Sr. died in March 2012. His son Donald Payne Jr. won the June 5, 2012 Democratic special and regular primaries for this seat and the subsequent special and regular general elections, winning all in landslides.

zh.t: 2012年新泽西州第十国会选区联邦众议员特别选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行新泽西州第十国会选区联邦众议员特别选举。民主党籍时任众议员唐纳德·M·佩恩于2012年3月去世。他的儿子唐纳德·佩恩二世在2012年6月5日举行的民主党特别选举和常规初选中胜出，随后又在特别选举和常规大选中以压倒性优势获胜。

en.t: 2012 West Virginia Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2012 West Virginia Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 2012, to elect the Secretary of State of West Virginia. It was held concurrently with the 2012 U.S. presidential election, along with elections to the United States Senate and United States House of Representatives, as well as various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Secretary of State Natalie Tennant easily won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 2012年西弗吉尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州州务卿选举，与2012年美国总统选举、联邦参议院和众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍时任州务卿娜塔莉·坦南特轻松连任第二个任期。

en.t: 2012 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2012 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 6, 2012, to elect a shadow member to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The member was only recognized by the District of Columbia and not officially sworn or seated by the United States Senate. Incumbent Michael D. Brown was re-elected to a second term.

zh.t: 2012年哥伦比亚特区美国影子参议员选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，哥伦比亚特区举行选举，选出一名代表特区的美国影子参议员。该职位只获哥伦比亚特区承认，没有在美国参议院正式宣誓就职或取得席位。时任影子参议员迈克尔·D·布朗连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2012 Oregon Commissioner of Labor and Industries election was held on November 6, 2012, in order to elect the Oregon Commissioner of Labor and Industries. The election was held on a nonpartisan basis. Incumbent Commissioner Brad Avakian was re-elected, defeating State Senator Bruce Starr.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行俄勒冈州劳工与工业专员选举，选出该州劳工与工业专员。选举不分党派。时任专员布拉德·阿瓦基安击败州参议员布鲁斯·斯塔尔，连任成功。

en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2012, to elect all 41 members to Delaware's House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, Governor, Lieutenant Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary election was held on September 11, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行选举，选出特拉华州众议院全部41名议员。选举与总统、州长、副州长、联邦参议员、联邦众议员和州参议员等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2012年9月11日举行。

en.t: Timeline of the 2012 United States presidential election
en.s: The following is a timeline of major events leading up to the United States presidential election of 2012. The election was the 57th quadrennial United States presidential election held on November 6, 2012.

zh.s: 以下为2012年美国总统选举前重要事件的时间线。2012年11月6日举行的总统选举是美国第57次四年一度的总统选举。

en.t: 2012 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 6, 2012, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Incumbent Shadow Representative Mike Panetta declined to run for a fourth term. Nate Bennett-Fleming was elected in his place.

zh.t: 2012年哥伦比亚特区美国影子联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，哥伦比亚特区举行联邦众议院选举，选出一名影子众议员。与没有投票权的特区代表不同，影子众议员只获特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或取得席位。时任影子众议员迈克·帕内塔没有竞选第四个任期，内特·贝内特-弗莱明当选接替他。

en.s: The 2012 Will County Executive election was held on November 6, 2012. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Larry Walsh ran for re-election to a third term. He was challenged in the Democratic primary by Leonard Thompson, a former state Department of Corrections employee, and won renomination with 68 percent of the vote. In the general election, Walsh was challenged by Republican Cory Singer, the President of the Will County Forest Preserve District.

zh.t: 2012年伊利诺伊州威尔县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州威尔县行政长官选举。民主党籍时任行政长官拉里·沃尔什竞选第三个任期，面对前州惩教部门员工伦纳德·汤普森在民主党初选中的挑战。沃尔什以68%的得票率赢得党内提名。大选中，他面对共和党候选人科里·辛格，后者是威尔县森林保护区区长。

en.s: The 2012 Northern Mariana Islands general election were held on Tuesday, 6 November 2012. The election coincided with the 2012 United States general elections. Voters in the Northern Mariana Islands voted for the non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives, 3 seats in the Northern Mariana Islands Senate, all twenty seats in the Northern Mariana Islands House of Representatives, 4 mayors, seats for the municipal council, seats for the board of education, and 2 judges.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，星期二，北马里亚纳群岛举行大选，与2012年美国大选同时进行。选民选出一名无投票权的联邦众议院代表、北马里亚纳群岛参议院3个席位、众议院全部20个席位、4名市长、市政委员会成员、教育委员会成员和2名法官。

en.s: Elections for the Connecticut State Senate took place on November 6, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行康涅狄格州参议院选举。

en.s: The 2012 Oregon Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 2012, to elect the Oregon Secretary of State. Incumbent Democratic Secretary of State Kate Brown ran for a second term against Republican Knute Buehler. Brown and Buehler ran against each other again in the 2018 Oregon gubernatorial election.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行俄勒冈州州务卿选举。民主党籍时任州务卿凯特·布朗竞选第二个任期，对手是共和党人克努特·布勒。两人后来在2018年俄勒冈州州长选举中再次交锋。

en.s: The 2012 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, with the primary election held on Tuesday, August 28, 2012. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，星期二，举行亚利桑那州众议院选举。初选于2012年8月28日，星期二举行。亚利桑那州选民从多席位选区选出全部60名州众议员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举及亚利桑那州选举同时举行，包括总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州参议院选举。

en.s: Elections were held in California on November 6, 2012. On the ballot were eleven propositions, various parties' nominees for the United States presidency, the Class I Senator to the United States Senate, all of California's seats to the House of Representatives, all of the seats of the State Assembly, and all odd-numbered seats of the State Senate.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，加利福尼亚州举行选举。选票上包括11项公投提案、各党总统候选人、联邦参议院第一类席位、加利福尼亚州全部联邦众议院席位、州众议院全部席位，以及州参议院所有奇数编号席位。

en.s: The 2012 Missouri Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 2012, alongside the presidential and gubernatorial elections. Democratic State Representative Jason Kander defeated Republican Speaker Pro Tem Shane Schoeller by 39,085 votes.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行密苏里州州务卿选举，与总统和州长选举同时进行。民主党州众议员杰森·坎德尔以39,085票的优势击败共和党临时议长谢恩·舍勒。

en.s: The 2012 Delaware Senate election was held on November 6, 2012 to elect all 21 members of the Delaware Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the Presidency, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor, and state house. The primary election was held on September 11, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行特拉华州参议院全部21个席位的选举。选举与总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长和州众议院等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2012年9月11日举行。

en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2012 to elect all 100 members to Montana's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Governor and State Senate. The primary election was held on June 5, 2012. Republicans retained control of the House despite a net loss of seven seats, winning 61 seats compared to 39 seats for the Democrats.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行选举，选出蒙大拿州众议院全部100名议员。选举与总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长和州参议院等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2012年6月5日举行。共和党虽然净失去7席，仍以61席对民主党的39席保住众议院控制权。

en.t: 2012 United States House of Representatives election in Northern Mariana Islands
en.s: The 2012 Congressional election in the Northern Mariana Islands was held on November 6, 2012 to elect the territory's sole Delegate to the United States House of Representatives. Representatives and non-voting Delegates are elected for two-year terms. Delegate Gregorio Sablan, an independent who caucuses with the Democratic Party, has held the seat since its creation in 2008.

zh.t: 2012年北马里亚纳群岛联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行北马里亚纳群岛国会选举，选出该地区唯一一名美国联邦众议院代表。联邦众议员和无投票权代表任期均为两年。独立人士格雷戈里奥·萨布兰自该席位于2008年设立以来一直担任代表，并与民主党团共同活动。

en.s: One justice of the North Carolina Supreme Court and three judges of the North Carolina Court of Appeals were elected by North Carolina voters on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the elections for President, U.S. House, Governor, Council of State, State Senate, State House, and other offices. North Carolina judicial elections are non-partisan. Terms for seats on each court are eight years.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，北卡罗来纳州选民选出一名州最高法院大法官和三名州上诉法院法官，与总统、联邦众议院、州长、州行政委员会、州参议院和州众议院等职位选举同时进行。北卡罗来纳州司法选举不分党派。两个法院的法官任期均为八年。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on November 6, 2012. Primary elections took place on May 29, 2012. Runoff elections took place on July 31, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，得克萨斯州举行选举。初选于2012年5月29日举行，决选于2012年7月31日举行。

en.t: 2012 San Juan, Puerto Rico, mayoral election
en.s: San Juan, Puerto Rico, held an election for mayor on November 6, 2012. Among other elections, it was held concurrently with the 2012 Puerto Rico gubernatorial election. It saw the election of Popular Democracy Party nominee Carmen Yulín Cruz, who unseated incumbent New Progressive Party mayor Jorge Santini.

zh.t: 2012年波多黎各圣胡安市长选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，波多黎各圣胡安举行市长选举，与2012年波多黎各州长选举等其他选举同时进行。人民民主党候选人卡门·尤林·克鲁兹当选，击败新进步党籍时任市长豪尔赫·桑蒂尼。

en.s: The 2012 Wyoming Senate election was held on November 6, 2012, to elect members to the Wyoming Senate for its 62nd session as part of the 2012 United States elections. Partisan primaries were held on August 21. Neither Republicans nor Democrats made any gains in the state senate. Of the fifteen seats up for election, only two saw competition between Republicans and Democrats, with each party winning one.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行怀俄明州参议院选举，选出第62届州议会的议员，这是2012年美国大选的一部分。党派初选于8月21日举行。共和党和民主党都没有增加州参议院席位。15个待改选席位中，只有两个席位出现共和党和民主党之间的竞争，双方各赢得一个。

en.s: The Massachusetts general election, 2012 was held on November 6, 2012, throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections took place on September 6, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，马萨诸塞州举行大选，初选于2012年9月6日举行。

en.s: Michigan's 11th congressional district election was held on November 6, 2012, for a seat in the 113th United States Congress alongside a presidential election, other elections to the United States House of Representatives and elections for class I of the United States Senate. In Michigan, all of the state's 14 congressional seats were at stake. Michigan's junior United States Senator Debbie Stabenow is running for re-election.

zh.t: 2012年密歇根州第11国会选区联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 密歇根州第11国会选区联邦众议院选举于2012年11月6日举行，选出第113届国会的一名议员。选举与总统选举、其他联邦众议院选举以及第一类联邦参议院席位选举同时举行。密歇根州全部14个联邦众议院席位均进行选举。该州初级联邦参议员黛比·斯塔贝诺竞选连任。

en.s: A general election was scheduled in the U.S. state of Idaho on November 6, 2012. Along with the presidential election, Idaho's two seats in the United States House of Representatives were up for election, as were all the seats in both chambers of the state Legislature. Primary elections were held on May 15, 2012.

zh.s: 美国爱达荷州定于2012年11月6日举行大选。除总统选举外，爱达荷州的两个联邦众议院席位和州议会两院全部席位都进行选举。初选于2012年5月15日举行。

en.s: Elections were held in Illinois on November 6, 2012. Primaries were held March 20.

zh.s: 2012年，伊利诺伊州举行选举，初选于3月20日举行。

en.s: The 2012 Utah Attorney General election was held on November 6, 2012. Mark Shurtleff, the incumbent Attorney General of Utah since 2001, elected to retire. Republican John Swallow won the election, defeating Weber County Attorney Dee W. Smith in a landslide and underperformed Republican nominee Mitt Romney in the concurrent presidential election by 13%. In December 2013, Swallow resigned after investigations into improprieties.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行犹他州总检察长选举。自2001年以来担任州总检察长的马克·舒特勒决定退休。共和党人约翰·斯沃洛以压倒性优势击败韦伯县总检察长迪·W·史密斯，当选；他的表现比同日总统选举中的共和党候选人米特·罗姆尼低13%。斯沃洛于2013年12月在不当行为调查后辞职。

en.s: The 2012 West Virginia Senate election took place on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, to elect members to the 81st and 82nd Legislatures; held concurrently with the presidential, U.S. House, U.S. Senate, State House, and gubernatorial elections. State senate seats in West Virginia are staggered, with senators serving 4-year terms. 17 of the 34 state senate seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2012年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，星期二，举行西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举，选出第81届和第82届州议会成员，与总统、联邦众议院和参议院、州众议院及州长选举同时进行。西弗吉尼亚州参议员任期交错，每届四年。本次改选34个州参议院席位中的17个。

en.s: The 2012 Arizona Senate election was held on November 6, 2012. Voters elected members of the Arizona Senate in all 30 of the state's legislative districts to serve a two-year term. These were the first elections following the 2010 redistricting cycle. Since passage of Proposition 106 in 2000, redistricting in Arizona is done by the Arizona Independent Redistricting Commission (AIRC). Following redistricting, many incumbents were moved into new districts.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行亚利桑那州参议院选举，选出该州全部30个立法选区的州参议员，任期两年。这是2010年选区重划周期后的首次选举。自2000年《106号提案》通过后，亚利桑那州由独立选区重划委员会负责重划选区。重划后，许多时任议员被划入新的选区。

en.s: The 2012 Alaska Senate elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, with the primary elections on August 28, 2012. 19 of the 20 districts of the Alaska Senate were up for election. Prior to the election, the Senate was evenly split between Democrats and Republicans, with 6 Republicans joining the Democrats in coalition.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，星期二，举行阿拉斯加州参议院选举，初选于2012年8月28日举行。州参议院20个选区中有19个进行选举。选举前，参议院由民主党和共和党平分席位，其中6名共和党人与民主党组成联盟。

en.s: The 2012 elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives were held on November 6, 2012, with all districts being contested. The primary elections were held on April 24, 2012. The term of office for those elected in 2012 began when the House of Representatives convened in January 2013. Pennsylvania State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with all 203 seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2012年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举，全部选区都进行改选。初选于2012年4月24日举行。2012年当选议员的任期从2013年1月众议院召开会议时开始。宾夕法尼亚州众议员任期两年，全部203个席位每两年改选一次。

en.s: The 2012 Oregon State Treasurer election was held on November 6, 2012, to elect the Oregon State Treasurer. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Ted Wheeler was re-elected to a full term after being appointed to the role in 2010 by Governor Ted Kulongoski due to the death of Ben Westlund and then being elected to finish the term.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行俄勒冈州财政部长选举。民主党籍时任州财政部长泰德·惠勒再次当选完整任期。2010年，州长泰德·库隆戈斯基在本·韦斯特伦去世后任命惠勒担任该职；之后惠勒通过选举完成了剩余任期。

en.s: The Kansas 2012 general elections were held on November 6, 2012. Primary elections were held on August 7, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行堪萨斯州大选。初选于2012年8月7日举行。

en.s: The 2012 Elections for the Illinois House of Representatives was conducted on Tuesday, November 6, 2012. State Representatives are elected for two-year terms, with the entire House of Representatives up for a vote every two years. The votes were as close as to the previous election, but the Democrats were able to win "3/5 of the seats in the House of Representatives (a supermajority in Illinois)".

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，星期二，举行伊利诺伊州众议院选举。州众议员任期两年，全部众议院席位每两年改选一次。此次选举的票数与上届接近，但民主党赢得众议院五分之三的席位，在伊利诺伊州议会中取得绝对多数。

en.s: The 2012 Missouri State Treasurer election was held on November 6, 2012, alongside the presidential and gubernatorial elections. Incumbent Democratic State Treasurer Clint Zweifel was re-elected to a second term against Republican State Representative Cole McNary.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行密苏里州财政部长选举，与总统和州长选举同时进行。民主党籍时任州财政部长克林特·茨魏费尔击败共和党州众议员科尔·麦克纳里，连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2012 Cheyenne mayoral election was held on November 6, 2012, in order to elect the Mayor of Cheyenne, Wyoming. Incumbent Nonpartisan Mayor Richard L. Kaysen won re-election against Nonpartisan candidate John Palmer.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行怀俄明州夏延市长选举。无党派籍时任市长理查德·L·凯森击败无党派候选人约翰·帕尔默，成功连任。

en.s: The 2012 United States state legislative elections were held on November 6, 2012, for 86 state legislative chambers in 44 states. Across the fifty states, approximately 65 percent of all upper house seats and 85 percent of all lower house seats were up for election. Nine legislative chambers in the five permanently inhabited U.S. territories and the federal district of Washington, D.C. also held elections.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，美国44个州的86个州议会院举行选举。在50个州中，约65%的上院席位和85%的下院席位进行改选。美国5个永久有人居住的属地和哥伦比亚特区的9个议会院也举行了选举。

en.s: The 2012 Wisconsin Senate elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012. Sixteen of the 33 seats in the Wisconsin Senate were up for election—the even-numbered districts. This was the first Senate general election to take place after redistricting following the 2010 United States census. Before the election, 17 Senate seats were held by Democrats and 16 seats were held by Republicans.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，星期二，举行威斯康星州参议院选举，改选33个席位中的16席，即所有偶数编号选区。这是2010年美国人口普查后重新划分选区以来首次举行参议院大选。选举前，民主党占17席，共和党占16席。

en.t: 2012 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2012 to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including Presidency, Governor, U.S. House of Representatives, and State Senate. The primary election was held on May 8, 2012 with a primary run-off held on July 17, 2012.

zh.t: 2012年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行选举，改选北卡罗来纳州众议院全部120个席位。选举与总统、州长、联邦众议院和州参议院等职位的选举同时进行。初选于2012年5月8日举行，决选于2012年7月17日举行。

en.s: The 2012 Missouri elections took place on November 6, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行密苏里州选举。

en.s: The 2012 South Carolina Senate elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012. The primary elections were held on June 12 and the runoff elections were held two weeks later on June 26. The current composition of the state delegation is 28 Republicans and 18 Democrats. Senators are elected for four-year terms, all in the same year.

zh.t: 2012年南卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2012年11月6日，星期二，举行南卡罗来纳州参议院选举。初选于6月12日举行，决选于两周后的6月26日举行。州参议院目前由28名共和党人和18名民主党人组成。参议员任期四年，所有席位都在同一年改选。

en.s: On November 6, 2012, the U.S. state of Oregon held statewide general elections for four statewide offices (secretary of state, attorney general, treasurer, and commissioner of labor), both houses of the Oregon Legislative Assembly, and several state ballot measures. The primary elections were held on May 15, 2012. Both elections also included national races for President of the United States and five U.S. House Representatives.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日，俄勒冈州举行全州大选，选出州务卿、总检察长、财政部长和劳工专员等4个全州职位，并选举州议会两院成员和就若干州级公投提案投票。初选于2012年5月15日举行。大选还包括总统和5个联邦众议院席位的全国性竞选。

en.s: The 2012 Hawaii Senate Elections were held on November 6, 2012. State senators in all 25 districts of the Hawaii Senate were up for election. 9 seats were won in the primary uncontested. No seats changed parties in this election.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行夏威夷州参议院全部25个选区的选举。初选中有9个席位无人竞争。此次选举没有席位易手。

en.t: 2012 United States presidential election in Georgia
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential election in Georgia took place on November 6, 2012, as part of the 2012 General Election in which all 50 states plus the District of Columbia participated. Georgia voters chose 16 electors to represent them in the Electoral College via a popular vote pitting incumbent Democratic President Barack Obama and his running mate, Vice President Joe Biden, against Republican challenger and former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney and his running mate, Congressman Paul Ryan.

zh.s: 2012年佐治亚州美国总统选举于11月6日举行，是2012年美国大选的一部分，当年美国50个州和哥伦比亚特区均参加选举。佐治亚州选民通过普选选出16名选举人，代表该州进入选举人团。民主党现任总统巴拉克·奥巴马及其竞选搭档、副总统乔·拜登，对阵共和党挑战者、马萨诸塞州前州长米特·罗姆尼及其竞选搭档、众议员保罗·瑞安。

en.t: 2012 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in New York took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the U.S. presidential election, other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Governor David Paterson appointed then-U.S. Representative Kirsten Gillibrand to serve as U.S. senator from New York until the 2010 special election, succeeding former U.S.

zh.t: 2012年美国纽约州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2012年美国纽约州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行，与总统选举、其他联邦参议院和众议院选举以及各类州和地方选举同时进行。州长戴维·帕特森任命时任联邦众议员克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德接替参议员席位，任期至2010年特别选举；前参议员希拉里·克林顿辞职后出任奥巴马政府国务卿。吉利布兰德在2010年特别选举中以62.95%的得票率击败前联邦众议员约瑟夫·迪奥瓜迪。

en.s: The 2012 Cuyahoga County Council election was held on November 6, 2012, to elect members in even-numbered districts to four-year terms. No seats changed hands in this election, and only District 2 was contested. Democrats defended all four of their seats up for election, maintaining their majority in the chamber.

zh.s: 2012年凯霍加县议会选举于11月6日举行，改选偶数编号选区的议员，任期4年。没有席位易手，只有第2选区出现竞争。民主党守住了全部4个待改选席位，继续在议会中占多数。

en.t: 2012 San Francisco Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2012 San Francisco Board of Supervisors elections occurred on November 6, 2012. Six of the eleven seats of the San Francisco Board of Supervisors were contested in this election. One incumbent was termed out of office, four ran for reelection, and one ran for initial election after being appointed to the seat. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though most candidates in San Francisco do receive funding and support from various political parties.

zh.s: 2012年旧金山监事会选举于11月6日举行，11个席位中有6个进行改选。一名现任监事因任期限制不能继续任职，4人竞选连任，另有一名因获任命就任席位的监事首次参加选举。加利福尼亚州市政选举依法不设党派，不过旧金山多数候选人会获得不同政党的资助和支持。

en.s: The 2012 Wilmington mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, to elect the mayor of Wilmington, Delaware, United States. Incumbent mayor James Baker was ineligible to run again because of term limits. Democratic Party primaries were held on September 11, 2012, and won by Dennis P. Williams. Williams faced a write-in campaign from Kevin Melloy in the general election. Williams won the general election.

zh.t: 2012年特拉华州威尔明顿市市长选举
zh.s: 2012年威尔明顿市市长选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出美国特拉华州威尔明顿市市长。现任市长詹姆斯·贝克因任期限制不能再次参选。民主党初选于2012年9月11日举行，丹尼斯·P·威廉姆斯胜出。威廉姆斯在大选中面对凯文·梅洛伊的写入候选人竞选，并最终赢得大选。

en.s: The 2012 Oakland County Executive election was held on November 6, 2012. Incumbent County Executive L. Brooks Patterson ran for re-election to a sixth term. He was challenged by businessman Kevin Howley, the Democratic nominee. Patterson defeated Howley by a wide margin, winning 57 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2012年奥克兰县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。现任县行政长官L·布鲁克斯·帕特森竞选第六个任期。民主党提名人、商人凯文·豪利向他发起挑战。帕特森以较大优势击败豪利，获得57%的选票。

en.s: The 2012 Washington Secretary of State election took place on November 6, 2012. Republican Kim Wyman was narrowly elected Secretary of State to succeed incumbent Republican Sam Reed, who did not seek re-election.

zh.s: 2012年华盛顿州州务卿选举于11月6日举行。共和党人金·怀曼以微弱优势当选，接替没有竞选连任的共和党现任州务卿萨姆·里德。

en.s: The 2012 New Castle County Executive election was held on November 6, 2012. Incumbent County Executive Paul Clark, who ascended to the role following former County Executive Chris Coons' election to the U.S. Senate in 2010, ran for election to a full term. However, he was defeated in the Democratic primary by former County Executive Thomas P. Gordon, 46–33 percent.

zh.t: 2012年纽卡斯尔县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2012年纽卡斯尔县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。现任县行政长官保罗·克拉克在前任克里斯·库恩斯于2010年当选美国参议员后接任，他竞选完整任期。但他在民主党初选中以46%对33%败给前任县行政长官托马斯·P·戈登。

en.s: The 2012 Washington gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2012. Candidates in the election were chosen in an August 7, 2012 primary election, under the state's nonpartisan blanket primary system, which allows voters to vote for any candidate running in the race, regardless of party affiliation. The two candidates who received the most votes in the primary election qualified for the general election.

zh.s: 2012年华盛顿州州长选举于11月6日举行。候选人由8月7日举行的初选选出，初选采用该州无党派综合初选制度，选民可投票给任何候选人，不受党派归属限制。初选中得票最高的两名候选人进入大选。

en.s: The 2012 Baton Rouge mayoral election was held on November 6, 2012, to elect the mayor-president of Baton Rouge, Louisiana. It saw the reelection of incumbent mayor-president Kip Holden. Since Holden won an outright majority in the first round, no runoff was necessitated.

zh.s: 2012年巴吞鲁日市长选举于11月6日举行，选出路易斯安那州巴吞鲁日市长兼市府主席。现任市长兼市府主席基普·霍尔登连任。他在首轮投票中直接获得过半选票，因此无需举行决选。

en.t: 2012 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 2012 United States Senate election in Washington took place on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the 2012 U.S. presidential election as well as other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Maria Cantwell won re-election to a third term by a significant margin, outperforming President Barack Obama's margin in the concurrent presidential election by 6%.

zh.t: 2012年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2012年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，与2012年美国总统选举、其他美国参议院和众议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。民主党现任参议员玛丽亚·坎特韦尔以明显优势连任第三个任期，她的胜选优势比同期总统选举中巴拉克·奥巴马的优势高6个百分点。

en.s: The 2012 Bay County Executive election was held on November 6, 2012. Incumbent County Executive Thomas L. Hickner ran for re-election to a sixth term. He defeated Mark McFarlin, a perennial candidate, in the Democratic primary, by a wide margin. Hickner faced no opposition in the general election and was re-elected unopposed.

zh.s: 2012年贝县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。现任县行政长官托马斯·L·希克纳竞选第六个任期。他在民主党初选中以较大优势击败长期参选的马克·麦克法林。希克纳在大选中没有对手，因此无竞争连任。

en.s: The 2012 San Diego mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, to elect the mayor of San Diego. Incumbent mayor Jerry Sanders was term-limited and ineligible to run for re-election. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, though some candidates do receive funding and support from various political parties. The non-partisan primary was held Tuesday, June 5, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年圣迭戈市长选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出圣迭戈市市长。现任市长杰里·桑德斯已达到任期限制，不能竞选连任。加利福尼亚州市政选举依法不设党派，但一些候选人会获得不同政党的资助和支持。无党派初选于2012年6月5日星期二举行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Georgia on November 6, 2012. Along with the presidential election, all of Georgia's fourteen seats in the United States House of Representatives and all seats in both houses of the Georgia General Assembly were up for election, as were two seats on the Georgia Public Service Commission. Primary elections were held on July 31, 2012.

zh.s: 佐治亚州于2012年11月6日举行普选。除总统选举外，该州在美国众议院的14个席位和佐治亚州议会两院全部席位都进行改选，佐治亚州公共服务委员会也有两个席位改选。初选于2012年7月31日举行。

en.s: The 2012 New York State Assembly elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, with the primary election on September 13, 2012. Voters in the 150 districts of the New York State Assembly elected their representatives. Districts were redrawn as a result of the 2010 United States census. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including for President, US Senate, Congress, and the state senate.

zh.s: 纽约州众议院选举于2012年11月6日星期二举行，初选于2012年9月13日举行。选民从纽约州众议院150个选区选出议员。根据2010年美国人口普查结果，选区重新划分。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括总统、美国参议院、国会和州参议院选举。

en.s: The 2012 Summit County, Ohio Executive election took place on November 6, 2012. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Russ Pry ran for re-election to a second full term. He won the Democratic primary unopposed and was challenged in the general election by Munroe Falls Mayor Frank Larson, the Republican nominee.

zh.t: 2012年俄亥俄州萨米特县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2012年萨米特县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。民主党现任县行政长官拉斯·普赖竞选第二个完整任期。他在民主党初选中无人挑战；大选对手是共和党提名人、门罗福尔斯市市长弗兰克·拉森。

en.s: The 2012 Pierce County Executive election took place on November 6, 2012, to elect the county executive of Pierce County, Washington. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Pat McCarthy ran for re-election to a second term. She was challenged for re-election by independent Bruce Minker, a corrections deputy at the Pierce County Jail.

zh.s: 2012年皮尔斯县行政长官选举于11月6日举行，选出华盛顿州皮尔斯县行政长官。民主党现任县行政长官帕特·麦卡锡竞选连任第二个任期。她的对手是独立人士布鲁斯·明克，他在皮尔斯县监狱担任惩教副警员。

en.s: The 2012 Salt Lake County mayoral election was held to elect the Mayor of Salt Lake County, Utah on November 6, 2012, alongside the presidential, House of Representatives, Senate, and gubernatorial elections. This marked the fourth election to the office since the post was created in 2000. Incumbent two-term Democratic County Mayor Peter Corroon honored his two-term pledge and did not run for a third term.

zh.s: 2012年盐湖县市长选举于11月6日举行，同时举行总统、众议院、参议院和州长选举。这是该职位自2000年设立以来的第四次选举。民主党现任县长彼得·科伦已连任两届，遵守只任两届的承诺，没有竞选第三个任期。

en.t: 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in New York
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in New York were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, to elect the 27 U.S. representatives from the state. New York lost two congressional seats following the 2010 United States census; the two existing districts that were eliminated were District 9, held by Republican Rep. Bob Turner, and District 22, held by retiring Democratic Rep. Maurice Hinchey.

zh.s: 2012年纽约州美国众议院选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出该州27名美国众议员。根据2010年美国人口普查结果，纽约州失去两个国会席位。被撤销的两个选区是由共和党众议员鲍勃·特纳代表的第9选区，以及由即将退休的民主党众议员莫里斯·欣奇代表的第22选区。

en.s: The 2012 Corpus Christi mayoral election was held on November 6, 2012, to elect the mayor of Corpus Christi, Texas. It saw the election of Nelda Martinez.

zh.t: 2012年科珀斯克里斯蒂市长选举
zh.s: 2012年科珀斯克里斯蒂市长选举于11月6日举行，选出得克萨斯州科珀斯克里斯蒂市市长。内尔达·马丁内斯当选。

en.t: 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, and elected the 14 U.S. Representatives from the state, one from each of the state's 14 congressional districts, an increase of one seat following the 2010 United States census. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a quadrennial presidential election.

zh.t: 2012年佐治亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2012年佐治亚州美国众议院选举于2012年11月6日星期二举行，选出该州14名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。根据2010年美国人口普查结果，该州增加了一个席位。选举还与其他联邦和州级职位选举同时举行，包括每四年一次的总统选举。

en.s: The 2012 New York State Senate elections were held on November 6, 2012 to elect representatives from all 63 State Senate districts in the U.S. state of New York. Primary elections were held on September 13, 2012. Democrats won a total of 33 seats for a three-seat majority.

zh.s: 2012年11月6日举行纽约州参议院选举，改选纽约州全部63个参议院选区的议员。初选于2012年9月13日举行。民主党共赢得33席，取得3席多数。

en.t: 2012 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election
en.s: The 2012 DeKalb County, Georgia Chief Executive Officer election took place on November 6, 2012. Incumbent CEO Burrell Ellis ran for re-election to a second term. Though he faced little-known opponents in the primary, he faced controversy over his relationship with the County Commission. Ellis ultimately won renomination without need for a runoff, but by a narrower margin than expected, receiving 60 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2012年佐治亚州迪卡尔布县首席行政官选举
zh.s: 2012年迪卡尔布县首席行政官选举于11月6日举行。现任首席行政官伯雷尔·埃利斯竞选连任第二个任期。他在初选中面对的对手知名度不高，但因与县委员会的关系而陷入争议。埃利斯最终无需举行决选便获得连任提名，但得票率为60%，低于预期。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 6, 2012. Primaries were held March 20, 2012. Elections were held for Clerk of the Circuit Court, Recorder of Deeds, State's Attorney, all three seats on the Board of Review, three seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县于2012年11月6日举行普选。初选于2012年3月20日举行。此次选举改选巡回法院书记官、契据登记官、州检察官、审查委员会全部3个席位、水资源回收区委员会3个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官职位。

en.s: The 2012 Washington Attorney General election was held on November 6, 2012, concurrently with the other statewide elections and the gubernatorial election. Incumbent Republican State Attorney General Rob McKenna retired to run for governor. Democratic King County Councilmember Bob Ferguson won the general election over Republican King County Councilmember Reagan Dunn.

zh.s: 2012年华盛顿州总检察长选举于11月6日举行，与其他全州选举和州长选举同时举行。共和党现任总检察长罗布·麦肯纳退休并竞选州长。民主党人、金县议会议员鲍勃·弗格森在大选中击败共和党人、金县议会议员里根·邓恩。

en.t: 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington
en.s: The 2012 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, to elect the ten U.S. representatives from the state, one from each of the state's ten congressional districts, a gain of one seat following the 2010 United States census. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including a federal quadrennial presidential election, concurrent statewide gubernatorial election, quadrennial statewide lieutenant gubernatorial election, and an election to the U.S.

zh.t: 2012年美国华盛顿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2012年美国华盛顿州联邦众议院选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出该州10个国会选区的10名联邦众议员；根据2010年人口普查，席位增加了1个。选举与其他联邦和州级职位选举同时举行，包括四年一度的总统选举、州长选举、副州长选举和联邦参议院选举。州政府于2012年12月6日认证选举结果。初选于2012年8月7日举行。

en.s: The 2012 Honolulu mayoral election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2012, to elect the Mayor of the City and County of Honolulu. Kirk Caldwell was elected mayor, beating opponent and former Hawaii governor Ben Cayetano. The position of Mayor of Honolulu is non-partisan. A non-partisan blanket primary was held on August 11, 2012.

zh.s: 2012年檀香山市长选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出檀香山市与县市长。柯克·考德威尔当选，击败对手、夏威夷州前州长本·卡耶塔诺。檀香山市长职位依法不设党派。无党派综合初选于2012年8月11日举行。

en.s: The 2012 New Mexico Senate election took place as part of the biennial United States elections. New Mexico voters elected state senators in all 42 of the state senate's districts. State senators serve four-year terms in the New Mexico Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S House, and state house.

zh.s: 2012年新墨西哥州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。新墨西哥州全部42个州参议院选区均举行选举。州参议员任期四年。选举还与总统、联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州众议院等职位选举同时举行。

en.t: 2012 New Mexico House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2012 New Mexico House of Representatives election took place as part of the biennial United States elections. New Mexico voters elected state representatives in all 70 of the state house's districts. State representatives serve two-year terms in the New Mexico House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including for U.S. President, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State Senate.

en.s: Municipal elections were held in San Diego in 2012 for mayor, city attorney, five seats to the San Diego City Council, and propositions. The primary election was held on June 5, 2012, and the general election was held on November 6, 2012. This was the first city council election to use nine council districts.

zh.s: 圣迭戈于2012年举行市政选举，改选市长、市检察官、圣迭戈市议会5个席位，并就多项提案进行表决。初选于2012年6月5日举行，普选于11月6日举行。这是市议会选举首次采用9个议会选区。

en.s: The 2012 North Carolina State Senate elections selected members to serve in the North Carolina Senate for a two-year term commencing in January 2013. Going into the election, the Senate had 31 Republican and 19 Democratic members, which constituted a two-thirds super-majority for the Republican Party. Following the election, the Senate had 33 Republican and 17 Democratic members.

zh.t: 2012年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举
zh.s: 2012年北卡罗来纳州参议院选举选出新一届州参议员，任期两年，于2013年1月开始。选举前，州参议院有31名共和党议员和19名民主党议员，共和党占三分之二多数。选举后，州参议院由33名共和党议员和17名民主党议员组成。

en.s: The 2012 Illinois judicial elections consisted of both partisan and retention elections, including those one seat of the Supreme Court of Illinois for ten seats in the Illinois Appellate Court. zh.s: 2012年伊利诺伊州司法选举包括党派选举和留任选举，涉及伊利诺伊州最高法院一个席位以及伊利诺伊州上诉法院10个席位。初选于2012年3月20日举行，普选于11月6日举行。这些选举是2012年伊利诺伊州选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2012 elections for the Oregon Legislative Assembly determined the composition of both houses for the 77th Oregon Legislative Assembly. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were on May 15, 2012, and the general election was on November 6, 2012. Sixteen of the Oregon State Senate's 30 seats were up for election, as were all 60 seats of the Oregon House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2012年俄勒冈州议会选举决定了第77届俄勒冈州议会两院的组成。共和党和民主党初选于2012年5月15日举行，普选于11月6日举行。俄勒冈州参议院30个席位中有16个改选，州众议院全部60个席位也进行改选。

en.t: Third-party and independent candidates for the 2012 United States presidential election
en.s: This article contains lists of official third-party and independent candidates associated with the 2012 United States presidential election. "Third party" is a term commonly used in the United States to refer to political parties other than the two major parties, the Democratic Party and Republican Party. An independent candidate is one who runs for office with no formal party affiliation.

zh.t: 2012年美国总统选举中的第三党及独立候选人
zh.s: 本文列出与2012年美国总统选举相关的正式第三党及独立候选人。“第三党”是美国对民主党、共和党这两大党以外政治党的常见称呼。独立候选人则是在没有正式党派隶属关系的情况下参选的人。

en.s: The 2012 Iowa State Senate elections took place as part of the biennial 2012 United States elections. Iowa voters elected state senators in 26 of the state senate's 50 districts—the 25 even-numbered state senate districts and the 49th district. State senators serve four-year terms in the Iowa State Senate, with half of the seats up for election each cycle.

zh.s: 2012年艾奥瓦州参议院选举是当年美国两年一度选举的一部分。艾奥瓦州选民选出26个州参议院选区的议员，包括25个偶数编号选区和第49选区。州参议员任期四年，每轮选举改选一半席位。

The winners of this election served in the 83rd Texas Legislature, with seats apportioned according to the 2010 United States census. State representatives serve for two-year terms.

en.t: Tammy Baldwin becomes the first openly gay politician to be elected to the United States Senate
en.s: Tammy Suzanne Green Baldwin (born February 11, 1962) is an American politician and lawyer serving since 2013 as the junior United States senator from Wisconsin. A member of the Democratic Party, she has also served as the secretary of the Senate Democratic Caucus since 2017. Baldwin has been the dean of the United States congressional delegation from Wisconsin since 2023, when Representative Ron Kind retired.

zh.t: 塔米·鲍德温成为首位公开同性恋身份并当选美国联邦参议员的政治人物
zh.s: 塔米·苏珊·格林·鲍德温（生于1962年2月11日）是美国政治人物和律师，自2013年起担任威斯康星州联邦参议员，资历较浅。她是民主党成员，自2017年起兼任参议院民主党党团秘书。罗恩·金德众议员于2023年退休后，鲍德温成为威斯康星州国会代表团资历最深的成员。

en.s: Stockton, California, held an election for mayor on June 5, 2012 and November 6, 2012. It saw Anthony Silva unseat incumbent mayor Ann Johnston. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州斯托克顿市于2012年6月5日和11月6日举行市长选举。安东尼·席尔瓦击败现任市长安·约翰斯顿，当选。加利福尼亚州市政选举依法不设党派。

en.t: 2012 United States presidential straw poll in Guam
en.s: The 2012 United States presidential straw poll in Guam was held on November 6, 2012. Guam is a territory and not a state. Thus, it is ineligible to elect members of the Electoral College, who would then in turn cast direct electoral votes for president and for vice president. To draw attention to this fact, the territory conducts a non-binding presidential straw poll during the general election as if they did elect members to the Electoral College.

zh.t: 2012年美国总统选举关岛非约束性投票
zh.s: 2012年美国总统选举关岛非约束性投票于11月6日举行。关岛是属地而非州，因此不能选举随后投票选举总统和副总统的选举人团成员。为引起人们对这一情况的关注，该领地会在大选期间举行无约束力的总统民意投票，形式上仿照选举选举人团成员的州。

en.t: Amanda Fritz wins Portland’s 2012 commissioner runoff
en.s: Amanda Fritz won the runoff for Portland city commissioner, position 1, on 6 November 2012. Multnomah County’s official Portland results summary gives her 140,400 votes and 59.19% of the total across the city’s three counties. This runoff is separate from the May primary.
en.n: The actual occurrence year has been corrected using the cited primary record.

zh.t: 阿曼达·弗里茨赢得波特兰市委员第1职位决选
zh.s: 阿曼达·弗里茨于2012年11月6日在波特兰市委员第1职位决选中获胜。马特诺马县官方波特兰选举结果摘要显示，她获得140,400票，占该市三个县总票数的59.19%。这场决选与5月初选分开举行。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Tajikistan on 6 November 2013. Incumbent President Emomali Rahmon was re-elected with a reported 84% of the vote on a turnout of 86.6%. In power since 1992, Rahmon was seeking a new term in office, and was widely expected to be re-elected.

zh.s: 2013年11月6日，塔吉克斯坦举行总统选举。时任总统埃莫马利·拉赫蒙以据报84%的得票率连任，投票率为86.6%。拉赫蒙自1992年以来一直执政，竞选新一届任期，并被普遍认为会连任。

en.s: The 2013 Westchester County Executive election was held on November 6, 2013. Incumbent GOP County Executive Rob Astorino won re-election over Noam Bramson, the Mayor of New Rochelle and Democratic nominee, by a margin of 12 percentage points. As of 2026, this is the most recent time a Republican was elected Westchester County Executive.

zh.t: 2013年韦斯特切斯特县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2013年韦斯特切斯特县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍时任县行政长官罗布·阿斯托里诺击败民主党候选人、纽罗谢尔市市长诺姆·布兰森，以12个百分点的优势连任。截至2026年，这是共和党人最近一次当选韦斯特切斯特县行政长官。

en.t: Battle of the Shaer gas field (October–November 2014)
en.s: The Battle of the Shaer gas field took place between the Islamic State (IS) and the Syrian government for the control over the Shaer gas field (Sha'er gas field) during the Syrian Civil War. It is the second attack that was launched by the Islamic State on the gas field.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 伊斯兰国（IS）与叙利亚政府军为争夺沙尔气田而发生了沙尔气田战役。这是伊斯兰国对该气田发动的第二次进攻。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Bulgaria on 6 November 2016, alongside a referendum on changes to the electoral system and political party funding. The second round was held on 13 November 2016, resulting in the victory of Rumen Radev.

zh.s: 2016年11月6日，保加利亚举行总统选举，并就选举制度和政党经费改革举行公投。第二轮投票于2016年11月13日举行，鲁门·拉德夫获胜。

en.s: The 2016 FAI Cup final was the final match of the 2016 FAI Cup, the national association football cup of the Republic of Ireland. The match took place on 6 November 2016 at the Aviva Stadium in Dublin, and wascontested between Cork City and Dundalk. The match was a repeat of the 2015 FAI Cup Final. Cork City won the game 1-0 after extra time with a late winning goal.

zh.s: 2016年爱尔兰足协杯决赛是该届爱尔兰全国性足球杯赛的最后一场比赛。比赛于2016年11月6日在都柏林的英杰华体育场举行，对阵双方是科克城和邓多克。这场决赛是2015年足协杯决赛的重演。科克城在加时赛后以1比0获胜，凭借比赛末段的进球取胜。

en.s: General elections were held in Nicaragua on 6 November 2016 to elect the President, the National Assembly and members of the Central American Parliament. Incumbent President Daniel Ortega of the Sandinista National Liberation Front (FSLN) was re-elected for a third consecutive term amid charges he and the FSLN used their control of state resources to bypass constitutional term limits and hamstring political rivals.

zh.s: 2016年11月6日，尼加拉瓜举行大选，选出总统、国民议会议员和中美洲议会议员。桑地诺民族解放阵线时任总统丹尼尔·奥尔特加连任第三个连续任期，但有人指称他和该党利用对国家资源的控制，绕过宪法任期限制并打压政治对手。

en.s: The Battle of al-Bab was a battle for the city of al-Bab in the Aleppo Governorate that included a military offensive launched by Syrian rebel groups (including groups affiliated with the Free Syrian Army) and the Turkish Armed Forces north of al-Bab, a separate Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) offensive east and west of the city, and another Syrian Army offensive from the south of the city.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴卜战役是围绕阿勒颇省巴卜市展开的战斗。战斗包括：叙利亚反对派武装（包括与自由叙利亚军有关联的组织）和土耳其武装部队从巴卜以北发动的军事攻势；叙利亚民主力量从城市东西两侧发动的另一场攻势；以及叙利亚政府军从南面发动的攻势。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 2016 Hama offensive, codenamed as the Battle for the Sake of God by the rebels, was a military offensive operation launched by Syrian rebels during the Syrian civil war in the northern parts of Hama Governorate as an attempt to relieve pressure on rebels fighting in Aleppo city.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2016年哈马攻势是叙利亚反对派发动的一场军事行动，反对派将其称为“为真主而战”。行动发生在叙利亚内战期间，目标是叙利亚哈马省北部，意在减轻阿勒颇市反对派武装所承受的压力。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Raqqa campaign (codenamed Operation Wrath of Euphrates) was a military operation launched in November 2016 during the Rojava–Islamist conflict by the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) against the Islamic State (IS) in the Raqqa Governorate, with the goal of isolating and eventually capturing the Islamic State's capital city, Raqqa. The SDF's subsidiary goals included capturing the Tabqa Dam, the nearby city of al-Thawrah, and the Mansoura Dam further downstream.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 拉卡战役又称“幼发拉底河之怒行动”，是叙利亚民主力量在2016年11月于罗贾瓦—伊斯兰主义冲突期间对“伊斯兰国”发动的军事行动，目标是孤立并最终夺取“伊斯兰国”首都拉卡。叙利亚民主力量还计划夺取塔布卡大坝、附近的塞乌拉市和更下游的曼苏拉大坝。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件起始日期。

en.s: The 20th Hollywood Film Awards were held on November 6, 2016. The ceremony took place at The Beverly Hilton Hotel in Santa Monica, California.

zh.s: 第20届好莱坞电影奖于2016年11月6日举行，颁奖典礼在加利福尼亚州圣莫尼卡的比佛利希尔顿酒店举办。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 21st Hollywood Film Awards were held on November 6, 2017. The ceremony took place at The Beverly Hilton Hotel in Beverly Hills, California.

zh.s: 第21届好莱坞电影奖于2017年11月6日举行，颁奖典礼在加利福尼亚州比佛利山庄的比佛利希尔顿酒店举办。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2018 Wisconsin Fall general election was held in the U.S. state of Wisconsin on November 6, 2018. All of Wisconsin's partisan executive and administrative offices were up for election, as well as one of Wisconsin's U.S. Senate seats, Wisconsin's eight seats in the United States House of Representatives, 17 seats in the Wisconsin State Senate, and all 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly.

zh.s: 2018年威斯康星州秋季普选于11月6日举行。州内所有党派职位和行政职位、一个联邦参议院席位、8个联邦众议院席位、17个州参议院席位以及全部99个州众议院席位均进行选举。

en.t: 2018 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election
en.s: The 2018 California Superintendent of Public Instruction election was held on June 5 and November 6, 2018, to elect the Superintendent of Public Instruction of California. Unlike most other elections in California, the superintendent is not elected under the state's "top-two primary". Instead, the officially nonpartisan position is elected at a primary election, with a runoff at a general election if no candidate receives a majority of the vote.

zh.t: 加利福尼亚州公立教育总监选举，2018
zh.s: 2018年6月5日和11月6日举行加利福尼亚州公立教育总监选举。与加州大多数其他选举不同，该职位不采用“前两名晋级”初选制度，而是在初选中选举这一正式上无党派的职位；如果无人获得多数票，则在大选中举行第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2018 Tallahassee mayoral election took place on August 28 and November 6, 2018, to elect the mayor of Tallahassee, Florida. Incumbent mayor Andrew Gillum decided to focus his campaign on the 2018 Florida gubernatorial election instead of seeking re-election which opened up a new seat for the mayor's office. A blanket primary was held on August 28 with both John E. Dailey and Dustin R.

zh.t: 2018年佛罗里达州塔拉哈西市长选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州塔拉哈西市于2018年8月28日和11月6日举行市长选举。时任市长安德鲁·吉勒姆决定专注于2018年佛罗里达州州长选举，不再寻求连任，因此市长职位出现空缺。8月28日举行不分党派的初选，约翰·E·戴利和达斯汀·R。

en.s: In the elections to the Florida State Senate that were held on November 6, 2018, 20 of the 40 seats were contested in regular elections and two seats in special elections. The winners of the 20 regular elections would serve four-year terms from November 6, 2018, to November 6, 2022, and the winners of the two special elections would serve two-year terms from November 6, 2018, to November 6, 2020.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行佛罗里达州参议院选举。40个席位中，20席举行常规选举，另有2席举行特别选举。常规选举胜者的任期为四年，从2018年11月6日至2022年11月6日；特别选举胜者的任期为两年，从2018年11月6日至2020年11月6日。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of South Carolina on November 6, 2018. All of South Carolina's executive officers were up for election, as well as all of South Carolina's seven seats in the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，南卡罗来纳州举行大选，改选全部州级行政官员和该州全部7个联邦众议院席位。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Utah
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Utah took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Utah, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. The primaries took place on June 26.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行犹他州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员，与其他州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及各州和地方选举同时进行。初选于6月26日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Florida gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of Florida, alongside an election to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and other state and local elections. Incumbent two-term Republican Governor Rick Scott was term-limited and could not run for a third term, and he successfully ran for Florida's Class I Senate seat.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行佛罗里达州州长选举，与联邦参议院和众议院以及其他州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍时任州长里克·斯科特已任职两届，受任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期；他成功竞选佛罗里达州第一类联邦参议员席位。

en.s: The 2018 Maryland House of Delegates elections were held on November 6, 2018, as part of the biennial United States elections. All 141 of Maryland's state delegates were up for reelection. Prior to the election, there was little doubt that Democrats would hold their majority in the chamber. Maryland's House of Delegates has had a Democratic majority since the elections of 1920, and it remains a solidly Democratic in elections at both the national and state level.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行马里兰州众议院选举，这是美国两年一度大选的一部分。州众议院全部141个席位都进行改选。选举前，民主党几乎肯定会保住议会多数。自1920年选举以来，马里兰州众议院一直由民主党占多数；在全国和州级选举中，该州至今仍稳固支持民主党。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Arkansas were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the U.S. state of Arkansas, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. Primaries were held on May 22, 2018. The elections and primaries coincided with the elections and primaries of other federal and state offices.

zh.t: 2018年阿肯色州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日，星期二，举行阿肯色州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州的4名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各1名。初选于2018年5月22日举行。选举和初选与其他联邦及州职位的选举和初选同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 Florida Chief Financial Officer election took place on November 6, 2018. Incumbent Republican Chief Financial Officer Jimmy Patronis, who was appointed in 2017, successfully ran for a full term, defeating Democratic nominee Jeremy Ring, a former state senator, in the general election.

zh.t: 2018年佛罗里达州首席财务官选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行佛罗里达州首席财务官选举。共和党籍时任首席财务官吉米·帕特罗尼斯于2017年获任命，此次成功竞选完整任期，在大选中击败民主党候选人、前州参议员杰里米·林。

en.s: The 2018 New Hampshire gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of New Hampshire. Incumbent Republican governor Chris Sununu won re-election to a second term, defeating former state senator Molly Kelly. Sununu was the first incumbent Republican to win reelection as governor since Steve Merrill was reelected in 1994. Primary elections were held on September 11, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州州长选举。共和党籍时任州长克里斯·苏努努连任第二个任期，击败前州参议员莫莉·凯利。这是自1994年史蒂夫·梅里尔连任以来，首位共和党籍时任州长成功连任。初选于2018年9月11日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Arizona Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of Arizona. Incumbent Republican Mark Brnovich won re-election to a second term, defeating former Arizona Department of Health Services Director January Contreras. Primaries took place on August 28, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年亚利桑那州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行亚利桑那州总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长马克·布尔诺维奇连任第二个任期，击败亚利桑那州卫生服务部前主任珍纽瑞·孔特雷拉斯。初选于2018年8月28日举行。

en.s: All 60 seats in the Wyoming House of Representatives were up for election on November 6, 2018, as part of the 2018 Wyoming elections. Primary elections were held on August 21.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行怀俄明州众议院全部60个席位的选举，这是2018年怀俄明州选举的一部分。初选于8月21日举行。

en.s: The 2018 elections for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives was held on November 6, 2018, with all districts being decided. The term of office for those who were elected in 2018 began when the House of Representatives convened in January 2019. Pennsylvania state representatives are elected for two-year terms, with all 203 seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2018年宾夕法尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州众议院全部选区的选举。2018年当选议员的任期从2019年1月众议院召开会议时开始。宾夕法尼亚州众议员任期两年，全部203个席位每两年改选一次。

en.t: 2018 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia
en.s: The 2018 United States Shadow Senator election in the District of Columbia took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a shadow member to the United States Senate to represent the District of Columbia. The member was only recognized by the District of Columbia and not officially sworn or seated by the United States Senate. Incumbent Mike Brown was re-elected to a third term.

zh.t: 2018年哥伦比亚特区美国影子参议员选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日，哥伦比亚特区举行选举，选出一名代表特区的美国影子参议员。该职位只获哥伦比亚特区承认，没有在美国参议院正式宣誓就职或取得席位。时任影子参议员迈克·布朗连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 2018 Massachusetts Senate election took place on November 6, 2018 to elect members of the Massachusetts Senate. Massachusetts voters elected all 40 members of the State Senate to serve two-year terms in the Massachusetts General Court. The election coincided with United States national elections and Massachusetts state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and Massachusetts House. Democrats expanded their supermajority from 31 seats before the election to 34 after the election.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行马萨诸塞州参议院选举，改选全部40名州参议员，任期两年，进入马萨诸塞州议会。选举与美国全国选举和马萨诸塞州选举同时进行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院和州众议院选举。民主党在选举前占31席，选举后扩大绝对多数至34席。

en.s: The 2018 election in North Carolina's 9th congressional district was held on November 6, 2018, to elect a member for North Carolina's 9th congressional district to the United States House of Representatives. Republican Mark Harris, an evangelical minister, defeated incumbent Republican Congressman Robert Pittenger in the primary and then faced Democrat Dan McCready, a veteran and businessman, in the general election.

zh.t: 2018年北卡罗来纳州第九国会选区选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行北卡罗来纳州第九国会选区选举，选出一名进入联邦众议院的该选区代表。共和党候选人、福音派牧师马克·哈里斯在初选中击败时任共和党众议员罗伯特·皮廷格，随后在大选中面对民主党人、退伍军人兼商人丹·麦克雷迪。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Missouri
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Missouri took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Missouri, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections, including Missouri's quadrennial State Auditor election.

zh.t: 2018年密苏里州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行密苏里州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员，与其他州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及各州和地方选举同时进行，其中包括密苏里州每四年举行一次的州审计长选举。

en.s: The 2018 United States state legislative elections were held on November 6, 2018, for 87 state legislative chambers in 46 states. Across the fifty states, approximately 56 percent of all upper house seats and 92 percent of all lower house seats were up for election. Additionally, six territorial chambers in four territories and the District of Columbia were up as well.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，美国46个州的87个州议会院举行选举。在50个州中，约56%的上院席位和92%的下院席位进行改选。此外，4个属地的6个议会院以及哥伦比亚特区也举行了选举。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Nevada were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the State of Nevada, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with the Nevada gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the United States House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年内华达州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行内华达州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州的4名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举与内华达州州长选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 Ohio gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of Ohio, concurrently with the election of Ohio's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various Ohio and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor John Kasich was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行俄亥俄州州长选举，与俄亥俄州第一类联邦参议员席位选举、其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及俄亥俄州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍时任州长约翰·卡西奇受任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Montana
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Montana was held on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Montana, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. This was one of ten Democratic-held Senate seats up for election in a state that Donald Trump won in the 2016 presidential election.

zh.t: 2018年蒙大拿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行蒙大拿州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员，与其他州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及各州和地方选举同时进行。这是10个由民主党现任议员担任的参议院席位之一，这些席位都位于唐纳德·特朗普在2016年总统选举中获胜的州。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Nevada
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Nevada took place November 6, 2018, to elect one of two U.S. senators from Nevada. Incumbent Republican senator Dean Heller lost re-election to a second full term, being defeated by Democratic nominee Jacky Rosen. Heller had considered a bid for Nevada governor but instead announced he would run for reelection to a second full term.

zh.t: 2018年内华达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行内华达州美国参议院选举，选出该州两名联邦参议员中的一名。共和党籍时任参议员迪恩·海勒竞选连任第二个完整任期失败，败给民主党候选人杰基·罗森。海勒曾考虑竞选内华达州州长，但最终宣布竞选连任第二个完整任期。

en.s: The 2018 Arkansas gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Arkansas, concurrently with elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican governor Asa Hutchinson won re-election to a second term, winning by more than 33 percentage points and carrying all but seven counties, marking the largest winning margin of any Republican gubernatorial candidate in Arkansas history.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行阿肯色州州长选举，与其他州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及各州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍时任州长阿萨·哈钦森连任第二个任期，以超过33个百分点的优势获胜，只在7个县落败。这是阿肯色州共和党州长候选人历史上最大的胜选优势。

en.s: The 2018 Wisconsin gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018. It occurred concurrently with a Senate election in the state, elections to the state's U.S. House seats, and various other elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Scott Walker sought a third term, and was challenged by Democratic candidate and then-Superintendent of Public Instruction Tony Evers, as well as Libertarian Phil Anderson and independent Maggie Turnbull.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行威斯康星州州长选举，与该州参议院、联邦众议院及其他选举同时进行。共和党籍时任州长斯科特·沃克竞选第三个任期，面对民主党候选人、时任公共教育总监托尼·埃弗斯，以及自由意志党候选人菲尔·安德森和独立候选人玛吉·特恩布尔。

en.s: A general election was held in the state of Kansas on November 6, 2018. Primary elections were held on August 7, 2018. Voters elected all six executive officers, the lower house of the state legislature, and all of the state's delegations to the U.S. House.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，堪萨斯州举行大选。初选于2018年8月7日举行。选民选出全部6名州级行政官员、州议会下院议员和该州所有联邦众议员。

en.s: The 2018 South Dakota elections were held on November 6, 2018. All of South Dakota's executive officers were up for election as well as South Dakota's at-large seat in the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行南达科他州选举。该州所有州级行政官员和联邦众议院全州单一选区的席位都进行选举。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate special election in Mississippi
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate special election in Mississippi took place on November 6, 2018, in order to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Mississippi. On April 1, 2018, a U.S. Senate vacancy was created when Republican senator Thad Cochran resigned due to health concerns. Mississippi Governor Phil Bryant appointed Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith to fill the vacancy.

zh.t: 2018年密西西比州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行密西西比州美国参议院特别选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员。2018年4月1日，共和党参议员萨德·科克伦因健康原因辞职，造成席位空缺。密西西比州州长菲尔·布莱恩特任命共和党人辛迪·海德-史密斯填补空缺。

en.s: The 2018 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018. The date included the election of the governor, lieutenant governor, and all members of the Maryland General Assembly. Popular incumbent Governor Larry Hogan and Lieutenant Governor Boyd Rutherford, both Republicans, were elected to a second term in a landslide against Democrat Ben Jealous, the former NAACP CEO, and his running mate Susan Turnbull.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行马里兰州州长、副州长和州议会全体成员选举。广受欢迎的共和党籍时任州长拉里·霍根和副州长博伊德·卢瑟福以压倒性优势击败民主党候选人、前全国有色人种协进会首席执行官本·杰勒斯及其竞选搭档苏珊·特恩布尔，双双连任第二个任期。

en.s: The Maryland Attorney General election of 2018 was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of Maryland. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Brian Frosh was eligible to seek a second term in office, filed for re-election on February 15, 2018, and was unopposed for the Democratic nomination. Republican former prosecutor and trade group CEO Craig Wolf was unopposed for the Republican nomination.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行马里兰州总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长布赖恩·弗罗什符合竞选第二个任期的资格，于2018年2月15日登记竞选连任，并在民主党初选中没有对手。共和党前检察官、行业协会首席执行官克雷格·沃尔夫也在共和党初选中没有对手。

en.s: Elections for the Maryland Senate were held on November 6, 2018, with all 47 seats being contested. Republicans had initially hoped to break the Democrats' supermajority in the upper chamber by knocking off five incumbents, known as their "Drive for Five" plan. Though they did make a net gain of one seat, they came short of their goal.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行马里兰州参议院全部47个席位的选举。共和党原本希望通过击败5名时任议员，打破民主党在上院的绝对多数，这项计划被称为“五席目标”。共和党净增1席，但未能实现目标。

en.s: Elections were held in Texas on November 6, 2018. All of Texas's executive officers were up for election as well as a United States Senate seat, and all of Texas's 36 seats in the United States House of Representatives. The Republican and Democratic Parties nominated their candidates by primaries held on March 6, 2018. Convention parties nominated their candidates at a series of conventions.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，得克萨斯州举行选举。该州所有州级行政官员、一个联邦参议院席位和全部36个联邦众议院席位都进行选举。共和党和民主党候选人通过2018年3月6日举行的初选产生，另有一些政党通过多场党代会提名候选人。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Missouri were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Missouri, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts.

zh.t: 2018年密苏里州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行密苏里州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州的8名联邦众议员，每个国会选区各1名。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Delaware
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Delaware took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Delaware, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. The primary for this U.S. Senate election was held on Thursday, September 6, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年特拉华州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行特拉华州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员，与其他州的联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及各州和地方选举同时进行。联邦参议院初选于2018年9月6日星期四举行。

en.s: The 2018 Nevada Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of Nevada. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Adam Laxalt did not run for re-election to a second term and instead ran unsuccessfully for governor. Nevada Senate Majority Leader Aaron Ford won the Democratic nomination and defeated Republican nominee and former Nevada Assembly member Wesley Duncan in the general election.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行内华达州总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长亚当·拉克索尔特没有竞选连任第二个任期，而是转而竞选州长，但未能当选。内华达州参议院多数党领袖亚伦·福特赢得民主党提名，并在大选中击败共和党候选人、前内华达州众议员韦斯利·邓肯。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Michigan
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Michigan took place on November 6, 2018, in order to elect the Class 1 U.S. Senator from the State of Michigan, concurrently with a gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House of Representatives. This was one of ten Democratic-held Senate seats up for election in a state that Donald Trump won in the 2016 presidential election.

zh.t: 2018年密歇根州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行密歇根州美国参议院第一类席位选举，与州长选举及其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举同时进行。这是10个由民主党现任议员担任的参议院席位之一，这些席位都位于唐纳德·特朗普在2016年总统选举中获胜的州。

en.s: The 2018 Michigan gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of Michigan, concurrently with the election of Michigan's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行密歇根州州长选举，与该州第一类联邦参议员席位选举、其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 elections for the Illinois Senate took place on November 6, 2018, to elect senators from 39 of the state's 59 Senate districts to serve in the 101st General Assembly, with seats apportioned among the states based on the 2010 United States census. Under the Illinois Constitution of 1970, senators are divided into three groups, each group having a two-year term at a different part of the decade between censuses, with the rest of the decade being taken up by two four-year terms.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州参议院选举，改选59个州参议院选区中的39个，选出第101届州议会成员。席位根据2010年美国人口普查数据在各州之间分配。根据1970年《伊利诺伊州宪法》，参议员分为三组，每组任期两年，在两次人口普查之间的十年中分别于不同时间选举；十年中的其余时间则进行两次四年任期选举。

en.s: The 2018 election for lieutenant governor of Idaho took place on November 6, 2018. The primary election to select the candidates from each party to run in the general election took place on May 15, 2018. Lieutenant governors serve a four-year term or terms. In 2018, the incumbent lieutenant governor, Brad Little, won the Republican nomination for governor and declined to run for re-election in order to run for governor.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行爱达荷州副州长选举。各党候选人初选于2018年5月15日举行。副州长任期四年。时任副州长布拉德·利特尔赢得共和党州长候选人提名，因此没有竞选副州长连任。

en.s: The 2018 New York gubernatorial election occurred on November 6, 2018. Incumbent Democratic Governor Andrew Cuomo won a third term, defeating Republican Marc Molinaro and several minor party candidates. Cuomo defeated actress and activist Cynthia Nixon in the Democratic gubernatorial primary. Cuomo's running mate, Lt. Governor Kathy Hochul, beat New York City councillor Jumaane Williams in the Democratic primary for the lieutenant governorship.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行纽约州州长选举。民主党籍时任州长安德鲁·科莫击败共和党人马克·莫利纳罗和若干小党候选人，赢得第三个任期。科莫在民主党州长初选中击败演员兼活动人士辛西娅·尼克松。他的竞选搭档、副州长凯西·霍楚尔在民主党副州长初选中击败纽约市议员朱马内·威廉姆斯。

en.s: General elections were held in American Samoa on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect members of the Fono and the non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives from the territory's at-large congressional district. The elections coincided with the nationwide 2018 United States House of Representatives elections and the wider 2018 United States elections.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，星期二，美属萨摩亚举行大选，选出议会成员，以及该属地全州单一国会选区的美国联邦众议院无投票权代表。选举与2018年美国联邦众议院选举和更广泛的2018年美国选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Maine
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Maine was held on November 6, 2018, alongside a gubernatorial election, U.S. House elections, and other state and local elections. Incumbent independent Senator Angus King won re-election to a second term, defeating Democratic nominee Zak Ringelstein and Republican nominee Eric Brakey. This was one of two independent-held Senate seats up for election in a state that Hillary Clinton won in the 2016 presidential election.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行缅因州美国参议院选举，与州长、联邦众议院以及其他州和地方选举同时进行。无党派籍时任参议员安格斯·金击败民主党候选人扎克·林格尔斯坦和共和党候选人埃里克·布雷基，连任第二个任期。这是两个无党派参议员席位之一；这些席位都位于希拉里·克林顿在2016年总统选举中获胜的州。

en.s: The 2018 Wisconsin Secretary of State election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the Wisconsin Secretary Of State. It occurred concurrently with a Senate election in the state, elections to the state's U.S. House seats, and various other elections. Incumbent Doug La Follette who had been serving in the position since 1983 won re-election to a 10th four-year term, defeating Republican nominee Jay Schroeder 53-47%.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行威斯康星州州务卿选举，与该州参议院、联邦众议院及其他选举同时进行。自1983年以来一直担任州务卿的时任官员道格·拉福莱特以53%对47%的得票率击败共和党候选人杰伊·施罗德，连任第十个四年任期。

en.s: The 2018 Alaska Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, with the primary election on August 21, 2018. Voters in the 10 districts of the Alaska Senate elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for the state House.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，星期二，举行阿拉斯加州参议院选举，初选于2018年8月21日举行。阿拉斯加州参议院10个选区的选民选出各自代表。选举与州众议院选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Illinois were held on November 6, 2018, to elect U.S. representatives, one from each of the state's eighteen congressional districts. The primaries for all parties were held on March 20, 2018. The state congressional delegation changed from an 11–7 Democratic majority to a 13–5 Democratic majority.

zh.t: 2018年伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州18个国会选区的联邦众议员。各党初选于2018年3月20日举行。伊利诺伊州国会代表团从民主党占11席、共和党占7席，变为民主党占13席、共和党占5席。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Vermont
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Vermont was held November 6, 2018, alongside a gubernatorial election, U.S. House election, and other state and local elections. Incumbent independent Senator Bernie Sanders won re-election to a third term, defeating Republican nominee Lawrence Zupan. The primaries were held on August 14. This was one of two independent-held Senate seats up for election in a state that Hillary Clinton won in the 2016 presidential election.

zh.t: 2018年佛蒙特州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行佛蒙特州美国参议院选举，与州长、联邦众议院以及其他州和地方选举同时进行。无党派籍时任参议员伯尼·桑德斯击败共和党候选人劳伦斯·祖潘，连任第三个任期。初选于8月14日举行。这是两个无党派参议员席位之一；这些席位都位于希拉里·克林顿在2016年总统选举中获胜的州。

en.s: The 2018 Alabama House of Representatives elections were held on November 6, 2018, as part of the biennial United States elections. All 105 of Alabama's state representatives were up for reelection. In Alabama, members of both the House of Representatives and the Senate serve four-year terms, running in years corresponding with presidential midterm elections. The Republican Party picked up five seats in the chamber, despite national success for the Democratic Party throughout the United States.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行阿拉巴马州众议院选举，这是美国两年一度大选的一部分。阿拉巴马州众议院全部105个席位都进行改选。该州众议院和参议院议员任期均为四年，选举年份与总统中期选举年份相同。尽管民主党在全美取得成功，共和党在州众议院仍增加5个席位。

en.s: The 2018 Texas Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the Attorney General of Texas. Incumbent Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton ran for re-election. The Democratic Party nominated attorney Justin Nelson. Paxton was narrowly re-elected to a second term by a 3.56% margin of victory.

zh.t: 2018年得克萨斯州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行得克萨斯州总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长肯·帕克斯顿竞选连任，民主党提名律师贾斯汀·纳尔逊。帕克斯顿以3.56个百分点的优势险胜，赢得第二个任期。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Maine
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Maine were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Maine, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other offices, including a gubernatorial election, other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行缅因州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州两个国会选区的两名联邦众议员。选举与州长、其他联邦众议院和参议院以及各州和地方职位的选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 Missouri Senate elections were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the seventeen Missouri Senators to the Missouri Senate. Half of the Senate's thirty-four seats are up for election every two years, with each Senator serving four-year terms. The last time that these seats were up was in 2014; the next time was in 2022.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行密苏里州参议院选举，选出17名州参议员。34个州参议院席位中，每两年改选一半，每名参议员任期四年。这些席位上次于2014年改选，下次将于2022年改选。

en.s: The 2018 South Dakota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 2018. Incumbent attorney general Marty Jackley was term-limited and ran for governor of South Dakota. In June 2018, the South Dakota Republican party nominated Jason Ravnsborg for attorney general, and the Democratic party nominated Randy Seiler. Ravnsborg won the election to become the 31st attorney general of South Dakota.

zh.t: 2018年南达科他州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行南达科他州总检察长选举。时任总检察长马蒂·杰克利受任期限制，转而竞选南达科他州州长。2018年6月，南达科他州共和党提名杰森·拉文斯伯格竞选总检察长，民主党提名兰迪·塞勒。拉文斯伯格胜选，成为该州第31任总检察长。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Indiana on November 6, 2018. Three of Indiana's executive offices were up for election, as well as a United States Senate seat and all of Indiana's nine seats in the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，印第安纳州举行大选。选举包括3个州级行政职位、一个联邦参议院席位和该州全部9个联邦众议院席位。

en.t: 2018 Arizona State House of Representatives election
en.s: The 2018 Arizona House of Representatives election took place on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, with the primary election held on Tuesday, August 28, 2018. Arizona voters elected all 60 members of the Arizona House of Representatives in multi-member districts to serve two-year terms. The election coincided with United States national elections and Arizona state elections, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, Arizona governor and Arizona Senate.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，星期二，举行亚利桑那州众议院选举。初选于2018年8月28日，星期二举行。亚利桑那州选民从多席位选区选出全部60名州众议员，任期两年。选举与美国全国选举和亚利桑那州选举同时举行，包括联邦参议院、联邦众议院、州长和州参议院选举。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Florida
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Florida was held on November 6, 2018, alongside a gubernatorial election, elections to the U.S. House of Representatives and other state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Bill Nelson ran for election to a fourth term, but was narrowly defeated by Republican Governor Rick Scott. The election was the closest Senate race in the state's history, and remains the last Florida U.S.

zh.t: 2018年美国佛罗里达州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年美国佛罗里达州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行，与州长选举、联邦众议院选举及其他州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍现任参议员比尔·纳尔逊竞选第四个任期，但以微弱差距败给共和党籍州长里克·斯科特。这是佛罗里达州历史上差距最小的联邦参议院选举，至今仍是该州唯一一次获胜者得票率低于55%的参议院选举。

en.s: The 2018 Maine gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Maine. It occurred along with elections for the U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and other state and local elections. Incumbent Republican Governor Paul LePage was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. He later unsuccessfully sought a third term in 2022.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行缅因州州长选举，与联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及其他州和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍时任州长保罗·勒佩奇受任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。他后来于2022年再次竞选州长，但未能当选。

en.s: The 2018 Illinois gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Illinois. Republican Governor Bruce Rauner ran for reelection to a second term in office, but was defeated by Democratic nominee JB Pritzker. This is the most recent Illinois gubernatorial contest in which an incumbent was defeated and the last time the governorship of Illinois changed partisan control.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州州长选举。共和党籍州长布鲁斯·劳纳竞选连任第二个任期，但败给民主党候选人JB·普利兹克。这是伊利诺伊州最近一次州长选举中时任州长败选，也是该州州长职位最近一次由一党转为另一党。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Oregon were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the U.S. state of Oregon; one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The primaries were held on May 15, 2018. The elections and primaries coincided with the elections and primaries of other federal and state offices.

zh.t: 2018年俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日，星期二，举行俄勒冈州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州5个国会选区的5名联邦众议员。初选于2018年5月15日举行。选举和初选与其他联邦及州职位的选举和初选同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 Iowa Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the Attorney General of Iowa. The election was held concurrently with that year's gubernatorial election. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Tom Miller won re-election with 76.5% of the vote. The Republican Party did not nominate anyone, but the Libertarian Party nominated Marco Battaglia.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行艾奥瓦州总检察长选举，与当年的州长选举同时进行。民主党籍时任总检察长汤姆·米勒以76.5%的得票率连任。共和党没有提名候选人，自由意志党提名马尔科·巴塔利亚。

en.s: The 2018 Oregon gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Oregon to serve a full four-year term. In the 2016 special election, Democratic governor Kate Brown had been elected to serve the last two years of John Kitzhaber's term. The Republican Party nominated Knute Buehler, her opponent in the 2012 Oregon Secretary of State election; the Independent Party of Oregon nominated Patrick Starnes.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行俄勒冈州州长选举，选出任期完整的四年州长。2016年特别选举中，民主党籍州长凯特·布朗当选，接替约翰·基茨哈伯任期最后两年。共和党提名克努特·布勒，他曾在2012年俄勒冈州州务卿选举中与布朗竞争；俄勒冈独立党提名帕特里克·斯塔恩斯。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Vermont on November 6, 2018. All of Vermont's executive officers were up for election, as well as Vermont's Class I Senate seat and at-large seat in the United States House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on August 14, 2018.
