zh.s: 2018年11月6日，佛蒙特州举行大选。选举包括该州所有州级行政官员、第一类联邦参议院席位，以及全州单一选区的联邦众议院席位。初选于2018年8月14日举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Nebraska were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the U.S. state of Nebraska, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. Primaries were held on May 15, 2018. The elections and primaries coincided with the elections and primaries of other federal and state offices.

zh.t: 2018年内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日，星期二，举行内布拉斯加州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州3个国会选区的3名联邦众议员。初选于2018年5月15日举行。选举和初选与其他联邦及州职位的选举和初选同时进行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Minnesota
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a United States senator from Minnesota. Incumbent Democratic–Farmer–Labor U.S. Senator Amy Klobuchar was reelected in a landslide, defeating Republican state House of Representatives member Jim Newberger. This election was held alongside a special election for Minnesota's other Senate seat, which was held by Al Franken until he resigned in January 2018.

zh.t: 2018年明尼苏达州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行明尼苏达州美国参议院选举，选出一名明尼苏达州联邦参议员。民主党—农工党籍时任联邦参议员艾米·克洛布彻以压倒性优势击败共和党州众议员吉姆·纽伯格，连任成功。此次选举与该州另一个参议院席位的特别选举同时举行，该席位此前由阿尔·弗兰肯担任，他于2018年1月辞职。

en.s: The Maryland Comptroller election of 2018 was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the Comptroller of Maryland. Incumbent Democratic Comptroller Peter Franchot filed for re-election to a third term on October 5, 2017, and was unopposed for the Democratic nomination. Anjali Reed Phukan became a candidate under the Republican Party on April 20, 2017, and was unopposed for the Republican nomination.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行马里兰州审计长选举。民主党籍时任审计长彼得·弗兰乔于2017年10月5日登记竞选第三个任期，并在民主党初选中没有对手。安贾莉·里德·普坎于2017年4月20日作为共和党候选人参选，也在共和党初选中没有对手。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Virginia
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Virginia took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the Commonwealth of Virginia, concurrently with other elections to the U.S. Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表弗吉尼亚州的联邦参议员，与其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 Illinois Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of Illinois. Incumbent Democratic Attorney General Lisa Madigan, who had served since 2003, did not seek re-election to a fifth term. Democrat Kwame Raoul won the election with 55 percent of the vote, while Republican Erika Harold took 43 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2018年伊利诺伊州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长丽莎·马迪根自2003年起任职，但没有竞选第五个任期。民主党人夸梅·劳尔以55%的得票率获胜，共和党人埃丽卡·哈罗德获得43%。

en.s: The 2018 New York State Senate elections were held on November 6, 2018, to elect representatives from all 63 State Senate districts in the U.S. state of New York. Primary elections were held on September 13, 2018. In April 2018, The Wall Street Journal described the state senate as the "last bastion of power" of the Republican Party in the State of New York.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行纽约州参议院全部63个选区的选举。初选于2018年9月13日举行。2018年4月，《华尔街日报》称州参议院是共和党在纽约州“最后的权力堡垒”。

en.t: 2018 District of Columbia Attorney General election
en.s: The 2018 District of Columbia Attorney General election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the Attorney General of Washington, D.C. This was the second ever Attorney General election in D.C. history. Incumbent Attorney General Democrat Karl Racine handily won re-election.

zh.t: 2018年哥伦比亚特区总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行哥伦比亚特区总检察长选举，选出华盛顿特区总检察长。这是该地区历史上第二次总检察长选举。民主党籍时任总检察长卡尔·拉辛轻松连任。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in South Carolina were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of South Carolina, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The elections coincided with a gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行南卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举，选出代表该州7个国会选区的7名联邦众议员。选举与州长选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 6, 2018. All of Minnesota's executive officers were up for election as well as all the seats in the Minnesota House of Representatives, several judicial seats, two United States Senate seats, Minnesota's eight seats in the United States House of Representatives, and several seats for local offices.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，明尼苏达州举行大选。选举包括该州所有州级行政官员、明尼苏达州众议院全部席位、若干司法职位、两个联邦参议院席位、该州8个联邦众议院席位，以及一些地方职位。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Michigan were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the 14 U.S. representatives from the state of Michigan, one from each of the state's 14 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other offices, including a gubernatorial election, other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年密歇根州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行密歇根州联邦众议院选举，选出该州14个国会选区各1名联邦众议员。选举与州长、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2018 Connecticut Secretary of the State election
en.s: The 2018 Connecticut Secretary of the State election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next Secretary of the State of Connecticut. Incumbent Democrat Denise Merrill won re-election to a third term.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行康涅狄格州州务卿选举，选出下一任州务卿。民主党籍时任州务卿丹妮丝·梅里尔连任第三个任期。

en.s: The 2018 Tennessee State Senate election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect 18 of the 33 seats for the Tennessee's State Senate. The elections coincided with the Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House, and State House elections. The primary elections were held on August 2, 2018. Following the 2018 elections, no seats changed hands, leaving Tennessee's State Senate delegation at a 28–5 Republican supermajority.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行田纳西州参议院33个席位中的18席选举，与州长、联邦参议院和众议院以及州众议院选举同时进行。初选于2018年8月2日举行。选举后，没有席位易手，田纳西州参议院仍由共和党以28席对5席占据绝对多数。

en.s: Elections to the Indiana Senate took place on November 6, 2018. Primary elections were held on May 8, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行印第安纳州参议院选举。初选于2018年5月8日举行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate special election in Minnesota
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate special election in Minnesota took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a United States senator from Minnesota to replace incumbent Democratic senator Al Franken until the regular expiration of the term on January 3, 2021. Facing multiple accusations of sexual misconduct, Franken announced on December 7, 2017, that he would resign effective January 2, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年明尼苏达州美国参议院特别选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行明尼苏达州美国参议院特别选举，选出一名明尼苏达州联邦参议员，接替民主党籍参议员阿尔·弗兰肯，任期至2021年1月3日届满。弗兰肯面临多项性行为不端指控，于2017年12月7日宣布辞职，辞职于2018年1月2日生效。

en.s: The 2018 Arizona gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Arizona. It was held concurrently with the election of Arizona's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as elections for Arizona's congressional seats and various state and local elections. The primary was held on August 28. Despite considerably closer contests in other Arizona state elections, which included Democratic gains for U.S.

zh.s: 2018年亚利桑那州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。选举与亚利桑那州第一类联邦参议院席位、联邦众议院席位及其他州和地方选举同时举行。初选于8月28日举行。尽管其他州选举竞争更激烈，并出现民主党赢得联邦参议院席位、州务卿和公共教育总监职位等进展，共和党籍时任州长道格·杜西仍成功连任，得票优势略高于2014年，也是所有州级候选人中胜选差距最大者。

en.s: The 2018 Kentucky House of Representatives elections were held on November 6, 2018, as part of the biennial United States elections. All 100 of Kentucky's state representatives were up for reelection. In Kentucky, members of the House of Representatives serve two-year terms. Accordingly, they are up for reelection in both presidential and midterm election years.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行肯塔基州众议院选举，这是美国两年一度大选的一部分。州众议院全部100个席位都进行改选。肯塔基州众议员任期两年，因此在总统选举年和中期选举年都要竞选连任。

en.s: The 2018 Texas gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Texas, concurrently with the election of Texas's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other congressional, state, and local elections throughout the United States and Texas. Incumbent Republican governor Greg Abbott won re-election to a second term in office defeating Democratic nominee Lupe Valdez, the former sheriff of Dallas County, and Libertarian nominee Mark Tippetts, a former member of the Lago Vista city council.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行得克萨斯州州长选举，与得克萨斯州第一类联邦参议院席位选举，以及美国和得克萨斯州其他国会、州级和地方选举同时进行。共和党籍时任州长格雷格·阿博特击败民主党候选人、达拉斯县前警长卢佩·巴尔德斯和自由意志党候选人、拉戈维斯塔市议会前成员马克·蒂佩茨，连任第二个任期。

en.s: A special election for Michigan's 13th congressional district was held on November 6, 2018, following the resignation of Democratic U.S. Representative John Conyers. The Democratic primary was held on August 7, 2018. No Republican candidate ran in the special election, making the win in the Democratic primary tantamount to election in this district.

zh.t: 2018年密歇根州第十三国会选区联邦众议员特别选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日，约翰·康耶斯辞去民主党联邦众议员职务后，密歇根州第十三国会选区举行特别选举。民主党初选于2018年8月7日举行。特别选举中没有共和党候选人，因此赢得民主党初选就等于在该选区当选。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Pennsylvania, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. This was one of ten Democratic-held Senate seats up for election in a state that Donald Trump won in the 2016 presidential election.

zh.t: 2018年宾夕法尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员，与其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。这是10个由民主党现任议员担任的参议院席位之一，这些席位都位于唐纳德·特朗普在2016年总统选举中获胜的州。

en.s: The 2018 California Attorney General election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of California. The 2014 election winner, Kamala Harris, was elected to the United States Senate during the 2016 Senate election; incumbent Democratic Attorney General, Xavier Becerra, won election to a full term.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州总检察长选举。2014年当选的卡玛拉·哈里斯在2016年参议院选举中当选联邦参议员后，民主党籍时任总检察长泽维尔·贝塞拉当选完整任期。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Montana
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Montana was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the U.S. representative from Montana's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年蒙大拿州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行蒙大拿州联邦众议员选举，选出代表该州全州单一国会选区的联邦众议员。选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Alaska were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the U.S. representative from Alaska's at-large congressional district, who would represent the state of Alaska in the 116th United States Congress. The election coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, as well as elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年阿拉斯加州联邦众议员选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行阿拉斯加州联邦众议员选举，选出代表阿拉斯加州全州单一国会选区的联邦众议员，进入第116届国会。选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: One justice of the seven-member North Carolina Supreme Court and three judges of the 15-member North Carolina Court of Appeals were elected by North Carolina voters on November 6, 2018, concurrently with other state elections. Terms for seats on each court are eight years. These elections were partisan for the first time since the elections of 2002.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，北卡罗来纳州选民选出州最高法院7名大法官中的1名，以及州上诉法院15名法官中的3名。选举与其他州级选举同时举行。两个法院的法官任期均为八年。2002年后，北卡罗来纳州司法选举首次恢复党派标识。

en.s: The 2018 Minnesota Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the secretary of state of the U.S. state of Minnesota. Steve Simon, the incumbent and Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) nominee, won the election.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行明尼苏达州州务卿选举。明尼苏达州民主党—农工党候选人、时任州务卿史蒂夫·西蒙赢得选举。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in West Virginia were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the West Virginia, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. The filing deadline was January 27, 2018. The primary elections were held on May 8, 2018. The elections coincided with the other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州联邦众议院选举，选出该州3个国会选区各1名联邦众议员。候选人登记截止日为2018年1月27日。初选于2018年5月8日举行。选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of Colorado, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The Republican and Democratic Party primaries in Colorado were held on June 26, 2018. The elections coincided with the gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年科罗拉多州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行科罗拉多州联邦众议院选举，选出该州7个国会选区各1名联邦众议员。共和党和民主党初选于2018年6月26日举行。选举与州长选举、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2018 Pennsylvania's 7th and 15th congressional district special elections
en.s: Special elections for the 7th and 15th congressional districts in Pennsylvania were held on November 6, 2018, following the resignations of Republican U.S. Representatives Pat Meehan (7th district) and Charlie Dent (15th district).

zh.t: 2018年宾夕法尼亚州第七和第十五国会选区联邦众议员特别选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日，宾夕法尼亚州第七和第十五国会选区举行特别选举，填补共和党联邦众议员帕特·米汉（第七选区）和查理·登特（第十五选区）辞职后留下的空缺。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in West Virginia
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in West Virginia took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of West Virginia, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行西弗吉尼亚州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员，与其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 election for California's 21st congressional district was held on November 6, 2018, during the 2018 elections to the U.S. House of Representatives to determine who would represent California's 21st congressional district. The district, centered in the San Joaquin Valley, represents parts of Fresno County, Kern County, Kings County and Tulare County. It was represented by the incumbent, Republican David Valadao, since 2013.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州第二十一国会选区选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州第二十一国会选区选举，选出代表该选区的联邦众议员。该选区以圣华金谷为中心，涵盖弗雷斯诺县、克恩县、金斯县和图莱里县的部分地区。自2013年以来，该选区由共和党籍时任众议员戴维·瓦拉代奥代表。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in North Carolina were held on November 6, 2018, electing the thirteen U.S. representatives from the State of North Carolina, one from each of the state's congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行北卡罗来纳州联邦众议院选举，选出该州13个国会选区各1名联邦众议员。选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 Connecticut Senate election was held on November 6, 2018, concurrently with the elections for the Connecticut House of Representatives, to elect members to the Connecticut General Assembly. All 36 seats in the Connecticut Senate were up for election. The election resulted in Democrats expanding control in both chambers of the Connecticut General Assembly, ending the split control in the Senate, that had been in place since the 2016 elections.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行康涅狄格州参议院选举，与州众议院选举同时进行，选出州议会成员。州参议院全部36个席位都进行改选。民主党在选举后扩大了对州议会两院的控制权，并结束自2016年选举以来州参议院由两党分掌的局面。

en.s: Virginia's 10th congressional district election was one of the highest-profile United States House of Representatives elections of 2018, and the most competitive in Virginia. Republican incumbent Barbara Comstock lost re-election to a third term to Democrat Jennifer Wexton, a lawyer and state senator representing Loudoun County. In the general election, held on November 6, 2018, the race was called relatively early in the night, with Wexton finishing with 56 percent of the vote to Comstock's 44 percent.

zh.t: 2018年弗吉尼亚州第十国会选区选举
zh.s: 2018年弗吉尼亚州第十国会选区选举是当年最受关注、也是弗吉尼亚州竞争最激烈的联邦众议院选举之一。共和党籍时任众议员芭芭拉·康斯托克竞选第三个任期失败，败给民主党律师、代表劳登县的州参议员詹妮弗·韦克斯顿。11月6日举行的大选中，韦克斯顿以56%对44%的得票率获胜，选举结果当晚较早时便已确定。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Indiana
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Indiana took place on November 6, 2018, along with other elections to the United States Senate and House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Joe Donnelly ran for re-election to a second term, however, he lost in the general election to Republican Mike Braun by a margin of 6%.

zh.t: 2018年印第安纳州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行印第安纳州美国参议院选举，与其他联邦参议院和众议院选举以及各州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍时任参议员乔·唐纳利竞选连任第二个任期，但在大选中以6个百分点的差距败给共和党人迈克·布劳恩。

en.s: The 2018 Wisconsin Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of Wisconsin. Republican incumbent Brad Schimel, first elected in 2014, ran for re-election to a second term. Voting rights attorney and former federal prosecutor Josh Kaul, the Democratic nominee, narrowly defeated Schimel in the general election and became the first Democrat to be elected Wisconsin Attorney General since 2002.

zh.t: 2018年威斯康星州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行威斯康星州总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长布拉德·希梅尔于2014年首次当选，此次竞选连任第二个任期。民主党候选人乔希·考尔是投票权律师和前联邦检察官，他以微弱优势在大选中击败希梅尔，成为自2002年以来首位当选威斯康星州总检察长的民主党人。

en.s: The 2018 Connecticut House of Representatives election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect members to the Connecticut House of Representatives, one from each of the state's 151 General Assembly districts. The date of this the election corresponded with other elections in the state, including ones for governor, U.S. Senate, and the Connecticut State Senate. Democrats retained control of the House of Representatives, winning 92 seats to the Republicans 59.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，星期二，举行康涅狄格州众议院选举，选出州议会151个选区各1名议员。选举与州长、联邦参议院和州参议院等其他职位选举同时举行。民主党保住众议院控制权，以92席对共和党的59席获胜。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Washington were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the 10 U.S. representatives from the state of Washington, one from each of the state's 10 congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年华盛顿州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行华盛顿州联邦众议院选举，选出该州10个国会选区各1名联邦众议员。选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Maryland were held on November 6, 2018, electing the eight U.S. representatives from the State of Maryland, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other offices, including a gubernatorial election, other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年马里兰州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行马里兰州联邦众议院选举，选出该州8个国会选区各1名联邦众议员。选举与州长、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Alabama were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the seven U.S. representatives from the state of Alabama, one from each of the state's seven congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, as well as elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行阿拉巴马州联邦众议院选举，选出该州7个国会选区各1名联邦众议员。选举与其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 Vermont gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Vermont, concurrently with the election of Vermont's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行佛蒙特州州长选举，与佛蒙特州第一类联邦参议院席位、其他州的联邦参议院和众议院，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Maryland
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Maryland took place on November 6, 2018, in order to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Maryland. It was held concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic U.S.

zh.t: 2018年美国马里兰州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年美国马里兰州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表马里兰州的联邦参议员。选举与其他联邦参议院、联邦众议院以及州和地方选举同时举行。民主党籍现任参议员本·卡丁以近35个百分点的优势压倒性连任第三个、也是最后一个任期；这是马里兰州自1913年开始直选参议员以来，该席位差距最大的一次选举。初选于2018年6月26日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Florida Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the Florida attorney general. Incumbent Republican attorney general Pam Bondi was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. Republican candidate Ashley Moody defeated Democrat Sean Shaw in the election on November 6, 2018, at 93% of the precincts reporting. Moody won by about 6 percentage points, the widest margin of any Florida statewide race in 2018.

zh.t: 2018年佛罗里达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行佛罗里达州总检察长选举。共和党籍时任总检察长帕姆·邦迪受任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。共和党候选人阿什利·穆迪击败民主党人肖恩·肖。93%的投票区完成计票时，穆迪以约6个百分点获胜，是2018年佛罗里达州全州职位选举中领先幅度最大的一场。

en.s: The 2018 Nebraska gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Nebraska, concurrently with the election of Nebraska's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various Nebraska and local elections.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行内布拉斯加州州长选举，与该州第一类联邦参议院席位选举、其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及内布拉斯加州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 Delaware Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018. The Delaware primary election for federal and state candidates took place on September 6, 2018. Incumbent Attorney General Matthew Denn announced on August 28, 2017 that he would not seek re-election.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行特拉华州总检察长选举。联邦和州候选人的初选于2018年9月6日举行。时任总检察长马修·登于2017年8月28日宣布不会竞选连任。

en.s: The 2018 Arizona Secretary of State election took place in the U.S. state of Arizona on November 6, 2018, to elect the Secretary of State of Arizona, concurrently with the election of Arizona's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行亚利桑那州州务卿选举，与该州第一类联邦参议院席位选举、其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Arizona on November 6, 2018. All of Arizona's executive offices were up for election as well as a United States Senate seat and all of Arizona's nine seats in the United States House of Representatives. The Republican Party won the majority of statewide offices while the Democratic Party picked up three statewide offices.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，亚利桑那州举行大选。选举包括全部州级行政官员、一个联邦参议院席位和该州全部9个联邦众议院席位。共和党赢得多数州级职位，民主党则增加了3个州级职位。

en.s: The 2018 elections for the Pennsylvania State Senate were held on November 6, 2018, with 25 of 50 districts being contested. Primary elections were held on May 15, 2018. The term of office for those elected in 2018 began when the Senate convened in January 2019. Pennsylvania state senators are elected for four-year terms, with half of the seats up for election every two years.

zh.t: 2018年宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州参议院选举，改选50个选区中的25个。初选于2018年5月15日举行。2018年当选议员的任期从2019年1月参议院召开会议时开始。宾夕法尼亚州参议员任期四年，每两年改选一半席位。

en.s: The 2018 Minnesota State Auditor election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the state auditor of the U.S. state of Minnesota. Julie Blaha, the Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) endorsed candidate, won the election.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行明尼苏达州审计长选举。明尼苏达州民主党—农工党背书的候选人朱莉·布拉哈赢得选举。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in New Mexico
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in New Mexico took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of New Mexico, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Senator Martin Heinrich won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 2018年新墨西哥州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行新墨西哥州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员，与其他州的联邦参议院和众议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍时任参议员马丁·海因里希连任第二个任期。

en.s: The 2018 Colorado Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next attorney general of Colorado. Incumbent Republican Cynthia Coffman did not run for re-election, instead opting to run for governor. The Democratic Party nominated Phil Weiser, who subsequently defeated Republican nominee George Brauchler in the general election.

zh.t: 2018年科罗拉多州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行科罗拉多州总检察长选举，选出下一任州总检察长。共和党籍时任总检察长辛西娅·科夫曼没有竞选连任，而是转而竞选州长。民主党提名菲尔·韦泽，他随后在大选中击败共和党候选人乔治·布劳克勒。

en.t: 2018 United States Shadow Representative election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 6, 2018, the District of Columbia held a U.S. House of Representatives election for its shadow representative. Unlike its non-voting delegate, the shadow representative is only recognized by the district and is not officially sworn or seated. Incumbent Shadow Representative Franklin Garcia won reelection unopposed.

zh.t: 2018年哥伦比亚特区美国影子众议员选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日，哥伦比亚特区举行联邦众议院选举，选出一名影子众议员。与没有投票权的特区代表不同，影子众议员只获特区承认，不会正式宣誓就职或取得席位。无党派籍时任影子众议员富兰克林·加西亚没有对手，成功连任。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Idaho on November 6, 2018. All of Idaho's executive officers were up for election as well as both of Idaho's two seats in the United States House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on May 15, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，爱达荷州举行大选。选举包括全部州级行政官员和该州两个联邦众议院席位。初选于2018年5月15日举行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Wyoming
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Wyoming took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Wyoming. The primary election took place on August 21, 2018. Republican John Barrasso won re-election with 67% percent of the vote, the lowest percentage of his four U.S.

zh.t: 2018年美国怀俄明州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年美国怀俄明州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表该州的联邦参议员。初选于2018年8月21日举行。共和党人约翰·巴拉索以67%的得票率连任；这是他四次联邦参议员竞选中得票率最低的一次，也是自1996年以来民主党人最接近赢得该州参议院席位的一次。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Rhode Island were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of Rhode Island, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The election coincided with the 2018 U.S. mid-term elections, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年罗得岛州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行罗得岛州联邦众议院选举，选出该州两个国会选区各1名联邦众议员。选举与2018年美国中期选举，以及其他联邦众议院和参议院、州和地方选举同时进行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Rhode Island
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Rhode Island took place on November 6, 2018, in order to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Rhode Island. Incumbent Democrat Sheldon Whitehouse was reelected to a third term, defeating Republican Robert Flanders by a margin of twenty-three percent.

zh.t: 2018年罗得岛州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行罗得岛州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员。民主党籍时任参议员谢尔登·怀特豪斯连任第三个任期，以23个百分点的差距击败共和党人罗伯特·弗兰德斯。

en.s: The 2018 Ohio Senate election was held on November 6, 2018, with the primary election held on May 8, 2018. Ohio voters elected state senators in the 17 odd-numbered Ohio Senate districts. State senators elected in 2018 were eligible to serve a four-year term beginning January 2019 and ending December 2022. These elections coincided with elections for Ohio governor, the Ohio House, the U.S.

zh.s: 2018年俄亥俄州参议院选举于11月6日举行，初选于同年5月8日举行。俄亥俄州选民选出17个奇数编号选区的州参议员。2018年当选的州参议员任期四年，从2019年1月至2022年12月。选举还与州长、州众议院、联邦众议院、联邦参议院及其他州级职位选举同时举行。尽管全州选票略向民主党倾斜，共和党仍保住参议院24席的绝对多数，民主党为9席。

en.s: The 2018 California State Treasurer general election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the State Treasurer of California. Incumbent Democratic Treasurer John Chiang did not run for re-election to a second term and instead ran unsuccessfully for governor. The race was between Fiona Ma, Democratic, Chair of the State Board of Equalization (California), and Greg Conlon, Republican, former president of the California Public Utilities Commission, after they won the two top spots from the June 5 direct primary election.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行加利福尼亚州财政部长大选。民主党籍时任财政部长江俊辉没有竞选第二个任期，而是转而竞选州长，但未能当选。民主党候选人梅·方和共和党候选人格雷格·康伦进入大选；两人此前在6月5日举行的直接初选中分获前两名。方克明曾任加利福尼亚州税务均衡委员会主席，康伦曾任加利福尼亚州公共事业委员会主席。

en.s: The 2018 Champaign County, Illinois Executive election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the County Executive of Champaign County, Illinois. The 2018 elections is the first election for the position after voters approved a referendum that adopted a county executive form of government. County Clerk Gordy Hulten won the Republican nomination unopposed and faced Democrat Darlene Kloeppel, the community services director for the Champaign County Regional Planning Commission, in the general election.

zh.t: 2018年伊利诺伊州尚佩恩县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行伊利诺伊州尚佩恩县行政长官选举。这是选民通过公投设立县行政长官政府体制后的首次选举。县书记官戈迪·霍尔滕在无人竞争的情况下获得共和党提名，大选中面对民主党候选人达琳·克洛佩尔，她是尚佩恩县区域规划委员会的社区服务主管。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Connecticut were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the state of Connecticut, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with the gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日，星期二，举行康涅狄格州联邦众议院选举，选出该州5个国会选区各1名联邦众议员。选举与州长、其他联邦众议院和参议院选举，以及各州和地方选举同时进行。

en.s: The 2018 Pennsylvania gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania, concurrently with the election of Pennsylvania's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as elections to the United States House of Representatives and various local elections. Incumbent Governor Tom Wolf won a second term by a double-digit margin, defeating Republican challenger Scott Wagner and two third-party candidates from the Green Party, Paul Glover and Libertarian Party, Ken Krawchuk.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行宾夕法尼亚州州长和副州长选举，与该州第一类联邦参议院席位、联邦众议院和地方选举同时进行。民主党籍时任州长汤姆·沃尔夫以两位数优势连任第二个任期，击败共和党挑战者斯科特·瓦格纳，以及绿党候选人保罗·格洛弗和自由意志党候选人肯·克拉奇克。

en.s: The Wisconsin State Assembly elections of 2018 were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018. All 99 seats in the Wisconsin State Assembly were up for election. The Republican Party maintained a majority it had held since 2011, winning 63 seats, losing one seat, and receiving 44.75% of the voting share. Despite winning a majority of ballots cast, the Democratic Party won only 36 seats, thus remaining a minority and gaining just one seat from the Republicans, District 14.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，星期二，举行威斯康星州众议院全部99个席位的选举。共和党以63席保住自2011年以来一直拥有的多数，减少1席，得票率为44.75%。尽管民主党赢得多数选票，但只获得36席，仍处于少数地位，并仅从共和党手中赢得1席，即第14选区。

en.s: The 2018 Nevada State Assembly election was held on November 6, 2018. The election coincided with elections for other offices including Governor, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and the Nevada Senate. Primary elections were held on June 12. As of 2024, this is the last time Democrats won the popular vote for the chamber.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行内华达州众议院选举，与州长、联邦参议院和众议院、州参议院等职位选举同时进行。初选于6月12日举行。截至2024年，这是民主党最近一次赢得该州众议院普选票。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Mississippi
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Mississippi took place on November 6, 2018, in order to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Mississippi. Incumbent Republican Roger Wicker was re-elected to a second full term, defeating his Democratic challenger, David Baria.

zh.t: 2018年密西西比州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行密西西比州美国参议院选举，选出一名代表该州的联邦参议员。共和党籍时任参议员罗杰·威克击败民主党挑战者戴维·巴里亚，连任第二个完整任期。

en.s: The 2018 Connecticut State Comptroller election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next Connecticut State Comptroller. Incumbent Democrat Kevin Lembo was re-elected to a third term, defeating Republican nominee Kurt Miller.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行康涅狄格州审计长选举，选出下一任州审计长。民主党籍时任审计长凯文·伦博击败共和党候选人科特·米勒，连任第三个任期。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Ohio
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Ohio took place on November 6, 2018. The candidate filing deadline was February 7, 2018; the primary election was held on May 8, 2018. Incumbent Senator Sherrod Brown—the only remaining elected Democratic statewide officeholder in Ohio at the time of the election—won his bid for a third term, defeating Republican U.S.

zh.t: 2018年美国俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年美国俄亥俄州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行。候选人登记截止日期为2018年2月7日，初选于5月8日举行。民主党籍现任参议员谢罗德·布朗是当时俄亥俄州唯一经选举产生的民主党州级官员，他成功竞选第三个任期，在普选中以6.82个百分点击败共和党籍联邦众议员吉姆·雷纳奇。

en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect all 110 members to Michigan's House of Representatives. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, governor and Senate. The primary election was held on August 7, 2018. Republicans retained control of the House, despite losing the popular vote, after a net loss of five seats, winning 58 seats compared to 52 seats for the Democrats.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行选举，选出密歇根州众议院全部110名议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国参议院、美国众议院、州长和州参议院选举。初选于2018年8月7日举行。共和党虽然失去5个席位、普选票也少于民主党，仍保住众议院控制权，获得58席，民主党获得52席。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Tennessee was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the state of Tennessee, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including the senate and gubernatorial election. Following the 2018 elections, no seats changed hands, leaving the Tennessee delegation at a 7-2 Republican majority.

zh.t: 2018年田纳西州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行选举，选出田纳西州9名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举与其他联邦和州级职位选举同时举行，包括参议院和州长选举。选举后没有席位易手，田纳西州代表团仍由共和党以7比2占多数。

en.t: 2018 California State Board of Equalization election
en.s: The 2018 California State Board of Equalization elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018. The primary election was held on June 5, 2018. All four seats on the State Board of Equalization were contested. The board's members serve four-year terms and are limited to two terms. A nonpartisan blanket primary was used for the election, starting with the primary in June 2018.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州平等化委员会选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州平等化委员会选举于2018年11月6日星期二举行。初选于2018年6月5日举行。委员会全部4个席位都要改选。委员任期4年，最多连任一次。此次选举采用无党派综合初选，2018年6月的初选也采用这一制度。

en.t: 2018 North Carolina House of Representatives election
en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect all 120 members to North Carolina's House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. House of Representatives and State Senate. The primary election was held on May 8, 2018, with a runoff on June 26, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年北卡罗来纳州众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行选举，选出北卡罗来纳州众议院全部120名议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国众议院和州参议院选举。初选于2018年5月8日举行，并于6月26日举行决选。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections were held on November 6, 2018. The 2018 House elections were midterm elections that occurred during President Donald Trump's first term in office. Early voting took place in some states in the weeks preceding Election Day. Voters chose representatives from all 435 congressional districts across each of the 50 U.S. states to serve in the 116th United States Congress.

zh.s: 2018年美国众议院选举于2018年11月6日举行。这是唐纳德·特朗普总统第一个任期内举行的中期选举。一些州在选举日前几周开放提前投票。选民从美国50个州的435个国会选区选出代表，进入第116届美国国会。

en.s: The 2018 Ohio State Auditor election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the Ohio State Auditor, concurrently with an election to the U.S. Senate, governor, U.S. House of Representatives, and other state and local elections. Incumbent Republican auditor Dave Yost was term-limited and could not seek re-election to a third consecutive term. Primary elections were held on May 8, 2018, though both the Republican and Democratic nominees ran uncontested.

zh.s: 2018年俄亥俄州审计长选举于2018年11月6日举行，选出俄亥俄州审计长，并与美国参议院、州长、美国众议院以及其他州和地方选举同时举行。共和党现任审计长戴夫·约斯特已达到任期限制，不能竞选第三个连续任期。初选于2018年5月8日举行，共和党和民主党提名人均未遇到党内竞争。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Guam on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, along with the election for the Guam delegate to the U.S. House of Representatives. Before the election, the Democratic Party held nine of the fifteen seats in the Legislature while the Republican Party held six seats. The election resulted in a gain of one seat for the Democrats and a loss of one seat for Republicans.

zh.s: 关岛立法机构选举于2018年11月6日星期二举行，同时举行关岛驻美国众议院代表选举。选举前，民主党在立法机构15个席位中占9席，共和党占6席。选举后民主党增加1席，共和党失去1席。

en.s: The 2018 New Mexico gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of New Mexico, concurrently with the election of New Mexico's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives and various local elections.

zh.s: 2018年新墨西哥州州长选举于2018年11月6日举行，选出新任州长。选举还与新墨西哥州一个第一类美国参议院席位的选举、其他州的美国参议院选举、美国众议院选举以及多场地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The Michigan Senate elections of 2018 took place on November 6, 2018, alongside elections for Michigan's governor, Class I United States Senator, attorney general, and secretary of state, as well as elections for Michigan's 14 seats in the United States House of Representatives and all 110 seats in the Michigan House of Representatives, to elect the 38 members that would comprise the Michigan Senate.

zh.s: 2018年密歇根州参议院选举于11月6日举行，同时举行密歇根州州长、第一类美国参议员、州检察长和州务卿选举，也改选密歇根州在美国众议院的14个席位及州众议院全部110个席位，以选出组成州参议院的38名议员。

en.s: The 2018 New Hampshire Executive Council elections were held on November 6, 2018 to elect all five members of the Executive Council of New Hampshire. The party primaries were held on September 11. The Democrats gained a majority on the council for the first time since 2014.

zh.t: 2018年新罕布什尔州行政委员会选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行新罕布什尔州行政委员会选举，改选全部5名委员。党内初选于9月11日举行。民主党自2014年以来首次在委员会中取得多数。

en.s: The 2018 California's 39th congressional district election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, with a primary election being held on June 5, 2018. Incumbent Republican Representative Ed Royce retired instead of running for a 14th term. This election was one of 53 House elections that were held in California and 435 held nationwide, but it was called "the weirdest race in the country" due to an over-abundance of Democratic candidates potentially spoiling the ability for any Democrats to place first or second in the primary.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州第39国会选区选举
zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州第39国会选区选举于11月6日星期二举行，初选于2018年6月5日举行。共和党现任众议员埃德·罗伊斯选择退休，没有竞选第14个任期。这次选举是加利福尼亚州53场众议院选举之一，全国共有435场；由于民主党候选人过多，可能导致没有民主党人能在初选中进入前两名，这场竞选被称为“全国最奇怪的竞选”。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of New Mexico on November 6, 2018. All of New Mexico's executive officers were up for election, as well as a United States Senate seat, and all of New Mexico's three seats in the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，新墨西哥州举行普选。州内所有行政官员职位、一个美国参议院席位以及新墨西哥州在美国众议院的全部3个席位都要改选。

en.s: The 2018 West Virginia Senate elections were held on November 6, 2018, as part of the biennial United States elections. 17 of West Virginia's 34 state senators were up for election. West Virginia Senate districts each have two elected representatives. State senators serve staggered four-year terms in West Virginia, with one senator from each district up in even-numbered years corresponding to presidential election years (most recently held in 2016), and the other up in even-numbered years corresponding to presidential midterm years.

zh.t: 2018年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年西弗吉尼亚州参议院选举于11月6日举行，是两年一度的美国选举的一部分。西弗吉尼亚州参议院34个席位中有17个改选。每个州参议院选区选出两名议员。州参议员任期交错，每届4年；偶数年改选各选区中的一名议员，最近一次是在2016年；另一名议员则在中期选举年份改选。

en.s: The 2018 Connecticut Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of Connecticut. Incumbent Connecticut Attorney General George Jepsen did not seek re-election. Democratic nominee and state representative William Tong defeated Republican nominee Susan Hatfield.

zh.t: 2018年康涅狄格州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年康涅狄格州总检察长选举于11月6日举行，选出州总检察长。现任总检察长乔治·杰普森没有竞选连任。民主党提名人、州众议员威廉·汤与共和党提名人苏珊·哈特菲尔德竞选，最终获胜。

en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect all 99 members to Ohio's House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, state governor and state senate. The primary election was held on May 8, 2018. Republicans retained a supermajority in the House despite a net loss of five seats, winning 61 seats compared to 38 seats for the Democrats.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行选举，选出俄亥俄州众议院全部99名议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国参议院、美国众议院、州长和州参议院选举。初选于2018年5月8日举行。共和党虽然失去5个席位，仍保住众议院的绝对多数，获得61席，民主党获得38席。

en.s: The 2018 United States Senate elections were held on November 6, 2018. Among the 100 seats, the 33 of Class 1 were contested in regular elections while two others were contested in special elections due to Senate vacancies in Minnesota and Mississippi. The regular election winners were elected to six-year terms running from January 3, 2019, to January 3, 2025.

zh.s: 2018年美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。100个席位中，第一类的33席举行常规选举，另外两席因明尼苏达州和密西西比州的参议院席位空缺而举行特别选举。常规选举当选者的六年任期为2019年1月3日至2025年1月3日。

en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect all 100 members to Montana's House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including the U.S Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state senate. The primary election was held on June 5, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行选举，选出蒙大拿州众议院全部100名议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国参议院、美国众议院和州参议院选举。初选于2018年6月5日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Delaware Senate election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect 10 of the 21 members to Delaware's State Senate. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The primary election was held on September 6, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年特拉华州参议院选举于11月6日举行，改选州参议院21个席位中的10个。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国参议院、美国众议院和州众议院选举。初选于2018年9月6日举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in California
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in California were held on November 6, 2018, with the primary elections being held on June 5, 2018. Voters elected the 53 U.S. representatives from the state of California, one from each of the state's 53 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other offices, including a gubernatorial election, other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，初选于2018年6月5日举行。选民从该州53个国会选区各选出1名美国众议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括州长选举、其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Delaware was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the U.S. representative from Delaware's at-large congressional district, who will represent the state of Delaware in the 116th United States Congress. The election coincided with the election of a U.S. Senator from Delaware and other federal and state offices. Democratic Congresswoman Lisa Blunt Rochester, the incumbent, won re-election.

zh.t: 2018年特拉华州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年特拉华州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表特拉华州唯一一个国会选区的美国众议员，任职于第116届美国国会。选举还与特拉华州美国参议员及其他联邦和州级职位选举同时举行。现任民主党众议员丽莎·布朗特·罗切斯特成功连任。

en.s: The 2018 South Dakota gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of South Dakota. Incumbent Republican governor Dennis Daugaard was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. Republican candidate Kristi Noem won against Democratic candidate Billie Sutton in the closest gubernatorial election in South Dakota history. Noem also became the first female governor of the state.

zh.s: 2018年南达科他州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出新任州长。共和党现任州长丹尼斯·道高德已达到任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。共和党候选人克里斯蒂·诺姆击败民主党候选人比利·萨顿，当选；这是南达科他州历史上差距最小的州长选举。诺姆也成为该州首位女州长。

en.t: 2018 West Virginia House of Delegates election
en.s: Elections to the West Virginia House of Delegates took place on November 6, 2018. All the seats in the West Virginia House of Delegates were up for election.

zh.t: 2018年西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举
zh.s: 西弗吉尼亚州众议院选举于2018年11月6日举行，众议院全部席位都进行改选。

en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect 25 members to Montana's Senate. The election coincided with elections for other offices, including the U.S Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, and state house. The primary election was held on June 2, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行选举，选出蒙大拿州参议院25名议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国参议院、美国众议院和州众议院选举。初选于2018年6月2日举行。

en.s: The 2018 South Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of South Carolina. Incumbent Republican Governor Henry McMaster, who took office after Nikki Haley resigned to become U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations, ran for election to a full term. The primary was held on June 12, with the Democrats nominating State Representative James E. Smith Jr.

zh.s: 2018年南卡罗来纳州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。共和党现任州长亨利·麦克马斯特在尼基·黑利辞职出任美国驻联合国大使后接任州长，并竞选完整任期。初选于6月12日举行，民主党提名了州众议员詹姆斯·E·史密斯。

en.s: The 2018 Kansas gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of Kansas. On July 26, 2017, Governor Sam Brownback was nominated by President Donald Trump to serve as United States Ambassador-at-Large for International Religious Freedom. He was confirmed by the United States Senate on January 24, 2018; he resigned the governorship on January 31 and was succeeded by Lieutenant Governor Jeff Colyer.

zh.s: 2018年堪萨斯州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出新任州长。2017年7月26日，州长萨姆·布朗巴克获唐纳德·特朗普总统提名，出任美国国际宗教自由无任所大使。美国参议院于2018年1月24日确认提名；布朗巴克于1月31日辞去州长职务，副州长杰夫·科尔耶继任。

en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect all 41 members to Delaware's House of Representatives. The election coincided with the elections for other offices, including for the U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, attorney general, state treasurer, and state senate. The primary election was held on September 6, 2018. Democrats consolidated their majority in the House by gaining one seat, winning 26 seats compared to 15 seats for the Republicans.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行选举，选出特拉华州众议院全部41名议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国参议院、美国众议院、州总检察长、州财政部长和州参议院选举。初选于2018年9月6日举行。民主党增加1席，进一步巩固在众议院的多数，以26席对共和党的15席。

en.s: On November 6, 2018, the U.S. state of Massachusetts held an election for each of the eight total seats for the Massachusetts Governor's Council. Joseph Ferreia won the Democratic Party primary election vote, while Thomas Keyes won the overall Republican Party primary vote. Robert Jubinville was the independent candidate for the District 2 of the 8. Marilyn Petitto Devaney won the vote for District 3, against Nick Carter by 10,000 votes.

zh.t: 2018年马萨诸塞州州长委员会选举
zh.s: 2018年11月6日，马萨诸塞州举行选举，改选州长委员会全部8个席位。约瑟夫·费雷拉赢得民主党初选，托马斯·凯斯赢得共和党初选。罗伯特·朱宾维尔作为独立候选人竞选第2选区。玛丽莲·佩蒂托·德瓦尼在第3选区以一万票之差击败尼克·卡特。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Oklahoma were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the five U.S. representatives from the state of Oklahoma, one from each of the state's five congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年俄克拉何马州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年俄克拉何马州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州5名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Idaho were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the U.S. state of Idaho, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. Primaries were held on May 15, 2018. The elections and primaries coincided with the elections and primaries of other federal and state offices.

zh.t: 2018年爱达荷州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年爱达荷州美国众议院选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出该州2名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。初选于2018年5月15日举行。选举和初选还与其他联邦及州级职位的选举和初选同时举行。

en.s: The 2018 Nebraska elections were held on November 6, 2018. All of Nebraska's executive were up for election, as well as a United States Senate seat, all three of Nebraska's seats in the United States House of Representatives, half of the seats in the Nebraska Legislature, and seats on the Nebraska Public Service Commission, the State Board of Education, and the Board of Regents.

zh.s: 2018年内布拉斯加州选举于11月6日举行。州内所有行政职位、一个美国参议院席位、该州在美国众议院的全部3个席位、内布拉斯加州议会一半席位，以及公共服务委员会、州教育委员会和摄政委员会的席位都要改选。

en.s: The 2018 Connecticut State Treasurer election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next Connecticut State Treasurer. Five-term incumbent Democratic Party Treasurer Denise Nappier did not seek re-election. Democratic nominee Shawn Wooden defeated Republican nominee Thad Gray with 55.1% of the vote.

zh.t: 2018年康涅狄格州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2018年康涅狄格州财政部长选举于11月6日举行，选出新任州财政部长。担任五届财政部长的民主党人丹尼斯·纳皮尔没有竞选连任。民主党提名人肖恩·伍登击败共和党提名人撒迪厄斯·格雷，获得55.1%的选票。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in New Jersey were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the 12 U.S. representatives from the state of New Jersey, one from each of the state's 12 congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年新泽西州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年新泽西州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州12名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives election in North Dakota was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the U.S. representative for North Dakota's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the U.S. Senate election, as well as other statewide, legislative, and local elections. Though incumbent Republican U.S. Representative Kevin Cramer announced on January 11, 2018 that he would run for re-election to a fourth term, he later expressed an intention to run for the United States Senate instead.

zh.t: 2018年北达科他州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年北达科他州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州唯一一个国会选区的美国众议员。选举还与美国参议院选举以及其他全州、州议会和地方选举同时举行。共和党现任众议员凯文·克莱默于2018年1月11日宣布竞选连任第四个任期，后来改为有意竞选美国参议院。

en.s: The 2018 Massachusetts gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts. Republican Governor Charlie Baker and Lieutenant Governor Karyn Polito won election to a second term in office, defeating Democratic challengers Jay Gonzalez and Quentin Palfrey, respectively. Candidates were selected in the primary election held on September 4, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年马萨诸塞州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长和副州长。共和党州长查理·贝克和副州长卡琳·波利托击败民主党挑战者杰伊·冈萨雷斯和昆廷·帕尔弗雷，连任第二个任期。候选人由2018年9月4日举行的初选选出。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Oregon on November 6, 2018. Primary elections were held on May 15, 2018.

zh.s: 俄勒冈州于2018年11月6日举行普选。初选于2018年5月15日举行。

en.t: 2018 United States Virgin Islands gubernatorial election
en.s: The 2018 U.S. Virgin Islands gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to select the governor of the United States Virgin Islands. The election was held concurrently with the 2018 United States midterm elections. On election day, November 6, Bryan earned 38.08% of the vote, with Mapp coming in second with 33.45%.

zh.t: 2018年美属维尔京群岛州长选举
zh.s: 2018年美属维尔京群岛州长选举于11月6日举行，选出美属维尔京群岛州长。选举与2018年美国中期选举同时举行。投票日当天，布莱恩获得38.08%的选票，马普以33.45%排名第二。

en.s: The 2018 California State Assembly election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, with the primary election being held on June 5, 2018. Voters in the 80 districts of the California State Assembly elected their representatives. The election coincided with those for other offices, including for governor and the California State Senate. The Democratic Party flipped five Republican seats: the 16th, 38th, 40th, 74th, and 76th districts.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州州众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州州众议院选举于11月6日星期二举行，初选于2018年6月5日举行。选民从加利福尼亚州众议院80个选区中选出代表。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括州长和加利福尼亚州参议院选举。民主党在第16、38、40、74和76选区赢得5个原属共和党的席位。

en.s: A special election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 6, 2018, to elect a new senator for District 13 in the Minnesota Senate, caused by the resignation of Republican Senator Michelle Fischbach effective on May 25, 2018. The special election determined which political party would control the Senate given that Fischbach's resignation left it equally divided between the Republicans and the DFL.

zh.t: 2018年明尼苏达州参议院第13选区特别选举
zh.s: 明尼苏达州于2018年11月6日举行特别选举，选出州参议院第13选区的新议员。共和党参议员米歇尔·菲施巴赫于2018年5月25日辞职，引发此次选举。菲施巴赫辞职后，共和党和民主党农民劳工党在参议院席位数相同，此次选举决定由哪个党控制参议院。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in New Mexico were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the three U.S. representatives from the state of New Mexico, one from each of the state's three congressional districts. The elections coincided with the gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年新墨西哥州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年新墨西哥州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州3名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与州长选举、其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Florida were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the 27 U.S. representatives from the state of Florida, one from each of the state's 27 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other offices, including a gubernatorial election, other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年佛罗里达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年佛罗里达州美国众议院选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出该州27名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括州长选举、其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举。

en.s: The 2018 Rhode Island gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Rhode Island, concurrently with the election of Rhode Island's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2018年罗得岛州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。选举还与罗得岛州一个第一类美国参议院席位的选举、其他州的美国参议院选举、美国众议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2018 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018. Incumbent Governor Kay Ivey (R), who took office upon the resignation of Robert Bentley (R), ran for election to a full term and defeated Democratic Tuscaloosa mayor Walt Maddox by a wide margin. Ivey was sworn in for her first full term on January 14, 2019.

zh.s: 2018年阿拉巴马州州长选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任州长凯·艾维在罗伯特·本特利辞职后接任州长，她竞选完整任期，并以较大优势击败民主党候选人、塔斯卡卢萨市长沃尔特·麦多克斯。艾维于2019年1月14日宣誓就任首个完整任期。

en.s: On November 6, 2018, Washington, D.C., held an election for its mayor. Incumbent Democrat Muriel Bowser won re-election, becoming the first mayor to do so for Washington, D.C., since Anthony A. Williams won a second term in 2002. In the first 80 days of her re-election campaign, Bowser raised about $1.4 million for her campaign fund.

zh.t: 2018年华盛顿哥伦比亚特区市长选举
zh.s: 华盛顿哥伦比亚特区于2018年11月6日举行市长选举。现任民主党市长穆里尔·鲍泽成功连任，成为自安东尼·A·威廉姆斯于2002年连任以来，该区首位成功连任的市长。在连任竞选的前80天里，鲍泽为竞选基金筹得约140万美元。

en.s: The 2018 Yap gubernatorial election took place on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the Governor and Lieutenant Governor of the Yap State in the Federated States of Micronesia to a four-year term in office. The election coincided with the Yap State general election, including legislative contests to select Senators of the Yap State Legislature.

zh.s: 2018年雅浦州州长选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出密克罗尼西亚联邦雅浦州州长和副州长，任期4年。选举与雅浦州普选同时举行，其中包括选出雅浦州议会议员的立法选举。

en.s: The 2018 elections for the Illinois House of Representatives took place on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect representatives from all 118 districts. The winners of this election served in the 101st General Assembly, with seats apportioned among the states based on the 2010 United States census. The Democratic Party had held a House majority since 1997. The inauguration of the 101st General Assembly occurred on Wednesday, January 9, 2019.

zh.s: 2018年伊利诺伊州众议院选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出该州118个选区的议员。当选者进入第101届伊利诺伊州议会，席位按2010年美国人口普查结果分配。民主党自1997年以来一直在众议院占多数。第101届州议会于2019年1月9日星期三就职。

en.s: The 2018 California Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the California Secretary of State. Incumbent Democratic Secretary Alex Padilla won re-election to a second term.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举
zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州州务卿选举于11月6日举行，选出州务卿。现任民主党州务卿亚历克斯·帕迪利亚成功连任，开始第二个任期。

en.s: A general election was held in Montana on November 6, 2018. Montana's Class 1 United States Senate seat and its seat in the United States House of Representatives were up for elections, along with all of the seats in the Montana House of Representatives and half of the seats in the Montana Senate. Various local offices and ballot measures were also up for election.

zh.s: 蒙大拿州于2018年11月6日举行普选。该州第一类美国参议院席位和美国众议院席位进行改选，蒙大拿州众议院全部席位及州参议院一半席位也进行改选。此外，还有多个地方职位和公投议题进行选举。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Wyoming on November 6, 2018. All of Wyoming's executive offices were up for election, as well as a United States Senate seat and Wyoming's at-large seat in the United States House of Representatives. Primary elections were held on August 21, 2018.

zh.s: 怀俄明州于2018年11月6日举行普选。州内所有行政职位、一个美国参议院席位以及怀俄明州在美国众议院的唯一席位都要改选。初选于2018年8月21日举行。

loc: 俄克拉何马县，俄克拉何马州，美国

en.s: The 2018 Oklahoma gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of Oklahoma. Incumbent Republican governor Mary Fallin was term-limited, and was prohibited by the Constitution of Oklahoma from seeking a third term. Republican Businessman Kevin Stitt was elected with 54.3% of the vote, defeating Democratic nominee and former Oklahoma attorney general Drew Edmondson. Primary elections occurred on June 26, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年俄克拉何马州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出新任州长。共和党现任州长玛丽·法林已达到任期限制，州宪法禁止她竞选第三个任期。共和党商人凯文·斯蒂特获得54.3%的选票，当选并击败民主党提名人、俄克拉何马州前总检察长德鲁·埃德蒙森。初选于2018年6月26日举行。

en.s: The 2018 New York Comptroller election was held on November 6, 2018, alongside other New York elections for Governor, State Senate, State Assembly, and Attorney General. Incumbent Democrat Thomas DiNapoli easily won a third term, defeating Republican nominee Jonathan Trichter and minor party candidates. In the general election, DiNapoli carried every county won by Andrew Cuomo in the concurrent gubernatorial election as well as Orange, Putnam, Dutchess, Sullivan, Columbia, Rensselaer, Washington, Saratoga, Schenectady, Otsego, Montgomery, Warren, Essex, Clinton, Franklin, St.

zh.s: 2018年纽约州审计长选举于11月6日举行，与州长、州参议院、州众议院和州检察长选举同时举行。民主党籍现任审计长托马斯·迪纳波利轻松连任第三个任期，击败共和党候选人乔纳森·特里希特及小党候选人。迪纳波利在安德鲁·科莫赢下的所有县，以及奥兰治、普特南、达奇斯、沙利文、哥伦比亚、伦斯勒、华盛顿、萨拉托加、斯克内克塔迪、奥齐戈、蒙哥马利、沃伦、埃塞克斯、克林顿、富兰克林、圣劳伦斯、奥奈达、麦迪逊、布鲁姆、科特兰、卡尤加、塞内卡、安大略、尼亚加拉和肖托夸县获胜。

en.s: Elections were held in Nevada on November 6, 2018. On that date, the state held elections for Governor, Lieutenant Governor, Attorney General, Secretary of State, Treasurer, Controller, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Nevada Senate, Nevada Assembly, and various others. In addition, several measures were on the ballot.

zh.s: 内华达州于2018年11月6日举行选举。州内当天举行州长、副州长、总检察长、州务卿、财政部长、审计长、美国参议院、美国众议院、州参议院、州众议院等职位选举，选票上还有多项公投议题。

en.s: The Maryland county executive elections of 2018 took place on November 6, 2018, with the primary election occurring on June 26, 2018. Anne Arundel County, Baltimore County, Frederick County, Harford County, Howard County, Montgomery County, Prince George's County, and Wicomico County elected county executives.

zh.t: 2018年马里兰州县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2018年马里兰州县行政长官选举于11月6日举行，初选于2018年6月26日举行。安妮阿伦德尔县、巴尔的摩县、弗雷德里克县、哈福德县、霍华德县、蒙哥马利县、乔治王子县和威科米科县选出县行政长官。

en.s: The 2018 Wyoming Senate election was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, with the primary election held on August 21, 2018. Voters in the 15 odd-numbered districts of the Wyoming State Senate elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other offices, including U.S. Senate, U.S. House, governor, and the State House.

zh.s: 2018年怀俄明州参议院选举于11月6日星期二举行，初选于2018年8月21日举行。选民从怀俄明州参议院15个奇数编号选区选出议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括美国参议院、美国众议院、州长和州众议院选举。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Virginia
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Virginia were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the 11 U.S. representatives from the state of Virginia, one from each of the state's 11 congressional districts. The elections coincided with other states' elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections. Primary elections took place on June 12.

zh.t: 2018年弗吉尼亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年弗吉尼亚州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州11名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他州的众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。初选于6月12日举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Guam
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Guam was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the non-voting Delegate to the United States House of Representatives from Guam's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the elections of other federal and state offices, including the larger 2018 Guamanian general election, the 2018 Guamanian gubernatorial election, and the 2018 United States House of Representatives elections.

zh.t: 2018年关岛美国众议院代表选举
zh.s: 2018年关岛美国众议院代表选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出关岛唯一国会选区的无投票权驻会代表。选举还与其他联邦和州级职位选举同时举行，包括2018年关岛普选、关岛州长选举和美国众议院选举。

en.s: The 2018 Colorado gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of Colorado. Incumbent Democratic Governor John Hickenlooper was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. The primary election was held on June 26. The major party nominees were Democratic U.S. Representative Jared Polis and Republican State Treasurer Walker Stapleton. The general election took place on November 6, 2018, with Polis winning by 268,000 votes.

zh.s: 2018年科罗拉多州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出新任州长。民主党现任州长约翰·希肯卢珀已达到任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。初选于6月26日举行。主要政党提名人为民主党籍美国众议员贾里德·波利斯和共和党籍州财政部长沃克·斯台普顿。大选于2018年11月6日举行，波利斯以26.8万票优势获胜。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in New Hampshire were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the state of New Hampshire, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年新罕布什尔州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年新罕布什尔州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州2名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Indiana
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Indiana were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the state of Indiana, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, as well as elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年印第安纳州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年印第安纳州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州9名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Texas
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Texas was held on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Texas. Republican incumbent Ted Cruz won re-election to a second term, defeating Democratic congressman Beto O'Rourke. The primary was held on March 6, 2018, the first primary of the 2018 season.

zh.t: 2018年得克萨斯州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年得克萨斯州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表该州的美国参议员。共和党现任参议员特德·克鲁兹成功连任，开始第二个任期，击败民主党众议员贝托·奥罗克。初选于2018年3月6日举行，是2018年选举季的首场初选。

en.s: The 2018 Tennessee gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of Tennessee, alongside other state and local elections. Incumbent Republican governor Bill Haslam was term-limited and prohibited by the Constitution of Tennessee from seeking a third consecutive term. Republican candidate Bill Lee was elected with 59.6% of the vote, defeating Democratic nominee and former Nashville mayor Karl Dean in a landslide.

zh.s: 2018年田纳西州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出新任州长，并与其他州和地方选举同时举行。共和党现任州长比尔·哈斯拉姆已达到任期限制，田纳西州宪法禁止他连续竞选第三个任期。共和党候选人比尔·李获得59.6%的选票，当选并大胜民主党提名人、纳什维尔前市长卡尔·迪恩。

en.s: The 2018 Utah House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Utah on November 6, 2018, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 63rd Utah State Legislature. A primary election was held in several districts on June 26, 2018. The election coincided with the election for U.S. Senate and other elections.

zh.s: 犹他州于2018年11月6日举行选举，选出第63届犹他州议会众议院议员。部分选区于2018年6月26日举行初选。选举还与美国参议院选举及其他选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2018 Missouri elections were held on November 6, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年密苏里州选举于11月6日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Florida Commissioner of Agriculture election occurred on November 6, 2018, to elect the Florida Commissioner of Agriculture. Incumbent Republican Commissioner of Agriculture Adam Putnam was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. Democrat Nikki Fried narrowly defeated Republican Matt Caldwell. This was the only statewide victory in 2018 for Democrats in Florida.

zh.t: 2018年佛罗里达州农业专员选举
zh.s: 2018年佛罗里达州农业专员选举于11月6日举行，选出州农业专员。共和党现任农业专员亚当·普特南已达到任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。民主党人妮基·弗里德以微弱优势击败共和党人马特·考德威尔。这是2018年民主党在佛罗里达州唯一一次全州范围选举胜利。

en.s: The 2018 Massachusetts general election was held on November 6, 2018, throughout Massachusetts. Primary elections took place on September 4. Early voting took place from October 22 through November 2. At the federal level, Elizabeth Warren was re-elected to the United States Senate, and all nine seats in the United States House of Representatives were won by Democratic Party candidates.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于2018年11月6日举行普选。初选于9月4日举行，提前投票从10月22日持续至11月2日。在联邦层面，伊丽莎白·沃伦连任美国参议员，该州美国众议院全部9个席位均由民主党候选人赢得。

en.s: The 2018 general election was held in the U.S. state of Oklahoma on November 6, 2018. All of Oklahoma's executive officers were up for election as well as the state's five seats in the United States House of Representatives, half of the 48 seats in the Oklahoma Senate, and all 101 seats in the Oklahoma House, and five offices in each of Oklahoma's 77 counties.

zh.s: 俄克拉何马州于2018年11月6日举行普选。州内所有行政职位、美国众议院5个席位、俄克拉何马州参议院48个席位中的一半、州众议院全部101个席位，以及该州77个县各自的5个职位都要改选。

en.s: The 2018 San Diego City Council election occurred on November 6, 2018. The primary election was held June 5, 2018. Four of the nine seats of the San Diego City Council were contested. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan, although most members do identify a party preference. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with a primary in June followed by a runoff in November between the top-two candidates in each district.

zh.s: 2018年圣迭戈市议会选举于11月6日举行。初选于2018年6月5日举行，市议会9个席位中的4个进行改选。加利福尼亚州市政选举依法不设党派，但多数议员会表明自己的政党倾向。此次选举采用两轮制：6月举行初选，11月由各选区前两名候选人参加决选。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Massachusetts took place on November 6, 2018. Incumbent Democratic U.S. senator Elizabeth Warren ran for re-election to a second term. The candidate filing deadline was June 5, 2018, and the primary election was held on September 4, 2018. Warren won re-election, defeating her Republican opponent, state Representative Geoff Diehl.

zh.t: 2018年马萨诸塞州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年马萨诸塞州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。现任民主党参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦竞选连任第二个任期。候选人登记截止日期为2018年6月5日，初选于9月4日举行。沃伦击败共和党对手、州众议员杰夫·迪尔，成功连任。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in New Jersey
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in New Jersey took place on November 6, 2018, in order to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of New Jersey. Incumbent Democratic U.S. Senator Bob Menendez won election to a third term over Republican businessman Bob Hugin, after the former's criminal trial ended in a mistrial.

zh.t: 2018年新泽西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年新泽西州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表该州的美国参议员。现任民主党参议员鲍勃·梅嫩德斯击败共和党商人鲍勃·休金，赢得第三个任期；此前，梅嫩德斯的刑事审判以审判无效告终。

en.s: The 2018 Minnesota Attorney General election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of the U.S. state of Minnesota. A primary election was held on August 14, 2018, in which Doug Wardlow was nominated as the Republican candidate and Keith Ellison was nominated as the Democratic–Farmer–Labor (DFL) candidate. Ellison won the election, albeit with the narrowest margin of victory for the DFL since 1998.

zh.t: 2018年明尼苏达州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年明尼苏达州总检察长选举于11月6日举行，选出明尼苏达州总检察长。初选于2018年8月14日举行，道格·沃德洛获提名为共和党候选人，基思·埃里森获提名为民主党农民劳工党候选人。埃里森赢得选举，但这是民主党农民劳工党自1998年以来优势最小的一次胜利。

en.s: The 2018 Alabama Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of Alabama. Incumbent attorney general Steve Marshall, who was appointed by former Governor Robert J. Bentley defeated the Democratic candidate, Joseph Siegelman, the son of former Governor Don Siegelman.

zh.t: 2018年阿拉巴马州总检察长选举
zh.s: 2018年阿拉巴马州总检察长选举于11月6日举行，选出州总检察长。现任总检察长史蒂夫·马歇尔由前州长罗伯特·J·本特利任命，他击败了民主党候选人约瑟夫·西格尔曼。约瑟夫是前州长唐·西格尔曼的儿子。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Kansas were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Kansas, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The state congressional delegation changed from a 4–0 Republican majority to a 3–1 Republican majority, the first time the Democrats had won a house seat in the state since 2008.

zh.t: 2018年堪萨斯州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年堪萨斯州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州4名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。该州国会代表团的席位分布由共和党4比0占优变为共和党3比1，这是民主党自2008年以来首次在该州赢得众议院席位。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives election in the District of Columbia
en.s: On November 6, 2018, the District of Columbia held an election for its non-voting House delegate representing the District of Columbia's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with the 2018 elections of other federal, state, and local offices. The non-voting delegate is elected for a two-year term. Democrat Eleanor Holmes Norton, the incumbent delegate first elected in 1990, was re-elected for a 15th consecutive term.

zh.t: 2018年哥伦比亚特区美国众议院代表选举
zh.s: 哥伦比亚特区于2018年11月6日举行选举，选出该区唯一国会选区的无投票权驻会代表。选举还与2018年其他联邦、州和地方职位选举同时举行。无投票权代表任期为两年。民主党籍现任代表埃莉诺·霍姆斯·诺顿自1990年首次当选，她成功连任，开始连续第15个任期。

en.t: 2018 United States Virgin Islands general election
en.s: The United States Virgin Islands general election was held on 6 November 2018. Voters chose the non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives, all fifteen seats in the Legislature of the Virgin Islands, and the governor of the United States Virgin Islands.

zh.s: 美属维尔京群岛普选于2018年11月6日举行。选民选出一名无投票权的美国众议院代表、维尔京群岛议会全部15个席位以及美属维尔京群岛州长。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Connecticut
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Connecticut took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Connecticut. Incumbent Democrat Chris Murphy sought and won reelection to a second term. The primary election was held on August 14, 2018, following a June 12 candidate filing deadline.

zh.t: 2018年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年康涅狄格州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表康涅狄格州的美国参议员。现任民主党参议员克里斯·墨菲竞选并成功连任第二个任期。候选人登记截止日期为6月12日，初选于2018年8月14日举行。

en.t: 2018 Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court election
en.s: The 2018 Montana Supreme Court Clerk election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court. The election was part of the 2018 Montana elections. Incumbent Democratic Clerk Ed Smith opted not to run for re-election. Republican Bowen Greenwood and Democrat Rex Renk won their respective primaries uncontested.

zh.t: 2018年蒙大拿州最高法院书记员选举
zh.s: 2018年蒙大拿州最高法院书记员选举于11月6日举行，选出该州最高法院书记员。选举是2018年蒙大拿州选举的一部分。民主党现任书记员埃德·史密斯决定不竞选连任。共和党人鲍恩·格林伍德和民主党人雷克斯·伦克均在没有党内竞争的情况下赢得各自政党的初选。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Hawaii were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the two U.S. representatives from the U.S. state of Hawaii, one from each of the state's two congressional districts. Primaries were held on August 11, 2018. The elections and primaries coincided with the elections and primaries of other federal and state offices.

zh.t: 2018年夏威夷州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年夏威夷州美国众议院选举于11月6日星期二举行，选出该州2名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。初选于2018年8月11日举行。选举和初选还与其他联邦及州级职位的选举和初选同时举行。

en.s: The 2018 Arizona State Treasurer election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the State Treasurer of Arizona, concurrently with other federal and state elections. Incumbent Republican state treasurer Jeff DeWit announced on April 6, 2016, that he would not run for re-election to a second term as state treasurer. DeWit resigned in April 2018 to become CFO of NASA and his replacement, Eileen Klein, announced that she would not be running for re-election.

zh.t: 2018年亚利桑那州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2018年亚利桑那州财政部长选举于11月6日举行，并与其他联邦和州级选举同时举行。共和党现任财政部长杰夫·德威特于2016年4月6日宣布不竞选连任。德威特于2018年4月辞职，转任美国国家航空航天局首席财务官；接任的艾琳·克莱因也宣布不竞选连任。

en.s: The 2018 Iowa House of Representative elections took place on November 6, 2018, to elect representatives from all 100 districts. The winners would serve in the 88th General Assembly, apportioned among the states based on the 2010 United States census. The Republican Party retained control of the House, while the Democratic Party gained a net of five seats.

zh.s: 2018年艾奥瓦州众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州100个选区的议员。当选者进入第88届州议会，席位按2010年美国人口普查结果分配。共和党保住众议院控制权，民主党净增5席。

en.s: The 2018 Utah Senate election was held on November 6, 2018. Fourteen Senate seats were up for election. Prior to the election, the Republicans held a majority.

zh.s: 2018年犹他州参议院选举于11月6日举行，共有14个席位改选。选举前，共和党占多数。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Kentucky were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Kentucky, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年肯塔基州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年肯塔基州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州6名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2018 Iowa gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018. Incumbent Republican Governor Kim Reynolds ran for election to a full term, facing Democratic businessman Fred Hubbell, Libertarian Jake Porter, and independent candidate Gary Siegwarth. On election day, Reynolds won 50.3% of the vote, a 2.8% margin of victory, and carried 88 of Iowa's 99 counties. She became the first female governor of Iowa elected in her own right.

zh.s: 2018年艾奥瓦州州长选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任州长金·雷诺兹竞选完整任期，对手包括民主党商人弗雷德·哈贝尔、自由党候选人杰克·波特和独立候选人加里·西格沃思。投票日当天，雷诺兹获得50.3%的选票，以2.8个百分点的优势获胜，并赢得艾奥瓦州99个县中的88个。她成为首位通过选举当选艾奥瓦州州长的女性。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Washington
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Washington took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of Washington. Incumbent Democrat Maria Cantwell won election to a fourth term over television news journalist Susan Hutchison, a Republican.

zh.t: 2018年华盛顿州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年华盛顿州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表华盛顿州的美国参议员。现任民主党参议员玛丽亚·坎特韦尔击败共和党人、电视新闻记者苏珊·哈奇森，赢得第四个任期。

en.s: West Virginia held elections on November 6, 2018. Elections for the United States House and Senate were held as well as two high-profile ballot measures. These elections were held concurrently with other elections nationwide. Primary elections were held on May 8, 2018.

zh.s: 西弗吉尼亚州于2018年11月6日举行选举。州内举行美国众议院和美国参议院选举，选票上还有两项备受关注的公投议题。选举与全国其他选举同时举行。初选于2018年5月8日举行。

en.s: The Michigan Secretary of State election of 2018 was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the secretary of state of Michigan. Democratic former university dean Jocelyn Benson won her first term in office, defeating Republican university vice chair Mary Treder Lang. Benson succeeded Republican incumbent Ruth Johnson, who was term limited and ineligible to seek a third term.

zh.s: 2018年密歇根州州务卿选举于11月6日举行，选出州务卿。民主党人、前大学院长乔斯琳·本森当选，开始首个任期；她击败了共和党人、大学副校长玛丽·特雷德·朗。本森接替共和党现任州务卿露丝·约翰逊，后者已达到任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。

en.s: The 2018 Ohio general elections were held on November 6, 2018, throughout Ohio.

zh.s: 俄亥俄州于2018年11月6日举行普选。

en.s: The Michigan general election, 2018 was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, throughout Michigan. The Democrats swept all of the statewide offices formerly held by the Republicans.

zh.s: 密歇根州于2018年11月6日星期二举行普选。民主党赢得了共和党此前占据的全部州级职位。

en.s: The 2018 Wyoming gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Wyoming. Incumbent Republican governor Matt Mead was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. Republican nominee Mark Gordon defeated Democratic nominee Mary Throne by nearly 40 percentage points. This was the only time since 1978 that a candidate from the president's party was elected governor of Wyoming.

zh.s: 2018年怀俄明州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。共和党现任州长马特·米德已达到任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。共和党提名人马克·戈登以近40个百分点的优势击败民主党提名人玛丽·索恩。自1978年以来，这是唯一一次总统所属政党的候选人当选怀俄明州州长。

en.s: The 2018 Wisconsin Senate elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, at the Fall general election in Wisconsin.
