Seventeen of the 33 seats in the Wisconsin Senate were up for election—the odd-numbered districts. Before the election, Republicans held 18 seats and Democrats held 15 seats. Of the seats up for election, 10 were held by Republicans and seven were held by Democrats.

zh.s: 威斯康星州参议院选举于2018年11月6日星期二举行，与该州秋季普选同时进行。州参议院33个席位中有17个改选，即奇数编号选区。选举前，共和党占18席，民主党占15席；此次改选席位中，共和党占10席，民主党占7席。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Massachusetts were held on November 6, 2018, electing the nine U.S. representatives from the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other offices, including a gubernatorial election, other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年马萨诸塞州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年马萨诸塞州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州9名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括州长选举、其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举。

en.s: The 2018 Ohio Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of Ohio. Incumbent Attorney General Mike DeWine was term-limited and ran for governor. Republican nominee and Ohio State Auditor Dave Yost defeated Democratic nominee and former US Attorney Steve Dettelbach in the general election.

zh.s: 2018年俄亥俄州总检察长选举于11月6日举行，选出州总检察长。现任总检察长迈克·德温已达到任期限制，转而竞选州长。共和党提名人、俄亥俄州审计长戴夫·约斯特在大选中击败民主党提名人、美国前检察官史蒂夫·德特尔巴赫。

en.s: The 2018 Connecticut gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor and lieutenant governor of Connecticut, concurrently with the election of Connecticut's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2018年康涅狄格州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长和副州长。选举还与康涅狄格州一个第一类美国参议院席位的选举、其他州的美国参议院选举、美国众议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2018 California Insurance Commissioner election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the Insurance Commissioner of California. Under California's nonpartisan blanket primary law, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party. In the primary, voters may vote for any candidate, regardless of their party affiliation.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州保险专员选举
zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州保险专员选举于11月6日举行，选出州保险专员。根据加利福尼亚州无党派综合初选法，所有候选人不论党派都出现在同一张选票上。初选中，选民可以投票给任何候选人，不受其党派归属限制。

en.s: The 2018 Delaware State Treasurer election took place on November 6, 2018. The Delaware primary election for federal and state candidates took place on September 6, 2018. Incumbent State Treasurer Ken Simpler announced on November 2, 2017, that he would seek re-election to a second term. He lost the general election to Democratic nominee Colleen Davis in a major upset.

zh.s: 2018年特拉华州财政部长选举于11月6日举行。联邦和州级候选人的特拉华州初选于2018年9月6日举行。现任州财政部长肯·辛普勒于2017年11月2日宣布竞选连任第二个任期。他在大选中意外败给民主党提名人科琳·戴维斯。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Texas were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018. Voters elected the 36 U.S. representatives from the state of Texas, one from each of the state's 36 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the elections of other offices, including the gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年得克萨斯州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年得克萨斯州美国众议院选举于11月6日星期二举行。选民从该州36个国会选区各选出1名美国众议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括州长、其他众议院、美国参议院以及多场州和地方选举。

en.s: On November 6, 2018, a general election in the U.S. state of Missouri was held for the post of State Auditor of Missouri. The election for Missouri State Auditor coincided with the U.S. federal midterm elections that were held throughout all 50 states, as well with other state legislative and local races in Missouri. Missouri's Class 1 United States Senate seat was also up for election on November 6, 2018.

zh.s: 密苏里州于2018年11月6日举行普选，选出州审计长。选举与美国50个州举行的联邦中期选举以及密苏里州其他州议会和地方选举同时举行。密苏里州第一类美国参议院席位也于2018年11月6日改选。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Arizona were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the nine U.S. representatives from the State of Arizona, one from each of the state's nine congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2018 Arizona gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年亚利桑那州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年亚利桑那州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州9名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与2018年亚利桑那州州长选举、其他美国众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Illinois on November 6, 2018. The elections for Illinois's 18 congressional districts, governor, statewide constitutional officers, Illinois Senate, and Illinois House were held on this date. Primaries were held March 20, 2018. The Democratic Party made gains, including picking up the state's governorship and flipping two of its U.S. House seats.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州于2018年11月6日举行普选。该日举行了该州18个国会选区、州长、州级宪法职位、州参议院和州众议院选举。初选于2018年3月20日举行。民主党取得进展，包括赢得州长职位并翻转两个美国众议院席位。

en.s: The 2018 California lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the lieutenant governor of California. Incumbent Democratic lieutenant governor Gavin Newsom was ineligible to run for reelection due to term limits and ran for governor of California instead. Democrats Eleni Kounalakis and Ed Hernandez faced each other in the general election, as no Republican finished in the top two positions of the nonpartisan blanket primary that was held on June 5, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州副州长选举
zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州副州长选举于11月6日举行，选出副州长。民主党现任副州长加文·纽森因任期限制不能竞选连任，转而竞选州长。民主党人埃莱妮·库纳拉基斯和埃德·埃尔南德斯在大选中对决，因为6月5日举行的无党派综合初选中没有共和党候选人进入前两名。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Pennsylvania
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Pennsylvania were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the 18 U.S. representatives from the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania, one from each of the state's 18 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the 2018 gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年宾夕法尼亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年宾夕法尼亚州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州18名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与2018年州长选举、其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Arizona
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Arizona took place on November 6, 2018. Incumbent Republican Senator Jeff Flake did not seek a second term. The election was held concurrently with a gubernatorial election, other elections to the U.S. Senate, elections to the U.S. House of Representatives, and various other state and local elections. Primaries were held on August 28, 2018, three days after the death of longtime U.S.

zh.t: 2018年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年美国亚利桑那州联邦参议院选举于11月6日举行。共和党籍现任参议员杰夫·弗莱克没有竞选连任。选举与州长、其他联邦参议院和联邦众议院选举以及州和地方选举同时举行。初选于2018年8月28日举行，距资深联邦参议员约翰·麦凯恩去世仅三天。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Wisconsin took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the U.S. Senate from Wisconsin. This election coincided with a gubernatorial election, U.S. House elections and various other state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic senator Tammy Baldwin won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican nominee Leah Vukmir by more than 10 percentage points.

zh.t: 2018年威斯康星州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年威斯康星州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出威斯康星州的美国参议员。选举还与州长、美国众议院以及其他州和地方选举同时举行。现任民主党参议员塔米·鲍德温击败共和党提名人莉亚·武克米尔，以超过10个百分点的优势连任。

en.t: 2018 North Dakota Secretary of State election
en.s: The 2018 North Dakota Secretary of State election occurred on November 6, 2018, to elect the North Dakota Secretary of State, concurrently with various other state and local elections. Six-time incumbent Republican Secretary of State Alvin Jaeger was eligible to run for re-election to a seventh term in office, but withdrew from his party's primary after failing to receive the endorsement.

zh.s: 2018年北达科他州州务卿选举于11月6日举行，并与其他州和地方选举同时举行。共和党籍现任州务卿阿尔文·耶格已连续六届任职，符合竞选第七个任期的资格，但未能获得党内背书后退出党内初选。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Minnesota were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Minnesota, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with an open gubernatorial election, a U.S. Senate election, a special U.S. Senate election, State House elections, and other elections. Primaries were held on August 14.

zh.t: 2018年明尼苏达州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年明尼苏达州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州8名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与州长职位开放的选举、美国参议院选举、美国参议院特别选举、州众议院选举以及其他选举同时举行。初选于8月14日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Connecticut state elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, to elect the following offices: governor and lieutenant governor (on one ticket), attorney general, secretary of the state, comptroller, treasurer, U.S. Senate, U.S. House of Representatives, Connecticut State Senate, Connecticut State House of Representatives, and various others. Primary elections were held on August 14, 2018.

zh.s: 康涅狄格州于2018年11月6日星期二举行州选举，改选州长和副州长（共同参选）、总检察长、州务卿、审计长、财政部长、美国参议院、美国众议院、州参议院、州众议院等职位。初选于2018年8月14日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Nevada gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of Nevada. Incumbent Republican governor Brian Sandoval was ineligible to run for re-election due to the absolute two-term limit established by the Nevada Constitution. Nevada is one of eight U.S. states (or nine U.S. states and territory) that prohibits its governors or any other state and territorial executive branch officials from serving more than two terms, even if they are nonconsecutive.

zh.s: 2018年内华达州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出新任州长。共和党现任州长布赖恩·桑多瓦尔受到内华达州宪法规定的两届绝对任期限制，不能竞选连任。美国有8个州（或8个州和一个属地）规定州和属地行政部门官员最多只能任职两届，即使任期不连续也不例外。

en.s: The 2018 California State Controller election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the California State Controller. Democratic incumbent Betty Yee won re-election to a second term, defeating Republican city commissioner Konstantinos Roditis.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州审计长选举
zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州审计长选举于11月6日举行，选出州审计长。民主党现任审计长贝蒂·易击败共和党人、城市委员康斯坦丁诺斯·罗迪蒂斯，成功连任第二个任期。

en.s: Elections were held in California on November 6, 2018, with primary elections being held on June 5, 2018. Voters elected one member to the United States Senate, 53 members to the United States House of Representatives, all eight state constitutional offices, all four members to the Board of Equalization, 20 members to the California State Senate, and all 80 members to the California State Assembly, among other elected offices.

zh.s: 加利福尼亚州于2018年11月6日举行选举，初选于2018年6月5日举行。选民选出1名美国参议员、53名美国众议员、全部8名州级宪法职位官员、平等化委员会全部4名委员、20名州参议员和州众议院全部80名议员，以及其他职位人员。

en.t: 2018 Arizona Superintendent of Public Instruction election
en.s: The 2018 Arizona Superintendent of Public Instruction election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the Arizona Superintendent of Public Instruction, concurrently with the election of Arizona's Class I U.S. Senate seat, as well as other elections to the United States Senate in other states and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年亚利桑那州公共教育总监选举
zh.s: 2018年亚利桑那州公共教育总监选举于11月6日举行，选出州公共教育总监。选举还与亚利桑那州第一类美国参议院席位选举、其他州的美国参议院选举、美国众议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2018 New Hampshire Senate election was held on November 6, 2018, concurrently with the elections for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, to elect members to the 166th New Hampshire General Court. All 24 seats in the New Hampshire Senate were up for election. It resulted in Democrats gaining control of both chambers of the New Hampshire General Court, ending the total control of New Hampshire's state government that Republicans had held since the 2016 elections.

zh.t: 2018年新罕布什尔州参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年新罕布什尔州参议院选举于11月6日举行，与州众议院选举同时进行，选出第166届新罕布什尔州议会议员。州参议院全部24个席位都进行改选。选举后，民主党同时控制州议会两院，结束共和党自2016年选举以来对新罕布什尔州政府的全面控制。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in North Dakota
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in North Dakota took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the State of North Dakota, concurrently with other elections to the U.S. Senate, and other federal, state, and local elections in North Dakota. This was one of ten Democratic-held Senate seats up for election in a state that Donald Trump won in the 2016 presidential election.

zh.t: 2018年北达科他州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年北达科他州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表该州的美国参议员，并与其他美国参议院选举以及北达科他州其他联邦、州和地方选举同时举行。这是10个由民主党占据、但所在州在2016年总统选举中支持唐纳德·特朗普的参议院席位之一。

en.s: The 2018 Florida House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Florida on November 6, 2018, to elect members to the House of Representatives. The election coincided with the election for governor, and other elections. The Republicans won 73 seats and losing only two, maintaining their control since 1997, while the Democrats gained six seats.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州于2018年11月6日举行州众议院选举，选出州众议院议员。选举还与州长和其他选举同时举行。共和党赢得73席，失去2席，保住自1997年以来的控制权；民主党增加6席。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Wyoming was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the U.S. representative from Wyoming's at-large congressional district, who would represent the state of Wyoming in the 116th United States Congress. The election coincided with the 2018 U.S. mid-term elections, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年怀俄明州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年怀俄明州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表该州唯一国会选区的美国众议员，进入第116届美国国会。选举与2018年美国中期选举、其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives election in Vermont was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the U.S. representative from the state of Vermont from Vermont's at-large congressional district. The election coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections. The primary elections were held on August 14.

zh.t: 2018年佛蒙特州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年佛蒙特州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表佛蒙特州唯一国会选区的美国众议员。选举还与其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。初选于8月14日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Louisville mayoral election was the fifth quadrennial Louisville Metro mayoral election, held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018. The Democratic candidate, incumbent mayor and businessman Greg Fischer, was elected to his third and final term. He defeated the Republican candidate, engineer and former Louisville Metro Councilwoman Angela Leet. As the incumbent mayor, Fischer secured his party's nomination with little resistance.

zh.s: 2018年路易维尔都会区市长选举于11月6日星期二举行，是第五次每四年举行一次的市长选举。民主党候选人、现任市长兼商人格雷格·费舍尔当选，开始第三个也是最后一个任期。他击败了共和党候选人、工程师兼前路易维尔都会区议会议员安吉拉·利特。作为现任市长，费舍尔几乎没有遇到阻力便获得党内提名。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Wisconsin were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the eight U.S. representatives from the state of Wisconsin, one from each of the state's eight congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年威斯康星州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年威斯康星州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州8名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2018 Kentucky Senate election was held on November 6, 2018. The Republican and Democratic primary elections were held on May 22. Half of the senate (all even-numbered seats) were up for election. Republicans increased their majority in the chamber, gaining one seat. A numbered map of the senate districts at the time can be viewed here.

zh.s: 2018年肯塔基州参议院选举于11月6日举行。共和党和民主党初选于5月22日举行。参议院一半席位，也就是所有偶数编号席位，都要改选。共和党增加1席，扩大了在参议院的多数优势。

en.s: The 2018 Minnesota House of Representatives election was held in the U.S. state of Minnesota on November 6, 2018, to elect members to the House of Representatives of the 91st Minnesota Legislature. A primary election was held in several districts on August 14, 2018. The election coincided with the 2018 Minnesota gubernatorial election for governor, a special election for the Minnesota Senate, and other elections.

zh.s: 明尼苏达州于2018年11月6日举行选举，选出第91届州议会众议院议员。部分选区于2018年8月14日举行初选。选举还与2018年明尼苏达州州长选举、州参议院特别选举以及其他选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Nebraska
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Nebraska took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Nebraska. Incumbent Republican Deb Fischer was re-elected to a second term against Lincoln city councilwoman Jane Raybould and Libertarian candidate Jim Schultz. The candidate filing deadline was March 1, 2018, and the primary election was held on May 15, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年内布拉斯加州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年内布拉斯加州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表内布拉斯加州的美国参议员。共和党现任参议员黛布·费舍尔击败林肯市议员简·雷博尔德和自由党候选人吉姆·舒尔茨，成功连任第二个任期。候选人登记截止日期为2018年3月1日，初选于2018年5月15日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Alaska gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor and lieutenant governor of Alaska. In the primaries for recognized political parties, candidates for governor and lieutenant governor run separately. The winners of each respective primary for governor and lieutenant governor then become a joint ticket in the general election for their political party.

zh.s: 2018年阿拉斯加州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长和副州长。获认可政党的初选中，州长和副州长候选人分别竞选。各党州长和副州长初选的胜者在大选中组成该党的联合候选名单。

en.s: The 2018 Wisconsin State Treasurer election was held on November 6, 2018, and saw Democratic nominee Sarah Godlewski defeat Republican nominee Travis Hartwig. Incumbent Republican Matt Adamczyk, first elected in 2014, did not sought re-election.

zh.t: 2018年威斯康星州财政部长选举
zh.s: 2018年威斯康星州财政部长选举于11月6日举行。民主党提名人莎拉·戈德莱夫斯基击败共和党提名人特拉维斯·哈特维格。共和党现任财政部长马特·阿达姆奇克于2014年首次当选，没有竞选连任。

en.s: The 2018 Guam gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the next governor of Guam, concurrently with the election of Guam elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican governor Eddie Baza Calvo was term-limited and ineligible to seek a third term in office.

zh.s: 2018年关岛州长选举于11月6日举行，选出新任州长，并与关岛驻美国众议院代表选举以及其他州和地方选举同时举行。共和党现任州长埃迪·巴扎·卡尔沃已达到任期限制，不能竞选第三个任期。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Utah were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the four U.S. representatives from the state of Utah, one from each of the state's four congressional districts. The elections coincided with other states' elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate and various state and local elections.

zh.s: 2018年犹他州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州4名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他州的众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Hawaii
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Hawaii was held on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent the state of Hawaii. Democratic incumbent Mazie Hirono won a second term, defeating Republican nominee Ron Curtis. Hirono won by the largest margin of any U.S. senate candidate in 2018. The primary election took place on August 11, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年夏威夷州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年夏威夷州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表夏威夷州的美国参议员。民主党现任参议员梅兹·希罗诺击败共和党提名人罗恩·柯蒂斯，赢得第二个任期。希罗诺的胜选优势是2018年所有美国参议员候选人中最大的。初选于2018年8月11日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Michigan Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018, alongside elections to elect Michigan's governor, Class I United States Senator, Secretary of State, Michigan's 14 seats in the United States House of Representatives, all 38 seats in the Michigan Senate, and all 110 seats in the Michigan House of Representatives.

zh.s: 2018年密歇根州总检察长选举于11月6日举行，同时举行州长、第一类美国参议员、州务卿、密歇根州在美国众议院的14个席位、州参议院全部38个席位以及州众议院全部110个席位的选举。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Rhode Island on November 6, 2018. The party primaries for the election occurred on September 12, 2018. All of Rhode Island's executive officers were up for election, as well as Rhode Island's Class I U.S. Senate seat and both of Rhode Island's two seats in the United States House of Representatives.

zh.s: 罗得岛州于2018年11月6日举行普选。党内初选于2018年9月12日举行。州内所有行政职位、一个第一类美国参议院席位以及该州在美国众议院的两个席位都要改选。

en.s: The 2018 Hawaii gubernatorial election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of Hawaii and lieutenant governor of Hawaii. After prevailing in an intensely competitive primary election on August 11, 2018, incumbent Democratic governor David Ige ran successfully for re-election to a second term in office, considerably improving on his margin of victory from 2014, in which he only won a plurality.

zh.s: 2018年夏威夷州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长和副州长。民主党现任州长戴维·伊艺在8月11日竞争激烈的初选中胜出后，成功连任第二个任期；与2014年仅获相对多数相比，他这次的胜选优势明显扩大。

en.s: The 2018 California gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the governor of California, concurrently with elections for the rest of California's executive branch, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Incumbent Democratic Governor Jerry Brown was ineligible to run for a third consecutive term due to term limits.

zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长，并与该州其他行政职位、美国参议院、美国众议院以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。民主党现任州长杰里·布朗因任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in Tennessee
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in Tennessee took place on November 6, 2018, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Incumbent Republican senator Bob Corker opted to retire instead of running for a third term. Republican U.S. representative Marsha Blackburn won the open seat, defeating former Democratic governor Phil Bredesen.

zh.t: 2018年田纳西州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年田纳西州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，并与其他美国参议院、美国众议院以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。共和党现任参议员鲍勃·科克选择退休，没有竞选第三个任期。共和党籍美国众议员玛莎·布莱克本赢得这个空缺席位，击败民主党籍前州长菲尔·布雷德森。

en.s: A general election was held in Guam on Tuesday, November 6, 2018. Voters in Guam chose their governor, non-voting delegate to the United States House of Representatives, attorney general, public auditor, and all fifteen members of the territorial legislature. The election coincided with the United States mid-term elections.

zh.s: 关岛于2018年11月6日星期二举行普选。选民选出州长、一名无投票权的美国众议院代表、总检察长、公共审计长以及领地议会全部15名议员。选举与美国中期选举同时举行。

en.s: The 2018 Alaska House of Representatives election were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, with the primary election on August 21, 2018. Voters in the 40 districts of the Alaska House of Representatives elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections for other state offices, including the gubernatorial election and the state senate elections.

zh.s: 阿拉斯加州众议院选举于2018年11月6日星期二举行，初选于2018年8月21日举行。选民从阿拉斯加州众议院40个选区选出议员。选举还与其他州级职位选举同时举行，包括州长和州参议院选举。

en.s: The 2018 California State Senate elections were held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, with the primary election being held on June 5, 2018. Voters in the 20 even-numbered districts of the California State Senate elected their representatives. The elections coincided with the elections of other offices, including for governor and the California State Assembly. The Democratic Party gained three seats: the 12th, 14th, and 34th districts.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州参议院选举
zh.s: 加利福尼亚州参议院选举于2018年11月6日星期二举行，初选于2018年6月5日举行。选民从州参议院20个偶数编号选区选出议员。选举还与其他职位选举同时举行，包括州长和加利福尼亚州众议院选举。民主党在第12、14和34选区增加3个席位。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in California
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in California took place on November 6, 2018, to elect a member of the United States Senate to represent California, concurrently with other elections to the United States Senate, elections to the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Under California's non-partisan blanket primary law, all candidates appear on the same ballot, regardless of party.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举
zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行，选出代表加利福尼亚州的美国参议员，并与其他美国参议院、美国众议院以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。根据加利福尼亚州无党派综合初选法，所有候选人不论党派都出现在同一张选票上。

en.s: A general election was held in the state of Alaska on November 6, 2018. Primary elections were held on August 21, 2018. Alaska voters elected the governor, lieutenant governor, and parts of the Alaska Legislature, as well as their sole member of the U.S. House of Representatives representing the at-large district.

zh.s: 阿拉斯加州于2018年11月6日举行普选。初选于2018年8月21日举行。选民选出州长、副州长、阿拉斯加州议会部分议员，以及代表全州单一选区的美国众议员。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Louisiana were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the six U.S. representatives from the state of Louisiana, one from each of the state's six congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年路易斯安那州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年路易斯安那州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州6名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Ohio were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the 16 U.S. representatives from the U.S. state of Ohio, one from each of the state's 16 congressional districts. The elections coincided with other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年俄亥俄州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年俄亥俄州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州16名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与其他众议院选举、美国参议院选举以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The Cook County, Illinois, general election was held on November 6, 2018. Primaries were held March 20, 2018. Elections were held for Assessor, Clerk, Sheriff, Treasurer, President of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, all 17 seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners, Cook County Board of Review districts 2 and 3, five seats on the Water Reclamation District Board, and judgeships on the Circuit Court of Cook County.

zh.s: 伊利诺伊州库克县于2018年11月6日举行普选。初选于2018年3月20日举行。选举改选评估员、书记官、警长、财政部长、库克县委员委员会主席、委员会全部17个席位、库克县审查委员会第2和第3选区、水资源回收区委员会5个席位，以及库克县巡回法院法官职位。

en.s: United States gubernatorial elections were held on November 6, 2018, in 36 states and three territories. These elections formed part of the 2018 United States elections. Other coinciding elections were the 2018 United States Senate elections and the 2018 United States House of Representatives elections. Many of the states holding gubernatorial elections have term limits which made some multi-term governors ineligible for re-election.

zh.s: 美国36个州和3个属地于2018年11月6日举行州长选举。这些选举是2018年美国选举的一部分，并与2018年美国参议院和众议院选举同时举行。许多举行州长选举的州设有任期限制，因此一些已连任多届的州长不能竞选连任。

en.s: The 2018 Jackson Executive election took place on November 6, 2018. County Executive Frank White, who was appointed in 2016 upon the resignation of former County Executive Mike Sanders, and elected in a special election later that year to serve out the remaining two years of Sanders's term, ran for re-election. White faced controversy as he sought a second term, including personal financial difficulties and mismanagement of the county detention center.

zh.t: 2018年密苏里州杰克逊县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2018年杰克逊县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。弗兰克·怀特于2016年在前任迈克·桑德斯辞职后获任命接任县行政长官，同年又在特别选举中当选，完成桑德斯剩余的两年任期，此次竞选连任。怀特竞选第二个任期时面临争议，包括个人财务困难和县拘留中心管理不善。

en.s: The 2018 Jefferson County Commission election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect all members to the Jefferson County, Alabama Commission. Primary elections were held on June 5, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年阿拉巴马州杰斐逊县委员会选举
zh.s: 2018年杰斐逊县委员会选举于11月6日举行，改选阿拉巴马州杰斐逊县委员会全部成员。初选于2018年6月5日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Wayne County Executive election was held on November 6, 2018. Incumbent County Executive Warren Evans ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by Republican nominee Denis Curran, a retired mechanical engineer. Evans defeated Curran in a landslide, winning 73 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2018年韦恩县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。现任县行政长官沃伦·埃文斯竞选连任第二个任期。他的对手是共和党提名人、退休机械工程师丹尼斯·柯伦。埃文斯以压倒性优势击败柯伦，获得73%的选票。

en.s: The 2018 Macomb County Executive election was held on November 6, 2018. Incumbent County Executive Mark Hackel ran for re-election. In the general election, he was challenged by corporate trainer Joseph Hunt, the Republican nominee. Hackel defeated Hunt in a landslide, winning 67 percent of the vote.

zh.s: 2018年马科姆县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。现任县行政长官马克·哈克尔竞选连任。大选中，他的对手是共和党提名人、企业培训师约瑟夫·亨特。哈克尔以压倒性优势击败亨特，获得67%的选票。

en.s: The 2018 Cuyahoga County Executive election took place on November 6, 2018, to elect the County Executive of Cuyahoga County, Ohio. Incumbent Democratic County Executive Armond Budish won reelection to a second term with 67.47% of the vote, making him the first since the establishment of the office to be reelected.

zh.s: 2018年凯霍加县行政长官选举于11月6日举行，选出俄亥俄州凯霍加县行政长官。民主党现任行政长官阿蒙德·布迪什以67.47%的选票连任第二个任期，成为该职位设立以来首位成功连任的人。

en.s: An indirect mayoral election was held at a special sitting of the Cape Town City Council on 6 November 2018 to determine the successor of former mayor Patricia de Lille after she resigned on 31 October. Former mayor and Provincial Minister of Community Safety, Dan Plato, of the Democratic Alliance won the election as the party holds a two-thirds majority in the city council.

zh.s: 开普敦市议会于2018年11月6日召开特别会议，举行间接市长选举，选出帕特里夏·德莉尔于10月31日辞职后的继任者。民主联盟的前市长、前省社区安全部长丹·普拉托当选；该党在市议会占三分之二多数。

en.s: An election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the mayor of Reno, Nevada. It saw the reelection of Hillary Schieve.

zh.s: 里诺市于2018年11月6日举行市长选举。希拉里·希夫成功连任。

en.s: The 2018 Georgia Secretary of State election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the secretary of state of Georgia. It was held concurrently with the 2018 gubernatorial election, as well as elections for the United States Senate and elections for the United States House of Representatives, and various state and local elections. Republican Incumbent Secretary of State Brian Kemp chose not to run for re-election, and instead ran successfully for governor.

zh.s: 2018年佐治亚州州务卿选举于11月6日举行，并与州长、美国参议院、美国众议院以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。共和党现任州务卿布赖恩·坎普没有竞选连任，而是成功竞选州长。

en.s: Elections to the New York State Assembly were held on November 6, 2018, along with elections for the state senate, governor, and U.S. senator, among others. The Democrats retained their majority with no net change in seats from 2016. Eight seats changed hands, four from Republican to Democrat and four from Democrat to Republican.

zh.s: 纽约州众议院选举于2018年11月6日举行，同时举行州参议院、州长和美国参议员选举等。民主党保住多数席位，与2016年相比席位总数没有净变化。共有8个席位易手，其中4席由共和党转为民主党，另4席由民主党转为共和党。

en.s: The 2018 Corpus Christi mayoral election was held on November 6, 2018, and December 18, 2018, to elect the mayor of Corpus Christi, Texas. The general election, held on November 6, 2018, did not produce a winner (elections for the mayoralty of Corpus Christi require a majority); therefore, a runoff was required and held on December 18, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年科珀斯克里斯蒂市长选举
zh.s: 科珀斯克里斯蒂市于2018年11月6日和12月18日举行市长选举。11月6日的大选没有产生胜者，因为该市要求市长候选人获得过半选票，因此于12月18日举行决选。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia were held on November 6, 2018, to elect the fourteen U.S. representatives from the state of Georgia, one from each of the state's fourteen congressional districts. The elections coincided with a gubernatorial election, as well as other elections to the House of Representatives, elections to the United States Senate, and various state and local elections.

zh.t: 2018年佐治亚州美国众议院选举
zh.s: 2018年佐治亚州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州14名美国众议员，每个国会选区各1名。选举还与州长、其他众议院、美国参议院以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。

en.s: The Navajo Nation presidential election of 2018 was held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018. The candidates for President of the Navajo Nation in the general election were Jonathan Nez and Joe Shirley, Jr. Jonathan Nez and running mate Myron Lizer won the election. Although neither Nez nor Shirley were incumbents, they possessed the high name recognition associated with incumbents.

zh.s: 纳瓦霍族总统选举于2018年11月6日星期二举行。大选总统候选人为乔纳森·内兹和小乔·雪莉。内兹和竞选搭档迈伦·利泽赢得选举。内兹和雪莉都不是现任官员，但两人都具有通常与现任者相关的高知名度。

en.s: The 2018 United States attorney general elections were held on November 6, 2018, in 30 states, 2 territories, and the District of Columbia. The previous attorney general elections for this group of states took place in 2014, except in Vermont where attorneys general serve only two-year terms and elected their current attorney general in 2016.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日，美国30个州、2个属地和哥伦比亚特区举行州总检察长选举。上一届这些州的州总检察长选举于2014年举行；佛蒙特州例外，该州总检察长任期仅两年，现任总检察长于2016年当选。

en.s: The 2018 St. Louis County Executive election took place on November 6, 2018. Incumbent County Executive Steve Stenger ran for re-election to a second term. He faced a difficult challenge from businessman Mark Mantovani in the Democratic primary, and won renomination with just 50.3 percent of the vote. In the general election, Stenger was opposed by Republican Paul Berry III, a political commentator and bail bondsman.

zh.t: 2018年圣路易斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2018年圣路易斯县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。现任县行政长官史蒂夫·斯坦格竞选连任第二个任期。他在民主党初选中受到商人马克·曼托瓦尼的有力挑战，仅以50.3%的选票获得连任提名。大选中，斯坦格的对手是共和党人保罗·贝里三世，他是政治评论员和保释金经纪人。

en.t: 2018 Cook County Board of Commissioners election
en.s: The 2018 Cook County Board of Commissioners election was held on November 6, 2018, and was preceded by primary elections held on March 20, 2018. It saw all seventeen seats of the Cook County Board of Commissioners up for election to four-year terms and coincided with other 2018 Cook County, Illinois, elections (including the election for president of the Cook County Board of Commissioners).

zh.s: 2018年库克县委员委员会选举于11月6日举行，初选于2018年3月20日举行。库克县委员委员会全部17个席位都要改选，任期4年。选举还与2018年伊利诺伊州库克县其他选举同时举行，包括委员会主席选举。

en.s: Lexington, Kentucky held an election for mayor on November 6, 2018, with the primary election held on May 22. It saw the election of Republican Linda Gorton.

zh.t: 2018年肯塔基州列克星敦市市长选举
zh.s: 肯塔基州列克星敦市于2018年11月6日举行市长选举，初选于5月22日举行。共和党人琳达·戈顿当选。

en.s: The 2018–19 Phoenix mayoral special election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the new Mayor of Phoenix, Arizona. The election was officially nonpartisan; candidates ran on the same ballot. In the initial round of the election, since no candidate reached 50 percent plus one vote (as required by Phoenix City Charter), a runoff election was held on March 12, 2019, between the top two finishers.

zh.s: 2018年11月6日举行菲尼克斯市长特别选举，选出亚利桑那州菲尼克斯市的新市长。选举依法不设党派，所有候选人列在同一张选票上。首轮投票中没有候选人获得市宪章要求的50%加1票，因此前两名候选人于2019年3月12日参加决选。

en.s: The 2018 Cuyahoga County Council election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect members of the County Council of Cuyahoga County, Ohio. Odd-numbered districts were up for election to four-year terms, while District 10 held a special election to fill out the remainder of Anthony Hairston's term following his election to Cleveland City Council in 2017.

zh.s: 2018年凯霍加县议会选举于11月6日举行，选出俄亥俄州凯霍加县议会议员。奇数编号选区改选，任期4年。第10选区还举行特别选举，以完成安东尼·海尔斯顿的剩余任期；他于2017年当选克利夫兰市议会议员后离任。

en.s: The 2018 Anaheim mayoral election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the mayor of Anaheim, California. It saw the election of Harry Sidhu. Sidhu is the first person of color to serve as mayor of Anaheim and the first Sikh to serve as the city's mayor. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.s: 2018年阿纳海姆市长选举于11月6日举行，选出加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆市市长。哈里·西杜当选，成为阿纳海姆首位有色人种市长，也是该市首位锡克教徒市长。加利福尼亚州市政选举依法不设党派。

en.s: The 2018 New York's 14th congressional district election was held on November 6, 2018. The primaries for New York's federal elections were held earlier in the year on June 26. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez defeated incumbent congressman Joe Crowley in the primary, and went on to defeat Republican opponent Anthony Pappas in the general election. As a political newcomer, Ocasio-Cortez was not expected to defeat Crowley in the primary election.

zh.s: 2018年纽约州第14国会选区选举于11月6日举行。纽约州联邦选举初选于当年6月26日举行。亚历山德里娅·奥卡西奥-科尔特斯在初选中击败现任众议员乔·克劳利，随后在大选中击败共和党对手安东尼·帕帕斯。作为一名政坛新人，奥卡西奥-科尔特斯原本不被看好能在初选中击败克劳利。

en.s: The 2018 Jefferson County, Missouri Executive election took place on November 6, 2018. Incumbent County Executive Ken Waller declined to run for re-election to a third term, instead opting to run for County Clerk. Businessman Dennis Gannon, the former President of the County Port Authority, won the Republican primary over sheriff's deputy Gary Stout, and faced former State Representative Jeff Roorda, the Democratic nominee, in the general election.

zh.t: 2018年密苏里州杰斐逊县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2018年杰斐逊县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任县行政长官肯·沃勒拒绝竞选第三个任期，转而竞选县书记官。商人丹尼斯·甘农曾任县港务局主席，他在共和党初选中击败警员加里·斯托特，并在大选中对阵民主党提名人、州前众议员杰夫·罗尔达。

en.s: The 2018 Oakland mayoral election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the mayor of Oakland, California. Incumbent mayor Libby Schaaf was reelected. The election was held using instant-runoff voting, but Schaaf received a majority of votes in the first round, so no additional rounds were necessary. Municipal elections in California are officially non-partisan.

zh.s: 2018年奥克兰市长选举于11月6日举行，选出加利福尼亚州奥克兰市市长。现任市长利比·沙夫成功连任。选举采用即时决选投票制，但沙夫在首轮投票中就获得过半选票，因此无需进行后续轮次。加利福尼亚州市政选举依法不设党派。

en.s: A general election was held in the U.S. state of Georgia on November 6, 2018. All of Georgia's executive officers were up for election, as well as all of Georgia's fourteen seats in the United States House of Representatives. Neither U.S. Senate seat was up for election in 2018. Early voting for the general election was held from October 15 to 26.

zh.s: 佐治亚州于2018年11月6日举行普选。州内所有行政职位以及在美国众议院的全部14个席位都要改选。2018年没有美国参议院席位改选。普选提前投票于10月15日至26日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Georgia attorney general election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the attorney general of Georgia. Incumbent Republican attorney general Christopher M. Carr was appointed to the office on November 1, 2016, after Sam Olens resigned to become the president of Kennesaw State University. Carr won the election to a full term over Democrat Charlie Bailey with 51.3% of the vote.

zh.s: 2018年佐治亚州总检察长选举于11月6日举行，选出州总检察长。共和党现任总检察长克里斯托弗·M·卡尔于2016年11月1日获任命接替萨姆·奥伦斯；后者辞职出任肯尼索州立大学校长。卡尔击败民主党人查理·贝利，获得51.3%的选票，当选完整任期。

en.t: 2018 New York's 25th congressional district special election
en.s: A special election for New York's 25th congressional district was held following the death of U.S. Representative Louise Slaughter. Democrat Joseph Morelle defeated Republican Jim Maxwell on November 6, 2018.

zh.t: 2018年纽约州第25国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 纽约州第25国会选区在美国众议员路易丝·斯劳特去世后举行特别选举。民主党人约瑟夫·莫雷尔于2018年11月6日击败共和党人吉姆·麦克斯韦。

en.s: The 2018 Shreveport mayoral election resulted in the election of Democrat Adrian Perkins who defeated incumbent mayor of Shreveport Ollie Tyler in the runoff. The nonpartisan blanket primary was held on November 6, 2018, and as no candidate obtained the required majority, the general election followed on December 8, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年什里夫波特市长选举中，民主党人阿德里安·珀金斯在决选中击败现任市长奥利·泰勒，当选市长。无党派综合初选于2018年11月6日举行，由于没有候选人获得规定的多数票，大选于12月8日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Jefferson County Sheriff election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the sheriff of Jefferson County, Alabama. The primary election was held on June 5, 2018. Incumbent Republican sheriff Mike Hale lost re-election to a sixth term. Democratic nominee Mark Pettway won the election.

zh.t: 2018年阿拉巴马州杰斐逊县警长选举
zh.s: 2018年杰斐逊县警长选举于11月6日举行，选出阿拉巴马州杰斐逊县警长。初选于2018年6月5日举行。共和党现任警长迈克·黑尔未能连任第六个任期。民主党提名人马克·佩特韦当选。

en.t: 2018 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 2018 United States Senate election in New York took place on November 6, 2018. Incumbent U.S. Senator Kirsten Gillibrand was re-elected to a second full term, defeating Republican Chele Chiavacci Farley with nearly 67% of the vote. Gillibrand carried a majority of the state's counties and 26 of the state's 27 congressional districts, including five that elected Republicans the same night.

zh.s: 2018年纽约州美国参议院选举于11月6日举行。现任参议员克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德成功连任完整的第二个任期，以近67%的选票击败共和党人谢尔·恰瓦奇·法利。吉利布兰德赢得该州多数县和27个国会选区中的26个，其中包括当晚选出共和党人的5个选区。

en.t: 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in New York
en.s: The 2018 United States House of Representatives elections in New York were held November 6, 2018 to elect a U.S. Representative from each of New York's 27 congressional districts. The elections coincided with the gubernatorial election, as well as an election to the United States Senate and various state and local elections. Contested primaries were held June 26, 2018.

zh.s: 2018年纽约州美国众议院选举于11月6日举行，选出该州27个国会选区的众议员。选举还与州长、美国参议院以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。有竞争的初选于2018年6月26日举行。

en.s: The 2018 Austin mayoral election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the mayor of Austin, Texas. The election was a non-partisan mayoral election. If a candidate received a majority of the votes (50%+1 or greater), the candidate was elected, otherwise a runoff would be held between the top two candidates with the most votes.

zh.s: 2018年奥斯汀市长选举于11月6日举行，选出得克萨斯州奥斯汀市市长。选举依法不设党派。候选人获得过半选票（50%加1票或更多）即可当选，否则由得票最高的两名候选人参加决选。

en.s: The 2018 St. Charles County Executive election took place on November 6, 2018. Incumbent Republican County Executive Steve Ehlmann ran for re-election to a fourth term. He won the Republican primary unopposed and faced St. Peters Prosecuting Attorney Lorna Frahm, the Democratic nominee, in the general election. Ehlmann defeated Frahm by a wide margin, winning re-election with 62 percent of the vote.

zh.t: 2018年圣查尔斯县行政长官选举
zh.s: 2018年圣查尔斯县行政长官选举于11月6日举行。共和党现任县行政长官史蒂夫·埃尔曼竞选第四个任期。他在共和党初选中无人挑战，大选对手是民主党提名人、圣彼得斯市检察官洛娜·弗拉姆。埃尔曼以62%的选票大胜弗拉姆，成功连任。

en.s: The 2018 Georgia lieutenant gubernatorial election was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the lieutenant governor of Georgia, concurrently with the 2018 gubernatorial election, as well as elections to the United States Senate and elections to the United States House of Representatives and various state and local elections. Then-incumbent Republican lieutenant governor Casey Cagle chose to not run for re-election in order to run for governor.

zh.s: 2018年佐治亚州副州长选举于11月6日举行，并与州长、美国参议院、美国众议院以及多场州和地方选举同时举行。共和党时任副州长凯西·凯格尔选择竞选州长，没有竞选连任副州长。

en.s: The 2018 New York Attorney General election took place on November 6, 2018. New York City Public Advocate Letitia James, a Democrat, was elected. James is the first woman and the first African-American to be elected New York Attorney General. Former attorney general Eric Schneiderman resigned on May 8, 2018, after allegations of domestic abuse and withdrew from his then-ongoing reelection campaign.

zh.s: 2018年纽约州总检察长选举于11月6日举行。民主党人、纽约市公共 advocate 莱蒂希娅·詹姆斯当选。她是首位当选纽约州总检察长的女性，也是首位非裔美国人。前总检察长埃里克·施奈德曼于2018年5月8日在遭到家庭暴力指控后辞职，并退出当时正在进行的连任选举。

en.s: The 2018 Texas Senate elections took place as part of the biennial United States elections. Texas voters elected state senators in 15 of the state senate's 31 districts. The winners of this election served in the 86th Texas Legislature. State senators serve four-year terms in the Texas State Senate. A statewide map of Texas's state Senate districts can be obtained from the Texas Legislative Council here, and individual district maps can be obtained from the U.S.

en.t: 2018 Orange County, California District Attorney election
en.s: The 2018 Orange, County, California District Attorney election took place on June 5, 2018, for the first round. Because no candidate received a majority in the first round, a runoff took place November 6, 2018, to elect the Orange County, California District Attorney. County-level elections in California are officially nonpartisan. Because no candidate received a majority, a runoff was held on November 6, 2018.
en.n: This entry records the runoff, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州橙县地方检察官选举
zh.s: 2018年加利福尼亚州橙县地方检察官选举于6月5日举行首轮投票。由于没有候选人获得多数票，11月6日举行决选，选出橙县地方检察官。加利福尼亚州县级选举依法不设党派。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的决选日期。

en.t: 2018 Orange County Board of Supervisors election
en.s: The 2018 Orange County Board of Supervisors elections were held on June 5, 2018, and November 6, 2018. Three of the five seats of the Orange County, California Board of Supervisors were up for election. County elections in California are officially nonpartisan. A two-round system was used for the election, starting with the first round in June, followed by a runoff in November between the top two candidates in each district.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 2018年加利福尼亚州橙县监事会选举
zh.s: 2018年橙县监事会选举于6月5日和11月6日举行。加利福尼亚州橙县监事会5个席位中有3个需要改选。加利福尼亚州县级选举依法不设党派。此次选举采用两轮制：6月举行首轮投票，11月由各选区前两名候选人参加决选。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的选举日期。

en.s: The 2019 Philadelphia City Council elections were held on November 6, 2019. They took place on the same day as the 2019 Philadelphia mayoral election, 2019 Philadelphia municipal election, and other local elections in the United States.

zh.s: 2019年费城城市议会选举于11月6日举行，与费城市长选举、费城地方选举及美国其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The Battle of Shusha (Azerbaijani: Şuşa döyüşü or Şuşa uğrunda döyüş; Armenian: Շուշիի ճակատամարտ, romanized: Shushii chakatamart) was the final and decisive battle of the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War, fought between the armed forces of Azerbaijan and the self-proclaimed Republic of Artsakh, militarily supported by Armenia, over the control of the city of Shusha. The battle is considered one of the bloodiest battles of the war.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 舒沙战役（阿塞拜疆语：Şuşa döyüşü或Şuşa uğrunda döyüş；亚美尼亚语：Շուշիի ճակատամարտ，转写：Shushii chakatamart）是第二次纳戈尔诺-卡拉巴赫战争的最后一场决定性战役。阿塞拜疆武装部队与自称阿尔察赫共和国、并得到亚美尼亚军事支持的部队为争夺舒沙市而战。这场战役被认为是该战争中最血腥的战斗之一。
zh.n: 此条记录的是来源信息框所列的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 2021 Anambra State gubernatorial election took place on 6 November 2021, to elect the Governor of Anambra State. Incumbent APGA Governor Willie Obiano was term-limited and could not seek a third consecutive term. APGA nominee, former Central Bank Governor Charles Chukwuma Soludo, retained the office for APGA with a 24% win over PDP nominee, former Transcorp CEO Valentine Ozigbo.

zh.s: 2021年阿南布拉州州长选举于11月6日举行，选出州长。现任全进步大会党州长威利·奥比亚诺已达到任期限制，不能竞选连续第三个任期。全进步大会党提名人、前中央银行行长查尔斯·索卢多以24个百分点的优势击败人民民主党提名人、前Transcorp首席执行官瓦伦丁·奥齐格博，为全进步大会党保住州长职位。

en.s: UFC 268: Usman vs. Covington 2 was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 6, 2021, at Madison Square Garden in New York City, New York, United States.

zh.s: UFC 268：乌斯曼对阵科温顿2是一场由终极格斗冠军赛主办的综合格斗赛事，于2021年11月6日在美国纽约州纽约市麦迪逊广场花园举行。

en.s: War Chamber (2021) was a professional wrestling supercard event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW), which took place on November 6, 2021, at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. It was the second event under the War Chamber chronology, and featured the finals of the 2021 Opera Cup. The event was a television taping for MLW Fusion: Alpha on MLW's YouTube channel and beIN Sports USA, with the main event streaming as a special episode that aired on November 17, 2021.

zh.s: 《战争密室》（2021）是职业摔角大型赛事，由美国职业摔角联盟主办，于2021年11月6日在宾夕法尼亚州费城的2300竞技场举行。这是“战争密室”系列的第二场赛事，并包括2021年歌剧杯决赛。该赛事为美国职业摔角联盟Fusion：Alpha节目的录制内容，在YouTube频道和beIN Sports USA播出；主赛作为特别节目，于11月17日播出。

en.s: A leadership election was held by the Pan-Malaysian Islamic Party (PAS) on 6 and 7 November 2021. It was won by incumbent President of PAS, Abdul Hadi Awang.

zh.t: 2021年泛马来西亚伊斯兰党党魁选举
zh.s: 泛马来西亚伊斯兰党于2021年11月6日至7日举行党魁选举。现任党主席阿卜杜勒·哈迪·阿旺胜出。

en.s: The 2022 NSW Open was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor hard courts. It was the second edition of the tournament which was part of the 2022 ATP Challenger Tour and the eighth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It took place in Sydney, Australia between 31 October and 6 November 2022.

zh.s: 2022年新南威尔士州公开赛是一项在室外硬地球场举行的职业网球赛事。它是2022年ATP挑战赛巡回赛的一站，也是ITF女子世界网球巡回赛的第八届赛事。比赛于2022年10月31日至11月6日在澳大利亚悉尼举行。

en.t: 2022 Trofeo de Campeones de la Liga Profesional
en.s: The 2022 Trofeo de Campeones de la Liga Profesional (officially the Trofeo de Campeones Binance 2022 for sponsorship reasons) was the third edition of the Trofeo de Campeones de la Liga Profesional, an annual football match contested by the winners of Primera División and Copa de la Liga Profesional competitions, similar to the defunct Trofeo de Campeones de la Superliga Argentina. As Boca Juniors won both championships, 2022 Primera División and 2022 Copa de la Liga Profesional, Racing and Tigre (runners-up of the aforementioned competitions) played a semi-final to define the rival of Boca Juniors. Racing defeated Tigre by a 3–2 score. The final was played on 6 November 2022 at Estadio Único in Villa Mercedes, between Boca Juniors and Racing.

zh.s: 2022年职业联赛冠军杯（因赞助原因正式称为2022年Binance冠军杯）是职业联赛冠军杯第三届赛事。这项年度足球比赛由阿根廷甲级联赛和职业联赛杯的冠军参加，形式类似已停办的阿根廷超级联赛冠军杯。由于博卡青年赢得了2022年阿根廷甲级联赛和职业联赛杯两个冠军，前述赛事的亚军竞技俱乐部和老虎队先进行半决赛，以确定博卡青年的决赛对手。竞技俱乐部以3比2击败老虎队。决赛于2022年11月6日在梅塞德斯镇的尤尼科球场举行，由博卡青年对阵竞技俱乐部。

en.s: The 2022 GB Pro-Series Shrewsbury was a professional tennis tournament played on indoor hard courts. It was the thirteenth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It took place in Shrewsbury, United Kingdom between 31 October and 6 November 2022.

zh.t: 2022年英国职业系列赛什鲁斯伯里站
zh.s: 2022年英国职业系列赛什鲁斯伯里站是一项在室内硬地球场举行的职业网球赛事，也是2022年ITF女子世界网球巡回赛的一站。本届是该赛事的第13届，于2022年10月31日至11月6日在英国什鲁斯伯里举行。

en.s: The 2022 FAI Women's Cup final (known as The EVOKE.ie FAI Women's Cup Final for sponsorship reasons) was the final match of the 2022 FAI Women's Cup, the national association football Cup of the Republic of Ireland. The match took place on 6 November 2022 at Tallaght Stadium in Dublin. Shelbourne and Athlone Town contested the match.

zh.s: 2022年爱尔兰足协女子杯决赛（因赞助原因称为EVOKE.ie爱尔兰足协女子杯决赛）是2022年爱尔兰足协女子杯的决赛。这是爱尔兰共和国的全国足球杯赛。比赛于2022年11月6日在都柏林塔拉特体育场举行，由谢尔本和阿斯隆镇交手。

en.s: The 2022 Dow Tennis Classic was a professional tennis tournament played on indoor hard courts. It was the twenty-eighth edition of the tournament which was also part of the 2022 WTA 125 tournaments. It took place at the Greater Midland Tennis Center in Midland, Michigan, United States between 31 October and 6 November 2022.

zh.s: 2022年道指网球经典赛是一项在室内硬地球场举行的职业网球赛事，也是2022年WTA125赛事的一站。本届是该赛事的第28届，于2022年10月31日至11月6日在美国密歇根州米德兰的大米德兰网球中心举行。

en.s: The 2022 Engie Open Nantes Atlantique is a professional tennis tournament played on indoor hard courts. It is the eighteenth edition of the tournament which is part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It takes place in Nantes, France between 31 October and 6 November 2022.

zh.s: 2022年南特大西洋Engie公开赛是一项在室内硬地球场举行的职业网球赛事，也是2022年ITF女子世界网球巡回赛的一站。本届是该赛事的第18届，于2022年10月31日至11月6日在法国南特举行。

en.s: The 2022 Barranquilla Open is a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor hard courts. It is the first edition of the tournament which is part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It takes place in Barranquilla, Colombia between 31 October and 6 November 2022.

zh.s: 2022年巴兰基亚公开赛是一项在室外硬地球场举行的职业网球赛事，也是2022年ITF女子世界网球巡回赛的首届赛事。比赛于2022年10月31日至11月6日在哥伦比亚巴兰基亚举行。

en.s: The 2023 Warren mayoral election took place on November 6, 2023, following a primary on August 8, 2023. Following an amendment to the city charter in 2020, incumbent mayor James R. Fouts was term-limited and ineligible to seek re-election.

zh.s: 2023年沃伦市长选举于11月6日举行，初选则在同年8月8日举行。根据2020年通过的市宪章修正案，时任市长詹姆斯·R·福茨因任期限制而不得竞选连任。

en.s: NXT 2300 was a professional wrestling television special produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT. The event was broadcast live on November 6, 2024, from the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania as a special episode of NXT on The CW in the United States.

zh.s: NXT 2300是由WWE为旗下发展联盟NXT制作的职业摔角电视特别节目。节目于2024年11月6日在宾夕法尼亚州费城的2300竞技场现场直播，并作为特别一期NXT节目在美国CW电视网播出。

en.s: The 37th Tokyo International Film Festival took place from 28 October to 6 November 2024. This edition, introduced a new 'Women's Empowerment' section and showcased the works of director Yu Irie, a Japanese film director and screenwriter in its 'Nippon Cinema Now' strand. Hong Kong actor and singer Tony Leung served as jury president.
en.n: This entry records the closing, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第37届东京国际电影节于2024年10月28日至11月6日举行。本届新增“女性赋权”单元，并在“日本电影新视野”单元展映导演兼编剧入江悠的作品。香港演员兼歌手梁朝伟担任评审团主席。
